### [1] [Merging Methods for Multilingual Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models: An Empirical Odyssey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13919)
*Kunil Lee,Ki-Young Shin,Jong-Hyeok Lee,Young-Joo Suh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This paper investigates vector merging methods for multilingual knowledge editing (MKE), evaluating six merging variants across multiple languages and models. The key findings are that vector summation with shared covariance is the most reliable method, TSVM has limited effectiveness in reducing multilingual interference, and performance depends heavily on weight scaling and rank ratio parameters.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Language-specific edits interfere with one another in multilingual knowledge editing, even when locate-then-edit methods work well in monolingual settings.

Method: Evaluated six merging variants with two LLMs, two base knowledge editing methods, and 12 languages on the MzsRE benchmark under large-scale batch-editing setting.

Result: Vector summation with shared covariance is the most reliable strategy; TSVM only improves performance in some settings but cannot effectively mitigate multilingual interference; performance is sensitive to both weight scale and rank ratio.

Conclusion: Simple summation without shared covariance performs poorly; TSVM has limited effectiveness in mitigating multilingual interference; performance is sensitive to weight scale and rank ratio, with larger-than-default scaling and relatively low rank often yielding better results.

Abstract: Multilingual knowledge editing (MKE) remains challenging because language-specific edits interfere with one another, even when locate-then-edit methods work well in monolingual settings. This paper focuses on three issues: the effectiveness of vector merging methods for MKE, the extent to which Task Singular Vectors for Merging (TSVM) can reduce multilingual interference, and the influence of the weight scaling factor and rank compression ratio on performance. We evaluate six merging variants with two popular backbone large language models, two base knowledge editing methods, and 12 languages on the MzsRE benchmark under a large-scale batch-editing setting. Our results show that vector summation with shared covariance is the most reliable overall strategy, whereas simple summation without shared covariance performs poorly. TSVM improves performance in some settings, but its ability to mitigate multilingual interference is limited. We also find that performance is sensitive to both weight scale and rank ratio, with larger-than-default scaling and relatively low rank often yielding better results. These findings clarify the practical strengths and limits of current vector merging methods for MKE and provide guidance for future multilingual knowledge editing research.

</details>


### [2] [VectraYX-Nano: A 42M-Parameter Spanish Cybersecurity Language Model with Curriculum Learning and Native Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13989)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 VectraYX-Nano：一个仅 41.95M 参数、从零预训练的西班牙语（拉美向）网络安全解码器模型，原生支持 MCP 工具调用，配套 170M token 自建语料 VectraYX-Sec-ES、三阶段带回放课程预训练、16K byte-fallback BPE 分词器、自建五任务评测集 VectraYX-Bench（B1–B5）与 81MB GGUF 权重。全流程复现成本约 29 美元，可在树莓派 4 上亚秒级首 token 推理。三条核心经验发现：(1) 困惑度与对话语域倒挂——困惑度更低的 mC4-ES 自举语料反而带来更差的对话行为；(2) 工具调用能力的 0 分地板是 SFT 语料密度伪影而非参数容量瓶颈，工具比例 1:211→1:21 即激活工具选择；(3) 超过 Chinchilla 最优继续加预训练算力会摧毁工具调用可塑性，故最终发布 v7（≈0.49× Chinchilla）而非过训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者指出公开 LLM 生态在两个维度上存在交叉空白：其一，强开源对话模型几乎全为英文训练，西语在预训练混合中占比极小；其二，网络安全专用模型几乎全部基于英文语料，且极少覆盖拉丁美洲 CSIRT 术语与区域威胁情报语境。叠加后，拉美 SOC 分析师只能被迫在“仅英文的领域模型”“无技术精度的通用西语模型”与“不可审计/不可私有化部署的闭源前沿模型”之间取舍；而 SOC 常需处理涉密事件报告、客户 PII 与未公开 IoC，出网部署不可接受。同时，网络安全知识每日更新（新增 CVE、KEV 收录、TTP 变更），参数化记忆必然过期，而“某 CVE 是否在被利用”“某哈希是否被标记”这类问题存在权威外部答案，因此小型模型若懂得“何时调用工具”，其可用性可能高于更大但会幻觉的模型。作者据此主张：在 nano 尺度上，正确语料（语域匹配）与正确训练顺序（课程+回放）比单纯堆参数或追求更低困惑度更能决定用户可感知的行为。

Method: 方法分为语料、架构、训练、工具接入与评测五层。语料：八台 VM 跨 GCP/Azure 两云并行两天采集（约 25 美元），汇聚 NVD REST API（87,998 条 CVE）、过滤后的西语 Wikipedia（53,590 篇、约 82M token，占语料 48%）、OpenSubtitles-ES 与 OASST1-ES 对话语料、自建 NVD 镜像“Pikachu”的 50,601 条西语 CVE 与 27,121 条 exploit、98K IOC、ExploitDB（2,385 条经 Ollama qwen2.5:1.5b 本地翻译）、HackTricks-ES/OWASP-ES/PayloadsAllTheThings 等工具文档与西语安全博客；去重采用小写化+空白折叠后的精确哈希；按对话/技术/工具三阶段切分为 42.4M/117.7M/10.1M token，uint16 memory-map 分片存储（≈340MB）。分词器：SentencePiece BPE，词表 16,384，byte_fallback、nmt_nfkc、split_digits、split_by_unicode_script，训练混合 50/50 对话/技术，保留 27 个用户定义符号（控制、对话角色、工具调用、领域、严重度）；选择 16K 而非 32K/50K 是因权重绑定下嵌入层占 8.4M 参数（约 20%），且 GGUF Q4 量化友好。架构：8 层、d_model=512、8 查询头/2 KV 头（GQA，比率 4:1）、d_ffn=2048、最大上下文 1024、RoPE base 10⁴、RMSNorm(ε=1e-6)、SwiGLU、QK-Norm、权重绑定、无 bias、z-loss 系数 1e-4、残差初始化按 σ/√(2L) 缩放，总参数 41.95M。训练：三阶段课程（阶段一 100% 对话 2 epoch → 阶段二 75% 技术 + 25% 对话回放 → 阶段三 70% 工具 + 20% 技术 + 10% 对话回放），由 MixedCurriculumDataset 以阶段权重做分类采样、回放比例作为单一超参；AdamW、余弦 LR + 线性 warmup、BF16（NVIDIA L4）、梯度裁剪 1.0、131,072 token/step、吞吐约 40.8k tok/s；SFT 采用 assistant-only 掩码的三 epoch 内部小课程（100% 对话 → 70/30 → 55/30/15）。工具接入：6,327 条工具轨迹 SFT 数据，模板化于真实 CVE/IOC 库，绑定六个 MCP 服务器（NVD、KEV、MITRE ATT&CK、OTX、LATAM 情报、bash 执行），模型只负责生成 `<|tool_call|>` JSON 封装，由 MCP 运行时执行。评测：自建 VectraYX-Bench（B1 CVE 问答 500、B2 威胁分类 200、B3 命令补全 100、B4 工具选择 200、B5 对话门控 314，共 1314 条），并做 v2/v4/v6 自举语料消融（各 N=4 种子 {42,7,13,23}）、回放比例扫描 {0,5,10,25,50}%、LoRA（rank 16）密度实验、post-Chinchilla 算力消融 v8–v15，以及与 SmolLM2-135M、Qwen2.5 3B/7B、GPT-4o 的同基准对照；另做 499 条对抗提示的自动化红队评估。

Result: 核心结果：(1) 课程+回放使预训练损失单调下降 9.80→3.17→3.00→2.16，阶段交界无尖峰，相对单阶段 v1（3.35）降约 36%；SFT 终损失 1.74–1.82。(2) 语域倒挂获 N=4 确证：mC4-ES 自举在 P2/P3/SFT 全面更低损失（P2 −0.29、P3 −0.28、SFT −0.17），但对话门控 B5 更差，v2(OpenSubs) 0.775±0.043 > v4(mC4) 0.700±0.122 > v6(混合) 0.675±0.083，v2 与 v6 差距约 2.3σ，配对 bootstrap 检验 p<0.05；典型输出显示 v4 用百科散文语域回答“hola”。(3) 工具密度结论：混合 SFT（比例 1:211）下 B4 在全部 12 次运行均为 0.000，且换成枚举全部工具的 SYSTEM_TOOL 重测仍为 0；LoRA(r=16) 配合 2,801 条工具语料（1:21）后 Nano 42M 得 0.145±0.046、Base 260M 得 0.445±0.201，Pro 3B 在约 1:10 密度下得 0.600、Pro 7B 得 0.880——证明这是首 token 先验冲突（`<|tool_call|>` 概率 <0.001）而非容量上限。(4) 发布的 v7（平衡 SFT，1:21）达 B4=0.230±0.052，同时保持 B1=0.332±0.005、B5=0.725±0.130（N=4）；相比 SmolLM2-135M+LoRA（B1 0.334）在 1/3 参数下持平。(5) 算力消融 v8–v15：预训练从 ≈850M 推至 ≈1.0–1.7B token 时 B4 立即塌陷为 0.000，仅 6 epoch 长 SFT 的 v14 恢复到 0.160；B1 仅微增 0.332→0.341、B5 保持，故 v7 保留为发布版本。(6) GPT-4o 对照：B1 0.333、B2 0.110、B3-TM 0.520、B4 0.615、B5 0.631；Nano v2/v7 在 B5 上超过 GPT-4o（v2 差距 >3σ），B4 则落后约 2.7 倍。(7) 效率：GGUF F16 81MB / Q4 ≈20MB，树莓派 4 上 6–10 tok/s、TTFT<1s、驻留内存 60–80MB；v2 训练本身仅约 4 小时 L4、约 4 美元，全流程 ≈29 美元。(8) 安全：无 RLHF 对齐的红队评估中，基础版与 LoRA 版危险 bash_exec 工具调用均为 0，合规响应率 21.0%/17.0%，显式拒绝仅 0.6%，多语言绕过 0% 合规——安全边界落在 MCP 运行时而非权重。已披露的缺陷包括 B2 评测读取 “prompt” 而分片用 “text” 的 harness bug（导致 B2≈0.20 为伪影）、LATAM 专项基准同样因该 bug 全为 0.0、>2000 字符技术文本约 5–10% 翻译噪声、B5 为单人评分未报告标注一致性、缺失正式人类评估与安全对齐。

Conclusion: 论文的贡献不只是发布一个 42M 的西语安全模型（声称是首个西语原生网络安全 LLM 且端到端 MCP 集成、首个 nano 级 LATAM 语料对话模型、首个亚百亿以下模型工具语料密度阈值的公开表征），更在于三条可迁移的方法论结论。其一，在小尺度上困惑度不是对话行为的正确早停信号，自举语料的语域匹配至少与语料覆盖同等重要，甚至可能压倒后者——因此应把自举语料选择当作语域匹配问题优先处理。其二，工具使用在小模型中是语料密度门控而非参数容量门控：约 1:20 的工具样本比例已足以在 42M 上激活可靠工具分派，任何在混合 SFT 上训练的小模型只要工具密度低于先验转移阈值都会出现工具地板。其三，post-Chinchilla 区间“训得更久”的通用建议对输出格式敏感任务会反转——42M 下翻倍预训练 token 可保住对话与 CVE 召回却摧毁工具调用可塑性，故发布版刻意停在 0.49× Chinchilla。此外，回放 10–25% 足以抑制对话行为灾难性遗忘，且把工具知识外置到 MCP（以“程序性记忆”换“参数化记忆”）是小参数预算下更划算的专精路径。需要提醒的是，论文自身证据强度不均：核心倒挂与密度结论有 N=4 与逐种子配对支撑，而 B2 与 LATAM 基准因 harness 键名 bug 全部失效、B5 为单人主观评分、post-Chinchilla 消融仅单种子、翻译质量与安全结论均未做人工校验，因此 B2 相关数值应视为不可用数据，安全结论应视为初步而非结论性结论。整体而言，这是一份工程成本极低、诊断链条清晰、对小模型训练实践具有直接指导价值的工作，但定量结论仍需在修复评测 harness、补充多人一致性评估与多 seed 过训练消融后方可视为稳固。

Abstract: We present VectraYX-Nano, a 41.95M-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch in Spanish for cybersecurity, with a Latin-American focus and native tool invocation via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Four contributions: (i) Corpus: VectraYX-Sec-ES, a 170M-token Spanish corpus from an eight-VM pipeline (~$25 USD) partitioned into conversational (42M tokens, OpenSubtitles-ES, OASST1), cybersecurity (118M tokens, NVD, Wikipedia-ES, CVE mirror, security blogs), and offensive-security tooling (10M tokens, ExploitDB, HackTricks, OWASP) phases. (ii) Architecture: 42M-parameter Transformer decoder with GQA, QK-Norm, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE, z-loss, and a 16,384-token byte-fallback BPE. (iii) Curriculum with replay: continual pre-training with a replay buffer yields monotonic loss descent (9.80->3.17->3.00->2.16); after SFT on OASST-ES, Alpaca-ES, CVE Q&A, and 6,327 tool-use traces, the model attains a conversational gate of 0.78+-0.05 (N=4 seeds). (iv) Two findings: a bootstrap-corpus ablation reveals a loss-vs-register inversion at nano scale; a LoRA study shows the B4 tool-selection floor of 0.000 is a corpus-density artifact, not a capacity gate -- a tool-dense corpus (2,801 examples) raises B4 to 0.145+-0.046 on Nano 42M and 0.445+-0.201 on a 260M mid-tier. The GGUF artifact is 81 MB (F16), runs at sub-second TTFT on commodity hardware under llama.cpp, and is to our knowledge the first Spanish-native cybersecurity LLM with end-to-end MCP integration. Corpus recipe, training scripts, GGUF weights, and B1-B5 benchmark are released.

</details>


### [3] [Mistletoe: Stealthy Acceleration-Collapse Attacks on Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14005)
*Shuoyang Sun,Chang Da,Hao Fang,Kuofeng Gao,Xinhao Zhong,Yi Sun,Fan Mo,Shu-Tao Xia,Bin Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Mistletoe攻击，通过针对投机解码的验证接受机制，在保持输出语义的同时大幅降低草稿令牌接受率，从而瓦解投机解码的加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码的效率高度依赖平均接受长度τ（即每次验证中存活的草稿令牌数量），而drafter模型训练时对target模型分布的近似不可避免地存在误差，这种drafter-target不匹配创造了一个隐藏的攻击面。

Method: 通过联合优化两个目标函数——降质目标（减少drafter与target模型的一致性）和语义保持目标（约束target模型输出分布），并引入零空间投影机制，将降质梯度投影到局部语义保持方向的零空间中，从而在最小化语义漂移的同时抑制草稿令牌接受率。

Result: Mistletoe能够显著降低平均接受长度τ，导致加速效果完全失效/token吞吐量下降，同时保持输出质量和困惑度不变。

Conclusion: Mistletoe攻击揭示了投机解码机制在安全层面的脆弱性，强调需要设计更健壮的LLM加速系统，以应对机制层面的新型攻击威胁。

Abstract: Speculative decoding has become a widely adopted technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by drafting multiple candidate tokens and verifying them with a target model in parallel. Its efficiency, however, critically depends on the average accepted length $τ$, i.e., how many draft tokens survive each verification step. In this work, we identify a new mechanism-level vulnerability in model-based speculative decoding: the drafter is trained to approximate the target model distribution, but this approximation is inevitably imperfect. Such a drafter-target mismatch creates a hidden attack surface where small perturbations can preserve the target model's visible behavior while substantially reducing draft-token acceptability. We propose Mistletoe, a stealthy acceleration-collapse attack against speculative decoding. Mistletoe directly targets the acceptance mechanism of speculative decoding. It jointly optimizes a degradation objective that decreases drafter-target agreement and a semantic-preservation objective that constrains the target model's output distribution. To resolve the conflict between these objectives, we introduce a null-space projection mechanism, where degradation gradients are projected away from the local semantic-preserving direction, suppressing draft acceptance while minimizing semantic drift. Experiments on various speculative decoding systems show that Mistletoe substantially reduces average accepted length $τ$, collapses speedup, and lowers averaged token throughput, while preserving output quality and perplexity. Our work highlights that speculative decoding introduces a mechanism-level attack surface beyond existing output robustness, calling for more robust designs of LLM acceleration systems.

</details>


### [4] [Physics-R1: An Audited Olympiad Corpus and Recipe for Visual Physics Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14040)
*Shan Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This paper audits multimodal physics evaluation pipelines and uncovers three hidden issues: train-eval contamination, translation drift, and MCQ saturation that distort benchmarking. The authors release four new artifacts (PhysCorp-A, PhysR1Corp, PhysOlym-A, Physics-R1) and demonstrate their approach achieves +18.3pp improvement on PhysOlym-A over the 8B base model.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Undetected construction practices distort how the field measures vision-language reasoning in multimodal physics evaluation pipelines, potentially compromising the validity of research findings.

Method: Three-stage audit combining Jaccard similarity, embedding cosine similarity, and LLM-judge; paired problem translation; format gradient comparison; cold-start GSPO+DAPO recipe for model training.

Result: Identified train-eval contamination (134 near-duplicates, 4,846 paraphrase candidates in SciInstruct), translation drift (17pp Sonnet 4.5 delta), and MCQ saturation (46pp format gradient). Released PhysCorp-A, PhysR1Corp, PhysOlym-A, and Physics-R1.

Conclusion: Proposed methodology and artifacts address identified issues, with Physics-R1 achieving significant improvements across multiple benchmarks.

Abstract: We audit the multimodal-physics evaluation pipeline end-to-end and document three undetected construction practices that distort how the field measures vision-language reasoning: train-eval contamination, translation drift, and MCQ saturation. (1) Public training pools (UGPhysics-Train, SciInstruct, MMK12) pass single-stage 5-gram-Jaccard audits with zero hits across all six public physics evals; a three-stage audit (Jaccard -> mxbai-embed-large cosine -> Haiku-4.5 LLM-judge) surfaces 134 near-duplicates and 4,846 paraphrase candidates in SciInstruct alone. (2) A 17-pp Sonnet 4.5 delta on 59 paired Estonian-English olympiad problems (30.5% vs. 13.6%; sign test p=0.011, McNemar p=0.021, paired bootstrap 95% CI [+5.1, +28.9] pp). (3) A 46-pp format-and-novelty gradient on identical Sonnet weights between MCQ (79.7% on PhyX) and open-ended olympiad evaluation (33.4% on PhysOlym-A). We release four artifacts addressing these gaps: PhysCorp-A (6,432-record three-stage-audited multimodal corpus), PhysR1Corp (2,268-record closed-form RL pool), PhysOlym-A (500-problem, 99.8% novel-source held-out olympiad eval with native difficulty labels and an EN/ET bilingual subset), and Physics-R1, a reference GSPO+DAPO recipe cold-started from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking. Across 3 seeds, Physics-R1 lifts the audited corpus over the 8B base by +18.3 pp on PhysOlym-A liberal (8.0 -> 26.3 +/- 1.7; 7.1 pp behind Sonnet 4.5), +15.7 pp on PhysReason (23.9 -> 39.6 +/- 6.4; ahead of Qwen3-VL-32B and Gemini 2.5 Pro), +6.9 pp on OlympiadBench-Physics (46.2 +/- 1.5), and +4.1 pp on PhyX MCQ (77.8 +/- 0.3).

</details>


### [5] [Derivation Prompting: A Logic-Based Method for Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14053)
*Ignacio Sastre,Guillermo Moncecchi,Aiala Rosá*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出「推导式提示」（Derivation Prompting）——一种受逻辑推导树启发的 RAG 生成阶段提示技术：将检索到的文档片段视为假设，用一组预定义的自然语言规则（Extract、Concat、Instantiate、Compose、Refine、NoInfo）逐步推导出结论作为答案，从而构建可解释的推导树，显著降低幻觉与错误推理。在乌拉圭共和国大学工程学院行政信息问答案例中，Claude Opus 下不可接受答案占比从 RAG 的 22.2% 降至 10.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 用于问答时在知识密集、领域特定任务上存在幻觉与错误推理问题。已有的 RAG、CoT、ToT、LoT、SymbCoT 等方法虽然改进了检索或推理链，但对中间推理步骤的构造缺乏显式约束（"how to reason" 未被定义），导致生成过程不可控、难以定位错误。论文希望为 RAG 的生成阶段引入一种显式规则化、可解释的推理机制，使答案严格建立在文档信息之上。

Method: 核心思想借鉴命题逻辑中的推导树：由假设集合 Γ 通过一组明确的推理规则逐步得到结论 c（h₁,…,hₙ ⊢ c），每个节点是一次规则应用，根节点为最终结论。不同于经典逻辑推导（结论已知、需构造证明），此处结论未知，需由查询 q 引导推导。定义六条自然语言规则：Extract（从假设中抽取部分作为结论）、Concat（合并两个独立假设）、Instantiate（将一般性假设实例化为具体情形）、Compose（合并含公共元素的两假设）、Refine（对假设做不改变语义的微调以贴合问题）、NoInfo（无相关信息时使用）。算法为迭代循环：LLM 逐步决定应用哪条规则、选择哪些假设、生成结论，并判断结论是否为最终答案；非最终答案则加入假设列表供后续使用。实现上比较两种方案：(1) One-step prompt——每步一次独立 LLM 调用；(2) Whole derivation prompt——用 6 个人工编写的完整少样本示例，让模型一次推理构造整棵推导树。后者结果相当但把 n 次推理压缩为 1 次，速度快、算力成本低，故实验主要采用后者。案例研究：UDELAR 工程学院行政信息西班牙语问答平台，爬取 17 个网页并用 LangChain Html2TextTransformer 转为 Markdown，构建来自真实邮件的 135 条查询数据集（用 Llama 2 7B 清洗隐私信息）；检索用 intfloat/multilingual-e5-large 句向量与 BAAI/bge-reranker-large 交叉编码器（后者更优），生成用 Claude 3 Haiku/Opus，k=3 个片段作上下文，Derivation Prompting 取 3 条初始假设。评测采用 LLM-as-judge（Claude Opus），评分提示沿用 Feedback Collection 数据集格式，含评估指令、被评回答、参考答案、1–5 分自定义量规；1–2 分判为"不可接受"，3–5 分为"可接受"，并统计均值与标准差。

Result: Derivation Prompting + Claude Opus 的可接受答案比例达 89.6%，显著高于 RAG（77.8%）与长上下文窗口（76.3%）；不可接受答案由 RAG 的 22.2% 降至 10.4%。Derivation Prompting + Claude Haiku 为 82.2%，同样优于 RAG-Haiku（72.6%）与长上下文-Haiku（65.2%）。平均分方面 Opus 下分别为 3.07（RAG 2.91，长上下文 2.90），标准差 0.79（RAG 0.92，长上下文 0.97），即质量更高且更稳定。分析显示改进主要来自精度（避免错误答案）而非召回（尽可能多回答）：许多其他方法中得 1–2 分的答案在推导式提示下变为 3 分（NoInfo 规则比单纯提示"无信息则不答"更有效）；同时也发现并非 4–5 分答案数必然增加，Haiku 上 4–5 分数量反而下降，说明模型规模与能力对有效构造推导至关重要。仍存在部分 1–2 分案例，文中给出实例展示 Refine 规则中模型幻觉出假设里不存在的事实（把"高中生物专业五年级"当作满足大学预科要求）；但推导树可解释性使定位这类错误成为可能，用户可沿推理链检查失效步骤而无需逐条核对原文。

Conclusion: Derivation Prompting 是一种受逻辑推导启发的 RAG 生成阶段提示技术，通过预定义自然语言规则逐级构造可解释的推导树，在不改动检索环节的前提下显著减少不可接受（错误/幻觉）答案，并提升结果的稳定性与可审计性。其效果依赖底层 LLM 的规模与能力（Opus 明显优于 Haiku）。未来工作包括：尝试不同规则集合、调整初始假设数量、形式化规则背后的形式语言以引入更强的正确性验证，并将方法推广到非 RAG 场景与其他用例；论文提及人工评估仍在进行中，实验为单一小型案例（135 条查询、西语、单机构语料），泛化性有待进一步验证。

Abstract: The application of Large Language Models to Question Answering has shown great promise, but important challenges such as hallucinations and erroneous reasoning arise when using these models, particularly in knowledge-intensive, domain-specific tasks. To address these issues, we introduce Derivation Prompting, a novel prompting technique for the generation step of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework. Inspired by logic derivations, this method involves deriving conclusions from initial hypotheses through the systematic application of predefined rules. It constructs a derivation tree that is interpretable and adds control over the generation process. We applied this method in a specific case study, significantly reducing unacceptable answers compared to traditional RAG and long-context window methods.

Abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is widely used for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) for various tasks. Recently, there has been an increasing demand for fine-tuning a single LLM for multiple tasks because it requires overall less data for fine-tuning thanks to the common features shared among tasks. More importantly, LLMs are resource demanding and deploying a single model for multiple tasks facilitates resource consolidation and consumes significantly less resources compared to deploying individual large model for each task. Existing PEFT methods like LoRA and Prefix Tuning are designed to adapt LLMs to a specific task. LoRA and its variation focus on aligning the model itself for tasks, overlooking the importance of prompt tuning in multi-task learning while Prefix Tuning only adopts a simple architecture to optimize prompts, which limits the adaption capabilities for multi-task. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）已在生产环境大规模部署，而近期事故（Moltbook 被攻破、ClawHub 恶意技能、提示注入经 up-vote 级联传播）表明智能体间的欺骗已成为现实威胁：单个说谎的"冒名者"就能抹平集体相对单体的全部推理增益（Wolf et al. 2025），且能规避既有防御（Liu et al. 2025）。现有对抗研究存在三处空白：(1) 缺少在"每次决策有客观代价"的任务上量化集体自我审查代价（性能、token、误指控）的研究；(2) 缺少对"会主动演化以规避检测器"的自适应冒名者的评测——第一类防御（同伴互相质询）只针对不适应的攻击者，第二类（外部检测器）则在攻击变化时需要完整重训；(3) 缺少能从少量标注样本快速重校准的检测器。此外，集体"被告知可能存在冒名者"的负面副作用此前无人研究。作者因此需要：(a) 一个可客观量化损害与防御收益的实验基座，(b) 一个能演化出隐蔽自适应攻击的基准，(c) 一个能对未见攻击快速在线适应的检测器。国际象棋满足需求：合法局面的指数增长迫使模型实时推理而非记忆棋谱；每步决策的损失可用 Stockfish 引擎以厘兵（CP）精确量化；子任务可分解性使多智能体审议能带来真实增益而非噪声。

Method: 环境与协议：集体为 4 个 Gemini 3.1 Pro 智能体，对抗 Stockfish 16（Elo 2200），随机开局，每配置 20 局、同种子配对开局。每回合由引擎给出 best/decent/mediocre/worst 四个分层候选着法及 CP 分；智能体分三阶段审议——P1 各自分析一个候选并给出 5 分制评分与理由，P2 读全部 P1 后推荐，P3 主/次投票（次票破平）。指标：局终中位 CP（主）、最佳着法率与平均 CPL（次）。基线 Base = 单智能体独走（中位 CP = 0）。14 个条件构成配对消融网格：Col、Awa（预警可能存在冒名者）、Dum（用"弱但诚实"智能体替换以区分欺骗与无能）、Imp₁/Imp₂（早期/高度演化策略）、Awa+Imp、Col/Awa+Imp₂+Ovs₁（把检测概率告知同伴投票）、Imp₂+Ovs₂（检测器静默驱逐被标记者，整局不再参与）。攻击构造：冒名者四步——隐藏的真实诚实分析 → 公开 P1 时翻转评分并编造理由 → 选一个"弱但非最差"的目标着法 → 公开 P2 辩护并在 P3 投票；其提示词由 10 维离散"基因"（人格、修辞支点、削弱领先着法的方式等）确定性映射而成，用遗传算法 + Optuna 联合优化"造成 CP 损害"与"规避既有检测器"两个目标，累积得到 240 条策略。防御：外部 overseer 为 SmolLM3-3B（各线性层加 LoRA）+ 末 token 隐状态上的两层分类头，输入为 XML 标注的 4 条 P1 分析 + 被评智能体的 P2 消息，问句"X 是冒名者吗？"。训练采用 ANIL（MAML 变体）：一个 task = 一条冒名者策略；每步采样 4 个 task，内循环仅用该策略 10 冒名 + 10 诚实的支持集对分类头做一次梯度步，外循环在同一策略的查询集上评估并更新 LoRA 参数与分类头；因内循环不触碰骨干，支持特征可无梯度预计算，外循环无需对 3B 骨干的二阶项，故元学习在此规模可行。部署时只做内循环一步（秒级）。基线检测器 6 个族：长度逻辑回归、TF-IDF bigram 逻辑回归、BGE-small-v1.5 冻结句嵌入（仅 P2 与 P1+P2）逻辑回归、LoRA SFT 的 LFM 1.2B 与 SmolLM3 3B。评测含离线（弱优化 22,104 实例训练 → 强优化 5,700 实例测试，指标为冒名者类 F1）与在线（20 标注样本单步重校准后 ΔF1，62 策略 × 5 种子）两种模式。

Conclusion: 三点结论：(1) 冒名者检测不应下放给审议中的智能体——集体被告知存在威胁后在无攻击时性能崩溃、推理预算被信任问题挤占、并把被抓原因直接告诉攻击者；仅把"判断"外移也不够，因为智能体会各自解读 overseer 分数（同一消息引发从安心到从众再到自我攻击的五种读法）；只有当外部检测器同时"判断"并"行动"（静默驱逐被标记者）时才能完全恢复无冒名者水平，且无偏执、无额外 token、无反馈泄露。(2) 提出可行的检测器：3B 模型的分类头元学习（ANIL）用 20 个标注样本、一次梯度步即可适配未见攻击，适应增益 8 倍、成本低 14×；据作者所知这是首次将 ANIL 用于该规模的 decoder-only LM，也是首次用梯度式元学习做 MAS 冒名者检测。(3) 发布 Gambit 基准（37,352 条标注审议、240 条演化冒名者策略、约 1,100 美元 API 成本）与完整流水线，审议协议、冒名者演化与检测器均不依赖棋类或特定模型，可迁移到任何具备客观单步代价的集体任务。局限：仅测了 Gemini 3.1 Pro 一个模型（出于学术成本考虑）、单任务、14 条件各 20 局，作者不宣称 CP 差异可跨模型复现，但预期"多数从众、把'可能有冒名者'当作存在证据、单个欺骗者抹平集体增益"等定性失效模式会在其他同构指令微调集体中复现；已发布流水线将智能体模型作为可配置项以便扩展。伦理上遵循 HarmBench/JailbreakBench 惯例同时公开攻击与防御，且实验处于无有害载荷的棋类沙箱，迁移攻击需重新生成提示并重跑演化搜索。

Abstract: In multi-agent systems (MAS), a single deceptive agent can nullify all gains of an agentic AI collective and evade deployed defenses. However, existing adversarial studies on MAS target only shallow tasks and do not consider adaptive adversaries, which evolve their strategies to evade the very detectors trained to catch them. To address that gap, we introduce GAMBIT, a benchmark with three evaluation modes and two independent scores for evaluating imposter detectors: the first two modes measure zero-shot detection under increasing distribution shift, and a third recalibration mode measures how quickly a detector adapts to novel attacks from just 20 labeled examples. The benchmark comes with a dataset of 27,804 labeled instances spanning 240 co-evolved imposter strategies. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Using chess as a substrate deep reasoning problem and Gemini 3.1 Pro for agents, we release GAMBIT and its dataset to evaluate imposter detectors under realistic constraints against a stealthy adaptive imposter; (2) We introduce an adaptive imposter agent based on an efficient evolutionary framework, generalizable beyond chess, that collapses collective task performance while remaining essentially undetectable (50.5% F1-score with a Gemini-based detector); (3) We show that zero-shot evaluation can be highly misleading for adaptive adversaries: two detectors with near-identical zero-shot scores differ by 8x on few-shot adaptation, while the meta-learned variant converges 20x faster, a gap only visible in the recalibration mode. Altogether, GAMBIT provides the first multi-agent benchmark where adversarial attacks and defenses co-evolve, with an imposter framework generalizable beyond our use case, and promising techniques for fast recalibration in a rapidly evolving adversarial system. Abstract: Most existing dialogue systems are user-driven, primarily designed to fulfill user requests. However, in many critical real-world scenarios, a conversational agent must proactively extract information to achieve its own objectives rather than merely respond. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Inquisitive Conversational Agents (ICAs)} and develop an ICA specifically tailored to U.S. Supreme Court oral arguments. We propose a Dual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning framework featuring two cooperating RL agents, each with its own policy, to coordinate strategic dialogue management and fine-grained utterance generation. By learning when and how to ask probing questions, the agent emulates judicial questioning patterns and systematically uncovers crucial information to fulfill its legal objectives. Evaluations on a U.S. Supreme Court dataset show that our method outperforms various baselines across multiple metrics. It represents an important first step toward broader high-stakes, domain-specific applications.

### [9] [Distribution Corrected Offline Data Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14071)
*Yumeng Zhang,Zhengbang Yang,Yevin Nikhel Goonatilake,Zhuangdi Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DisCorD：一个完全离线的推理蒸馏框架，通过按“学生-教师支撑集比值”对教师 token 监督做 token 级 sigmoid 重加权（r_t = σ(τ·log π̄_θ(y_t|·)/π̄_T(y_t|·))），纠正离线蒸馏中训练-推理分布漂移问题。数学推理实验表明其优于 SFT/KL/对称KL/ToDi 等离线基线，逼近在线 GKD 但仅需约 1/16 计算量（3.12 vs 49.56 GPU 小时），同时推理轨迹更短、更稳定、无重复与多答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 把强教师模型的推理链（reasoning traces）蒸馏给小模型是资源受限场景下提升智能水平的有效途径，但现有方法存在根本权衡：离线蒸馏（行为克隆/SFT、KL 类目标）监督质量高、样本效率高，却存在教师-学生分布漂移——训练时学生在教师生成的前缀（teacher prefix）上条件化，推理时却在自生成前缀上自回归，长推理链中误差累积；而 on-policy/自蒸馏（如 GRPO、GKD）虽然匹配推理分布，却需要昂贵的在线采样，且训练早期学生生成的轨迹质量低下。此外已有离线蒸馏方法（ToDi 等）通过改造散度度量（反向 KL、token 级散度控制）来缓解漂移，但优化仍聚焦于教师提供的分布，并未直接解决分布错配问题。

Method: DisCorD（Distribution-Corrected Distillation）完全基于离线数据：(1) 设计结构化 CoT 指令（understanding→strategy→solution→verification→final answer 五段式）作为条件上下文 c 引导教师生成高质量推理轨迹，并仅保留最终答案正确的轨迹构成离线语料；(2) 核心是 student-support-aware 的分布校正：以密度比 π̄_θ(y|x)/π̄_T(y|x;c) 对训练轨迹重加权。为解决密度比无界、方差大及序列级长度偏置问题，采用两步稳定化——先对对数密度比施加 sigmoid 变换 r=σ(τ·log ratio)（默认 τ=1，有界且保序），再将其 token 化为逐 token 梯度权重 r_t=σ(τ·log[π̄_θ(y_t|x;y_<t)/π̄_T(y_t|x;c;y_<t)])，最终梯度为 ∑_t r_t·∇_θ log π_θ(y_t|·)；该权重亦可乘到 KL 散度项上，形成 KL+DisCorD 目标（附录 G），故可与 SFT、KL、对称 KL 等多种离线目标组合。τ 在每个教师-学生-数据集设置内单独调参（1/2/4/8）。

Result: 数学推理基准上，DisCorD 一致优于离线基线：Qwen2.5-7B→3B 的 MATH500，SFT 58.0→62.6、对称KL 59.2→61.8；OOD 上 AMC23 32.5→40.0、Omni-Math 26.5→29.5、OlympiadBench 31.0→31.7；14B→3B（MATH500 59.6→61.8，GSM8K 81.27→82.79）、14B→1.5B 提升更大（41.0→45.4；对称KL 44.2→50.2）；跨家族 Qwen→Llama-3.2-3B 上 SFT 49.4→52.4。GSM8K 因轨迹较短、漂移影响小，区分度不足（SFT 略降 0.45）。与在线 GKD 相比差距缩小：DisCorD 零在线 rollout token、3.12 GPU 小时，而 GKD 需约 2.86M rollout token、49.56 GPU 小时（约 15.9×开销）。分布度量 ExAccErr 显示随前缀长度增长（32→256），SFT 由 31.53 恶化至 70.77，而 DisCorD 保持平稳（32.12→41.02）。推理质量上，MATH 上平均长度 4383→1358 字符、4-gram 重复率 0.6514→0.2698、答案后继续生成率 0.79→0.15、多答案率 0.75→0；AI 评审（GPT-5.4-mini）显示“答案对但推理无效”比例由 20% 降至 7%（OlympiadBench 26%→11%）。消融显示 sigmoid 变换最优（62.6），优于 raw ratio（61.2）、clip-exp（62.0）、ReLU（57.8），也优于 ToDi 的 token 级 KL 插值（59.2）。

Conclusion: DisCorD 表明：在保持离线数据效率与教师监督质量的同时，加入轻量的分布校正感知（分布错配感知）重加权即可显著增强离线推理蒸馏，尤其在需要长推理链的任务上；它不改变散度度量本身，而是重新分配教师监督的权重，使学习集中在学生推理时可达的支撑区域，从而带来更稳定、更干净、更自洽的推理轨迹。作者认为该方法可推广到代码生成、科学推理与工具使用代理等长程生成场景；未来工作包括与 off-policy/在线训练结合，以及在教师不可得时用代理模型（如更弱的参考模型或任意策略）近似支撑比权重，以在教师数据质量与对训练-推理漂移的鲁棒性之间取得更灵活的权衡。

Abstract: Distilling reasoning traces from strong large language models into smaller ones is a promising route to improve intelligence in resource-constrained settings. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: offline distillation from teacher-generated traces provides high-quality, sample-efficient supervision but suffers from distributional drift: during training, the student model conditions on teacher-generated prefixes, whereas during inference the student autoregresses on self-generated prefixes, leading to compounding errors over long reasoning trajectories. Meanwhile, on-policy or self-distillation methods better match the student's inference-time distribution, but require costly online sampling and often produce low-quality traces in early training. We propose a principled offline reasoning distillation framework that preserves the efficiency and supervision quality of offline teacher-generated data while correcting teacher-student distribution drift. It adaptively emphasizes teacher supervision that is better aligned with the student's on-policy distribution. Evaluations on mathematical reasoning benchmarks of GSM8K, MATH, MATH500, and harder held-out competition-style tasks, including AMC, AIME, and OlympiadBench, show that our method improves reasoning accuracy over prior offline distillation algorithms and yields more stable reasoning traces while preserving instruction-following capabilities. Our work shows that lightweight, distribution-correction-aware training can substantially strengthen offline reasoning distillation without online rollouts.

</details>


### [10] [Measuring and Mitigating Toxicity in Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Replication Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14087)
*Mokshit Surana,Archit Rathod,Akshaj Satishkumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对推理时毒性缓解方法 DExperts 做了三阶段复现与压力测试：未缓解的 GPT-2 Small 在 RealToxicityPrompts 上有 4.2% 的生成落入 toxicity≥0.5 的"危险区"；DExperts 将显式毒性失败率降至 0（安全率 100%），但在 ToxiGen 隐式/对抗性仇恨言论上退化至 98.5%（1.5% 泄漏），并带来约 10× 推理延迟（0.2s→2.0s），对抗样本进一步升至约 3.2s，形成"双重惩罚"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型从网络规模语料中吸收偏见与毒性模式，产生"毒性退化"（toxic degeneration），即在无害提示下也输出有害内容，威胁聊天机器人、自动写作等真实部署场景。现有缓解手段各有缺陷：关键词/黑名单过滤上下文盲、易被词形变体绕过且过度审查损害效用；重训练或 RLHF/Constitutional AI 计算成本高（数百万 GPU 小时）且仍无法保证对抗安全；多数安全评估只关注显式毒性（辱骂、威胁、脏话），而真实世界的隐式毒性（刻板印象、编码语言、微攻击、"礼貌化"偏见陈述）可轻易绕过检测。因此需要在统一框架下测量显式到隐式毒性之间的"鲁棒性差距"，并量化缓解方法的计算开销这一常被忽视但对部署关键的代价。

Method: 三阶段序列实验（对应三个研究问题）。Phase 1 基线：GPT-2 Small (117M)，RealToxicityPrompts（99,442 条 OpenWebText 片段）中按索引区间分片并行处理，top-p=0.9、T=1.0、每提示生成 1 条 20-token 续写，用 Perspective API（Toxicity/Severe Toxicity/Identity Attack）打分，以 toxicity≥0.5 定义"危险区"。Phase 2 缓解：复现 DExperts，即在每步解码按 P(x_t)∝P_base·(P_expert/P_anti)^α 融合基础模型与官方提供的 Jigsaw 微调专家/反专家模型（finetuned_gpt2_nontoxic / finetuned_gpt2_toxic），α=1.5（由 2.0 下调以缓解重复）、repetition penalty 1.2，生成参数与 Phase 1 一致，比较安全率与墙钟延迟。Phase 3 对抗鲁棒性：ToxiGen 隐式仇恨语料（274k 条机器生成、覆盖 13 个少数群体、避免显式脏话），使用其 prompt 字段、max_new_tokens 增至 30，做分布偏移（密度/小提琴/CDF/最坏 10%）、失败模式归类与延迟分析。实现细节含 Perspective API 速率限制（1 req/s）下的缓存与分片处理、三模型同载的显存批大小权衡、随机种子与数据索引记录以保证可复现。

Result: (1) 基线风险：95.8% 安全、4.2% 落入危险区，毒性分布呈长尾。(2) 显式缓解成功：DExperts 使危险区输出占比由 4.2% 降至 0.0%，安全率 100%，分布被"压缩"至近零，最坏 10% 输出仍远低于 0.5；代价是延迟由约 0.2s 升至约 2.0s（≈10×）。(3) 鲁棒性差距：ToxiGen 上安全率降至 98.5%（1.5% 泄漏），小提琴图出现越过 0.5 的"鼓包"；失败案例集中于以"事实/统计"口吻表述的刻板印象、编码化贬损语言、表里不一的"赞美式"微攻击，原因是反专家模型主要在显式有毒 Jigsaw 评论上训练、对隐式仇恨覆盖不足。(4) 双重惩罚：对抗提示平均延迟约 3.2s（比标准 DExperts 增长约 60%，尾部超过 5s），即"更用力却更差"。作者同时指出 Perspective API 自身存在对非裔美国人白话英语的误报与对隐式毒性检测不足，样本仅取子集、仅英文、仅单一方法，故结论的外推性受限。

Conclusion: 标准显式毒性基准上的满分并不等于真实部署的鲁棒性：DExperts 能完全消除 RealToxicityPrompts 上的 4.2% 毒性尾部，却在隐式/对抗性仇恨上出现 1.5% 泄漏并伴随 10×（对抗下更高）的推理开销，揭示了当前推理时控制方法"显式强、隐式弱"的鲁棒性差距。作者据此主张：需要能跨毒性形态泛化且计算成本可接受的混合方案（如显式用 DExperts、隐式配细粒度分类器）、在隐式仇恨数据上训练反专家、蒸馏轻量专家模型以降低延迟、引入上下文感知与人在环流程，并开展跨语言评估；否则固定数据集上的高分仍会高估真实世界的安全水平。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), when trained on web-scale corpora, inherently absorb toxic patterns from their training data. This leads to ``toxic degeneration'' where even innocuous prompts can trigger harmful outputs. This phenomenon poses significant risks for real-world deployments. Thus, necessitating effective mitigation strategies that should maintain model utility while ensuring safety. In this comprehensive replication study, we evaluate the efficacy of \textbf{DExperts} (Decoding-time Experts), which is an inference-time mitigation technique that steers generation without requiring model retraining. We structured our research into three systematic phases: (1) establishing baseline toxicity measurements using \textbf{RealToxicityPrompts} on standard GPT-2 models; then (2) implementing and evaluating DExperts to mitigate explicit toxicity; and finally (3) stress-testing the method against implicit hate speech using the adversarial \textbf{ToxiGen} dataset. Our empirical results confirm that while DExperts achieves near-perfect safety rates (100\%) on explicit toxicity benchmarks, it exhibits brittleness against adversarial, implicit hate speech, with safety rates dropping to 98.5\%. Furthermore, we quantify a critical trade-off. The method introduces a $\sim$10x latency penalty (from 0.2s to 2.0s per generation), posing challenges for real-time deployment scenarios. This study contributes to the growing body of work on AI safety by highlighting the robustness gap between explicit and implicit toxicity mitigation. We emphasize the need for more sophisticated approaches that generalize across diverse hate speech patterns without prohibitive computational costs.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学检索增强型LLM常常遇到不完整、误导性或内部矛盾的证据，但现有评估通常强调在有帮助语境下的答案准确性，而非在冲突情况下的可靠性。

Conclusion: 研究强调了评估和放弃回答方法需要明确考虑证据不一致性。在存在冲突证据的最困难条件下，基于置信度的放弃机制比单纯的置信度方法表现更好，这表明将证据冲突检测与模型置信度结合可以显著提高生物医学检索增强LLM的可靠性。

Abstract: Biomedical retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) often face evidence that is incomplete, misleading, or internally contradictory, yet evaluation usually emphasizes answer accuracy under helpful context rather than reliability under conflict. Using HealthContradict, we evaluate six open-weight LLMs under five controlled evidence conditions: no retrieved context, correct-only context, incorrect-only context, and two mixed conditions containing both correct and contradictory documents in opposite orders. In this conflicting-evidence order contrast, where the same two documents are both present and only their order is reversed, accuracy drops for every model and 11.4%--25.2% of predictions flip. To support abstention in these difficult cases, we also evaluate a conflict-aware abstention score that combines model confidence with a detector of evidence conflict. In the two hardest conditions, this score improves selective accuracy over confidence-only, with mean gains of 7.2--33.4 points in incorrect-only (`IC') and 3.6--14.4 points in incorrect-first conflicting (`ICC') conditions across 75%, 50%, and 25% coverage. These results show that conflicting biomedical evidence is both an uncertainty and robustness problem and motivate evaluation and abstention methods that explicitly account for evidence disagreement.

*Luis Lara,Aristides Milios,Zhi Hao Luo,Aditya Sharma,Ge Ya Luo,Christopher Beckham,Florian Golemo,Christopher Pal*

TL;DR: This paper presents a text-based floor plan generation system that fine-tunes an LLM and uses reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to generate professional floor plans meeting both topological and numerical constraints, outperforming prior methods by at least 94% on compatibility metrics.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: An AI system for professional floor plan design must precisely control room dimensions and areas while respecting the desired connectivity between rooms and maintaining functional and aesthetic quality. Existing generative approaches focus primarily on respecting the requested connectivity between rooms, but do not support generating floor plans that respect numerical constraints. We introduce a text-based floor plan generation approach that fine-tunes a large language model (LLM) on real plans and then applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to improve adherence to topological and numerical constraints while discouraging invalid or overlapping outputs. Furthermore, we design a set of constraint adherence metrics to systematically measure how generated floor plans align with user-defined constraints. Our model generates floor plans that satisfy user-defined connectivity and numerical constraints and outperforms existing methods on Realism, Compatibility, and Diversity metrics. Across all tasks, our approach achieves at least a 94% relative reduction in Compatibility compared with existing methods. Our results demonstrate that LLMs can effectively handle constraints in this setting, suggesting broader applications for text-based generative modeling.

</details>


### [13] [Polar probe linearly decodes semantic structures from LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14125)
*Pablo J. Diego-Simón,Pierre Orhan,Yair Lakretz,Jean-Rémi King*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了"极性探针（Polar Probe）"这一神经编码假设：在 LLM 激活空间的某个线性子空间中，两个实体嵌入之间的欧氏距离编码关系是否存在，而相对方向编码关系的类型。在 5 个合成语义域（算术序数、二维空间布局、主题角色、族谱、地铁图）和多个 LLM（Llama3/OLMo/Pythia）上，作者用线性探针成功解码出真实语义图结构（关系存在性 Spearman ρ≈0.8，关系类型 ρ≈0.5–0.7），且该编码主要出现在中间层，随预训练步数与模型规模提升，能泛化到未见实体与新关系表述，与 LLM 问答表现相关，并可通过原型方向干预因果地调节模型预测。结论：LLM 可能依赖一种简单几何原则（距离=存在性，方向=类型）来"绑定"概念并构建复杂语义结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类语言天然要求把词组合成丰富的语义结构（如亲属关系、空间排列、部分-整体关系），逐字组合的一热特征既不可行又阻碍泛化（Fodor & Pylyshyn, 1988）。先前工作（Hewitt & Manning 2019 的 Structural Probe；Diego-Simon et al. 2024 的 Polar Probe）已证明句法结构可用"距离编码句法关联存在性、方向编码句法关系类型"的几何原则在 LLM 激活子空间中读出；但这一绑定原则此前仅限于句法，语义层面的绑定是否遵循同样的原则仍不清楚。因此作者提出假设：LLM 通过同样的极坐标式几何编码来绑定实体、表示语义结构，并需要一套可控、无法靠训练记忆"的合成数据集来检验。

Method: 问题形式化：将语义结构定义为带标签节点（实体）与类型化有向边（关系）的关系图 G=(V,E,T)，用最短路径距离矩阵 M^ρ 与 {-1,0,1} 入射张量 M^φ 做代数表征。数据：自建 5 个合成域——算术序数（可变序数，单一关系）、二维空间布局（欧氏网格）、社会互动/主题角色（欧氏）、族谱（非交换、多对多亲缘）、地铁图（网络最短路径），每个图随机打乱关系顺序与实体顺序生成多种等价自然语言描述；训练集 30 图×20 描述，验证 50 图×20，测试 50 图×30；另设 13 个 OOD 实体名与 13 个 OOD 关系表述（surface form）用于泛化测试；实体名均为单 token。为避免"词距混淆"，文本后附加固定顺序的实体列表（"Who are James, Joseph, and Amelia?"）作为被探测 token。模型：Llama3/3.1-8B 为主，OLMo-7B 的 9 个预训练检查点用于涌现分析，Pythia 系列 14M–6.9B 用于规模分析，并与随机初始化模型作对照。方法：Polar Probe 为从激活空间到探测空间的线性变换 B，配以每种关系类型的原型向量 p_r；损失 = 结构损失 L_s（Sinkhorn 软排序的可微 Spearman 秩相关，Hewitt & Manning）+ 角向损失 L_a（探测入射张量与金标准入射张量的 MSE），总损失 L_s + λL_a，λ=5.0，学习率 1e-5，100 epoch，默认 probe rank 512，逐层独立训练。评测：关系存在性/类型各自的 Spearman ρ；OOD 泛化；与 QA 正确答案 logit 的相关（探针误差归一化后）；因果干预（v = B†p_r，沿 ±原型方向对隐藏态加 α·s·v）；子空间对齐（主角度的均方余弦）。附录还包括固定 identity 探针、线性基线、自然主义与多语（意/西/法/英）空间布局数据集的额外评估。

Result: 1) 语义结构可线性解码：Llama3-8B 上关系存在性 ρ 峰值约 0.80、关系类型约 0.50–0.70（探针空间 PCA 显示方向对应类型、距离对应关系存在与图上邻近）；随机初始化模型接近随机水平。2) 层与时间：性能在中间层（约 12–15 层）达峰且在深层不完全崩塌；族谱浅层类型分数高（名字的性别词汇线索），地铁图类型分数低且峰更晚。3) 预训练涌现：OLMo-7B 上性能随预训练步数持续上升且未饱和，地铁图涌现更晚——说明极性原则并非高维连接模型的平凡性质，而依赖模型学习存储与操作知识的能力。4) 复杂度：实体数增加时存在性与类型分数均下降，主题角色与地铁图的类型分数在增加两个实体后跌幅超 50%。5) 泛化：去掉域提示仅轻微下降，OOD 关系表述额外小幅下降，OOD 实体名影响明显更大，但各设置仍远高于随机基线。6) 模型规模：Pythia 系列上性能随规模单调上升（探针维度固定 128），随机初始化模型不随规模提升。7) 探针秩：性能在低秩即饱和，约 rank 32 已捕获大部分性能；序数域仅 2 维即达类型峰值——语义结构由紧凑子空间承载。8) 相关与因果：探针类型误差与 LLM 问答表现呈显著负相关（存在性误差无此相关）；沿原型方向的正/负干预可双向调控正确答案概率，效果在中间层最强。9) 子空间叠加：各语义域子空间大体互不相交，仅空间布局与序数域明显重叠，符合叠加假设。

Conclusion: LLM 通过一个极简几何原则——实体嵌入间的距离编码关系存在性、方向编码关系类型——来绑定表征并构建复杂语义结构，从而为"符号—连接主义"之争提供几何化解释，并把此前局限于句法树的极性探针推广到类型化的有向标签图（欧氏图）。方法的固有限制在于它依赖线性距离，因而只能忠实编码欧氏（零曲率）结构，对非交换、多对多关系与最短路径距离（族谱、地铁网）只能在局部成立、整体精度受限；此外性能随结构规模增长而衰减，且对 OOD 实体名较敏感。作者据此认为，语义结构的极坐标表示与模型的推理能力、预训练程度和规模密切相关，探针误差可作为模型结构化推理表现的部分诊断指标，且方向性干预说明该子空间具有功能性而非仅为副现象。

Abstract: How do artificial neural networks bind concepts to form complex semantic structures? Here, we propose a simple neural code, whereby the existence and the type of relations between entities are represented by the distance and the direction between their embeddings, respectively. We test this hypothesis in a variety of Large Language Models (LLMs), each input with natural-language descriptions of minimalist tasks from five different domains: arithmetic, visual scenes, family trees, metro maps and social interactions. Results show that the true semantic structures can be linearly recovered with a Polar Probe targeting a subspace of LLMs' layer activations. Second, this code emerges mostly in middle layers and improves with LLM performance. Third, these Polar Probes successfully generalize to new entities and relation types, but degrades with the size of the semantic structure. Finally, the quality of the polar representation correlates with the LLM's ability to answer questions about the semantic structure. Together, these findings suggest that LLMs learn to build complex semantic structures by binding representations with a simple geometrical principle.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM behavior as communicative actors in socially structured contexts remains underexplored, despite extensive computational and cognitive studies.

Method: Controlled experiment with 100 multi-agent debate sessions across five conditions (n=20 each), manipulating the framing of social observation (explicit monitoring, negation of monitoring, and observer-substitution with automated AI auditing).

Result: Monitored conditions showed higher TTR changes (Delta+24.9%, Delta+24.2%) and automated AI monitoring condition (Delta+22.2%) compared to audience-framing conditions (Delta+17.7%), F(4, 94)=2.79, p=.031. Message length showed a fully dissociated effect, F(4, 95)=19.55, p<.001. Observer identity matters: human evaluation elicits stronger register formalization than automated AI surveillance.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been extensively studied from computational and cognitive perspectives, yet their behavior as communicative actors in socially structured contexts remains underexplored. This study examines whether LLM-based multi-agent systems exhibit systematic linguistic adaptation in response to perceived social observation contexts -- a question with direct implications for AI governance and auditing. Drawing on Habermas's (1981) Theory of Communicative Action, Goffman's (1959) dramaturgical model, Bell's (1984) Audience Design framework, and the Hawthorne Effect, we report a controlled experiment involving 100 multi-agent debate sessions across five conditions (n = 20 each). Conditions varied the framing of social observation -- from explicit monitoring by university researchers, to negation of monitoring, to an observer-substitution condition replacing human researchers with an automated AI auditing system. Monitored conditions (Delta+24.9%, Delta+24.2%) and the automated AI monitoring condition (Delta+22.2%) produce higher TTR change than audience-framing conditions (Delta+17.7%), F(4, 94) = 2.79, p = .031. Message length shows a fully dissociated effect, F(4, 95) = 19.55, p < .001. A fifth condition -- replacing human with AI observers -- yields intermediate TTR adaptation, suggesting LLM behavior is sensitive to observer identity: human evaluation elicits stronger register formalization than automated AI surveillance. We discuss implications for AI governance, algorithmic auditing, and the repositioning of LLMs as contextually sensitive communicative actors.

Abstract: Safety evaluations for large language models (LLMs) increasingly target high-stakes National Security and Public Safety (NSPS) risks, yet multilingual safety is typically assessed through translation-only benchmarks that preserve the underlying scenario, and empirical evidence of how language and geopolitical context interact remains limited to a narrow set of language pairs. We introduce \emph{ROK-FORTRESS} https://huggingface.co/datasets/ScaleAI/ROK-FORTRESS_public, a bilingual, culturally adversarial NSPS benchmark that uses the English--Korean language pair and U.S.--ROK geopolitical axis as a case study, separating the effects of language and geopolitical grounding via a \emph{transcreation matrix}: adversarial intents are evaluated under controlled combinations of (i) English versus Korean language and (ii) U.S.\ versus Korean entities, institutions, and operational details. Each adversarial prompt is paired with a dual-use benign counterpart to quantify over-refusal. Model responses are then scored using calibrated LLM-as-a-judge panels, applying our expert-crafted, prompt-specific binary rubrics.

In many models, Korean grounding mitigates the Korean language-driven suppression -- with no model showing significant amplification in the other direction -- indicating that, at least in the English--Korean case, safety behavior is shaped by language-as-risk signals and context interactions that translation-only evaluations miss. The transcreation matrix methodology is designed to generalize to other language--culture pairs.

### [16] [BOOKMARKS: Efficient Active Storyline Memory for Role-playing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14169)
*Letian Peng,Ziche Liu,Yiming Huang,Longfei Yun,Kun Zhou,Yupeng Hou,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BOOKMARKS：一个面向角色扮演智能体（RPA）的“搜索式书签”记忆框架。它不把剧情压缩成单一画像，而是像读者在书中夹书签一样，为当前任务主动提出“信息小节”（如“角色的当前目标”），把已有语义等价的书签复用或新建，并从各自保存的检查点（checkpoint）增量同步到当前剧情点，从而保留对完整前序剧情的访问能力。三类书签（concept 概念、state 状态、behavior 行为）各有专属表示与更新算子。在 6 部作品、47 个角色、9537 个测试用例上，BOOKMARKS 在下一动作预测（NAP，五维评分）与推理选择题（MCQ）上均优于 RICL、ETA、3-way ETA 等基线；MCQ 准确率从最强基线 39.44% 提升到 45.42%，且检查点复用在不损失质量的前提下把实际输出 token 成本降到“完全不用复用”估计成本的 1/8.1–1/32.6。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色扮演智能体需要长程一致地体现角色状态与行为，但现有记忆方法存在两类缺陷：静态/增量摘要（如 profiling、ETA）通过压缩丢弃细节，被丢弃的信息后续 grounding 再也无法访问；检索式方法（RICL）只取少量相似样例，grounding 范围受限于个别例子。从通用搜索智能体引入的“基于搜索的 grounding”可访问完整前序剧情，能针对当前场景主动收集证据，但朴素实现每次搜索都要从剧情开头重算，成本高昂。核心问题因此是：如何既保留完整剧情证据可及性，又避免重复计算——即让记忆组织围绕“当前信息需求”而非无差别地拉长摘要。

Method: 数据与结构：剧情记为 A=[a1..aN]，角色序列 C 分配每个动作。书签 b=(q, y, τ, p)，q 为名词短语形式的小节标题（section），y 为维护内容，τ 为类型，p 为同步点（checkpoint）。三类型：concept（命名实体/概念的描述）、state（位置/关系/目标/知识等演化的有序状态节点轨迹，保留转移历史）、behavioral（角色动作及其场景样例）。

三阶段流程：
(1) Proposal（主动 grounding）：由 (s_i, c_i) 生成至多 K 个小节与类型，例如“角色当前目标”“角色面对危险的反应”；这是“主动”的，因为小节由当前任务决定。
(2) Passive updating：按类型+主体+小节语义匹配已有书签；命中则复用并从其 checkpoint 继续，无命中则在 p=0 新建空书签。同步仅处理未见后缀 [a_{p+1}..a_{i-1}]，用类型专属算子 U_τ 更新：Concept 用提及处的局部上下文 Refine 描述；State 按时间块判定 none/modify_current/append_state 三操作，保留旧节点作为转移历史；Behavioral 过滤保留与该小节相关的“场景-动作”对，并在 grounding 时用 Select 按当前场景检索相关样例。同步后 checkpoint 前移，后续只需处理新增后缀。
(3) Grounding：按类型组装视图——概念给描述、状态给按时间排序的最近节点、行为给场景相关的样例；并叠加 checkpoint 接近当前剧情点的近期维护上下文，构成 g_i，预测 a_i ~ RPA(·| s_i, c_i, g_i)。

实现：主干 gpt-5.1，另测 deepseek、qwen；每轮最多 3 个书签，行为样例用 BM25 选 8 条，状态书签按 64 个动作为一块更新；RICL 用 qwen3-embedding-8b 检索 8 个样例；ETA/3-way ETA 的输出 token 上限分别调至 1024/每节 256 以对齐成本。

评测：下一动作预测从剧情开头到结尾逐动作评测（局部场景含至多 10 个前序动作，记忆初始为空），用 gpt-4.1 作独立裁判在 emotion/intent/causality/position/content 五维分别做 yes/no 判定（人工校验 200 例/维，与裁判一致率 93.7%）；另有 284 道 Manosaba（Magical Girl Witch Trials）人写有唯一答案的多选题，材料在 gpt-5.1 知识截止后公开，用于测试无污染材料上的剧情推理。

Result: 主结果：Best@1 NAP 上 Bookmarks 在所有六个数据集全面领先（Haruhi 36.37、JOJO 38.87、FMA 37.88、AGOT 44.41、PoPiPa 39.87、Manosaba 43.97），高于 3-way ETA 与 ETA、RICL、Vanilla；Best@3 优势更大（45.04/52.21/49.18/56.84/48.89/59.23）。MCQ（Manosaba，284 题）从最强基线 3-way ETA 的 39.44% 提升至 45.42%。增益集中在 content 与 causality 两维；Recall 与 Preference 类动作提升高于全局均值，Trivial Interjections 提升很小；Reasoning 类在 Best@3 下提升更大，说明 Best@1 低估了记忆系统的贡献。

消融：去掉 state 或 behavioral 书签均降低五维 NAP 与 MCQ 准确率；移除 behavioral 主要伤害 emotion/intent，移除 state 主要影响 causality/content；MCQ 上分别下降 5.06 与 2.97 个百分点。关闭“复用”后性能与完整框架相当，说明复用是纯效率机制而非质量来源。

效率：随剧情推进，复用使实际输出 token 成本远低于无复用估计成本（估计为实际成本的 8.1–32.6 倍），并跳过大量重复更新步骤；增大书签预算（2→3→5）持续带来收益，而扩大 ETA 画像容量（128→1024）收益递减甚至略降。

跨模型：deepseek、qwen（含 27B 规模）同样在五个维度获得提升，说明方法不依赖单一闭源模型。开放域测试：200 个新起始场景、每场景 10 轮，gpt-4.1 与人工裁判均更偏好 Bookmarks 而非 3-way ETA。

需注意：摘要与 arXiv 全文的标题（“Efficient Active Storyline Memory” vs “Checkpoint-Accelerated Active Grounding”）以及规模数字（85 角色/16 作品 vs 47 角色/6 作品）不一致，全文应视为准据。

Conclusion: BOOKMARKS 证明：面向长程角色扮演的记忆系统应当围绕“当前信息需求”组织，而非写更长更全的摘要。它通过主动 grounding（按当前场景提议小节并定向检索完整前序剧情）提升角色扮演保真度与剧情推理能力，通过被动更新（书签复用 + 检查点增量同步）在几乎不损失质量的前提下大幅降低维护成本；同时扩展了评测基准，覆盖知识截止后发布的新作品与人写推理题。作者指出局限并规划未来方向：细粒度的“知情权”追踪（谁在何时知道什么）、与自我精修（self-refinement）整合以在证据暴露不一致时修订已生成动作、以及针对不同书签类型/查询类型/叙事结构的定制化更新策略。

Abstract: Memory systems are critical for role-playing agents (RPAs) to maintain long-horizon consistency. However, existing RPA memory methods (e.g., profiling) mainly rely on recurrent summarization, whose compression inevitably discards important details. To address this issue, we propose a search-based memory framework called BOOKMARKS, which actively initializes, maintains, and updates task-relevant pieces of bookmarks for the current task (e.g., character acting). A bookmark is structured as the answer to a question at a specific point in the storyline. For each current task, BOOKMARKS selects reusable existing bookmarks or initializes new ones (at storyline beginning) with useful questions. These bookmarks are then synchronized to the current story point, with their answers updated accordingly, so they can be efficiently reused in future grounding rounds. Compared with recurrent summarization, BOOKMARKS offers (1) active grounding for capturing task-specific details and (2) passive updating to avoid unnecessary computation. In implementation, BOOKMARKS supports concept, behavior, and state searches, each powered by an efficient synchronization method. BOOKMARKS significantly outperforms RPA memory baselines on 85 characters from 16 artifacts, demonstrating the effectiveness of search-based memory for RPAs.

</details>

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a powerful and widely used approach for improving large language models by grounding generation in retrieved evidence. However, RAG systems still produce incorrect answers in many cases. Why RAG fails despite having access to external information remains poorly understood. We present a model-internal study of retrieval-augmented generation that examines how retrieved evidence influences answer generation. Using circuit tracing, we construct attribution graphs that model the flow of information through transformer layers during decoding. These graphs represent interactions among retrieved context, intermediate model activations, and generated tokens, providing a graph, circuit-level view of how external evidence is integrated into the model's reasoning process across multiple question answering benchmarks, we observe consistent structural differences: correct predictions exhibit deeper reasoning paths, more distributed evidence flow, and a more structured pattern of local connectivity, while failed predictions show shallower, fragmented, and overly concentrated evidence flow. Building on these findings, we develop a graph-based error detection framework that uses attribution-graph topology features. Furthermore, we show that attribution graphs enable targeted interventions. By reinforcing question-constrained evidence grounding, we reshape internal routing so that answer generation remains guided by the question, leading to more effective integration of retrieved information and fewer errors.

</details>

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly run inside execution harnesses that dispatch tools, allocate resources, and route messages between specialized components. However, a harness can return a correct, benign answer over a trajectory that accesses unauthorized resources or leaks context to the wrong agent. Output-level evaluation cannot see these failures, yet most safety benchmarks score only final outputs or terminal states, even though many violations occur mid-trajectory rather than at termination. To address this gap, we propose HarnessAudit, a framework that audits full execution trajectories across boundary compliance, execution fidelity, and system stability, with a focus on multi-agent harnesses where these risks are most pronounced. We further introduce HarnessAudit-Bench, a benchmark of 210 tasks across eight real-world domains, instantiated in both single-agent and multi-agent configurations with embedded safety constraints. Evaluating ten harness configurations across frontier models and three multi-agent frameworks, we find that: (i) task completion is misaligned with safe execution, and violations accumulate with trajectory length; (ii) safety risks vary across domains, task types, and agent roles; (iii) most violations concentrate in resource access and inter-agent information transfer; and (iv) multi-agent collaboration expands the safety risk surface, while harness design sets the upper bound of safe deployment.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) pose a significant risk of safety misalignment after finetuning, as models can be compromised by both explicitly and implicitly harmful data. Even some seemingly benign data can inadvertently steer a model towards misaligned behaviors. To address this, we introduce GradShield, a principled filtering method that safeguards LLMs during finetuning by identifying and removing harmful data points before they corrupt the model's alignment. It removes potentially harmful data by computing a Finetuning Implicit Harmfulness Score (FIHS) for each data point and employs an adaptive thresholding algorithm. We apply GradShield to multiple utility fine-tuning tasks across varying levels of harmful data and evaluate the safety and utility performance of the resulting LLMs using various metrics. The results show that GradShield outperforms all baseline methods, consistently maintaining an Attack Success Rate (ASR) below $6\%$ while preserving utility performance.

</details>

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对受监管金融场景中"LLM 既解释治理政策、又自我判定合规"导致的主代理冲突与"合规表象"问题，提出 5 项在决策理由(rationale)层面度量治理质量的指标（CDL、DIU、FSR、FVS、ESD），并在合成银行决策域（N=300×2 制度×4 压力条件，Llama 3.1 70B）上对比纯文本治理 R1 与机械执行治理 R2（硬门控、I6Q 理由质量约束、CEFL 候选外化、E3 commit–reveal 熵隔离）。结果：R1 下 27% 延后为空洞信息；R2 使 CDL 降至 0.074（−73%）、DIU 由 0.298 升至 0.766、MCC 由 0.433 升至 0.884，消融验证各原语必要性。核心发现是"治理—任务解耦"：结构性压力（S2 低信息）下 R2 治理最优（CDL=0.088、DIU=0.852）而任务精度最差（MCC=0.285），证明准确率不足以作为治理的代理指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受监管金融工作流中，治理政策以自然语言形式给出，而解释与遵守该政策的是同一个模型，形成典型的主—代理冲突：模型只需满足"合规的表象"（使用监管话术、格式化输出）即可通过自检，产出形式合规但实质空洞的延后(deferral)，如"因情况复杂需进一步审查"。作者用 Goodhart 定律（尤其是 regressional Goodhart：代理指标与真实目标共享成因，在分布外失效）与 RL 中的 reward hacking 解释这一机制，并指出既有工作（Constitutional AI、安全分类器、红队、learning-to-defer、FinBen 等）要么关注价值对齐、要么只优化"何时延后"，要么只测任务准确率，缺乏对"延后理由是否保全决策相关信息（能否支撑下游人工复核）"的可操作化度量；模型风险管理文献亦承认"治理可执行性"是空白。因此需要一套独立于任务准确率的治理度量体系，并在压力条件下检验其鲁棒性。

Method: 在合成银行决策域上构建受控实验：案例变量含风险分 r、信息完备度 ι、5 类监管标记（AML/KYC/SANCTIONS/INSIDER/CONCENTRATION）、金额 a、司法辖区、客户年限、对手方风险；五类决策（APPROVE/CONDITIONAL/ESCALATE/DEFER/DECLINE），规则打分生成真值，约 40% 明确、60% 合法歧义，N=300/条件（seed=42），共 8 个单元（2 制度×4 压力条件），模型为 Llama 3.1 70B Instruct（AWS Bedrock，确定性推理）。压力条件区分参数型（S1 HighRisk：r 加噪）与结构型（S2 LowInfo：完备度乘 U(0.3,0.7) 并移除 1–2 标记；S3 Threshold：落入门控阈值邻域）。治理制度：R1 将政策作为 system prompt 由模型自解释；R2 在模型解释回路之外加入四个原语——硬门控（K0_6–K0_14，前置 LLM 与后置覆盖 K0_11）、I6Q（理由最小长度≥10 token、TTR≥0.4、最多重试 2 次）、CEFL（外部生成 3 个候选、随机生成+确定性选择，阻断 selection-by-negation）、E3（commit–reveal 熵种子承诺）。度量：5 项治理指标——观测型 CDL（spec<τ 或 expl<τ 的延后占比，τ=0.3 且在 [0.2,0.4] 稳定）与 DIU（spec·expl·bshift 几何均值，禁止补偿）；干预型 FSR（重述框架后决策改变比例）、FVS（完备度降至 0.10 后新标记为 DEFER/ESCALATE 的比例）、ESD（3 种熵种子下种子利用/信息泄漏/commit–reveal 完整性失败均值）；任务指标用 MCC 为主，另报 macro-F1 与准确率。推理：MSUP/bootstrap 10,000 次案例级重采样 95% CI + Holm–Bonferroni 校正；因果消融逐个关闭四个原语；±20% 参数扰动敏感性分析；机制性延后按模板记满分并单列 LLM-only 分解。

Result: S0 基线：R1→R2 的 CDL 0.273→0.074（−73%）、DIU 0.298→0.766（p<0.001）、MCC 0.433→0.884、macro-F1 0.462→0.901、准确率 0.422→0.909；FSR 0.333→0.260，FVS 0.350→0.550，ESD 0.057→0.070；GOR(R2)=0.327（pre-LLM 门控约 23%）。R2 的增益来自机械部分——LLM-only CDL≈0.41 与 R1 相当。压力下：S2 中 R2 同时取得最佳治理（CDL=0.088、DIU=0.852）与最差任务精度（MCC=0.285），R1 则治理与任务同步退化；S3 中 R2 优势收窄（CDL=0.256、GOR=0.530）；S1 仅改变频率不改质量。消融：移除 I6Q 使 CDL +47%（0.074→0.109）；A3 破坏 commit–reveal 使 DIU −2.9% 且 ESD 无显著变化；A4 禁用 DEFER 给出最低 FVS=0.500；FSR/ESD 在各消融下稳定（≤2pp）。稳健性：参数 ±20% 扰动下真值确定性变化 3.4pp、门控激活变化 3.6pp 无断点；10 组对比中 7 组经 Holm–Bonferroni 后显著，DIU 在所有条件下 p<0.001，CDL 仅 S2 显著（p=0.004）因 R1 延后数量少导致 bootstrap SD 偏大（0.14）。残余问题：两制度对框架操纵仍敏感（FSR>0.2），未拦截的约 67% LLM 案例仍是残余风险点。

Conclusion: 核心论断是"治理—任务解耦"（governance–task decoupling）：治理质量与任务准确率是正交的两条评估轴，准确率不能作为受监管 AI 治理的充分代理指标；纯文本治理在结构性压力下两条轴同时退化，而机械执行在任务精度下降时仍保持治理质量（以牺牲准确率换取信息保全型延后）。方法论贡献在于证明"治理质量可测量"——五项指标首次将延后理由质量操作化（CDL/DIU 为观测型、FSR/FVS/ESD 为干预型），并给出可复现的度量协议、基线、示例与参数选择依据（τ=0.3、I6Q 10 token/TTR 0.4、CEFL 3 候选）；实践建议是把治理指标与任务指标并列纳入评估流水线，并对结构型（信息缺失）而非仅参数型扰动做压力测试，机械门控可生成独立于模型自评的可审计轨迹。结论也明确指出：仅基于文档的治理（当前行业标准）必要但不充分——满足合规文本要求而违背其意图；对监管方而言，真正可执行的是把"可由结构化数据单独判定的治理决策"从模型控制中彻底剥离（separation of concerns）。局限与展望：结论限于单一模型家族与合成域，40/60 的确定性—歧义配比为建模假设；机械延后按构造记满分属方法学选择（作者已给出 LLM-only 分解以透明化）；CEFL/熵隔离的部分消融效应不显著；残留框架敏感性需在未拦截案例上进一步治理；附录 A.12 提出 R3（受不变量约束与漂移预算 δ 限制的有界自修改，指标 AIVR=0、IPI=0.50）作为第三代治理的理论方向，尚待每种子 ≥50 次修改周期的专门研究。

Abstract: Large language models in regulated financial workflows are governed by natural-language policies that the same model interprets, creating a principal--agent failure: outputs can appear compliant without being compliant. Existing evaluation measures task accuracy but not whether governance constrains behaviour at the decision rationale level -- where regulated decisions must be auditable. We introduce five governance metrics that quantify policy compliance at the rationale level and apply them in a synthetic banking domain to compare text-only governance against mechanical enforcement: four primitives operating outside the model's interpretive loop. Under text-only governance, 27% of deferrals carry no decision-relevant information. Mechanical enforcement reduces this rate by 73%, more than doubles deferral information content, and raises task accuracy from MCC~$0.43$ to $0.88$. The improvement is driven by architectural separation: LLM-generated rationales under mechanical enforcement show comparable CDL to text-only governance -- the gain comes from removing clear-cut decisions from the model's control. A causal ablation confirms that each primitive is individually necessary. Our central finding is a governance-task decoupling: under structural stress, text-only governance degrades on both dimensions simultaneously, whereas mechanical enforcement preserves governance quality even as task performance drops. This implies that governance and task evaluation are distinct axes: accuracy is not a sufficient proxy for governance in regulated AI systems.

</details>

### [22] [Factorization-Error-Free Discrete Diffusion Language Model via Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14305)
*Xun Fang,Yunchen Li,Hang Yuan,Zhou Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 FeF-DLLM：通过“前缀条件化（position-conditioned）”的干净 token 预测精确分解清洁后验分布，消除离散扩散语言模型（以 LLaDA 为骨干）$X_0$ 预测中的因子分解误差；再在扩散去噪内部嵌入投机解码以抵消前缀条件带来的顺序开销。理论上证明其采样自真实联合分布并给出期望加速比；实验显示平均准确率提升 5.04 个百分点、平均推理加速 3.86×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型（DLLM）通过在每一步并行预测多个 token 提升生成效率，但标准 $X_0$ 预测把干净 token 后验 $p(X_0\mid X_t)$ 近似为各位置独立分布之积 $\prod_i p(X_0^i\mid X_t)$，引入因子分解误差，与自然语言的句法/语义依赖相悖。已有补救方案各有缺陷：ReDi 用整流流与配对数据仅部分缓解；改进采样过程（如 DCD、DDOSP）显著拖慢推理；而已有的 DLLM+投机解码方案（SSD 等）把自回归解码行为引入 DLLM，破坏了其非自回归推理特性。此外，提高并行度（如每步解 2 个 token 的 LLaDA/2）虽带来约 2× 加速，却明显损害准确率，说明并行解码必须配合显式纠错机制。因此需要一个既无因子分解误差、又能维持并行性与高效率的生成框架。

Method: 【误差分析】由链式法则，精确分解为 $p(X_0\mid X_t)=\prod_i p(X_0^i\mid X_t,X_0^{<i})$；引理 1 证明在位置级独立腐蚀假设下 $p(X_0^i\mid X_t,X_0^{<i})=p(X_0^i\mid X_t^{\ge i},X_0^{<i})\propto p(X_0^i\mid X_t)\cdot p(X_0^i\mid X_t^{>i},X_0^{<i})/p(X_0^i\mid X_t^{-i})$，缺失的正是对清洁前缀的依赖。【训练】改用位置条件化目标 $\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}[-\sum_i\log p_\theta(X_0^i\mid X_t^{\ge i},X_0^{<i},t)]$，通过在输入中把位置 i 之前的 token 替换为干净 token 实现（Algorithm 1），仅需对现有 DLLM 骨干微调，前向扩散过程与解析后验转移不变。【推理加速】在每个去噪步内做投机解码：草稿模型仅以已验证前缀与剩余腐蚀上下文为条件，窗口内 $O(1)$ 并行提出 k 个候选 token；目标模型按左到右顺序以位置条件化输入验证，按 $\min(1,\pi/\rho)$ 接受，拒绝时从残差分布 $\text{norm}(\max(0,\pi-\rho))$ 重采样并重开窗口；随后按标准 $X_0$ 参数化构造反向转移，并对低置信位置做再腐蚀（Algorithm 2）。【理论】定理 1：若目标模型等于真实位置条件后验，采样严格等于真实联合分布 $p^\star(x_{J_t}\mid X_t,t)$；推论 1 给出再采样（resampling）下的条件正确性；定理 2 与推论 2：期望提交长度 $\mathbb{E}[C_k]=\sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1}\alpha^\ell$，理想加速比 $S=\mathbb{E}[C_k]c_\pi/(c_\rho+c_\pi)$，$c_\rho\approx c_\pi$ 时 $S\approx\mathbb{E}[C_k]/2$。【实验设置】LLaDA-Instruct 为骨干，7.2 万条 prompt–response 对（18k 数学 + 54k 代码）微调，AdamW、lr 1e-5、bf16、8×A100；投机窗口 k=16，步数 2/4；OpenCompass 评测。

Result: GSM8K/MATH/HumanEval/MBPP 上：FeF-DLLM(step=2) 平均准确率 51.79%（较 LLaDA 46.75% 提升 5.04 点），平均加速 3.86×（各任务 3.25–4.89×）；step=4 平均准确率 52.06%（+5.31 点）、加速 2.33×。均优于 SSD（48.58%）、LLaDA/2（42.30%）、DDOSP（39.30%）与 DCD（48.05%，且 DCD 慢至 0.43×）。消融：微调后模型单用原推理反而略降（46.28%），说明增益来自微调与推理策略的共同作用；关闭投机解码后准确率不变但速度降至 0.67×/0.40×；用未微调模型作草稿时接受率下降约 0.7–1.5 个百分点而准确率不变（接受率 56–93%）；窗口从 4→16 使速度由 0.78× 提升至 2.33× 且准确率完全一致。

Conclusion: FeF-DLLM 通过精确的前缀条件化分解取代独立 token 预测，从根本上消除了 DLLM 的因子分解误差，同时用投机解码摊销顺序代价，保持了并行预测与再掩码特性；理论上保证真实联合分布采样并给出期望加速比，实验证明其在提升生成质量的同时获得显著 wall-clock 加速，优于现有因子分解缓解方法与直接投机解码方案。局限在于前缀条件预测与投机验证的推理算力开销高于标准 DLLM 解码（无投机时反而慢于基线），未来工作将探索更高效的实现以进一步降低开销。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models improve generation efficiency through parallel token prediction, but standard $X_0$ prediction methods introduce factorization errors by approximating the clean token posterior with independent token-wise distributions. This paper proposes Factorization-Error-Free Discrete Diffusion Language Modeling (FeF-DLLM), which replaces independent clean-token prediction with an exact prefix-conditioned factorization of the clean posterior to better preserve token dependencies. To reduce the sequential cost introduced by prefix conditioning, FeF-DLLM further incorporates speculative decoding within diffusion denoising, accelerating inference while maintaining the parallel prediction and re-masking properties of DLLMs. Theoretically, we prove that FeF-DLLM generates from the true joint distribution and derive its expected acceleration ratio. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MBPP demonstrate that our method improves accuracy by an average of 5.04 percentage points while achieving an average inference speedup of $3.86\times$.

</details>

TL;DR: Developed a transformer-based system to measure political orientation on a continuous German left-right spectrum (d ∈ [-1, 1]). <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Need to better understand political rhetoric from various movements across the political spectrum. Existing multiclass classifiers cannot flexibly target specific segments (e.g., conservatives) without predefined classes that incorporate the desired orientation.

Method: Proposed a transformer-based model projecting political orientation onto a continuous left-to-right spectrum (normalized scalar d ∈ [-1, 1]). Evaluated 13 candidate transformers across four distinct German corpora: Bundestag plenary notes, Wahl-O-Mat decision tool, 33 newspapers, and 535,200 tweets from Bundestag members. Used two corpora for training and two for testing to mitigate overfitting.

Abstract: Elections represent a crucial milestone in a nation's ongoing development. To better understand the political rhetoric from various movements, ranging from left to right, we propose a transformer-based model capable of projecting the political orientation of a text on a continuous left-to-right spectrum, represented by a normalized scalar d between -1 and 1. This approach enables analysts to focus on specific segments of the political landscape, such as conservatives, while excluding liberal and far-right movements. Such a task can only be achieved with multiclass classifiers, provided that the desired orientation is incorporated within one of their predefined classes. To determine the most suitable foundation model among 13 candidate transformers for this task, we constructed four distinct corpora. One corpus comprised annotated plenary notes from the German Bundestag, while another was based on an official online decision-making tool, Wahl-O-Mat. The third corpus consisted of articles from 33 newspapers, each identified by its political orientation, and the fourth included 535,200 tweets from 597 members of the 20th and 21st German Bundestag. To mitigate overfitting, we used two distinct corpora for training and two for testing, respectively. For in-domain performance, DeBERTa-large achieved the highest F1 score F1=0.844 as well as for the X (Twitter) out-of-domain test ACC=0.864. Regarding the newspaper out-of-domain test, Gemma2-2B excelled (MAE = 0.172). This study demonstrates that transformer models can recognize political framing in German news at the level of public opinion polls. Our findings suggest that both the model architecture and the availability of domain-specific training data can be as influential as model size for estimating political bias. We discuss methodological limitations and outline directions for improving the robustness of bias measurement.

</details>

Abstract: We present a new computational framework for detecting and structuring manipulative political narratives. A task that became more important due to the shift of political discussions to social media. One of the primary challenges thereby is differentiating between manipulative political narratives and legitimate critiques. Some posts may also reframe actual events within a manipulative context.
  To achieve good clustering results, we filter manipulative posts beforehand using a detailed few-shot prompt that combines documented campaign narratives with legitimate criticisms to differentiate them. This prompt enables a reasoning model to assign labels, retaining only manipulative narrative posts for further processing.
  The remaining posts are subsequently embedded and dimensionality-reduced using UMAP, before HDBSCAN is applied to uncover narrative groups. A key advantage of this unsupervised approach is its independence from a predefined list of target categories, enabling it to uncover new narrative clusters.
  Finally, a reasoning model is employed to uncover the narrative behind each cluster. This approach, applied to over 1.2 million social media posts, effectively identified 41 distinct manipulative narrative clusters by integrating prompt-based filtering with unsupervised clustering.

</details>


### [25] [Reinforcement Learning with Semantic Rewards Enables Low-Resource Language Expansion without Alignment Tax](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14366)
*Zeli Su,Ziyin Zhang,Zhou Liu,Xuexian Song,Zhankai Xu,Longfei Zheng,Xiaolu Zhang,Rong Fu,Guixian Xu,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型扩展到低资源语言时的"对齐税"问题，提出基于语义空间对齐的新范式，利用强化学习和语义奖励替代传统监督微调，在保持通用能力的同时有效提升低资源语言处理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将大型语言模型扩展到低资源语言时面临"对齐税"问题：在目标语言上的改进以通用能力灾难性遗忘为代价。该问题源于监督微调（SFT）的刚性——在狭窄有偏的数据分布上进行 token 级表面模仿。

Method: 提出语义空间对齐范式，结合群组相对策略优化（GRPO），使用嵌入级语义奖励而非 likelihood 最大化进行优化，鼓励通过灵活表达保留语义，促进可控更新以减少对预训练知识的破坏性干扰。

Result: 藏汉机器翻译和藏文标题生成实验表明，该方法在获取低资源能力的同时显著缓解了对齐税，更有效地保留通用能力；虽然表面重叠度更低，但在开放式生成中产生更高的语义质量和偏好；少样本迁移显示其学习到更可迁移、更鲁棒的表示。

Conclusion: 强化学习结合语义奖励为低资源语言扩展提供了更安全、更可靠的路径，能在获取低资源能力的同时有效保留通用能力。

Abstract: Extending large language models (LLMs) to low-resource languages often incurs an "alignment tax": improvements in the target language come at the cost of catastrophic forgetting in general capabilities. We argue that this trade-off arises from the rigidity of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which enforces token-level surface imitation on narrow and biased data distributions. To address this limitation, we propose a semantic-space alignment paradigm powered by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), where the model is optimized using embedding-level semantic rewards rather than likelihood maximization. This objective encourages meaning preservation through flexible realizations, enabling controlled updates that reduce destructive interference with pretrained knowledge. We evaluate our approach on Tibetan-Chinese machine translation and Tibetan headline generation. Experiments show that our method acquires low-resource capabilities while markedly mitigating alignment tax, preserving general competence more effectively than SFT. Despite producing less rigid surface overlap, semantic RL yields higher semantic quality and preference in open-ended generation, and few-shot transfer results indicate that it learns more transferable and robust representations under limited supervision. Overall, our study demonstrates that reinforcement learning with semantic rewards provides a safer and more reliable pathway for inclusive low-resource language expansion.

</details>


### [26] [Where Should Diffusion Enter a Language Model? Geometry-Guided Hidden-State Replacement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14368)
*Injin Kong,Hyoungjoon Lee,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DiHAL：一个几何引导的扩散-Transformer 混合框架，用以回答"扩散应该插入预训练语言模型的哪一层"。核心思想是把"在哪个表示空间做连续扩散"当作一等设计变量，形式化为隐状态接口选择问题。作者用三个免训练的几何代理（局部紧致度、全局刚度、有效秩）筛出"扩散友好"的插入层，再把该层以下的 Transformer 前缀替换为条件潜扩散桥（SD-v1.5 风格 U-Net + 冻结 VAE），保留原后缀与 LM 头，从而把"连续→离散"的恢复问题转化为隐状态重建问题。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-8B 上，几何分数与固定预算下扩散桥的可桥接性高度相关（Spearman 0.914/0.927），在控制层深度的留一交叉验证中仍提供增量预测（Llama RMSE 降 28.4%）；完全训练后几何选层接近验证损失 oracle 并优于最差层对照；同预算下其 Gen.PPL/多样性优于 Diffusion-LM、SED、LD4LG、CoDAR。但保真度仍远低于原模型（PPL 比 10.6–21 倍），且推理开销高、无加速收益，作者本人明确承认该方法不是加速方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型在生成质量上落后于自回归 Transformer，一个关键原因是扩散被施加在与语言去噪、token 恢复不匹配的表示空间上：先前工作多在 token 嵌入、自条件嵌入或学习到的文本潜变量上扩散，再由额外的映射/解码机制回到离散 token，导致表征空间的微小误差会直接改变离散输出。作者提出换一个更基本的设计问题：扩散应该进入预训练 Transformer 的哪个内部位置？插入层同时决定了扩散需要建模的隐状态分布和被保留的后缀网络，因此它本质上是一个"接口选择（interface selection）"问题：找一个既能被扩散可靠建模、又与后缀兼容的内部表示。作者进一步假设这种"扩散友好性"会反映在表示几何上——好的扩散空间应能快速收缩到目标分布、能容忍分数估计误差、且变化集中于少数活跃方向，从而可用曲率与内在维度的谱性质做免训练的前置筛选。

Method: 问题形式化与理论动机。作者用理想化（过阻尼 Langevin 动力学）框架论证三类几何性质：定理 1 给出强对数凹下 W2 收缩率 W2(ν_t,μ)≤e^{-mt}W2(ν_0,μ)（曲率→快速收缩）；定理 2 给出分数扰动 ε 下的不变分布稳定性 W2(μ̂,μ)≤ε/m（曲率→抗估计误差）；引理 1 给出近 k 维流形时有效秩 r_eff=tr(Σ)/‖Σ‖=O(k)（低有效复杂度）；定理 3 结合两者给出方差尺度界与 Bakry–Émery/对数 Sobolev 意义下的高斯集中不等式。作者明确声明这些定理是理想化动机而非对 Transformer 隐状态的严格假设，实践中只用作"几何代理"的设计依据。 Locate（定位）阶段：从每层隐状态激活（mask 感知均值池化 + 固定随机投影到 D=64）计算三个免训练代理——局部紧致度 m̂_curv（k 近邻局部协方差 1/λ_max 的中位数）、全局刚度 m̂_mono（正则化精度矩阵 P=(Σ+λI)^{-1} 上的 Rayleigh 商型量 (x_i−x_j)ᵀP(x_i−x_j)/‖x_i−x_j‖² 的中位数）、有效秩 k̂=r_eff(Σ)；再以层间 z-score 归一化组合成 selection_score(ℓ)=z(log m̂_curv)+z(log m̂_mono)−z(log k̂)，系数固定不拟合，选 ℓ*=argmax。 Replace（替换）阶段：把 ℓ* 以下的 Transformer 前缀替换为条件潜扩散桥 D_θ：以 embedding 输出作为条件 c(x)（经学习投影送入预训练 U-Net 的 768 维 encoder_hidden_states 接口，不使用 CLIP/文本编码器），目标隐状态经 1×1 投影映射到三通道"类图像"张量并按 32×32/16×32 网格重排，冻结 VAE 编码为潜变量，加噪后由 SD-v1.5 风格 U-Net 去噪，VAE 解码再投影回隐藏维度；训练目标 L=L_diff+λ_rec·L_rec+λ_LM·L_LM+λ_KD·L_KD（ε 预测 MSE + 隐状态重建 MSE + 下一 token 交叉熵 + 温度缩放 logit 蒸馏），VAE 与调度器冻结、U-Net 与投影可训。推理时每步只提供已观测前缀 x≤t 的嵌入、其余网格位置掩蔽（不泄漏未来），重建的边界隐状态送入保留的因果后缀与 LM 头得到下一 token 分布，桥在每步用新噪声重跑。

Result: 1) 合成验证：固定预算 SD 风格去噪器下，去噪难度与三个几何因子方向一致，Spearman 分别为全局刚度 0.947、有效秩 0.946、局部紧致度 0.968，但在强多模态下关系减弱。2) 层扫描：几何分数与固定预算桥验证损失高度相关——Llama-3.1-8B ρ=0.9143±0.0069、τ=0.8011±0.0086；Qwen3-8B ρ=0.9267±0.0157、τ=0.8208±0.0256；分数选层为 Llama 第 3 层、Qwen 第 2 层，而最低固定预算损失在两者均为第 1 层（排名差距 2 和 1）。3) 深度控制（LOOCV 预测 log 桥损失）：二次深度模型 RMSE 0.7537/1.6102，加入几何后降至 0.5400/1.5316（−28.4%/−4.9%），OOS R² 从 0.0915/0.6983 提升到 0.5336/0.7271；几何在 Llama 上全面优于 CKA/隐状态距离/线性重建误差，但 Qwen 上 CKA 的 RMSE 与 R² 略优；仅用前 8 层时几何对 Llama 降 RMSE 14.1%，对 Qwen 反而升 3.9%，说明浅层深度本身仍是强预测量。4) 一轮训练的排序稳定性：归一化验证损失排名平均绝对变化 <10%。5) 桥族对比（Llama L3、512 样本/300 步共享预算）：SD 潜扩散桥最优（Hidden MSE 0.0067、Teacher KL 5.7446、NLL 7.6407、PPL 2081.3），相对参数匹配（939.7M）的确定性 MLP，MSE 降 98.8%、KL 降 36.3%、NLL 降 28.4%，优于 CVAE、流匹配、隐空间 DDPM。6) 完全训练（300K 样本、4 epoch、40 H100 小时）：Llama 几何选层 NLL 4.91/PPL 135.64/KL 0.73，优于最差层（5.17/175.91/1.32）并优于 oracle（5.11/165.67/0.62，KL 0.62 略优）；Qwen 几何选层 4.97/144.03/0.53，接近 oracle（4.94/139.77/0.54）并优于最差层（5.23/186.79/1.46）；相对原模型 PPL 比为 20.96× 与 10.63×。7) 接口对比（Qwen3-8B、同为 300K/40 H100 小时）：DiHAL Gen.PPL 136.02、多样性 0.5913，优于 Diffusion-LM(683.43/0.4324)、SED(778.82/0.4942)、LD4LG(166.11/0.5797)、CoDAR(144.83/0.4777)；341.1M 从零训练的缩小桥仍达 140.51/0.5230，说明优势不单由桥容量或 SD 权重初始化解释。8) 成本与敏感性：几何选层（浅层）比原模型更慢，4 次 NFE 吞吐仅为原 28.4%（20 次时 8.5% 且保真度反而变差），PPL 仍为 18.94×；插值实验显示后缀对边界误差的响应是渐进的，误差沿保留层放大约 1.44×，无突变阈值。9) 稳健性：投影维度 128/256/512/4096 的层排名与 D=64 的 Spearman 均 ≥0.9866。

Conclusion: 本文把"扩散在哪种表示空间中运作"确立为连续扩散语言模型的一等设计变量，主张把插入位置当作接口选择问题而非固定前提。三条主要结论：其一，理论启发的几何代理（局部紧致度、全局刚度、有效秩）能在不训练任何扩散模型的前提下预测固定预算下的扩散可桥接性，并在控制层深度后仍提供增量信息；其二，实例化的 DiHAL（Locate-and-Replace）表明几何选出的浅层接口在完全训练后接近验证损失 oracle、显著优于最差层对照，并且在同预算下优于现有的连续扩散语言模型接口（token 嵌入、自条件嵌入、学习潜变量、连续-离散恢复）；其三，隐藏态重建而非 token 解码是规避连续到离散恢复误差的有效途径。局限与保留态度方面，作者明确指出理论设定理想化、代理只是"操作标准"而非精确估计量；几何并非在所有骨干上支配 CKA 等启发式，在仅前 8 层的窄深度区间对 Qwen 甚至略有负收益；与原模型相比保真度差距很大（PPL 10.6–21 倍），当前浅层配置没有有利的质量-效率权衡，不应被解读为加速方法；此外 Gen.PPL 使用 GPT-2 评估器，对 8B 骨干可能偏好接近 GPT-2 分布或重复性输出，桥容量对照也未做总系统容量/推理 FLOP 匹配。后续方向是寻找兼顾几何友好性与深度更大（从而真正省去计算）的插入位置，并把扩散过程成本降到可接受水平。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models lag behind autoregressive transformers, partly because diffusion is applied in spaces poorly suited to language denoising and token recovery. We propose DiHAL, a geometry-guided diffusion-transformer hybrid that asks where diffusion should enter a pretrained transformer. DiHAL scores layers with geometry-based proxies, selects a diffusion-friendly hidden-state interface, and replaces the lower transformer prefix with a diffusion bridge while retaining the upper layers and original LM head. By reconstructing the selected-layer hidden state rather than tokens, DiHAL avoids direct continuous-to-discrete recovery. Experiments on 8B-scale backbones show that the geometry score predicts effective shallow insertion layers under a fixed bridge-training protocol and that hidden-state recovery improves over continuous diffusion baselines in a diagnostic comparison matching the diffusion/recovery training budget. These results suggest that hidden-state geometry helps identify where diffusion-based replacement is feasible inside pretrained language models.

Abstract: Memory-augmented LLM agents have advanced personalized recommendation, yet existing approaches universally adopt flat memory representations that conflate ephemeral signals with stable preferences, and none provides a complete lifecycle governing how memory should evolve. Abstract: While LLMs are increasingly used in commercial services, they pose privacy risks such as leakage of sensitive personally identifiable information (PII). KSS measures the overall unlearning quality across multiple languages, while KPS more specifically aims to assess consistent removal of information among different language pairs. Abstract: In hybrid automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, the vocabulary size is unambiguous, typically determined by the number of phones, bi-phones, or tri-phones present in the language. In contrast, end-to-end ASR systems derive their vocabulary, often referred to as tokens from the text corpus used for training. The choice and, more importantly, the size of this vocabulary is a critical hyper-parameter in training end-to-end ASR systems. Tokenization algorithms such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE), WordPiece, and Unigram Language Model (ULM) use the vocabulary size as an input hyper-parameter to generate the sub-words employed during ASR training. Popular toolkits like ESPNet provide a fixed vocabulary size in their training recipes, but there is little documentation or discussion in the literature regarding how these values are determined. We demonstrate the utility and usefulness of our approach by applying it on a standard Librispeech corpus and show that the optimal choice of vocabulary size hyper-parameter improves the performance of the ASR. Abstract: The Context-Compliance Regime in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) occurs when retrieved context dominates

TL;DR: 本文以明代政府为培养译员而编纂的《会同馆华夷译语》（HHY，15—16世纪）为研究对象，证明它不是零散的多语词汇汇编，而是一套用汉字记录非汉语口语形式的多语转写体系：正音（MT）大体遵循汉语音节结构，副音（ST）则主要标注与汉语音系相容性较弱的语音特征，且汉字音类在转写外语时的使用比以往研究认定的更为灵活。因此HHY应被视为一种"语音近似"的系统方法，而非汉语语音直接投射到其他语言的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往学界多将《会同馆华夷译语》视为按语言分卷罗列的词汇／译名表，各自孤立研究，缺乏对其转写原则的整体把握；既有对个别语言卷的拟音重建结论彼此不统一，难以揭示跨语言层面的规律。同时，学界通常预设外语音系向汉语音系"单向投影"，但这一假设缺乏对全套语料的横向检验。研究动机在于：把HHY当作一个内部结构化的转写系统来考察，厘清其音类使用规则，并借此检验其作为历史音系学证据（尤其针对文献稀缺、记录不足的亚洲语言）的材料价值。

Method: 大规模数字化HHY语料，并与汉语音韵类别（声母、韵母、声调等音类）逐条对齐标注；对以往各语言卷的拟音重建成果进行批判性评述与整合，建立统一的跨语言比较数据库；重点考察八个语言卷中正音（Main Transcription, MT）与副音（Supplementary Transcription, ST）两个层次的跨语言规律性；方法上以音系相容性（是否符合汉语音节结构）为判定MT/ST分工的主要分析维度。

Result: 1）MT（正音）总体只记录与明代汉语音节结构相容的音值/音类；2）ST（副音）则集中承载汉语音系相容性较弱的成分，承担额外的语音信息补充功能；3）分析显示汉语音类在外语转写中被使用得比先前假说更为灵活，说明转写者具备针对不同外语音系的适应性处理，而非机械套用汉语音系；4）由此得出结论：HHY是一种相对系统化的"语音近似"（phonetic approximation）策略，而非汉语语音向非汉语的直接投射。

Conclusion: HHY可被当作一个内部结构化的多语转写系统来整体分析，其MT/ST的分工揭示出一致的音系转写原则。这一发现的方法论意义在于：历史转写体系（历史文献中的音译、译名表等）能够为历史语音学提供重要证据，对于史料与记录不足的亚洲语言尤其如此，因为此类语言往往缺乏本土的音系描写传统，汉字转写材料遂成为稀缺的音系信息来源。

Abstract: Purpose: This study investigates the transcription principles underlying Huìtóngguǎnxì Huáyíyìyǔ (HHY), a series of multilingual glossaries compiled by the Ming government between the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries for interpreter training. The study treats HHY not as a collection of isolated language materials, but as a coherent multilingual transcription system representing spoken forms of non-Chinese languages through Chinese characters.
  Methods: A substantial portion of HHY was digitized and aligned with Chinese phonological categories. Previous reconstructions of individual language sections were critically reviewed and integrated into a unified comparative database. The analysis focuses on cross-linguistic regularities in Main Transcription (MT) and Supplementary Transcription (ST) across eight language sections.
  Results: MT generally represents sounds compatible with the Chinese syllable structure of the period, whereas ST mainly encodes phonetic features less compatible with Chinese phonology. The analysis further shows that Chinese phonological categories were used more flexibly in foreign-language transcription than previously assumed. HHY therefore functioned as a relatively systematic method of phonetic approximation rather than a direct projection of Chinese phonology onto non-Chinese languages.
  Conclusion: HHY can be analyzed as an internally structured transcription system rather than merely as a collection of glossaries. More broadly, the study demonstrates that historical transcription systems can provide valuable evidence for historical phonology, particularly for under-documented Asian languages with limited historical records.

</details>

*Jingbo Yang,Kwei-Herng Lai,Xiaowen Wang,Shiyu Chang,Yaar Harari,Evgeniy Gabrilovich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出GroupMemBench基准测试，针对多用户场景下的LLM Agent记忆系统进行评估，揭示了现有系统在处理群组对话时的严重性能下降（最高仅46%准确率），并指出BM25基线方法反而与大多数Agent记忆系统表现相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM记忆系统和基准测试均基于单一用户-智能体交互的二元模式构建，然而实际部署中常涉及多用户、多通道的群组场景。现有工作忽略了群组记忆的三个关键特性：(i)超越简单拼接的群组动态特性，(ii)需要用户级别建模的说话者锚定信念追踪，(iii)需要心智理论转换的角色适应性语言表达。这导致群组记忆能力完全未被测量。

Method: 提出了GroupMemBench基准测试，包含两个核心组件：(1)基于图的合成管道（graph-grounded synthesis pipeline）：生成可控回复结构和多轮回复的多方对话，每条消息均基于用户角色和目标受众进行条件化；(2)对抗性查询管道（adversarial query pipeline）：将问题绑定到特定提问者，涵盖六类推理任务——多跳推理、知识更新、术语歧义、用户隐式推理、时间推理和弃权，采用迭代搜索策略生成具有挑战性且现实的查询。

Result: 对主流记忆系统进行基准测试揭示了显著的性能崩溃：最强系统平均准确率仅达46.0%，其中知识更新任务为27.1%，术语歧义任务为37.7%。简单的BM25基线方法在多数情况下匹配或超越Agent记忆系统。

Conclusion: 当前记忆系统采用的记忆摄入方法抹除了群组记忆所依赖的结构特征和词汇特征，导致多用户记忆问题远未解决。这表明需要重新设计记忆系统架构以保留对话结构、说话者身份和受众信息等多用户场景关键信息。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly serve as personal assistants and workplace collaborators, where their utility depends on memory systems that extract, retrieve, and apply information across long-running conversations. However, both existing memory systems and benchmarks are built around the dyadic, single-user setup, even though real deployments routinely span groups and channels with multiple users interacting with the agent and with each other. This mismatch leaves three properties of group memory unmeasured: (i) group dynamics that go beyond concatenated one-on-one chats, (ii) speaker-grounded belief tracking, where the per-user memory modeling is needed, and (iii) audience-adapted language, where Theory-of-Mind shifts produce role-specific vocabulary. We introduce GroupMemBench, a benchmark that exposes all three. A graph-grounded synthesis pipeline produces multi-party conversations with controllable reply structure and conditions each message on per-user personas and target audiences. An adversarial query pipeline then binds every question to a specific asker across six categories, spanning multi-hop reasoning, knowledge update, term ambiguity, user-implicit reasoning, temporal reasoning, and abstention, and iteratively searches challenging, realistic queries that reflect comprehensive memory capability. Benchmarking leading memory systems exposes a sharp collapse: the strongest one reaches only 46.0% average accuracy, with knowledge update at 27.1% and term ambiguity at 37.7%, while a simple BM25 baseline matches or exceeds most agent memory systems. This indicates current memory ingestion erases the structural and lexical features group memory depends on, leaving multi-user memory far from solved.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整体评估分数虽能捕获输出整体质量，但无法区分模型是复制了用户请求的结构形式还是保留了用户的具体意图。
