### [72] [Vision-Based Runtime Monitoring under Varying Specifications using Semantic Latent Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13923)
*Bardh Hoxha,Oliver Schön,Hideki Okamoto,Lars Lindemann,Georgios Fainekos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究视觉观测下past-time STL的认证运行时监控，证明语义基向量是单调1-Lipschitz可复用接口的最小预测目标，通过单次共形校准实现无联合界的片段级认证，滚动预测利于短时域、语义基利于长时域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉观测下的运行时监控需要从图像推断安全相关量并提供有限样本保证，同时需具备可复用性：训练校准后应能无需逐公式重训练即可认证任意公式。

Method: (1) 证明语义基(原子鲁棒性分数向量)是单调1-Lipschitz可复用接口中的最小预测目标；(2) 任意公式由解析树导出的确定性解码器计算；(3) 单次共形校准覆盖整个片段；(4) 滚动预测监控仅预测当前谓词值并在线重构时序历史。

Result: 语义基监控在长时域比滚动预测紧4倍；滚动预测在短时域更紧；Waymo驾驶数据验证了两个监控均满足共形覆盖保证。

Conclusion: 通过语义基向量作为最小预测目标，结合共形校准实现跨公式的无联合界保证。滚动预测在短时域更紧，语义基方法在长时域最多可达4倍更紧，Waymo真实数据验证了覆盖保证。

Abstract: We study certified runtime monitoring of past-time signal temporal logic (ptSTL) from visual observations under partial observability. The monitor must infer safety-relevant quantities from images and provide finite-sample guarantees, while being \emph{reusable}: once trained and calibrated, it should certify any formula in a target fragment without per-formula retraining. For fragments induced by a finite dictionary of temporal atoms, we prove that the \emph{semantic basis}, the vector of atom robustness scores, is the minimum prediction target within the class of monotone, 1-Lipschitz reusable interfaces: any formula is evaluated by a deterministic decoder derived from the parse tree, and a single conformal calibration pass certifies the entire fragment with no union bound. We also introduce a \emph{rolling prediction monitor} that predicts only current predicate values and reconstructs temporal history online; this is easier to learn but grows conservative at long horizons. On a pedestrian-crossroad benchmark, rolling achieves tighter certified bounds at short horizons while the semantic-basis monitor is up to 4-times tighter at long horizons. We validate the presented monitors on real-world Waymo driving data, where both monitors satisfy the conformal coverage guarantee empirically.

</details>


### [73] [Croissant Baker: Metadata Generation for Discoverable, Governable, and Reusable ML Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15079)
*Rafi Al Attrach,Rajna Fani,Sebastian Lobentanzer,Joan Giner-Miguelez,Debanshu Das,Varuni H. K.,Nobin Sarwar,Rajat Ghosh,Anwai Archit,Surbhi Motghare,Christina Conrad Parry,Luis Oala,Lara Grosso,Joaquin Vanschoren,Steffen Vogler,Sujata Goswami,Eric S. Rosenthal,Marzyeh Ghassemi,Matthew McDermott,Tom Pollard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Croissant Baker 是一个本地优先、开源的命令行工具，通过模块化处理程序注册表直接从本地数据集目录生成符合 Croissant 1.1 规范的元数据，无需将数据上传至第三方平台。作者在 140 余个数据集上评估，达到 97%–100% 的一致率，并可扩展处理 MIMIC-IV（8.86 亿行、374 个 Parquet 文件）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Croissant 已成为机器学习数据集的事实元数据标准（NeurIPS 已要求 Datasets & Benchmarks 赛道提交 Croissant 元数据），但现有生成路径都以"先上传数据到公共平台"为前提。这对受 HIPAA/DUA 治理的临床数据、受采购与安全边界约束的政府数据、被 NDA/IP 锁定的企业数据而言不可行。此外，即便允许上传，平台侧生成也缺少"恢复层"（recovery layer）：无法重建 WFDB 的 .hea/.dat 耦合、FHIR 的 Bundle/NDJSON 内容分派、Parquet 的分区逻辑表、DICOM/NIfTI 头部中的采集元数据、多波段科学 TIFF 的波段结构，因而常出现把 datetime 误判为 date、把整数 ID 误判为 text、或对波形与多波段输入输出空 schema 等失败模式。已有的智能体辅助方案（eclair MCP 服务器、mlcbakery）擅长自然语言语义字段，但既无法仅凭本地文件恢复格式特定结构，也不默认完全离线；纯 LLM 生成则存在非确定性、上下文窗口不足、无法原生解析二进制头部三重结构障碍。

Method: 提出 Croissant Baker，其两项架构承诺为：(1) 将确定性的结构推断（源自文件字节、可溯源、可复现）与语义丰富化（CLI 或智能体提供并经显式人工审核）严格分离，输出中每个字段值都可溯源到源文件字节或某个显式输入；(2) 引入类型化 handler 协议，以注册表模式分发文件，新格式只需注册一次而无需修改推断核心，并配以 fixture 数据集上的回归测试。实现为四阶段流水线：文件发现（递归遍历、SHA-256 与字节大小）→ handler 分发 → 元数据抽取 → Croissant 生成（组装为 Metadata/FileObject/RecordSet/Field，序列化为 JSON-LD，用 mlcroissant 校验）。内置 handler 覆盖 CSV/TSV（含 gzip/bz2/xz，Arrow 类型推断加时间模式识别）、Parquet（仅读 Arrow schema 元数据）、FHIR（NDJSON 批量导出与 JSON Bundle，按 resourceType 内容嗅探）、通用 JSON/JSONL、WFDB（解析 .hea 头并把 .hea/.dat/.atr 分组为一个逻辑 RecordSet）、图像（JPEG/PNG/TIFF/GIF/BMP/WebP，多波段经 tifffile）、DICOM（pydicom header-only，stop_before_pixels）、NIfTI（nibabel header-only）。评估分为两个本地划分（开发覆盖 7 个数据集 + MIMIC-IV 全量与 MEDS 全量两个规模验证）与五个留出划分（NeurIPS 2025 跨域确定性种子抽样 25 个数据集/11 个 OpenReview primary_area 桶；Open Targets 55 个生产者撰写 Croissant 的 Parquet 数据集；SMART Health IT FHIR 的 NDJSON 与 JSON Bundle 两条摄取路径；dcm_validate 六个厂商模块的配对 DICOM/NIfTI；OpenNeuro 51 个 BIDS 数据集）。指标定义为字段名恢复率 R_field、严格类型一致率 T_strict 与语义类型一致率 T_sem（数值族内视为匹配）。

Result: 本地划分：9 个数据集全部生成有效元数据，768 个 FileObject、599 个 RecordSet，全部通过 mlcroissant 校验；耗时从 0.74 s（Glaucoma Fundus，13 文件）到 32.2 s（MIMIC-IV MEDS 全量，366 Parquet，3.67 GB），MIMIC-IV 全量 9.92 GB 仅需 13.3 s。留出划分：(1) NeurIPS 2025 跨域：25 个数据集中 24 个产出有效 Croissant，唯一失败者为以 Apache Arrow 而非 Parquet 分发的 UniHG，工具干净退出并提示"未找到支持文件"；235 个共享字段的语义类型一致率 97.9%；(2) Open Targets：55/55 RecordSet 名、819/819 字段名恢复，798/819 语义类型一致（97.4%），21 处差异均为人工标注把整数值列写成 sc:Float 而工具从 Parquet schema 推断出更精确整数；(3) FHIR：NDJSON 路径 18 个 RecordSet、406 个叶字段，397/406 严格类型匹配（97.8%），8 处差异源于规范用 FHIRPath System.String（sc:Text）而工具推断出更具体的 sc:URL，1 处为 10 患者样本中十进制列仅含整数值；JSON Bundle 路径产出 11 个 RecordSet 全部有效；(4) dcm_validate：处理 6678 个 DICOM 与 75 个 NIfTI 卷，48/48 发出的 DICOM 标签标识符 100% 解析到 PS3.6 关键字；(5) OpenNeuro：51/51 数据集全部烘焙成功并通过 Croissant 1.1 校验（含 268 个 NIfTI 体、7978 个 RecordSet、13966 个表格 RecordSet）。与 Hugging Face/Kaggle 的逐数据集对比显示：Baker 提供逐文件 SHA-256 与精确字节大小（HF 为占位链接、Kaggle 仅有整包 MD5）、更精确类型（cr:Int64/sc:DateTime 区分于 sc:Text/sc:Date）、多波段与多模态下不被压平的结构（HF 输出空、Kaggle 缺 RecordSet），并自动补全许可证、引用、datePublished、版本等溯源字段。下游效用上，mlcroissant 可无数据集专用代码加载并迭代 RecordSet，跨站点模式比对（OMOP/MEDS/MIMIC-IV）简化为一次加载加集合差，受控扰动（删文件、重命名波形组件、改列名）可在分析前被校验捕获。

Conclusion: Croissant Baker 通过本地优先的自动化生成补齐了"治理排除数据"这一空白，使受控访问与长尾格式数据也能进入标准化 ML 元数据工作流。核心技术贡献在于格式感知的"恢复层"：把 WFDB 记录组装、FHIR 序列化分派、嵌套 schema 展开、无需物化载荷的成像头解析等领域知识做成一等扩展面（模块化 handler 架构），并以结构/语义分离保证可复现与可审计。局限包括：类型推断基于采样行启发式，歧义编码字段可能误判，仍需人工复核；不支持格式被跳过，无结构化表格的二进制文件仅产出 FileObject 而无 RecordSet；超大文件需完整加载可能受内存限制；不自动推断表间外键与连接关系（如 OMOP 的 concept_id 关联），关系推断与 BAM/VCF 等科学容器支持、以及 Croissant 与 Bioschemas 双向兼容均列为未来工作；Croissant 只描述结构元数据，不覆盖数据采集方法与队列定义，仍需 Datasheets for Datasets 与 Data Cards 等互补框架。鉴于错误推断的元数据可能传播至下游摄取、模式匹配与评测，并可能提高敏感数据集可见性，作者建议强制人工复核并谨慎与智能体式语义丰富化结合。

Abstract: Croissant has emerged as the metadata standard for machine learning datasets, providing a structured, JSON-LD-based format that makes dataset discovery, automated ingestion, and reproducible analysis machine-checkable across ML platforms. Adoption has accelerated, and NeurIPS now requires Croissant metadata in every submission to its dataset tracks. Yet in practice Croissant generation usually starts with uploading data to a public platform, a path infeasible for governed and large local repositories that hold much of the high-value data ML increasingly relies on. We release Croissant Baker, a local-first, open-source command-line tool that generates validated Croissant metadata directly from a dataset directory through a modular handler registry. We evaluate Croissant Baker on over 140 datasets, scaling to MIMIC-IV at 886 million rows and 374 Parquet files. On held-out comparisons against producer-authored or standards-derived ground truth, Croissant Baker reaches 97-100% agreement across multiple domains.

</details>


### [74] [Mechanistic Interpretability of EEG Foundation Models via Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13930)
*William Lehn-Schiøler,Magnus Ruud Kjær,Rahul Thapa,Magnus Guldberg Pedersen,Anton Storgaard Mosquera,Nick Williams,Radu Gatej,Tue Lehn-Schiøler,Sándor Beniczky,Sadasivan Puthusserypady,James Zou,Lars Kai Hansen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过稀疏自编码器对三种EEG transformer基础模型进行可解释性分析，建立了一套基于临床分类学（异常、年龄、性别、药物）的单语义性基准，揭示了模型表征中的wrecking-ball效应和临床概念纠缠现象，并通过频谱解码器将潜在操作转化为可解释的生理频率特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型虽达到临床最优性能，但其内部计算机制不透明，阻碍了临床信任；需要打开这个"黑箱"以建立可解释的临床决策基础。

Method: 使用TopK稀疏自编码器(SAE)在三种不同架构的EEG transformer（SleepFM、REVE、LaBraM）上提取稀疏特征字典；通过概念导向（concept steering）和"目标vs脱靶"探针区域度量量化转向选择性；使用频谱解码器将潜在操作映射回振幅频谱。

Result: 发现了三种可操作性机制：选择性可转向、已编码但纠缠、不可编码；揭示了" wrecking-ball"干预会导致全局模型性能崩溃；发现临床概念纠缠（如年龄-病理混淆）；成功将潜在操纵转化为生理可解释的频率特征如病理性慢波抑制和α波段恢复。

Conclusion: SAE技术能够揭示EEG基础模型中的关键表征问题（ wrecking-ball效应、临床概念纠缠），并通过频谱解码器将潜在空间操作转化为可解释的生理频率特征，为EEG模型的临床可解释性提供了系统性分析框架。

Abstract: EEG foundation models achieve state-of-the-art clinical performance, yet the internal computations driving their predictions remain opaque: a barrier to clinical trust. We apply TopK Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) across three architecturally distinct EEG transformers: SleepFM, REVE, and LaBraM to extract sparse feature dictionaries from their embeddings. By grounding these features in a clinical taxonomy (abnormality, age, sex, and medication), we benchmark monosemanticity and entanglement across architectures. A single hyperparameter procedure, driven by an intrinsic dictionary health audit, transfers robustly across all three architectures. Via concept steering, we introduce a "target vs. off-target" probe area metric to quantify steering selectivity and reveal three operational regimes: selectively steerable, encoded but entangled, and non-encoded. This framework exposes critical representational failures: "wrecking-ball" interventions that collapse global model performance, and clinical entanglements, such as age-pathology confounding, where it is impossible to suppress one concept without corrupting the other. Finally, a spectral decoder maps these interventions back to the amplitude spectrum, translating latent manipulations into physiologically interpretable frequency signatures, such as pathological slow-wave suppression and $α$-band restoration.

</details>


### [75] [Rethinking Molecular OOD Generalization via Target-Aware Source Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13932)
*Zhuohao Lin,Kun Li,Jiameng Chen,Jiajun Yu,Duanhua Cao,Yizhen Zheng,Wenbin Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE-BENCH基准和POMA框架来解决分子属性预测中的极端分布外场景问题，通过簇级划分和强化学习引导的多源域适应提升模型在药物发现场景下的真实外推能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脚手架划分协议无法阻断微观语义重叠，导致模型产生捷径学习并高估真实外推能力；同时传统域适应方法在极端结构偏移下性能退化，因盲目对齐异构源库会注入拓扑噪声并触发负迁移。

Method: SCOPE-BENCH：基于显式理化描述符空间的簇级划分构建基准；POMA：检索-组合-自适应管道，结合强化学习策略自适应选择最优源子集，并在宏观拓扑和微观药效基团尺度执行双尺度域适应。

Conclusion: POMA框架在多样骨干架构上平均相对提升6.2%，MAE最高降低11.2%；SCOPE-BENCH为分子属性预测的OOD评估提供了更严格的基准。

Abstract: Robust prediction of molecular properties under extreme out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios is a pivotal bottleneck in AI-driven drug discovery. Current scaffold-splitting protocols fail to obstruct microscopic semantic overlap, predisposing models to shortcut learning and overestimating their true extrapolation capability; meanwhile, conventional domain adaptation paradigms suffer under extreme structural shifts, as blindly aligning heterogeneous source libraries injects topological noise and triggers negative transfer. To address these two challenges, scaffold-cluster out-of-distribution performance evaluation benchmark (SCOPE-BENCH), a benchmark built on cluster-level partitioning in an explicit physicochemical descriptor space, is proposed alongside policy optimization for multi-source adaptation (POMA), a framework that formulates knowledge transfer as a retrieve-compose-adapt pipeline: labeled source scaffolds structurally close to the unlabeled target are first identified as proxy targets; a reinforcement learning policy then adaptively selects the optimal source subset from an exponentially large candidate pool; and dual-scale domain adaptation is finally performed at macroscopic topological and microscopic pharmacophore scales. Evaluations show that prediction errors of state-of-the-art 3D molecular models surge by up to 8.0x on SCOPE-BENCH with a mean of 5.9x, while POMA achieves up to an 11.2% reduction in mean absolute error with an average relative improvement of 6.2% across diverse backbone architectures. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散MRI（dMRI）跨站点、跨扫描仪、跨协议的采集异质性会显著改变FA/MD等扩散指标、纤维追踪结果及结构连接组，使同一被试在不同协议下的连接组产生实质差异，从而在多中心分析中难以区分采集效应与真实生物学差异。现有解决方案主要分两类：一是ComBat等统计协调方法与依赖预定义站点/扫描仪标签的自编码器、图神经网络、条件VAE、对抗式去域框架；二是纯无监督降维方法（VAE、PCA）把所有变异建模为连续变量，导致采集效应被吸收进连续潜空间。作者希望构建一种无需站点标签、可在单一数据集内部发现采集结构（站点划分定义为"扫描仪–协议"唯一配对，共25个）的无监督模型。同时，原始混合潜空间模型（Joint-VAE, Dupont 2018）依赖 hinge-margin 手工设定连续/离散容量上界 C_c、C_d 与权重 β，对 C_c 高度敏感，容量设定不当会定性改变信息分配方式，亟需一种无需人工调参的容量平衡机制。

Abstract: Acquisition differences across sites, scanners, and protocols in dMRI introduce variability that complicates structural connectome analysis. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods model all variance as continuous, so acquisition effects often get absorbed into a continuous latent space. Recent hybrid latent-space models combine discrete and continuous components to address this, but typically require manual capacity tuning to ensure the discrete component captures the intended variability. We introduce an unsupervised framework that removes this manual tuning by architecturally annealing encoder outputs before decoding, allowing the model to adaptively balance discrete and continuous latent variables during training. Results show that a hybrid continuous-discrete latent space, with architectural rather than loss-based annealing, provides a useful unsupervised mechanism for capturing acquisition variability in dMRI: by jointly modeling smooth and categorical structure, the Joint-VAE recovers clusters aligned with scanner and protocol differences.

### [77] [Beyond Mode-Seeking RL: Trajectory-Balance Post-Training for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13935)
*Saba Ahmadi,Prasanna Parthasarathi,Yufei Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TraFL（Trajectory Flow Balancing），一种面向扩散语言模型（dLLM）后训练的轨迹平衡（trajectory-balance）目标。作者指出当前 dLLM 后训练普遍沿用"奖励最大化"范式，会引发"轨迹锁定"（trajectory locking）失效模式：采样式奖励驱动更新把概率质量过度集中到少数去噪路径上，削弱重复采样下对其他正确解的覆盖。为此 TraFL 将策略训练到一个以冻结参考模型为锚、奖励倾斜（reward-tilted）的目标分布 p*(τ|x) ∝ p_ref(τ|x)·exp(βr)，用掩码重建下界导出的扩散兼容序列级代理 log p̂_θ(y|x) 与一个可学习的、依赖 prompt 的归一化项 log Z_φ(x) 加以实现。基于 LLaDA-8B-Instruct（LoRA r=128），在 GSM8K/MATH-500/HumanEval/MBPP 上，TraFL 是唯一在全部 8 个"基准×长度"设置中均优于基座模型的后训练方法（平均 +2.0 Pass@5 分），且优势随采样预算增大而扩大；在留出评测 Minerva Math 与 LiveCodeBench 上同样领先（LCB 总体 53.8→62.6 / 61.4→66.3），LLM-as-a-judge 评估进一步表明增益来自更广的正确解策略覆盖而非单峰锐化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（LLaDA、Dream 等）作为自回归模型的替代路线在推理与代码生成上已展现潜力，但其后训练方法几乎全部沿用自回归 RL 的"奖励最大化"目标（diffu-GRPO、wd1、SPG、ESPO、JustGRPO、DMPO 等）。作者观察到这类方法存在一个共同失效模式——轨迹锁定（trajectory locking）：奖励只依赖最终补全，对产生该补全的去噪路径无差别；采样式策略梯度只对被采样到的轨迹回传梯度，早期被采样更多的路径获得更多正更新、概率进一步增大、后续采样更多，形成自强集中，使概率质量塌缩到窄路径集合。同时理论上，轨迹多样性是解模式覆盖的必要条件（|supp(M)| ≤ |supp(τ)|、H(M) ≤ H(τ)），路径塌缩必然导致解覆盖塌缩。此外，分布匹配类方法（DMPO、FlowRL）虽改用奖励倾斜目标，但其 Z 的处理（batch-softmax 归一化）仍具 rollout-local 特性，会重新引入集中问题。核心问题因此是：什么后训练目标既避免轨迹锁定又保持可实现性。

Method: TraFL 将策略对齐到参考锚定的奖励倾斜轨迹分布：p*(τ|x) = (1/Z(x))·p_ref(τ|x)·exp(βr(x,y))，β>0 控制奖励锐度，Z(x) 为 prompt 依赖归一化项。据此定义轨迹平衡残差 δ(τ,x)=log p_θ(τ|x) − log p_ref(τ|x) − βr(x,y) + log Z(x)，最小化 L = E_{τ~p_θ}[δ²]。两项关键实现：(1) 扩散兼容的序列级代理——由掩码重建下界推导的 log p̂_θ(y|x)=E_l E_{y_l}[(1/l)Σ_{masked i} log p_θ(y_i|y_l,x)]，对当前模型与参考模型使用相同掩码模式并用 4 组对偶（antithetic）复制降低方差，掩码仅作用于非 EOS 位置；1/l 因子用于消除掩码个数带来的计数依赖（类比 Dr. GRPO 的长度偏置修正），且明确不是序列长度归一化。(2) 可学习的 prompt 依赖归一化 log Z_φ(x)：2 层 MLP 作用于均值池化的 prompt 隐状态（backbone 特征 detach），与策略联合训练，每步都获得梯度信号。算法为完全在线 RL：每步采样 G=5 条 rollout，组内奖励中心化作为方差缩减启发式，计算 δ 后一步梯度更新。基座模型为 LLaDA-8B-Instruct，LoRA r=128、α=128，峰值学习率 6e-5 余弦衰减至 6e-6。数学分别用 GSM8K(7473) 与 MATH(7500) 独立训练，代码用 AceCode-89K 过滤(11937)+KodCode-Light-RL-10K 过滤(2695) 混合。奖励均为二值（数学精确匹配、代码执行测试通过）。评测使用 fastdLLM 并行解码、块长 32、低置信度掩码策略，最大长度 256/512，top-p=0.91，Pass@k 用 HumanEval 无偏估计器（n=16）。基线为 JustGRPO 与 ESPO 的公开 checkpoint（D1、DMPO 无公开权重，仅列其论文数值）；并给出理论分析：命题1（终端奖励对路径无差别）、定理1（轨迹多样性上界模式覆盖）、推论1、单纯形/复制子动力学视角下 DMPO 的 batch-softmax Ẑ 仍导致集中，以及理想轨迹平衡分解 P_F(τ|y,x)=P_B(τ|y,x) 的说明。

Result: 1) 采样鲁棒性：TraFL 在所有 k∈{1,2,4,8,16} 与 T∈{0.3,0.6,0.9} 下均优于基座，含 Pass@1；增益在 T=0.9、k 增大时最大，Pass@k 随预算稳定上升，说明受益于探索性采样而非饱和。因基座在 T=0.6 最强，主对比取 T=0.6（保守设置），TraFL 在 Pass@1–16 全程领先 ESPO、JustGRPO 与基座。2) Pass@5：TraFL 是唯一在 8 个"基准×长度"设置全部为正提升的方法，平均 +2.0 分；MATH-500@256 由 50.2→54.6，HumanEval 53.2→54.8（256）、53.7→55.7（512），MBPP 59.1→62.1（256）、59.2→62.0（512），GSM8K 两长度小幅提升。ESPO 在 GSM8K-512、HumanEval-256 低于基座，JustGRPO 在 GSM8K/HumanEval/MATH-500@512 下降。3) 去噪步数：TraFL 与基座、ESPO 相当，而 JustGRPO 明显提前终止但无一致增益，作者推测其可能是过早轨迹锁定。4) 留出迁移：Minerva Math 上 TraFL 两个长度均高于基座（256 长度 ESPO 略优 71.2–71.4 vs 69.5–70.7；512 长度 TraFL 最佳，GSM8K 训练 76.3、MATH 训练 75.8）；LiveCodeBench 上 TraFL 在全部难度划分与两个长度上最佳，总体 53.8→62.6（256）、61.4→66.3（512），256 长度 medium +7.9、hard +13.6，且超 JustGRPO 12.9/27.6 分，而 ESPO 与 JustGRPO 总体低于基座。5) LLM-as-a-judge 多样性评估（GPT-5-4，MATH-500 与 LCB，各 16 条样本）：正确解设定下 TraFL 显著优于基座（MATH-500 p=0.006，LCB p=4.1e-5），也显著优于 ESPO（14.3% vs 5.6%，p=0.001；38.3% vs 26.4%，p=7.8e-4）；全样本设定下仅 MATH-500 显著（p=0.023），LCB 不显著；ESPO 相对基座在两个基准均无显著多样性增益。6) 局限：代理仅是理想轨迹对数概率的近似、性能依赖掩码与 MC 估计设计；二值终端奖励过粗，全对或全错 prompt 无相对学习信号。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是指出并形式化了 dLLM 后训练中的"轨迹锁定"失效模式，并提出 TraFL——一个参考锚定、奖励倾斜的轨迹平衡后训练目标：奖励只负责决定高奖励补全获得多少概率质量，冻结参考模型负责锚定这些质量在合理轨迹与解之间的相对分配，从而在提升单样本与多样本 Pass@k 的同时保住并扩展正确解的多样覆盖。实证上，TraFL 在所有评测基准–长度设置中一致优于基座模型，平均优于 ESPO 与 JustGRPO，优势随采样预算上升而扩大，且可迁移到 Minerva Math 与 LiveCodeBench；judge 评估表明增益源于更广的正确解策略覆盖而非单峰锐化。作者希望推动 dLLM 后训练从"奖励最大化"转向"分布匹配/轨迹平衡"范式的进一步探索，并提示需关注代理近似偏差、二值奖励粗糙以及代码/推理能力增强带来的误用与误导风险。

Abstract: Diffusion language models are a promising alternative to autoregressive models, yet post-training methods for them largely adapt reward-maximizing objectives. We identify a central failure mode in this setting we call trajectory locking: sampled reward-driven updates over-concentrate probability mass onto a narrow set of denoising paths, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions under repeated sampling. To address this, we propose TraFL (Trajectory Flow baLancing), a trajectory-balance objective that trains the policy toward a reward-tilted target distribution anchored to a frozen reference model. We make this practical for diffusion language models with a diffusion-compatible sequence-level surrogate and a learned prompt-dependent normalization. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, TraFL is the only evaluated post-training method that improves over the base model in every benchmark-length setting, with gains that persist as the sampling budget increases. The improvements transfer to held-out evaluations: TraFL stays above the base model on Minerva Math and is the strongest method on every LiveCodeBench difficulty split.

</details>


### [78] [Towards the Next Frontier of LLMs, Training on Private Data: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Federated Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13936)
*Daniel M. Jimenez-Gutierrez,Enrique Zuazua,Georgios Kellaris,Joaquin del Rio,Oleksii Sliusarenko,Xabi Uribe-Etxebarria*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: Federated PEFT是可行的LLM适应方法，在保护数据隐私的同时接近中心化训练性能，QLoRA和IA3在效率与精度间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: The recent success of large language models (LLMs) has been largely driven by vast public datasets. However, the next frontier for LLM development lies beyond public data. Much of the world's most valuable information is private, especially in highly regulated sectors such as healthcare and finance, where data include patient histories or customer communications. Unlocking this data could represent a major leap forward, enabling LLMs with deeper domain expertise and stronger real-world utility. Yet, these data cannot be shared because they are distributed across institutions and constrained by privacy, regulatory, and organizational barriers. Moreover, institutional datasets are typically non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID), differing across sites in population characteristics, data modalities, documentation patterns, and task-specific label distributions.
  In this paper, we demonstrate a practical approach to unlocking private and distributed institutional data for LLM adaptation through federated collaboration across data silos. Built on the Sherpa.ai Federated Learning platform, our framework enables nodes to jointly fine-tune a shared LLM without exchanging private data. We evaluate this approach through a cross-domain benchmark in healthcare and finance, using four closed-ended question answering and classification datasets: MedQA, MedMCQA, FPB, and FiQA-SA. We compare three parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies-LoRA, QLoRA, and IA3-across pretrained backbones under non-IID settings reflecting institutional data heterogeneity. Our results show that federated fine-tuning performs close to centralized training and outperforms isolated single-institution learning. From a Green AI perspective, QLoRA and IA3 improve efficiency with limited accuracy degradation, supporting federated PEFT as a viable approach for adapting LLMs where data cannot be shared.

</details>


### [79] [EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13941)
*Jiaqi Liu,Xinyu Ye,Peng Xia,Zeyu Zheng,Cihang Xie,Mingyu Ding,Huaxiu Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvolveMem是一个自进化记忆架构，通过LLM诊断模块将检索配置作为可优化动作空间，在闭环中自动进行配置调整和策略发现，实现了无需人工干预的AutoResearch过程，在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆对跨多会话运行的LLM agent至关重要，但现有记忆系统将检索基础设施视为固定的：存储内容演进而评分函数、融合策略和答案生成策略在部署时保持冻结。作者认为真正自适应记忆需要在两个层面协同进化：存储的知识和查询它的检索机制。

Method: EvolveMem将完整检索配置作为结构化动作空间暴露出来，由LLM驱动的诊断模块进行优化。每个进化轮次中，模块读取逐问题失败日志，识别根本原因，提出针对性配置调整；受保护的元分析器以自动回归回滚和停滞探索 safeguard 的方式应用这些调整。

Result: 在LoCoMo基准上比最强基线相对提升25.7%，相比最小基线相对提升78.0%；在MemBench基准上比最强基线相对提升18.9%。进化的配置在跨基准迁移时表现出正向迁移（而非灾难性迁移），说明自进化过程捕获的是通用检索原理。

Conclusion: EvolveMem实现了一个AutoResearch流程，系统自主对自身架构进行迭代研究循环，替代了手动配置调优。从最小基线开始，该过程自主收敛，发现了有效的检索策略，包括原始动作空间中完全不存在的全新配置维度。在LoCoMo上比最强基线相对提升25.7%，比最小基线相对提升78.0%；在MemBench上比最强基线相对提升18.9%。进化后的配置跨基准迁移时呈现正向而非灾难性迁移，表明自进化过程捕获的是通用检索原理而非基准特定启发式方法。

Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for LLM agents that operate across multiple sessions, yet existing memory systems treat retrieval infrastructure as fixed: stored content evolves while scoring functions, fusion strategies, and answer-generation policies remain frozen at deployment. We argue that truly adaptive memory requires co-evolution at two levels: the stored knowledge and the retrieval mechanism that queries it. We present EvolveMem, a self-evolving memory architecture that exposes its full retrieval configuration as a structured action space optimized by an LLM-powered diagnosis module. In each evolution round, the module reads per-question failure logs, identifies root causes, and proposes targeted configuration adjustments; a guarded meta-analyzer applies them with automatic revert-on-regression and explore-on-stagnation safeguards. This closed-loop self-evolution realizes an AutoResearch process: the system autonomously conducts iterative research cycles on its own architecture, replacing manual configuration tuning. Starting from a minimal baseline, the process converges autonomously, discovering effective retrieval strategies including entirely new configuration dimensions not present in the original action space. On LoCoMo, EvolveMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 25.7% relative and achieves a 78.0% relative improvement over the minimal baseline. On MemBench, EvolveMem exceeds the strongest baseline by 18.9% relative. Evolved configurations transfer across benchmarks with positive rather than catastrophic transfer, indicating that the self-evolution process captures universal retrieval principles rather than benchmark-specific heuristics. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem.

</details>


### [80] [EMA: Efficient Model Adaptation for Learning-based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13942)
*Daiyang Yu,Xinyu Chen,Yihan Zhang,Yan Liang,Yaqi Qiao,Fan Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EMA 是首个面向学习型系统（网络/云资源管理、流量工程、流仿真、ABR 流媒体等）的通用模型适配系统。它以"系统驱动、数据中心"为思路，完全工作在模型与系统逻辑之外的输入数据层：通过基于 MMD/TCA 的"状态变换器"把新环境输入对齐到最相似的历史环境，从而复用已训练模型实现热启动；再通过成本感知的"标注代理"优先采集高效用、低成本标签；最后由"适配编排器"在训练与标注之间做边际收益-成本权衡。在 8 个代表性系统上，EMA 将适配成本（GPU/标注时间）降低 14.9%–42.4%，适配速度提升 2.3–15.3×，适配后系统性能提升 6.9%–31.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型系统（LR/LSTM/DL/RL/LLM）依赖模型与运行环境状态的匹配，但网络系统状态天然异质、长期运行且持续动态：在基础设施（集群规模、硬件、带宽）、工作负载（流/作业规模分布）与运营目标（延迟-吞吐-公平性权衡）三个维度上不断漂移，同一部署内也会因流量动态、机器升级而变化。动机证据显示：Sizeless 在新函数/新基础设施上决策质量大幅下降甚至崩塌；FIRM 不做应用级适配时性能退化 4.5%–79.2%；即便持续微调也可能因"负迁移"（negative transfer）反而不如从头训练（FLUX、FIRM 均出现），说明简单迁移不可靠。适配开销高昂：云微服务管理因 1034 个服务旋钮需 24 小时调参，期间性能退化最多 26%；NetLLM 微调约 340 A100 GPU 时（约 $458），而数据标注约 572 VM 时（约 $476），且环境一变就要重付；标注成本高度异质（10× 资源配置的评估远贵于 2×）。现有方案的缺陷：多为任务专用的一次性技巧（按带宽归一化信号）、需要侵入式改造（在模型中插入元学习器，如 Flash）、局限于单一部署的持续学习（Caravan），普遍忽视数据标注成本这一端到端主导项，也缺乏"何时标注、标注哪些、标注多少"的推理机制。结果是开发者需为每个系统/工作负载/环境反复定制适配流水线，导致工程复杂、周转慢、适配后性能次优。

Method: 三阶段协同流水线（Python 原型约 3200 行，通过 PyTorch 标准化 API + gRPC 与中心状态库通信，集成仅需数行代码）：
1) State Transformer（训练前状态适配，降低训练算力）：在共享高斯核潜在空间 G 中求解 min_W MMD(Φ(S), W·Φ(T))（迁移成分分析 TCA）以对齐源/目标状态分布；提出 regime-aware 分组对齐——先对源与目标状态聚类为"运行regime"，为每个目标 regime 选 MMD 最小的源 regime 并单独求变换矩阵，避免单一全局变换把长尾的大作业/象限流折叠进主导 regime；MMD 作为任务无关的相似度用于源环境选择，实验显示其与收敛速度/适配后精度呈更强正相关（优于 L2 距离）；可扩展性上用采样状态变换（基于集中不等式，m ≥ -(1/2ε²)ln((1-δ)/2)，仅需数千样本）与 K-medoids 聚类匹配（直接复用成对 MMD 距离，无需异构特征嵌入），匹配代价 C(K)=K+M/K，最优 K=√M，使数百状态时变换延迟 < 4 秒。
2) Labeling Agent（训练中适配，优化数据效率）：以轻量预测不确定性作为数据效用代理（分类用 top-2 置信度差，回归/RL 用预测区间宽度），因为模型最不确信的样本学习增益最大；放弃预算化背包 ILP（对离群点、长尾冗余、非平稳效用脆弱），改为按"效用/成本"比值成比例的概率化采样直到耗尽本轮预算，天然平滑离群与冗余。
3) Adaptation Orchestrator（跨轮编排）：比较"继续训练"与"标注后训练"的边际单位成本收益——用 1% 的代理数据集以 p·B_t 预算标注，测得不确定度下降并按 1/p 缩放为无偏估计 ΔU^label_t，结合训练样本数增量把训练成本修正为 C*_t = C_t(1+Δn_t/n_t)，仅当标注的收益成本比超过继续训练时才开启新一轮；预算 B_t 用 AIMD 反馈调节（比值下降则增预算加速收敛，否则减半避免过度标注）。另设 StateStore：每状态缓存模型与数百条样本，采用衰减感知 LFU 淘汰（访问频率按 0.9/天衰减），相似状态间淘汰精度较低者，并支持可配置的访问控制（同组织限定）与本地加噪的差分隐私友好性。
整体为"系统驱动、数据中心"：仅作用于系统输入数据层，不修改模型架构与系统逻辑。

Result: 在 SIGCOMM/NSDI/OSDI 的 8 个代表性系统上评估（DOTE/DNN WAN 流量工程、FIRM/RL 微服务资源管理、Flux/LR 流大小预测、MimicNet/LSTM 数据中心流仿真、IDS-LSTM/LSTM 流式入侵检测、Pensieve/RL ABR、NetLLM/LLM 的 ABR 与集群作业调度），30 节点集群（10×A100 + 20 CPU 节点），结果为 5 次平均，基线为默认训练、Caravan、Flash：适配成本降低 14.9%–42.4%（GCP 计价），达到目标精度所需训练量减少 2.3–15.3×，适配后系统性能提升 6.9%–31.3%（Pensieve QoE +31.3%、DOTE 吞吐 +12.5%、FIRM 复合奖励 +6.9%）；在线 FLUX 作业流式部署与流式 IDS 场景下 EMA 紧贴 oracle 表现。组件拆解：State Transformer 使 cost-to-accuracy 改善 10.7%，Labeling Agent+Orchestrator 改善 45.1%；考虑异质标注成本明显优于只按效用选取（成本感知优于成本无关的 AL）；系统开销仅 0.3%–2.9%；状态库规模 1–500 时性能稳定（约 12 个候选即可近最优）；采样量超过数千后收益趋平，验证轻量采样；源数据加高斯噪声（0/0.5/1/3）后适配性能基本不受影响。附录 C 显示在 NetLLM 集群作业调度上，训练期适配模块在同等性能下可再省 22.5% 成本。

Conclusion: EMA 首次给出一个通用、模型无关、可低侵入部署的模型适配系统框架，把"适配"从一次性手工流程转为可复用、数据中心的在线服务：状态变换器对齐分布以复用既有模型权重与数据，标注代理与编排器以成本-收益视角联合优化训练与数据采集，状态库支撑跨请求缓存与演化。它证明在多种模型族（LR/LSTM/DL/RL/LLM）与多类系统任务上可同时获得"更快、更便宜、更好"：成本降低 14.9%–42.4%、速度提升 2.3–15.3×、性能提升 6.9%–31.3%，且运行时开销不足 3%、对隐私噪声鲁棒。附录给出隐私定理（加噪后 MMD 变化为 O(‖η_max‖²)）与 DKW 采样界支撑其"轻量采样 + 隐私合规"的设计。局限与后续方向：仍依赖状态分布相似性假设的源选择质量，变换矩阵与 MMD 计算为一次性预处理成本，长尾与极端环境下的 regime 划分鲁棒性、以及在标注渠道受限场景下的效用代理精度仍有进一步探索空间。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly applied to optimize system performance in tasks such as resource management and network simulation. Unlike traditional ML tasks (e.g., image classification), networked systems often operate in heterogeneous, long-running, and dynamic environment states, where input conditions (e.g., network loads) and operational objectives can shift over time and across settings. Existing learning-based systems offer little support for adaptation, resulting in costly model training, extensive data collection, degraded system performance, and slow responsiveness.
  This paper presents EMA, the first model adaptation system supporting learning-based systems to adapt to evolving environments with minimal operational overhead. EMA takes a system-driven, data-centric approach that accommodates diverse system and model designs while addressing two key deployment challenges. First, it reduces expensive model training by introducing state transformers that align the input state of a new environment with previously similar states, allowing models to warm-start adaptation. Second, it addresses the often-overlooked yet costly process of data labeling--collecting ground truth for exploring and training on various system decisions--by prioritizing labeling high-utility data while balancing the tradeoff between training and labeling cost. Evaluations on eight representative learning-based systems show that EMA reduces adaptation costs (e.g., GPU training time) by 14.9-42.4% while improving system performance (e.g., network throughput) by 6.9-31.3%.

</details>


### [81] [A Unified Geometric Framework for Weighted Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13943)
*Raphael Vock,Edouard Duchesnay,Benoit Dufumier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题，揭示了不同对比学习目标（SupCon、Soft SupCon、y-Aware CL等）的几何特性与最优嵌入形式，发现加权方案是决定对比学习几何可实现性、一致性的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比学习旨在通过学习反映相似图的表示来保留样本间的结构关系，但其嵌入空间的几何特性尚未被充分理解。

Method: 将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题(DGP)，通过目标几何实现的角度分析最优嵌入；分析了有监督分类和连续标签场景下的多种对比学习目标。

Result: （1）有监督分类中：平衡SupCon恢复经典正则单纯形几何，但类不平衡破坏对称性；Soft SupCon无论类是否平衡都保持正则单纯形几何；（2）连续标签设置中：y-Aware CL通常无法达到其熵最优，除非标签位于超球面上，揭示了欧几里得标签权重与球面潜在相似性之间的不匹配；（3）几何一致的选择如欧几里得-欧几里得加权或X-CLR具有唯一最优嵌入。

Conclusion: 加权方案决定对比学习在几何上是否可实现、退化或不一致，为设计对比目标提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: Contrastive learning (CL) aims to preserve relational structure between samples by learning representations that reflect a similarity graph. Yet, the geometry of the resulting embeddings remains poorly understood. Here we show that weighted InfoNCE objectives can be interpreted as Distance Geometry Problems, where the weighting scheme specifies the target geometry to be realized by the representation. This viewpoint yields exact characterizations of the optimal embeddings for several supervised and weakly supervised objectives. In supervised classification, both SupCon and Soft SupCon (a dense relaxation of it where pairs from distinct classes have small non-zero similarity) collapse samples within each class to a single prototype. However, while balanced SupCon recovers the classical regular simplex geometry, class imbalance breaks this symmetry: SupCon induces non-uniform inter-class similarities depending on class sizes, whereas Soft SupCon preserves a regular simplex geometry regardless of class imbalance. In continuous-label settings, our framework reveals a different failure mode: y-Aware CL generally cannot attain its entropic optimum unless the labels lie on a hypersphere, exposing a mismatch between Euclidean label weights and spherical latent similarity. By contrast, geometrically consistent choices such as Euclidean-Euclidean weighting or X-CLR admit unique optimal embeddings. Our results show that the choice of weighting scheme determines whether contrastive learning is geometrically realizable, degenerate, or inconsistent, providing a principled framework for designing contrastive objectives.

</details>


### [82] [Quantum Advantage in Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14235)
*Simranjeet Singh Dahia,Claudia Szabo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过CHSH博弈和CoopNav导航任务，首次在有数学证明的经典基准下验证了QMARL的量子优势。实验表明纠缠（而非量子电路本身）是实现协调增益的关键，且量子演员与经典评论家的混合架构可达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有QMARL研究缺乏可证明的基准线，导致无法严格区分量子优势与算法偶发现象，限制了量子多智能体强化学习领域的可信发展。

Method: 采用去中心化QMARL框架结合变分量子电路(VQC)演员，在CHSH博弈和CoopNav导航任务中进行评估。通过对比纠缠态与独立态的表现，消融分析不同贝尔态结构的影响，并测试量子-经典混合配置的效能。

Result: CHSH博弈中，纠缠QMARL智能体达到Tsirelson极限0.854（经典上限0.75），证明量子优势；独立量子电路仅匹配经典基线，确认纠缠是核心协调机制；部分贝尔态可提升协调性能，而其他贝尔态反而损害性能；CoopNav任务中，无纠缠QMARL较经典MAA2C提升约2倍（0.85 vs 0.40）；量子演员+经典评论家的混合配置表现最优。

Conclusion: 本研究为QMARL中的量子纠缠优势提供了实证证据，表明纠缠（而非量子电路本身）是实现协调增益的关键机制。混合架构（量子演员+经典评论家）表现出最优性能，为后续研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: We present an empirical evaluation of quantum entanglement in agent coordination within quantum multi agent reinforcement learning (QMARL). While QMARL has attracted growing interest recently, most prior work evaluates quantum policies without provable baselines, making it impossible to rigorously distinguish quantum advantage from algorithmic coincidence. We address this directly by evaluating a decentralized QMARL framework with variational quantum circuit (VQC) actors with shared entangled states. In the CHSH game, which has a mathematically proven classical performance ceiling of 0.75 win rate, we show that entangled QMARL agents approach the Tsirelson limit of 0.854, providing clear evidence of their quantum advantage. We show that unentangled quantum circuits match the classical baseline, confirming that entanglement and not the quantum circuit itself is the active coordination mechanism. We also explore the effect of specific entanglement structures, as some Bell states enable coordination gains while others actively harm performance. On cooperative navigation (CoopNav), QMARL without entanglement achieves $\sim2\times$ improvement in success rate over classical MAA2C ($\sim$0.85 versus $\sim$0.40), with the hybrid configuration, quantum actor paired with a classical centralised critic, outperforming both fully classical and fully quantum solutions. We present our experimental analysis and discuss future work.

</details>


### [83] [Collider-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents with Particle Physics Analysis Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13950)
*Darius A. Faroughy,Sofia Palacios Schweitzer,Ian Pang,Siddharth Mishra-Sharma,David Shih*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Collider-Bench是一个评估LLM智能体能否仅使用公开论文和开源软件复现大型强子对撞机(LHC)实验分析的基准测试。该基准解决了现有评估工具无法捕捉真实科学研究复杂性的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体基准测试很少捕捉真实科学工作的复杂性和细微差别。LHC分析的复现尤为困难，因为公共工具链仅近似于实验合作内部使用的软件，且已发表论文必然省略了忠实重建所需的实现细节。智能体必须依靠物理推理、领域知识和试错来填补这些空白。

Method: 任务要求智能体将已发表分析转化为可执行的模拟-选择流程，并在指定信号区域提交预测的碰撞事件产额。使用标准直方图度量进行评估，提供连续保真度分数而非人工编写的评分标准。同时使用LLM评判器检测定性失败模式（如编造、幻觉和重复）。在通用编程智能体能力阶梯上进行评估。

Result: 平均而言，没有任何智能体能够可靠地超越物理学家参与（physicist-in-the-loop）的解决方案。

Conclusion: Collider-Bench为评估LLM智能体的科学推理能力提供了一个现实的基准，结果表明当前智能体在复杂科学复现任务中仍有显著差距。

Abstract: Autonomous language-model agents are increasingly evaluated on long-horizon tool-use tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely capture the complexity and nuance of real scientific work. To address this gap, we introduce Collider-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can reproduce experimental analyses from the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) using only public papers and open scientific software. Such analyses are often difficult to reproduce because the public toolchain only approximates the software used internally by the experimental collaborations, while the published papers inevitably omit implementation details needed for a faithful reconstruction. Agents must therefore rely on physical reasoning, domain knowledge, and trial-and-error to fill these gaps. Each task requires the agent to turn a published analysis into an executable simulation-and-selection pipeline and submit predicted collision event yields in specified signal regions. These predictions are evaluated with standard histogram metrics that provide continuous fidelity scores without a hand-written rubric. We also report the computational cost incurred by each agent per task. Finally, we evaluate the codebase and full session trace using an LLM judge to catch qualitative failure modes such as fabrications, hallucinations and duplications. We release an initial set of tasks drawn from LHC searches, together with a containerized sandbox and event simulation tools. We evaluate across a capability ladder of general purpose coding agents. Our results show that on average no agent reliably beats the physicist-in-the-loop solution.

</details>


### [84] [Data-Augmented Game Starts for Accelerating Self-Play Exploration in Imperfect Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14379)
*JB Lanier,Nathan Monette,Pierre Baldi,Roy Fox*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DAGS addresses sparse rewards and exploration challenges in imperfect-information zero-sum games by initializing RL exploration at strategically relevant intermediate states sampled from offline human demonstrations, achieving lower exploitability under fixed computational budgets while requiring bias mitigation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Large-scale imperfect-information competitive games (e.g., StarCraft, Dota) suffer from sparse rewards and prohibitively difficult exploration over long horizons, making approximate equilibrium computation computationally infeasible.

Method: Data-Augmented Game Starts (DAGS): A multi-agent starting-state sampling strategy that initializes RL data collection at intermediate states sampled from offline human demonstration data, facilitating exploration of strategically relevant subgames in two-player zero-sum games using regularized policy-gradient methods.

Result: Under fixed computational budgets, DAGS achieves lower exploitability in games with significantly more challenging exploration. Augmenting starting state distributions can lead to biased equilibria, which can be mitigated via multi-task observation flags.

Conclusion: DAGS enables regularized policy gradient methods to achieve lower exploitability in challenging games under fixed computational budgets, with a mitigation for potential equilibrium bias via multi-task observation flags. New benchmark environments are released to increase exploration challenges.

Abstract: Finding approximate equilibria for large-scale imperfect-information competitive games such as StarCraft, Dota, and CounterStrike remains computationally infeasible due to sparse rewards and challenging exploration over long horizons. In this paper, we propose a multi-agent starting-state sampling strategy designed to substantially accelerate online exploration in regularized policy-gradient game methods for two-player zero-sum (2p0s) games. Motivated by an assumption that offline demonstrations from skilled humans can provide good coverage of high-level strategies relevant to equilibrium play, we propose the initialization of reinforcement learning data collection at intermediate states sampled from offline data to facilitate exploration of strategically relevant subgames. Referring to this method as Data-Augmented Game Starts (DAGS), we perform experiments using synthetic datasets and analytically tractable, long-horizon control variants of two-player Kuhn Poker, Goofspiel, and a counterexample game designed to penalize biased beliefs over hidden information. Under fixed computational budgets, DAGS enables regularized policy gradient methods to achieve lower exploitability in games with significantly more challenging exploration. We show that augmenting starting state distributions when solving imperfect information games can lead to biased equilibria, and we provide a straightforward mitigation to this in the form of multi-task observation flags. Finally, we release a new set of benchmark environments that drastically increase exploration challenges and state counts in existing OpenSpiel games while keeping exploitability measurements analytically tractable.

</details>


### [85] [WarmPrior: Straightening Flow-Matching Policies with Temporal Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13959)
*Sinjae Kang,Chanyoung Kim,Kaixin Wang,Li Zhao,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 WarmPrior——基于近期动作历史的时序先验，替代扩散模型中的标准高斯源分布，显著提升机器人操作成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流匹配已成为机器人控制的主流生成策略，但源分布的设计（通常为标准高斯）未被充分探索。

Method: 1. 用 WarmPrior（来自近期动作历史的时序先验）替换标准高斯源分布；2. 在行为克隆和先验空间强化学习两种范式中验证。

Result: 1. 机器人操作任务成功率提升；2. 概率路径更直（类似最优传输耦合的效果）；3. 先验空间 RL 中探索分布改善，样本效率和最终性能均有提升。

Conclusion: WarmPrior (基于动作历史的时序先验) 优于标准高斯源分布，可作为扩散模型生成式机器人控制的重要设计轴。

Abstract: Generative policies based on diffusion and flow matching have become a dominant paradigm for visuomotor robotic control. We show that replacing the standard Gaussian source distribution with WarmPrior, a simple temporally grounded prior constructed from readily available recent action history, consistently improves success rates on robotic manipulation tasks. We trace this gain to markedly straighter probability paths, echoing the effect of optimal-transport couplings in Rectified Flow. Beyond standard behavior cloning, WarmPrior also reshapes the exploration distribution in prior-space reinforcement learning, improving both sample efficiency and final performance. Collectively, these results identify the source distribution as an important and underexplored design axis in generative robot control.

</details>


### [86] [The Geometry of LLM Quantization: GPTQ as Babai's Nearest Plane Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18553)
*Jiale Chen,Yalda Shabanzadeh,Elvir Crnčević,Torsten Hoefler,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明：GPTQ 在“由后向前”执行时，与经典最近向量问题(CVP)中 Babai 最近平面算法（不做 LLL 基规约）在数学上完全等价；据此得到无裁剪条件下紧的逐层误差上界，并据此设计出优于原始 GPTQ 的免裁剪量化方法（SSQR、HPTQ）及高效 GPU 推理内核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPTQ 虽已成为 LLM 一次性后训练量化(PTQ)的标准方法，但其算法只被描述为一串贪心的代数更新：逐个取权重、量化（舍入或裁剪）、再用误差传播最优修正未量化权重。文献中无法回答“局部贪心规则为何全局有效”，也缺乏几何直觉与最坏情况保证，导致难以进行原则性扩展与失效分析。本文目标是为 GPTQ 给出几何解释，并由此获得逐层的全局误差界，为量化算法的设计引入格(CVP)算法的几十年积累。

Method: 理论部分：(1) 形式化线性层 L2 量化目标 min‖X diag(s) z − X w‖²，证明它与以 Hessian XᵀX 定义的格上的 CVP 等价（定理1：Hessian 的任意因子分解在正交变换下相互等价，从而可用 c×c 方阵替代 n×c 矩阵降本）；(2) 定理2 给出 OBQ/GPTQ 误差传播的几何解释——它恰是 Babai 在原始基上对最近超平面的投影（用逆基 n_j 与夹角 θ 推导 Δζ 比例关系），推论3 说明 OBQ 的维度选择规则即“最小化目标残差到最近超平面的距离”；(3) 定理4 证明 GPTQ 与无基规约的 Babai 算法等价（几何证明 + 三步代数证明：先用累积误差 Δ=Q−W⁽⁰⁾ 改写 GPTQ 并归纳证明与原式等价；再改为 UDU 分解做由后向前迭代；最后逐维归纳证明舍入决策与 Babai 一致），附录 C.4 还证明“在 Babai 结果上再叠加一次 GPTQ 修正”严格冗余；(4) 定理5 给出无裁剪时的紧界：‖X diag(s) z − X w‖² ≤ ¼(T⁻¹s)ᵀ D (T⁻¹s)，D 为置换后 Hessian 的 LDL 对角阵，并给出相对误差界 γ ≤ √(1+max Σd'²/d²) ≤ √(c+1)·max d'/d；附录 D.2 证明若权重在 Babai 超长方体内均匀分布，期望误差为最坏界的 1/3；(5) 分析量化顺序的作用，提出 min-pivot 顺序（每步取当前最小对角元，Schur 补更新，三次复杂度），几何上等价于 Gram-Schmidt 中优先正交化最短残差向量。实践部分：设计免裁剪的 SSQR（按组共享尺度 + CSR 稀疏浮点离群值 + 二分搜索调节尺度至目标离群率）与 HPTQ（统一等距整数网格 + Huffman 编码，熵引导二分搜索标量尺度以达到目标平均位宽），并为 SSQR 实现支持 2–4bit 密集权重 + 稀疏离群值的 CUDA/C++ 内核。

Result: 等价性在数值与代数上严格成立（附录 C 的完整归纳证明），并揭示 GPTQ 本质是在激活空间中按预计算维度顺序对嵌套仿射子空间做“正交行走”；顺序敏感项 tr(D) 与置换强相关：act-order 相比前后向/随机顺序可降 tr(D) 约 35–50%（Q·K·V 与 Gate·Up 层），min-pivot 始终取得最小 tr(D) 但下游精度收益有限。实验（Qwen3 0.6B–14B、Llama-2-7B、Llama-3.1/3.2，FineWeb-Edu 校准，WikiText-2/C4 困惑度）：HPTQ 全面优于 GPTQ/RTN/HRTN，Qwen3-8B 在 4.125bit 为 9.81/13.64（GPTQ 10.10/13.92），3.125bit 为 10.34/14.23（GPTQ 12.77/15.61），2.125bit 为 13.97/16.89（GPTQ 崩塌至 57.51/36.14，RTN 达 2e10）；3.125bit 被验证为困惑度-压缩的 Pareto 最优位宽。SSQR 以 1–5% 离群率在 3.445–3.725bit 达 10.32–12.88，与 HPTQ 相当。对比 AQLM/QuIP#/QTIP，HPTQ 与 SSQR 使标量量化在 3–4bit 区间追平向量量化方法，2–3bit 区间仍具竞争力。CUDA 内核相对 PyTorch BF16 端到端解码约 2× 加速，低 batch 场景单层最高约 4×，在所有位宽/离群率设定下均优于基线。

Conclusion: GPTQ 被置于坚实的理论基础上：它是 Babai 最近平面算法在 Hessian 定义格上的一个实例，因而继承了其误差保证；等价性是紧的（算法复合无法进一步改进），误差传播首次获得直观几何解释。据此提出的免裁剪方法（HPTQ/SSQR）比原始 GPTQ 更准，HPTQ 使无限格 CVP 的假设与实际表示对齐，SSQR 配套内核证明该表示具备实际部署价值。作者指出更广的意义是打通“格算法→量化器”与“网络行为→格理论”的双向通道；未来工作包括扩展到裁剪网格、(尺度感知的)基规约，将视角推广到激活与 KV-cache 量化，并强调 MXFP4/NVFP4 等 4bit 浮点格式本质上接近无裁剪（group size 32/16 + AbsMax 尺度），故本文的无裁剪分析可直接落地到实际场景。

Abstract: Quantizing the weights of large language models (LLMs) from 16-bit to lower bitwidth is the de facto approach to deploy massive transformers onto more affordable accelerators. While GPTQ emerged as one of the standard methods for one-shot post-training quantization at LLM scale, its inner workings are described as a sequence of algebraic updates that obscure geometric meaning or worst-case guarantees. In this work, we show that, when executed back-to-front (from the last to first dimension) for a linear layer, GPTQ is mathematically identical to Babai's nearest plane algorithm for the classical closest vector problem (CVP) on a lattice defined by the Hessian matrix of the layer's inputs. This equivalence is based on a sophisticated mathematical argument, and has two analytical consequences: first, the GPTQ error propagation step gains an intuitive geometric interpretation; second, GPTQ inherits the error upper bound of Babai's algorithm under the assumption that no weights are clipped. Leveraging this bound, we design post-training quantization methods that avoid clipping, and outperform the original GPTQ. In addition, we provide efficient GPU inference kernels for the resulting representation. Taken together, these results place GPTQ on a firm theoretical footing and open the door to importing decades of progress in lattice algorithms towards the design of future quantization algorithms for billion-parameter models. Source code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/GPTQ-Babai.

</details>


### [87] [Towards Resource-Efficient LLMs: End-to-End Energy Accounting of Distillation Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13981)
*Katherine Lambert,Sasha Luccioni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了模型蒸馏中此前被忽视的教师端能耗成本，提出了完整的能耗核算框架，通过实证测量两种主流蒸馏方法的能量-质量权衡曲线，为研究者和工程师提供了在能源和预算约束下优化蒸馏策略的实用指导，并开源了标准化测量工具和核算协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型部署增加导致GPU需求激增和数据中心扩展，引发电力消耗、电网压力和对现代AI工作负载影响的担忧。蒸馏虽被视为获得更便宜、高效模型的有效途径，但这些主张往往忽视了完整端到端的能源和资源成本，包括教师端的数据生成、logit缓存和评估等关键工作负载。

Method: 通过详细阶段式跟踪GPU设备功耗，构建了完整的能耗核算框架；使用两种常用蒸馏方法（基于logit的知识蒸馏和合成数据监督微调）构建了能量-质量帕累托前沿。

Result: 系统测量了两种蒸馏方法的能耗和碳排放，揭示了此前被忽视的成本；基于测量结果推导出在能源和预算约束下选择蒸馏方法和超参数的实用设计规则。

Conclusion: 提出一种标准化的能耗核算协议和开源测量工具，为可比较、可复现的蒸馏研究奠定基础，明确要求对完整管道的能源影响负责。

Abstract: The rise in deployment of large language models has driven a surge in GPU demand and datacenter scaling, raising concerns about electricity use, grid stress, and the impacts of modern AI workloads. Distillation is often promoted as one of the most effective paths to obtain cheaper, more efficient models, yet these claims rarely account for the full end-to-end energy and resource costs, including crucial teacher-side workloads such as data generation, logit caching, and evaluation. We present a comprehensive energy accounting framework that measures the complete computational cost of distillation pipelines via detailed stage-wise tracking of GPU device power consumption. In our experiments, we separate and log empirical energy use across distinct phases and systematically measure the energy and emissions of two common distillation methods: the classic logit-based knowledge distillation and synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning, constructing energy-quality Pareto frontiers that expose the previously ignored costs. From these measurements and analyses, we derive practical design rules for selecting distillation methods and hyperparameters under energy and budget constraints, and release an open-source measurement harness and accounting protocol to provide a standardized foundation for comparable, reproducible distillation research, explicitly accountable for complete pipeline energy impact.

</details>


### [88] [Finite Sample Bounds for Learning with Score Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14168)
*Devin Smedira,Abhijith Jayakumar,Sidhant Misra,Marc Vuffray,Andrey Y. Lokhov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This work provides the first non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for learning exponential families of polynomials using score matching, showing polynomial dependence on model dimension—improving upon prior work that only gave asymptotic guarantees.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Learning continuous exponential family distributions with unbounded support is important for high-dimensional statistics, but score matching's statistical properties lack theoretical understanding.

Method: Score matching is employed for learning exponential families of polynomials with continuous variables.

Result: Provided non-asymptotic sample complexity analysis with sample bounds showing polynomial dependence on model dimension.

Conclusion: The derived bounds are the first non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for this problem; all prior work only provided asymptotic results.

Abstract: Learning of continuous exponential family distributions with unbounded support remains an important area of research for both theory and applications in high-dimensional statistics. In recent years, score matching has become a widely used method for learning exponential families with continuous variables due to its computational ease when compared against maximum likelihood estimation. However, theoretical understanding of the statistical properties of score matching is still lacking. In this work, we provide a non-asymptotic sample complexity analysis for learning the structure of exponential families of polynomials with score matching. The derived sample bounds show a polynomial dependence on the model dimension. These bounds are the first of its kind, as all prior work has shown only asymptotic bounds on the sample complexity.

</details>


### [89] [TabPFN-3: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13986)
*Léo Grinsztajn,Klemens Flöge,Oscar Key,Felix Birkel,Philipp Jund,Brendan Roof,Mihir Manium,Shi Bin,Hoo,Magnus Bühler,Anurag Garg,Dominik Safaric,Jake Robertson,Benjamin Jäger,Simone Alessi,Adrian Hayler,Vladyslav Moroshan,Lennart Purucker,Philipp Singer,Alan Arazi,Julien Siems,Jan Hendrik Metzen,Georg Grab,Nick Erickson,Siyuan Guo,Eliott Kalfon,Simon Bing,David Salinas,Clara Cornu,Lilly Charlotte Wehrhahn,Diana Kriuchkova,Kursat Kaya,Lydia Sidhoum,Marie Salmon,Jerry Chen,Madelon Hulsebos,Yann LeCun,Samuel Müller,Bernhard Schölkopf,Sauraj Gambhir,Noah Hollmann,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabPFN-3是表格数据的基础模型，在100万行规模数据上实现最先进性能，比前代快20倍，并通过测试时计算扩展和多模态扩展支持时间序列、关系数据和表格-文本数据任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据在科学和工业领域的高价值预测问题中具有核心地位。TabPFN已推动了该模态的基础模型革命，但需要扩展到更大规模数据集（100万训练行）并进一步降低训练和推理时间，同时拓展到时间序列、关系数据和表格-文本数据等新领域。

Method: 采用纯合成数据预训练方法，引入测试时计算扩展(test-time compute scaling)机制，通过TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking)模式激活扩展能力；采用缩减的KV缓存和行分块技术实现大规模数据扩展；针对时间序列任务设计了专用检查点TabPFN-TS-3。

Result: 在TabArena标准表格基准测试中，TabPFN-3单次前向传播显著超越所有模型（含调优和集成基线），实现帕累托最优的速度/性能权衡；在多分类数据集上排名第一；在高达100万行200特征的数据集上超越8小时调优的梯度提升树基线；TabPFN-3-Plus在TabArena上超越所有非TabPFN模型超过200 Elo，最大数据子集达420 Elo，且比AutoGluon 1.5 Extreme快10倍；关系数据新SOTA（RelBenchV1）；表格-文本数据SOTA（TabSTAR via TabPFN-3-Plus）；时间序列排名第2（fev-bench）；SHAP值计算提速最高120倍；比TabPFN-2.5快20倍；在单张H100上支持100万行数据处理。

Conclusion: TabPFN-3通过纯合成数据预训练实现了表格数据预测的最先进性能，同时支持时间序列、关系数据和表格-文本数据等多种模态，并成功扩展到100万行数据规模，在单个H100 GPU上实现高效推理。

Abstract: Tabular data underpins most high-value prediction problems in science and industry, and TabPFN has driven the foundation model revolution for this modality. Designed with feedback from our users, TabPFN-3 builds on this foundation to scale state-of-the-art performance to datasets with 1M training rows and substantially reduce training and inference time. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data from our prior, TabPFN-3 dramatically pushes the frontier of tabular prediction and brings substantial gains on time series, relational, and tabular-text data. On the standard tabular benchmark TabArena, a forward pass of TabPFN-3 outperforms all other models, including tuned and ensembled baselines, by a significant margin, and pareto-dominates the speed/performance frontier. On more diverse datasets, TabPFN-3 ranks first on datasets with many classes, and beats 8-hour-tuned gradient-boosted-tree baselines on datasets up to 1M training rows and 200 features. TabPFN-3 introduces test-time compute scaling to tabular foundation models. Our API offering TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) exploits this to beat all non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo on TabArena, rising to 420 Elo on the largest data subset, and outperforms AutoGluon 1.5 extreme while being 10x faster, without using LLMs, real data, internet search or any other model besides TabPFN. TabPFN-3 extends the capabilities of our models, enabling SOTA prediction on relational data (new SOTA foundation model on RelBenchV1) and tabular-text data (SOTA on TabSTAR via TabPFN-3-Plus); and improves existing integrations: a specialized checkpoint, TabPFN-TS-3, ranks 2nd on the time-series benchmark fev-bench, and SHAP-value computation is up to 120x faster. TabPFN-3 achieves this performance while being up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5. In addition, a reduced KV cache and row-chunking scale to 1M rows on one H100 with fast inference speed.

</details>


### [90] [Neural Fields for NV-Center Inverse Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13988)
*Zhixuan Zhao,Tao Zhong,Yixun Hu,Nathalie P. de Leon,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This work identifies and corrects a center-collapse failure mode in NV quantum magnetometry arising from an oversimplified forward model, and proposes NeTMY — a physics-informed neural field framework — which outperforms conventional free-density optimization in reconstructing sparse magnetic noise sources while providing a physics-faithful testbed for neural inverse problems.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Traditional approaches to inverse problems in scientific sensing — relying on hand-designed regularizers or supervised networks with simulated labels — fail under conditions involving nonlinear, spectrally coupled, and physically delicate forward models, as commonly encountered in NV-center-based magnetic noise sensing.

Method: The proposed NeTMY framework integrates an amortization-free coordinate neural field with a differentiable NV forward model, incorporating annealed positional encoding, multiscale optimization, sparsity/gating mechanisms, and spectrum-fidelity losses to stabilize the inverse landscape.

Result: Across sparse synthetic reconstructions using the corrected dipolar operator, NeTMY achieves superior localization and distributional metrics compared to the tested benchmark methods. Mechanism analysis confirms that NeTMY's parameterization smooths and redistributes raw gradient updates, effectively mitigating the center-collapse pathology.

Conclusion: NeTMY establishes NV quantum sensing as a compelling testbed for physics-faithful neural inverse problems, with demonstrated advantages in localization accuracy and distributional fidelity over conventional free-density optimization.

Abstract: Inverse problems in scientific sensing are often solved with either hand-designed regularizers or supervised networks trained on simulated labels, yet both can fail when the forward model is nonlinear, spectrally coupled, and physically delicate. We study this issue for noise sensing based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, where a quantum sensor measures magnetic-noise spectra generated by sparse spin sources. We show that replacing a common scalar/coherent forward approximation with a tensor power-summed dipolar operator changes the inverse landscape and exposes a center-collapse failure mode in free-density optimization. We propose NeTMY, an amortization-free coordinate neural field coupled to the differentiable NV forward model, with annealed positional encoding, multiscale optimization, sparsity/gating, and spectrum-fidelity losses. Across sparse synthetic reconstructions generated by the corrected operator, NeTMY achieves the best localization and distributional metrics in the tested benchmark. Mechanism experiments show that NeTMY does not directly execute the raw density-space gradient; its parameterization smooths and redistributes updates, mitigating the center-collapse pathology. These results position NV quantum sensing as a useful testbed for physics-faithful neural inverse problems.

</details>


### [91] [HodgeCover: Higher-Order Topological Coverage Drives Compression of Sparse Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13997)
*Tao Zhong,Dongzhe Zheng,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HodgeCover：一种免学习（learning-free）的稀疏 MoE 专家压缩方法。其核心洞察是：三个专家两两可合并却整体不可合并所形成的"不可约合并障碍"，在数学上正是专家可合并性单纯复形（2-复杂）上 1-Hodge 拉普拉斯算子的调和（harmonic）核；因此既有基于两两信号的压缩器（REAP、REAM、MC-SMoE、STUN）在结构上无法察觉这一高阶障碍。作者据此把调和核转化为一个子模覆盖式专家选择目标（HodgeCover），并与 Wanda 非结构化剪枝组合成混合压缩器（HodgeCover+Wanda）。在 OLMoE-1B-7B、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 三个开源骨干上做 33%/66% 专家削减，HodgeCover 在专家数量轴上与 REAP 持平（±0.3pp），混合轴在 66% 压缩率下以最高 C4 困惑度与最优下游平均准确率（DS-Avg）占据激进压缩前沿，并在四个 Hodge 分量上唯一保持均衡的保留质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏 MoE 层每层含数十至数百个 FFN 专家但每 token 仅激活少数几个，参数大量闲置；无需重训练即可压缩 MoE 层可在小集群上复用预训练检查点（无微调、无蒸馏、无 LoRA）。现有免学习压缩器（REAP 用输出显著性、REAM 用显著性感知合并分、MC-SMoE 用路由余弦聚类、STUN 用结构化剪枝+Wanda）全部建立在两两（pairwise）信号排序之上，因而对"高阶"属性结构性失明：若 A-B、B-C、C-A 两两兼容，但三者合并成单一专家时存在任何两两分都无法预测的不可约代价，这类三阶合并障碍被完全忽略。已有使用三元组输入的方法（超图谱切、三元组损失）只是把三元组聚合成 pairwise 之和的代理或二元否决，无法分离出真正承载信息的那部分拓扑残差。此外，把调和核仅当作诊断工具（拓扑深度学习、Betti 数、持久图）从未被用作参数选择目标，缺乏可落地的压缩机制。

Method: **1) 可合并性单纯复形（mergeability complex）**：每层 n 个专家为顶点，构造 2-维抽象单纯复形 K=(V,E,T)，E 为完全图边集（|E|=C(n,2)），T 为精选三角集（|T|≤500，取中位 pairwise 障碍子图的 3-团，固定种子 42 均匀下采样）。边携带两两 KL 合并障碍 b_ij（合并为路由频率加权平均，零频次回退到无权平均），面携带三元组障碍 b_ijk；障碍只作为 C¹/C² 上的信号，而非算子内部的权重。

**2) Hodge 分解**：用无权的 1-Hodge 拉普拉斯 L₁=∂₁ᵀ∂₁+∂₂∂₂ᵀ（链恒等式 ∂₁∂₂=0），由 Moore-Penrose 伪逆最小二乘求出投影 P_grad、P_curl、P_harm=I−P_grad−P_curl，把边障碍信号 b 唯一正交分解为 b=b_grad+b_curl+b_harm，ker(L₁) 维数为第一 Betti 数 β₁(K)。定理 1/2 给出正交直和分解与证明；命题 1 证明调和残差 ‖b_harm‖² 恰为任何"顶点势+三角边界"解释的最小残差，即下阶不可约障碍能量。刻意不采用阈值化边集，因为阈值会改变 ∂₁ 的秩、拆散调和环，使诊断依赖 τ 而非信号本身。

**3) HodgeCover 选择目标**：从分解中取 top-p% 按 |b_harm| 排序的调和关键边 E* 与 top-q_T% 按 |b_ijk| 排序的三元关键三角 T*；目标函数 Φ(S)=Σ sal(i)+λ_e·|C_E(S)|/|E*|+λ_t·|C_T(S)|/|T*|，其中 sal 为逐层归一化的 REAP 输出显著性。三项均归一化到 [0,1]，故 λ_e、λ_t 与层/模型无关；Φ 非负单调次模（最大覆盖项 + 模项），贪心算法给出 (1−1/e) 近似保证（命题 2）。Remark 1 给出 K₄ 上三完美匹配构造的不可表达性反例，证明 REAP/REAM/MC-SMoE 一类"个体化顶点打分"无法复现该覆盖率。丢弃专家按 Hodge 加权障碍 b_ij·(1+α|b_harm,ij|/‖b‖) 重定向到最近幸存者，幸存者权重保持 bit-exact；跨层预算用与 REAP/REAM 一致的均匀分配器。

**4) 混合 HodgeCover+Wanda**：Stage 1 专家轴 HodgeCover（r₁=0.20），Stage 2 对幸存者权重做免学习 Wanda 非结构化剪枝（r₂≈0.1625 / 0.575 对应 33%/66% 总率），复用同一校准语料的激活张量，无额外前向。默认超参 p=q_T=20%、λ_e=1.0、λ_t=0.5、α=3.0、|T|≤500，均在单层上一次性设定，跨模型不调参。

**5) 诊断与消融**：逐层计算谐调能量占比 ρ_harm 与组合失调度 δ（三元障碍超过最差两两障碍 20% 裕量的三角形比例）；对照方法包括 Greedy-Barrier（纯 pairwise 并查集）、Triplet-Penalty soft（三元软惩罚）、Triplet-Hypergraph hard（二元三角否决）、Hodge No-Triangle，并给出 REAP+Wanda/REAM+Wanda 匹配对照混合基线。

Result: **理论层面**：调和分量在三个模型族全部 104 层上非平凡——ρ_harm ∈ [0.289,0.616]（OLMoE 均值 0.352，Qwen-35B 0.503，Qwen-122B 0.456），失调度 δ ∈ [0.060,1.000]，且 ρ_harm 深度稳定、δ 深度敏感；ρ_curl 在 Qwen 上几乎为零（10⁻⁵~10⁻³）、OLMoE 约 3%，说明非成对内容几乎全部是调和的。β₁(K) 在 OLMoE 为 {1453,1454,1455}、Qwen 恒为 31,885（rank ∂₂=500 满秩），但因被 n 与 |T| 结构钉死而被降级为模型级描述子。

**专家数量轴（33%/66%）**：HodgeCover 在四个 Qwen 单元上与 REAP 的 DS-Avg 差距在 ±0.3pp 内并在其中三个领先；66% 时领先 REAM/MC-SMoE 6–16pp。OLMoE 在 66% 全部塌陷（DS-Avg 33.3，C4 PPL 535–1135），属压力区。

**混合轴**：HodgeCover+Wanda 在全部 (模型, 率) 单元取得最佳 C4 困惑度，并在全部 66% 单元取得最佳 WikiText 困惑度（领先 STUN+Wanda 1.4–3.8 点）。66% 下游提升结构性显著：Qwen-35B DS-Avg 74.6% vs STUN+W 62.0%（+12.6pp，主要来自 GSM8K 85.5% vs 22.1%，MMLU 领先 8.9pp），Qwen-122B 同型（75.9% vs 70.8%）；匹配对照 REAP+W/REAM+W 在两个 Qwen 尺度仍落后 0.3–0.8pp，OLMoE 落后 5–8pp。33% 时 Qwen-122B 混合轴达到 77.8% DS-Avg（近未压缩 78.0%）。

**消融（Qwen-35B, 66%）**：HodgeCover 66.7% DS-Avg，Triplet-Penalty 60.9%（−5.7pp，且 C4 PPL 几乎相同），Greedy-Barrier 60.7%，Hodge No-Triangle 55.2%（−11.5pp），Triplet-Hypergraph 36.2%（−30.5pp），证明 Hodge 分解是承重件、三角项必要、软形式优于二元否决。Qwen-122B 66% 时相对 No-Triangle +11.4pp、相对 Greedy-Barrier +8.9pp、相对 Triplet-Hypergraph +32.2pp。

**机制分析**：按四个 Hodge 分量统计保留质量，Greedy-Barrier/MC-SMoE 多保留 0.05–0.07 的 harmonic/gradient 却少 0.10–0.25 的 curl/三元质量，Random 反向偏置，而 HodgeCover 在四分量上同时贴近压缩前分解（唯一均衡者）；REAP/REAM 选择相同、偏离微弱，与其窄差距一致。

**系统代价**：Qwen 尺度 plan-time 约 480s（REAP 约 25s，约 19×），复杂形一次构建可跨压缩率缓存；推理吞吐与 REAP+Wanda 相差 ≤6%；路由熵在 Qwen 上差 ≤0.01；死专家比例在两个 Qwen 尺度比 REAM+Wanda 高 1–3pp（作者明确承认为劣势）。

Conclusion: 把稀疏 MoE 的高阶可合并性障碍形式化为单纯复形 1-Hodge 拉普拉斯的调和核，并将其从"诊断工具"升级为"参数选择目标"，会改变在最重要（激进压缩）区间的最优压缩器：覆盖调和关键边与三元关键三角的次模目标，在不改动幸存者权重的前提下，于三个生产级开源 MoE 规模上给出最优的激进压缩前沿，并在四个 Hodge 分量上取得唯一均衡的保留质量；Hodge 分解是承重机制而非修饰（跳过它的软三元组惩罚损失 5.7pp，完全去掉三角项损失 11.5pp）。局限与展望：仍属免学习族（恢复最后几个困惑度点通常需要微调或蒸馏）；plan-time 主要由两两障碍扫描主导（O((n²+|T|)|D|d²)），属可离线摊销的一次性成本；评测仅限语言 MoE，多模态与 RL 后训练检查点留待后续（构造本身与模态无关）；死专家比例略高、λ_e/λ_t/p/q_T 的经验敏感性带与 |T| 配对消融尚未开展。总体结论：揭示学习到的 MoE 结构的调和核能携带成对打分无法触及的信息。

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers route tokens through a handful of experts, and learning-free compression of these layers reduces inference cost without retraining. A subtle obstruction blocks every existing compressor in this family: three experts can each be pairwise compatible yet form an irreducible cycle when merged together, so any score that ranks experts on pairwise signals is structurally blind to which triples are jointly mergeable. We show the obstruction is a precise mathematical object, the harmonic kernel of the simplicial Laplacian on a 2-complex whose vertices are experts, whose edges carry KL merge barriers, and whose faces carry triplet barriers; Hodge-decomposing the edge-barrier signal isolates the kernel exactly. We turn the diagnostic into a selection objective: HodgeCover greedily covers the harmonic-critical edges and triplet-critical triangles, and a hybrid variant of HodgeCover pairs it with off-the-shelf weight pruning on survivors. On three open-weight Sparse MoE backbones under aggressive expert reduction, HodgeCover matches state-of-the-art learning-free baselines on the expert-reduction axis, leads on the aggressive-compression frontier of the hybrid axis, and uniquely balances retained mass across all four Hodge components. These results show that exposing the harmonic kernel of a learned MoE structure changes which compressor wins at the regime that matters most.

</details>


### [92] [Support Before Frequency in Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13999)
*Adrian Müller,Antoine Gonon,Zebang Shen,Ya-Ping Hsieh,Niao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了离散扩散模型的去噪目标如何分层组织学习：模型首先学习数据支持结构（语法有效性），然后学习数据频率（相对概率分布）。理论分析表明均匀扩散和吸收扩散在有效性改善机制上存在根本差异，实验验证了支持局部化学习早于频率排序出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在语言建模中已具备竞争力，但尚不清楚其去噪目标如何组织学习过程，即模型如何逐步获取数据结构信息。

Method: 对小噪声极限下的逆向过程进行数学分析，证明每个单token逆向编辑可分解为粗粒度尺度（由移动方向决定）和细粒度系数（确定相对概率）。在合成正则语言任务和掩码语言扩散模型上验证预测。

Result: 证明均匀扩散和吸收扩散的逆向过程在最终去噪步骤的小噪声极限下存在层级结构：粗尺度决定移动是否朝向数据支持（如语法有效句子），细系数决定同尺度内的相对概率。均匀扩散呈现有效性改善/保持/恶化三分类，吸收扩散则将主导质量集中于有效性改善的移动。

Conclusion: 离散扩散模型先学习数据支持结构（有效性），再学习数据频率（相对概率）。均匀扩散呈现三分类（改善/保持/恶化有效性），而吸收扩散聚焦于改善有效性的移动。实验验证了支持局部化早于频率排序出现，且两种扩散机制表现出预测的速率差异。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models are increasingly competitive for language modeling, yet it remains unclear how their denoising objectives organize learning. Although these objectives target the full data distribution, we show that the exact reverse process induces a hierarchy between coarse support information and finer frequency information. For uniform and absorbing (a.k.a. masking) diffusion, we prove that, in the small-noise regime of the final denoising steps, each single-token reverse edit decomposes into a leading scale, determined by whether it moves toward the data support (e.g., grammatically valid sentences), and a finer coefficient, determining relative probabilities within the same scale. Thus, recovering validity structure only requires learning the correct order of magnitude of reverse probabilities, whereas recovering data frequencies requires coefficient-level estimation. The separation is mechanism-dependent: uniform diffusion exhibits a trichotomy into validity-improving, validity-preserving, and validity-worsening edits, while absorbing diffusion places its leading-order mass on validity-improving moves. Experiments on a masked language diffusion model and synthetic regular-language tasks support these predictions: support-localization emerges earlier than within-support frequency ranking, and the contrast between uniform and absorbing diffusion matches the predicted rate separation. Together, our results suggest that discrete diffusion models learn data support before data frequencies.

</details>


### [93] [Dywave: Event-Aligned Dynamic Tokenization for Heterogeneous IoT Sensing Signal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14014)
*Tomoyoshi Kimura,Denizhan Kara,Jinyang Li,Hongjue Zhao,Yigong Hu,Yizhuo Chen,Xiaomin Ouyang,Shengzhong Liu,Tarek Abdelzaher*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Dywave提出了一种针对物联网传感信号的自适应动态分词框架，通过小波分层分解识别语义事件边界，在保持时间一致性的同时压缩冗余区间，实现精度提升12%且输入长度减少75%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT sensing signals are inherently non-stationary and multi-scale, posing challenges for standard tokenization techniques designed for stationary data.

Method: Dywave employs wavelet-based hierarchical decomposition to identify semantic event boundaries, then adaptively compresses redundant intervals while preserving temporal coherence to generate compact token representations aligned with intrinsic temporal structures.

Result: Dywave achieves up to 12% accuracy improvement and reduces input token lengths by 75% across 5 datasets and multiple sequence models, with improved robustness to domain shifts and varying sequence lengths.

Conclusion: Dywave provides a more efficient and robust approach to processing IoT sensing signals, achieving significant improvements in both accuracy and computational efficiency while maintaining strong generalization capabilities across different domains and sequence lengths.

Abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) systems continuously collect heterogeneous sensing signals from ubiquitous sensors to support intelligent applications such as human activity analysis, emotion monitoring, and environmental perception. These signals are inherently non-stationary and multi-scale, posing unique challenges for standard tokenization techniques. This paper proposes Dywave, a dynamic tokenization framework for IoT sensing signals that constructs compact input representations aligned with intrinsic temporal structures and underlying physical events. Dywave leverages wavelet-based hierarchical decomposition, identifies meaningful temporal boundaries corresponding to underlying semantic events, and adaptively compresses redundant intervals while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive evaluations on five real-world IoT sensing datasets across activity recognition, stress assessment, and nearby object detection demonstrate that Dywave outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 12% in accuracy, while improving computational efficiency by reducing input token lengths by up to 75% across mainstream sequence models. Moreover, Dywave exhibits improved robustness to domain shifts and varying sequence lengths.

</details>


### [94] [R2R2: Robust Representation for Intensive Experience Reuse via Redundancy Reduction in Self-Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14026)
*Sanghyeob Song,Donghyeok Lee,Jinsik Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: R2R2通过在自预测学习(SPL)中引入冗余减少来缓解强化学习中高更新数据比(UTD)下过度拟合的问题，通过非中心化目标设计解决标准零中心化与SPL谱特性的冲突，在11个连续控制任务中验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据稀缺的领域（如真实世界机器人）中，强化学习通过高强度数据重用提升效率，但会导致过度拟合问题。现有的研究主要关注评论家偏差，而对自预测学习(SPL)在高更新数据比(UTD)条件下的表征层不稳定性研究不足。

Method: 提出R2R2（通过冗余减少实现鲁棒表征），这是一种针对SPL的正则化方法。理论分析发现标准零中心化与SPL的谱特性存在冲突，进而设计了非中心化目标。在TD7等SPL原生算法上验证，并扩展了SimbaV2，集成定制的SPL模块形成SimbaV2-SPL。

Result: 在UTD比为20的条件下，R2R2使TD7性能提升约22%，并为SimbaV2-SPL提供额外增益。SimbaV2-SPL本身也达到了新的最先进水平。实验在11个连续控制任务中进行验证。

Conclusion: R2R2有效缓解了SPL在高UTD条件下的过度拟合问题，其非中心化设计解决了理论冲突，且与现有先进方法具有正交性，可进一步结合提升性能。

Abstract: For reinforcement learning in data-scarce domains like real-world robotics, intensive data reuse enhances efficiency but induces overfitting. While prior works focus on critic bias, representation-level instability in Self-Predictive Learning (SPL) under high Update-to-Data (UTD) regimes remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose Robust Representation via Redundancy Reduction (R2R2), a regularization method within SPL. We theoretically identify that standard zero-centering conflicts with SPL's spectral properties and design a non-centered objective accordingly. We verify R2R2 on SPL-native algorithms like TD7. Furthermore, to demonstrate its orthogonality to prior advancements, we extend the state-of-the-art SimbaV2, which originally lacks SPL, by integrating a tailored SPL module, termed SimbaV2-SPL. Experiments across 11 continuous control tasks confirm that R2R2 effectively mitigates overfitting; specifically, at a UTD ratio of 20, it improves TD7 by ~22% and provides additional gains on top of SimbaV2-SPL, which itself establishes a new state-of-the-art. The code can be found at: https://github.com/songsang7/R2R2

</details>


### [95] [Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention: Learning When to Write by Predicting Future Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14037)
*Gergely Szilvasy,Manuel Faysse,Maria Lomeli,Matthijs Douze,Pierre-Emmanuel Mazaré,Loïc Cabannes,Wen-tau Yih,Hervé Jégou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SP-KV是一种通过预测KV效用来实现KV缓存动态稀疏化的机制，可在预训练LLM基础上端到端训练，将KV缓存压缩3-10倍，显著提升推理效率且几乎不影响模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现代测试时计算和agentic范式下，LLM处理越来越长的序列时，受限于Key-Value缓存的内存占用和带宽瓶颈。

Method: 通过轻量级utility predictor在细粒度上评分每个KV对，采用动态稀疏化策略（阈值机制）+ 联合端到端训练（next-token prediction loss），从预训练LLM checkpoint适配。

Result: KV缓存压缩3-10倍，长序列更具可压缩性，内存使用和解码速度大幅改善，下游任务性能基本无退化。

Conclusion: SP-KV可作为高效的KV缓存压缩机制，并揭示了可用于设计混合局部-全局注意力架构的结构化稀疏模式。

Abstract: Under modern test-time compute and agentic paradigms, language models process ever-longer sequences. Efficient text generation with transformer architectures is increasingly constrained by the Key-Value cache memory footprint and bandwidth. To address this limitation, we introduce Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention (SP-KV), a mechanism designed to predict future KV utility in order to reduce the size of the long-term KV cache. This strategy operates at a fine granularity: a lightweight utility predictor scores each key-value pair, and while recent KVs are always available via a local window, older pairs are written in the cache and used in global attention only if their predicted utility surpasses a given threshold. The LLM and the utility predictor are trained jointly end-to-end exclusively through next-token prediction loss, and are adapted from pretrained LLM checkpoints.
  Rather than enforcing a fixed compression ratio, SP-KV performs dynamic sparsification: the mechanism adapts to the input and typically reduces the KV cache size by a factor of $3$ to $10\times$, longer sequences often being more compressible. This leads to vast improvements in memory usage and decoding speed, with little to no degradation of validation loss nor performance on a broad set of downstream tasks. Beyond serving as an effective KV-cache reduction mechanism, our method reveals structured layer- and head-specific sparsity patterns that we can use to guide the design of hybrid local-global attention architectures.

</details>


### [96] [Reliability-Gated Source Anchoring for Continual Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14063)
*Vikash Singh,Debargha Ganguly,Weicong Chen,Sabyasachi Sahoo,Sreehari Sankar,Biyao Zhang,Mohsen Harir,Shouren Wang,Osama Zafar,Christian Gagné,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对持续测试时域适应中的"盲目锚定"问题，提出基于源模型预测熵的可靠性门控机制RMemSafe。该方法在源模型可靠时保持源锚定，在源模型失效时自动关闭门控并切换到源无关回退方案，实现了优雅的性能衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有源锚定CTTA方法在源模型可靠性下降时仍采用相同的锚定强度，导致性能崩溃。这种"盲目锚定"问题在CCC-Hard基准上使ResNet-50源准确率仅剩约1.3%，严重限制了方法的实际应用。

Method: 提出RMemSafe，一种可靠性门控扩展方法。该方法利用冻结源模型的归一化预测熵来衰减目标函数中所有显式源耦合项。当源后验分布接近均匀时，门控关闭，移除源锚点和agreement filter，退化为包含ROID基础损失和边际校准的源无关回退方案。

Result: 与ASR结合后，RMemSafe在9个匹配分割持续腐蚀单元中的8个上取得最低误差，且在全部9个单元上都是最佳的reset-based方法。在ResNet-50上比ROID+ASR提升1.05pp，在ViT-B/16上提升0.48pp。源退化控制实验显示其危害斜率比ROID+ASR浅1.13倍。

Conclusion: RMemSafe通过可靠性门控机制，在源模型失效时自动切换到源无关的回退方案，实现了优雅的性能衰减。实验表明，该方法在持续腐蚀场景下显著优于基线，且对模型退化更具鲁棒性。

Abstract: Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) updates a pretrained model online on an unlabeled, non-stationary stream while anchoring it to a frozen source checkpoint. This anchor is useful only when the source remains reliable. On CCC-Hard, however, a ResNet-50 source falls to approximately $1.3\%$ top-$1$ accuracy, while existing source-anchored CTTA methods continue applying the same anchor strength. We call this failure mode blind anchoring and propose RMemSafe, a reliability-gated extension of ROID that uses the frozen source's normalized predictive entropy to attenuate all explicit source-coupled uses in the objective. When the source posterior approaches uniformity, the gate closes: the source anchor and agreement filter vanish, and the objective reduces to a source-agnostic fallback comprising ROID's base losses plus marginal calibration. Combined with ASR, RMemSafe achieves the lowest error on $8$ of $9$ matched-split continual-corruption cells and is the best reset-based method on all $9$, improving ROID+ASR by $1.05$~pp on ResNet-50 and $0.48$~pp on ViT-B/16. A controlled source-degradation sweep shows a $1.13{\times}$ shallower harm slope than ROID+ASR, consistent with the graceful-decay prediction. The entropy gate detects high-entropy source collapse, not confidently wrong low-entropy sources; this scope is explicitly evaluated and discussed.

</details>


### [97] [Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches for Minority-Class Financial Distress Prediction Under Class Imbalance Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14067)
*Karan Sehgal,Khawar Naveed Bhatti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一项面向企业财务困境（破产）预测的应用型比较评测研究。针对破产样本仅占约1.8%的严重类别不平衡环境，作者构建了包含预处理、相关性特征过滤、SMOTE过采样、多模型对比与SHAP可解释性分析的CRISP-DM式工程流水线，并强调可复现性、可审计性与治理导向评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实企业财务数据中破产/困境企业仅占极小比例（本文数据集约1.8%），导致传统分类模型虽获得虚高的整体准确率，却对少数类困境事件敏感度不足；而在企业财务风险场景中假阴性（漏报破产）会延迟干预、扩大风险敞口。此外，企业治理与监管要求模型具备可解释、透明、可审计、可复现的特性，而非黑箱分类器。因此需要一套面向不平衡条件的、以少数类召回率为核心的可复现可解释评测框架。

Method: 采用CRISP-DM导向的实验设计：数据来自台湾经济日报及Kaggle公开财务数据（约6,819条企业观测、96个财务属性，破产占约1.8%），二分类任务。流程为——80/20训练测试划分（先划分以防泄漏）→中位数插补缺失值→StandardScaler标准化→基于相关性的冗余特征过滤→仅在训练集上施加SMOTE（最近邻插值合成少数类，公式 x_new = x_i + λ(x_nn − x_i)）→训练多种模型族：Logistic Regression（基线）、Random Forest、AdaBoost、XGBoost、CatBoost、LightGBM，并探索性考察LSTM、ARIMA、SARIMA时序模型；采用分层5折交叉验证与固定随机种子以保证可复现。评价指标以少数类Precision、Recall、F1、ROC-AUC为主（明确不以accuracy为主），并对表现最佳模型进行SHAP全局/局部特征归因分析。工具链为Python + scikit-learn、XGBoost、CatBoost、LightGBM、PyTorch、SHAP，并提供配套代码仓库（预处理、特征工程、训练管线、评估notebook、依赖与实验配置）。

Result: XGBoost在召回率与ROC-AUC上取得最佳平衡（Precision 0.71、Recall 0.83、F1 0.76、ROC-AUC 0.91），CatBoost（0.69/0.81/0.74/0.89）与LightGBM（0.67/0.79/0.72/0.88）次之；Random Forest（0.63/0.74/0.68/0.84）与AdaBoost居中，Logistic Regression最弱（0.41/0.52/0.46/0.71），说明线性边界难以刻画异质财务特征间的非线性交互。梯度提升族整体优于基线统计模型与单独集成模型，漏报率（FN）更低。SMOTE前后对比显示多数模型的少数类召回与F1显著提升，但部分模型精度出现中等程度下降，存在精度—召回权衡。ROC曲线分析显示梯度提升模型轨迹更平滑、跨阈值判别力更强。SHAP全局摘要识别出杠杆率、留存收益、流动性、盈利能力与经营偿付能力类变量为破产预测的主要贡献因子，其中债务暴露与流动性不稳定影响尤为突出。LSTM等时序探索性模型在有限少数类样本下表现波动较大，稳定性不及表格类集成模型。

Conclusion: 论文结论是：面向严重类别不平衡的企业财务困境预测中，结合SMOTE等不平衡缓解手段、梯度提升集成模型与SHAP可解释性分析的工作流，配合标准化预处理、相关性特征过滤、训练集内过采样、分层交叉验证与固定随机种子等可复现工程实践，能够提供比传统统计评分模型（Altman Z-score、Ohlson O-score、Zmijewski）更可靠的少数类检测与决策支持基础。研究的定位是应用性工程评测而非提出新算法架构，同时强调可解释性、审计性、可复现性与治理导向的评估体系在金融高风险场景中的重要性。未来工作方向包括LSTM/ARIMA/SARIMA等时序建模、更高级的不平衡感知优化、状态感知的企业预测系统以及治理导向的可信部署编排框架。

Abstract: Financial distress prediction remains a significant challenge in enterprise risk analysis due to the highly imbalanced nature of real-world financial datasets, where bankrupt or distressed firms typically constitute only a small minority of observations.
  This paper presents a comparative evaluation of classical statistical methods, ensemble learning approaches, and exploratory neural models for minority-class financial distress prediction under class imbalance constraints.
  The study incorporates structured preprocessing, imbalance mitigation using the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), comparative evaluation across ensemble learning architectures including XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest, and explainability analysis using SHAP-based feature attribution methods.
  Experimental evaluation demonstrates that gradient-boosting approaches achieved improved minority-class sensitivity relative to baseline statistical classifiers under severe imbalance conditions. The workflow additionally emphasises reproducibility, interpretability, auditability, and governance-oriented machine learning evaluation within enterprise financial risk environments.
  The work is positioned as an applied engineering evaluation intended to support reproducible and interpretable machine learning workflows for financial distress prediction under severe class imbalance constraints.

</details>


### [98] [SurF: A Generative Model for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14069)
*Mohammad R. Rezaei,Tejas Balaji,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SurF是一个针对不规则采样多元事件流的生成模型，利用时间重缩放定理(TRT)作为可学习的双射，将事件序列映射到i.i.d.单位速率指数噪声，从而实现跨异构事件流数据集的联合训练。在6个真实世界基准上取得了最先进或接近最优的性能，是事件流领域基础模型的重要探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则采样的多元事件流是生成建模的难题：(1)基于分词的方法在事件间隔跨数量级变化时失效；(2)神经时间点过程受限于窗口级数值求积的瓶颈。

Method: 提出SurF模型：(1)利用时间重缩放定理(TRT)作为可学习的双射，将异构事件流映射到i.i.d.单位速率指数噪声；(2)三种可扩展至长序列的累积强度参数化方法；(3)基于Transformer的编码器实现多数据集预训练。

Result: 在6个真实世界基准上，SurF在Earthquake、Retweet、Taobao上达到最佳时间RMSE，其余3个数据集也达到与最佳专家模型相当的性能。严格留一法协议下，5/6数据集超越所有基线，Amazon和Earthquake上超越所有基线。

Conclusion: SurF是异步事件流基础模型的初步探索，通过TRT双射和跨数据集预训练策略，实现了对异构事件流的统一建模，为该领域后续研究提供了重要基础。

Abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate event streams remain a stubbornly difficult modality for generative modeling: tokenization-based approaches break down when inter-event intervals vary by orders of magnitude, and neural temporal point processes are bottlenecked by window-level numerical quadrature. We (i) propose SurF, a generative model that uses the Time Rescaling Theorem (TRT) as a learnable bijection between event sequences and i.i.d.\ unit-rate exponential noise, enabling a single model to be trained across heterogeneous event-stream datasets; (ii) three efficient parameterizations of the cumulative intensity that scale to long sequences; and (iii) a Transformer-based encoder for multi-dataset pretraining. On six real-world benchmarks, SurF achieves the best reported time RMSE on Earthquake, Retweet, and Taobao, and is within trial-level noise of the strongest specialist on the remaining three. Under a strict leave-one-out protocol, the held-out checkpoint beats every classical and neural-autoregressive baseline on 5/6 datasets and beats every baseline on Amazon and Earthquake, an initial step toward foundation models over asynchronous event streams.

</details>


### [99] [AttnGen: Attention-Guided Saliency Learning for Interpretable Genomic Sequence Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14073)
*Rayhaneh Shabani Nia,Ali Karkehabadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AttnGen 是一个把可解释性直接嵌入训练过程的框架：用一个轻量注意力模块在前向传播中估计每个核苷酸位置的重要性，据此在训练中逐步遮蔽（mask）低贡献位置，并用 KL 散度约束原始与遮蔽后预测的一致性。在 Genomic Benchmarks 的 demo_human_or_worm（10 万条 200 bp 序列的人 vs. 线虫二分类）上，10% 遮蔽取得 96.73% 验证准确率，超过传统 1D-CNN 基线 95.83%（+0.90 pp），且收敛更快、训练更稳定；梯度重要性验证显示移除高梯度位置会使准确率从 96.91% 急剧跌至随机水平，掩蔽 10–20% 位置在性能与可解释性之间取得最佳折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因组序列分类中仅有预测精度是不够的：输出常被用于下游生物学解读（识别调控 motif、排序候选区域以供实验验证），而性能好却无法解释决策过程的模型难以被信任。现有后验解释方法（saliency map、Integrated Gradients、DeepLIFT、attention-based 方法）均为训练后分析，既不改变模型如何形成决策，也存在噪声与不稳定问题；已有研究表明某些 saliency 方法在模型参数随机化后仍几乎不变，说明解释可能只是"看似合理"的伪影。而把基于梯度的 saliency 直接插入训练循环需要每步额外反向传播，计算开销大且会放大优化不稳定。因此需要一种能在前向传播中廉价获得重要性估计、并把可解释性约束真正作用于优化的方案。同时，基因组数据存在位置与组成偏置，模型可能靠偏置取得高训练准确率却缺乏泛化性。此外，与图像的连续像素不同，DNA 是离散符号序列，遮蔽单个核苷酸会同时改变局部上下文与下游表示，视觉领域的 saliency-guided 训练能否迁移到基因组建模仍不明确。

Method: 任务：Σ={A,T,G,C}、L=200 的 DNA 序列二分类（人 vs. C. elegans），学习 f_θ:Σ^L→R²。架构：基础分类器为 1D CNN——核苷酸 token 经嵌入层映射为 128 维向量，3 个卷积块（kernel size 8、BatchNorm、ReLU、max-pool stride 2）通道 128→32→16→4，展平后接两层全连接（dropout p=0.3）输出二分类 logits；kernel=8 对应约 6–8 nt 的短 motif。重要性估计：对嵌入张量 E(x)∈R^{B×L×d} 在特征维取均值得 s_{b,i}，沿序列维 softmax 得归一化权重 A_{b,i}∈R^{B×L}（用均值而非最大池化以降低早期训练噪声敏感度）。渐进遮蔽：给定遮蔽率 α，k=⌊αL⌋，取 A 最小的 k 个位置集合 I_mask（式4），用 padding token(index 0) 替换，逐序列独立进行；设置 baseline(0%)、moderate(10–25%)、high(50%)、extreme(75%) 四档。损失：L_total = L_CE(f(x),y) + λ·D_KL(f(x)‖f(x̃))，λ=0.1（在 {0.01,0.1,0.5} 上小网格搜索选取；α=0 时 λ=0 退化为标准 CE）。训练：Adam，lr=1e-3，batch 64，weight decay 1e-4，梯度裁剪 max-norm 1.0，早停 patience 10（按验证准确率），固定种子 42。梯度一致性验证：对 3000 条序列计算 I_i=‖∂f/∂E(x)_i‖₂，按梯度幅值降序逐步遮蔽并记录准确率随遮蔽位置数 m 的变化。消融：10% 配置下比较 Full(attention+KL)、Random Masking+KL、Attention Masking(无 KL)、Baseline。
