Conclusion: TILT 提供了一种简单而稳健的无监督域适应方案：把预测器分解为 f+b 并仅在目标无标签数据上惩罚 b，可隐式获得"自局部化、有一致界"的相对重要性加权，避免了精确重要性加权对支撑重叠与密度比估计精度的依赖；配合有限样本 oracle 不等式与稀疏 ReLU 的端到端保证，理论与实验一致表明其在协变量偏移下优于多种主流基线并具备良好的正则化稳定性。

Abstract: We introduce and analyze Target-Induced Loss Tilting (TILT) for unsupervised domain adaptation under covariate shift. It is based on a novel objective function that decomposes the source predictor as $f+b$, fits $f+b$ on labeled source data while simultaneously penalizing the auxiliary component $b$ on unlabeled target inputs. The resulting fit $f$ is deployed as the final target predictor. At the population level, we show that this target-side penalty implicitly induces relative importance weighting at the population level, but in terms of an estimand $b^*_f$ that is self-localized to the current error, and remains uniformly bounded for any source-target pair (even those with disjoint supports). We prove a general finite-sample oracle inequality on the excess risk, and use it to give an end-to-end guarantee for training with sparse ReLU networks. Experiments on controlled regression problems and shifted CIFAR-100 distillation show that TILT improves target-domain performance over source-only training, exact importance weighting, and relative density-ratio baselines, with a stable dependence on the regularization parameter.

</details>


### [125] [Smooth Multi-Policy Causal Effect Estimation in Longitudinal Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14284)
*Wenxin Chen,Weishen Pan,Kyra Gan,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对纵向（多时点）因果推断中"多个动态治疗策略对比评估"任务，作者指出当前主流方法（DeepACE、DeepLTMLE 等）对每个反事实策略独立拟合一套干扰模型，会在 LTMLE 去偏后残留"结构性不可控的二阶余项（second-order remainder）"，使 CATE 的有限样本方差膨胀。本文提出 PEQ-Net（Policy-Encoded Q Network）：对 ICE 的 Q-函数做"策略感知重参数化"，使模型显式以"未来策略尾部 π_{t+1:τ}"为输入并跨策略共享参数；用 RKHS 上的核均值嵌入（MMD）度量人群层面的策略差异并经 MDS 得到低维策略嵌入，再由一个反向 RNN 策略尾部编码器聚合后与共享 Transformer 主干拼接，训练时使用滞后目标网络（Polyak 平均，β=0.005），最后做一步 LTMLE 校正。在 MIMIC-III 半合成数据（N=1000，τ=15）上，PEQ-Net 在全部对照（G-comp/LTMLE Super Learner、DeepACE、DeepLTMLE）与全部反事实设定下取得最低的绝对偏差与 RMSE，在策略仅前两步不同时（如 CF 1b：偏差 0.0998→0.0015，RMSE 0.1255→0.0026）改善尤为显著；并在 MIMIC-IV 脓毒症血管加压药撤离的真实案例中给出临床一致的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床决策常需比较多个纵向（动态）治疗策略的疗效，但在时变混杂（treatment–confounder feedback loop）下，主流 ICE G-computation/LTMLE/深度 DR 方法对每个候选策略独立拟合一整套 Q 与倾向得分模型，无法利用反事实轨迹间的结构相似性。作者论证：这种"分离估计范式"即使经 LTMLE 去偏，仍缺乏对二阶余项（高阶误差交互项）的结构性约束——引理 3.1 证明即使两个策略行为完全相同，独立随机初始化下二阶余项也几乎必然不抵消（Rem^(i),(j) ≠ 0 a.s.），导致 CATE 呈现由干扰估计误差驱动的非平滑伪波动；且 CATE 由两个 CAPO 相减使余项偏差进一步复合，长时程下尤为严重。已有替代方案（IPTW 类、正向 G-computation、OPE 重要性采样等）在长时程、高维下分别存在权重方差爆炸或模型误设敏感等问题。因此需要在 ICE 估计步骤本身引入"策略相似性"度量以实现跨策略的信息共享。

Method: **问题设定**：n 条长度 τ 的轨迹 O=(L_1,A_1,…,L_τ,A_τ,Y)，行为策略 π* 未知；目标为 K 个动态反事实策略的 CAPO ψ^(i)=E[Y(π^(i))|L_1] 及 CATE（CAPO 之差），假设一致性、序贯可忽略性、正性。\n\n**核心方法 PEQ-Net**：\n1) *策略感知的 Q-函数重参数化*：Q_t(A_t,H_t,π_{t+1:τ}) = E[Q_{t+1}(π_{t+1}(H_{t+1}),H_{t+1},π_{t+2:τ}) | A_t,H_t,π_{t+1:τ}]，把"策略依赖"从隐式变为显式输入；引理 4.1（后向归纳）证明其与标准 ICE Q 函数逐点一致，故识别性不变，同时允许单模型覆盖多策略。\n2) *RKHS 策略嵌入*：每步用维度自适应的高斯核 κ_t 计算策略在观测历史上的诱导分布均值嵌入 μ_t^(i)，以 MMD² 度量策略间距离形成 K×K 距离矩阵 D_t，归一化后用度量 MDS（SMACOF）得到 ρ_t^(i)∈R^d；核带宽用中位数启发式（1/(2·median)）。确定性序列情形绕过 MDS 直接作为"退化嵌入"。\n3) *架构*：以 DeepLTMLE 的 decoder-only Transformer 为骨干（类型嵌入+位置编码，掩码保证因果性），共享 G-head（倾向）与 Q-head；策略尾部编码器 ρ̃ 为反向 RNN，将 ρ_{t+1:τ} 聚合成 p 维向量与主干表示拼接送入 Q-head。\n4) *训练*：按时间步、策略生成 G-computation 伪结果（MSE 损失），处理模型用 BCE；用滞后目标网络（Polyak 平均 β=0.005）稳定移动目标问题；所有步与所有策略损失求和联合优化。\n5) *推断*：对每个策略在留出集上做一步正则化 LTMLE（带 L1 正则的倾向得分加权 logit 扰动 ε_t 求解）得到 CAPO，差分得 CATE。\n\n**理论**：\n- 引理 3.1：分离估计范式下二阶余项不抵消；证明将余项分解为三项（权重差、倾向误差差、结果误差差），各自几乎必然非零。\n- 引理 B.1：归一化高斯核下，单步/子段 RKHS 距离可由全轨迹乘积 RKHS 距离以常数 C 支配（特征性核保证零距离⇒分布相同）。\n- 假设 B.2（正则性）：真实结果模型与反事实密度乘积对策略诱导分布的 MMD 具 Lipschitz 连续性。\n- 定理 4.2：CATE 二阶余项满足 |Rem^(i),(j)| ≤ L_R·||μ^(i)_{1:τ} − μ^(j)_{1:τ}||_{F_{1:τ}}，即余项随轨迹级策略距离线性衰减；共享倾向模型使分解中第二项恒为零，LTMLE 目标更新在严格正性下有界从而保留局部几何。\n\n**实验**：MIMIC-III 派生的两种半合成 DGP（有限混杂 / 扩展混杂，加入 5 个受治疗影响且影响治疗的时变协变量），N=1000、τ=15、20 个随机种子；对照为 G-comp(SL)、LTMLE(SL)、DeepACE、DeepLTMLE；反事实含确定性序列与动态阈值策略；另有 MIMIC-IV 脓毒症血管加压药案例。

Result: **主结果（表 1，确定性序列反事实）**：PEQ-Net 在两个 DGP、三个反事实上均取得最低偏差与 RMSE。例如有限混杂 DGP：CF1a 偏差 0.53±0.38 / RMSE 0.65（对比 DeepLTMLE 0.77/0.97、DeepACE 2.15/2.21、LTMLE-SL 2.92/3.28）；扩展混杂 DGP：CF2a 偏差 0.20±0.15、RMSE 0.26，显著优于所有基线。\n\n**动态策略反事实（表 2）**：仅前两步不同时（CF1b/2b）改善最显著：有限 DGP 偏差由 0.0998→0.0015、RMSE 由 0.1255→0.0026（CF2b：0.1006→0.0132）；扩展 DGP 偏差 0.1024→0.0003、0.1386→0.0030。全步不同时（CF1c/2c）仍优于 DeepLTMLE（有限 DGP RMSE 0.2725→0.1220；扩展 DGP 0.3692→0.1420）。\n\n**消融**：①去掉 LTMLE 仅用 ICE 的 Q 时，PEQ-Net 仍全面优于 DeepLTMLE（如扩展 DGP CF1c RMSE 0.4738→0.1071），说明增益主要来自策略编码器对 Q 函数的改进而非处理模型方差；②共享主干+微调、共享主干+多 Q-head 两种朴素参数共享方案均优于完全分离估计，但明显劣于 PEQ-Net，说明收益来自结构化策略嵌入而非单纯共享；③将"始终治疗(阈值0)/从不治疗(阈值1)"等极端差异策略加入联合训练集后，PEQ-Net 仍在所有配置下优于 DeepLTMLE，表明对异质策略集合仍稳健（但优势在结构相似策略上最强）；④核带宽在 γ∈{0.01,…,100} 范围内 RMSE 稳定；⑤策略嵌入运行时随 K 呈二次增长（K=3 时 2.68s，K=20 时 53.18s），总复杂度 O(K²N²τ²d)，N² 项是主要瓶颈（可用 Nyström 等近似缓解）。\n\n**真实案例**：MIMIC-IV 中 999 名符合 Sepsis-3、发生低血压（MAP≤65）且 24h 内使用血管加压药的 ICU 患者，以 72 小时血乳酸为结局，比较 MAP 维持阈值 65/70/75/80 mmHg 持续 12 小时即停药的四种策略；CAPO 估计（基于影响函数的 95% CI）显示 MAP 目标越高，72h 乳酸越高，但效应幅度不大，与 RCT（高 MAP 目标无生存获益）及避免不必要血管加压药暴露的指南方向一致。

Conclusion: 本文指出并形式化了"逐策略分离估计"范式在纵向 CATE 估计中的结构性缺陷：即使经过 LTMLE 去偏，二阶余项仍无结构性抵消机制，从而抬升有限样本方差。其解决方案是显式利用 ICE 递归结构的策略尾部依赖性，对 Q-函数做策略感知重参数化并以 RKHS/MMD+MDS 刻画的人群级策略相似度，从而在保留识别性的前提下实现跨反事实策略的参数共享与信息共享；定理证明余项受轨迹级 MMD 策略距离的 Lipschitz 控制，可抑制虚假非平滑波动。实验表明 PEQ-Net 相对 G-comp/LTMLE/DeepACE/DeepLTMLE 一致降低偏差与 RMSE（尤其在相近策略间），且消融证明增益源于策略嵌入而非单纯参数共享。局限与展望：理论依赖结果模型与策略编码器的 Lipschitz 假设及正则性条件；策略嵌入的 O(K²N²τ²d) 计算开销（可用核近似改进）；MDS 对确定性序列的处理较为退化、带宽依赖启发式选择；优势在结构相近策略上最强，异质策略集合下可考虑按相似性分组或自适应控制信息共享作为未来方向。

Abstract: Comparative evaluation of multiple dynamic treatment policies is essential for healthcare and policy decisions, yet conventional longitudinal causal inference methods estimate each in isolation, preventing information sharing across counterfactuals. We demonstrate that this separate estimation paradigm induces a structurally uncontrolled second-order bias, inflating finite-sample variance even after standard debiasing with longitudinal targeted maximum likelihood estimation(LTMLE). To address this, we propose a policy-aware reparameterization of Iterative Conditional Expectation (ICE) Q-functions that enables joint estimation through shared representations. We implement this approach in the Policy-Encoded Q Network (PEQ-Net), an architecture centered on a shared policy encoder. The encoder is trained using kernel mean embeddings, ensuring that the learned representation space reflects population-level policy dissimilarities. After applying an LTMLE correction step, we prove this design imposes a structural constraint on the second-order remainder, thereby stabilizing finite-sample variance. Experiments on semi-synthetic datasets demonstrate that PEQ-Net consistently outperforms existing ICE-based methods, achieving substantial reductions in root-mean-square error, particularly when evaluating closely related policies.

</details>


### [126] [MetaMoE: Diversity-Aware Proxy Selection for Privacy-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts Unification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14289)
*Weisen Jiang,Shuhao Chen,Sinno Jialin Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MetaMoE 是一个隐私保护的 MoE 统一框架：不共享任何私有数据，仅用公开数据中的「代理样本」（proxy）来训练路由器并对齐专家，从而把多个客户端各自独立微调的领域专家合并成单一可部署的 MoE 模型。其核心技术是「相关性加权行列式点过程（relevance-weighted DPP）」的多样性感知代理选择，辅以代理对齐的专家训练与上下文感知路由器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 问题设定：多个客户端基于同一种子模型在各自私有数据上独立微调，得到一组领域专家；受隐私约束，原始数据不可汇聚，传统集中式 MoE 训练不可行，联邦学习则通信成本高且在异构数据下退化。现有统一方案的缺陷：BTM 仅为集成推理、不产出单一可部署模型；Model Soup 直接参数平均，在专家差异大时脆弱；BTX 需用私有数据训练路由器；FlexOlmo 用相似度单一维度选代理，导致代理冗余、覆盖窄，且专家仅在私有数据上训练、与路由器监督分布不匹配（domain isolation）。因此需要更精细的代理选择与专家对齐策略。

Method: 四阶段流程：(1) 代理选择——训练二分类器 g 区分私有域与公开域，得到每个公开样本的相关性分数 r；取 top-n 候选池，用相关性加权 DPP（核 L̃ = Diag(r)·L·Diag(r)，目标 log det(L̃_S) = 2Σlog r_i + log det(L_S)）以贪心 MAP 推断选 m 个既相关又多样的代理；借助 Cholesky 增量更新将复杂度从 O(nm³) 降到 O(nm)。(2) 代理对齐专家训练——每客户端在私有数据 + 本客户端代理数据上仅微调 FFN 子层（LoRA），使专家行为与路由器监督分布对齐。(3) 上下文感知路由器——将 token 表示与序列级平均表示以可学习权重 λ 混合，路由向量 e_p^(l) 用私有+代理数据的均值嵌入做域感知初始化，避免相似 token 的路由碰撞。(4) 最终在所有代理数据并集上联合微调路由器与 MoE 的 FFN 专家。隐私方面仅上传公开代理索引、专家 FFN 权重和路由向量，原始样本/梯度/激活均不出域，属数据驻留模型，并给出敏感性界、不可恢复性与优于 FlexOlmo 的形式化保证。

Result: CV：Pets/Flowers/EuroSAT 三个客户端域，CLIP ViT-B/32 平均 94.52%（FlexOlmo 92.92%，+1.6），ViT-B/16 平均 96.24%（FlexOlmo 93.53%，+2.7）；BTM 90.33/91.75，ModelSoup 74.20/79.42，BTX 74.30/81.20。NLP：CSQA/CosmosQA/SocialIQA，LLaMA-3.2-3B 平均 74.42%（最强基线 FlexOlmo 72.50），LLaMA-3.1-8B 平均 81.59%（FlexOlmo 77.46）。消融：DPP 选择对 FlexOlmo 与 MetaMoE 均稳定增益（LLaMA-8B 分别 +2.32、+1.27）；上下文感知路由（+0.6~+2.2）与代理对齐训练（+0.6~+2.4）均带来一致提升；仅用代理训练专家会大幅退化（ViT-B/32 平均仅 44.74%，ViT-B/16 为 52.17%），说明私有数据对专家专门化不可替代。鲁棒性：更换公开数据集为 OpenOrca 仍领先（74.79%）；移除 ImageNet 中与客户端语义重叠类别后 MetaMoE 仅降 0.74（93.78%）而 FlexOlmo 降 3.53（89.39%）。效率：DPP 相对相似度选代理仅增加 0.2–0.3 分钟/客户端；统一时间与 FlexOlmo/BTX 相当，推理速度相当（BTM 约慢 3×）；同时优于联邦方法 CoMiGS 与 MoA。MetaMoE 与 UnrestrictedMoE（打破隐私的上界）差距很小（CV 约 0.4–0.5 点，NLP 上 8B 甚至略高）。

Conclusion: 多样性感知代理选择（相关性加权 DPP）+ 代理对齐专家训练 + 上下文感知路由三者结合，能在不共享私有数据的前提下有效统一异构领域专家，且在 CV/NLP 多基准上稳定超越 BTM、Model Soup、BTX、FlexOlmo 等隐私保护基线，接近甚至达到联合训练的 MoE 上界；所给出的路由向量隐私保证（O(1/m) 单样本敏感性、μ_priv 不可恢复、隐私暴露严格少于 FlexOlmo）在数据驻留威胁模型下成立。局限/开放问题：保证依赖「私有集大小 N 不泄露」等假设，尚未引入正式差分隐私机制（作者在影响声明中提示高风险领域需额外审计）；仅在 3 客户端、有限 backbone 与代理规模上验证；未验证更多客户端、跨更多模态与更大规模模型的可扩展性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity by combining specialized experts, but most existing approaches assume centralized access to training data. In practice, data are distributed across clients and cannot be shared due to privacy constraints, making unified MoE training challenging. We propose MetaMoE, a privacy-preserving framework that unifies independently trained, domain-specialized experts into a single MoE using public proxy data as surrogates for inaccessible private data. Central to MetaMoE is diversity-aware proxy selection, which selects client-domain-relevant and diverse samples from public data to effectively approximate private data distributions and supervise router learning. These proxies are further used to align expert training, improving expert coordination at unification time, while a context-aware router enhances expert selection across heterogeneous inputs. Experiments on computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks demonstrate that MetaMoE consistently outperforms recent privacy-preserving MoE unification methods. Code is available at https://github.com/ws-jiang/MetaMoE.

</details>


### [127] [Minimal-Intervention KV Retention: A Design-Space Study and a Diversity-Penalty Survivor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14292)
*Libo Sun,Po-wei Harn,Peixiong He,Xiao Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对小预算KV-cache压缩问题，先验证了七种现有机制均失败，随后提出只需修改一个函数的α方法（替换argmax-top-k为贪心设施位置选择+ V-space冗余惩罚），在预注册协议下确认其在特定模型和预算组合上显著有效，揭示了minimal scoring modification优于structural redesign的非对称性发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在小预算下 KV-cache 压缩是一个拥挤的设计空间，涉及五种机制族；现有七种机制在匹配的缓存预算下均被拒绝。

Method: 提出α方法：对TriAttention的retention scorer进行单函数修改，将argmax-top-k替换为基于贪心设施位置启发的选择机制，使用V-space冗余惩罚（由单一权重λ控制）；采用预注册协议在frozen development split上调优λ，在disjoint held-out split上确认。

Result: 在b ∈ {64, 128}的预算下，λ=0.5的α在四个(model, budget)组合中的两个（Qwen b=128和Llama b=64）通过Bonferroni校正，无任何cell显著负向，预注册Branch A触发。

Conclusion: α的改进效果具有非对称性：最小化的评分修改优于更重的结构重设计；combined matched-memory, sympy-graded, held-out confirmation protocol是揭示这种非对称性的关键。

Abstract: KV-cache compression at small budgets is a crowded design space spanning cache representation, head-wise routing, compression cadence, decoding behavior, and within-budget scoring. We study seven mechanisms across these five families under matched mean cache on long-form mathematical reasoning (MATH-500~\cite{hendrycks2021math}) with two distilled-reasoning models (Qwen-7B and Llama-8B variants of DeepSeek-R1-Distill~\cite{deepseek2025r1}) at budgets $b \in \{64, 128\}$. All seven were rejected. We then propose $α$, a one-function modification to the TriAttention~\cite{mao2026triattention} retention scorer that replaces argmax-top-$k$ with greedy facility-location-inspired selection under a V-space redundancy penalty controlled by a single weight $λ$. A pre-registered protocol tunes $λ$ on a frozen development split and confirms on a disjoint held-out split; with $λ= 0.5$, $α$ clears Bonferroni on two of the four (model, budget) cells (Qwen $b{=}128$ and Llama $b{=}64$), no cell is significantly negative, and the pre-registered Branch~A triggers. The finding is asymmetric: a minimal scoring modification beat heavier structural redesigns in this regime, and the combined matched-memory, sympy-graded, held-out confirmation protocol is the evidence standard that made the asymmetry visible.

</details>


### [128] [Policy Optimization in Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Action Spaces via Mixed Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14297)
*Matias Alvo,Daniel Russo,Yash Kanoria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HPO解决混合离散-连续动作空间中的强化学习问题，通过混合梯度估计器（在允许情况下反向传播模拟器梯度）与SF梯度结合来保持无偏性，同时利用离散动作结构实现方差缩减。实验表明在库存控制和切换线性二次调节器问题上显著优于PPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Standard model-free policy gradient methods rely on score-function estimators and suffer from severe credit-assignment issues in high-dimensional settings, leading to poor gradient quality. Differentiable simulation avoids these issues but yields biased/uninformative gradients when discrete actions or non-smooth dynamics are present.

Method: Hybrid Policy Optimization (HPO): backpropagates through simulator where smoothness permits, uses mixed gradient estimator combining pathwise and score-function gradients while maintaining unbiasedness. Problems with action discontinuities are reformulated in hybrid form.

Result: Substantially outperforms PPO on inventory control and switched linear-quadratic regulator problems. Cross term (capturing how continuous actions influence future discrete decisions) becomes negligible near discrete best response, enabling approximate decentralized updates and variance reduction near optimality.

Conclusion: HPO substantially outperforms PPO on benchmark problems, with performance gaps increasing as continuous action dimension grows. The cross term becomes negligible near discrete best response, enabling approximate decentralized updates.

Abstract: We study reinforcement learning in hybrid discrete-continuous action spaces, such as settings where the discrete component selects a regime (or index) and the continuous component optimizes within it -- a structure common in robotics, control, and operations problems. Standard model-free policy gradient methods rely on score-function (SF) estimators and suffer from severe credit-assignment issues in high-dimensional settings, leading to poor gradient quality. On the other hand, differentiable simulation largely sidesteps these issues by backpropagating through a simulator, but the presence of discrete actions or non-smooth dynamics yields biased or uninformative gradients. To address this, we propose Hybrid Policy Optimization (HPO), which backpropagates through the simulator wherever smoothness permits, using a mixed gradient estimator that combines pathwise and SF gradients while maintaining unbiasedness. We also show how problems with action discontinuities can be reformulated in hybrid form, further broadening its applicability. Empirically, HPO substantially outperforms PPO on inventory control and switched linear-quadratic regulator problems, with performance gaps increasing as the continuous action dimension grows. Finally, we characterize the structure of the mixed gradient, showing that its cross term -- which captures how continuous actions influence future discrete decisions -- becomes negligible near a discrete best response, thereby enabling approximate decentralized updates of the continuous and discrete components and reducing variance near optimality. All resources are available at github.com/MatiasAlvo/hybrid-rl.

</details>


### [129] [Language-Induced Priors for Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14301)
*Qiyuan Chen,Jiayu Zhou,Raed Al Kontar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出LIP框架，通过利用LLM从目标域文本描述中学习先验偏好，在冷启动域适应中指导源域选择，理论上证明了估计器的有效性和一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决冷启动域适应中的基本悖论：当目标数据稀缺时，统计方法难以区分相关与不相关的源域，容易导致负迁移。

Method: 提出Language-Induced Prior (LIP)概率框架，将LLM预训练语言模型中学习到的偏好转化为先验选择模型，集成到EM算法中识别源域相关性。LIP引导源选择，同时随样本积累逐步精炼选择。

Result: 实验验证了框架在描述性（高斯估计）、预测性（C-MAPSS数据集）和规范性任务（MuJoCo hopper）上的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出LIP框架并证明其在冷启动场景下的有效性，理论证明了该估计器在正确先验下与Oracle冷启动MSE大致匹配，且无论LIP质量如何都保持渐进一致性。实验验证了其在描述性、预测性和规范性任务中的泛化能力。

Abstract: Domain adaptation faces a fundamental paradox in the cold-start regime. When target data is scarce, statistical methods fail to distinguish relevant source domains from irrelevant ones, which often leads to negative transfer. In this paper, we address this challenge by leveraging expert textual descriptions of the target domain, a resource that is often available but overlooked. We propose a probabilistic framework that translates these semantic descriptions into a choice model, namely a Language-Induced Prior (LIP), that learns the preferences from a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM). The LIP is then integrated into an Expectation-Maximization algorithm to identify source relevance. Methodologically, this framework is compatible with any parametric model where a likelihood is available. It allows the LIP to guide the selection of sources when target signals are weak, while gradually refining these choices as samples accumulate. Theoretically, we prove that the estimator roughly matches an oracle cold-start MSE under a correct prior, while remaining asymptotically consistent regardless of the quality of the LIP. Empirically, we validated the framework on a descriptive (Gaussian estimation), a predictive (C-MAPSS dataset), and a prescriptive task (MuJoCo hopper).

</details>


### [130] [Matrix-Space Reinforcement Learning for Reusing Local Transition Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14304)
*Zuyuan Zhang,Carlee Joe-Wong,Tian Lan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出矩阵空间强化学习(MSRL)，通过正半定矩阵描述子表示轨迹片段以捕获转移的统计结构，实现跨任务迁移和组合泛化。理论证明了描述子的well-definedness、完备性和极小充分性，实验验证了优于基线方法的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing compositional generalization methods in sequential decision-making either reuse skills or predictive models, but fail to leverage rich local transition geometry and dynamics information embedded in prior rollouts.

Method: Matrix-Space Reinforcement Learning (MSRL): represents trajectory segments using positive semidefinite matrix descriptors that aggregate first- and second-order statistics of lifted one-step transitions, enabling algebraic composition in abstract matrix space; value functions are conditioned on trajectory-segment matrices to achieve first-order smooth approximation of action values.

Result: Empirically, MSRL achieves best average finite-budget target AUC of 0.73, outperforming MSRL from scratch (0.65), TD-MPC-PT+FT (0.63), and TD-MPC (0.57).

Conclusion: MSRL outperforms baseline methods with 0.73 AUC (vs MSRL scratch 0.65, TD-MPC-PT+FT 0.63, TD-MPC 0.57), demonstrating that matrix-based trajectory abstraction enables effective transfer across tasks while maintaining plug-in compatibility with existing RL methods.

Abstract: Compositional generalization in sequential decision-making requires identifying which parts of prior rollouts remain useful for new tasks. Existing methods reuse skills or predictive models, but often overlook rich local transition geometry and dynamics. We propose Matrix-Space Reinforcement Learning (MSRL), a geometric abstraction that represents trajectory segments through positive semidefinite matrix descriptors aggregating first- and second-order statistics of lifted one-step transitions. These descriptors expose shared hidden structure, support algebraic composition in an abstract matrix space, and reveal opportunities for transfer. We prove that the descriptor is well defined up to coordinate gauge, complete for the induced low-order additive signal class, additive under valid segment composition, and minimally sufficient among admissible additive descriptors. We further show that conditioning value functions on the trajectory-segment matrix yields a first-order smooth approximation of action values, enabling source-learned matrix-to-value mappings to bootstrap learning in new tasks. MSRL is plug-in compatible with standard model-free and model-based methods, while obstruction filtering rejects implausible compositions. Empirically, MSRL achieves the best average finite-budget target AUC of 0.73, outperforming MSRL from scratch (0.65), TD-MPC-PT+FT (0.63), and TD-MPC (0.57).

</details>


### [131] [Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14311)
*Yuchen Sun,Pei Fu,Shaojie Zhang,Anan Du,Xiuwen Xi,Ruoceng Zhang,Zhenbo Luo,Jian Luan,Chongyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BBCritic，将GUI批评从二元分类范式转变为度量学习范式，通过两阶段对比学习恢复affordance层级结构，并构建了首个支持细粒度排名的GUI批评基准BBench。实验证明3B规模的BBCritic可超越7B参数的二元分类SOTA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI批评模型采用二元分类（有效/无效），导致有效动作分数与似是而非的无效干扰项分数难以区分，原因在于两个结构性缺陷：Affordance Collapse（层级affordance空间被压缩为0/1标签）和Noise Sensitivity（二元目标对噪声决策边界过拟合）。

Method: 采用两阶段对比学习，将指令和动作对齐到共享的Affordance Space中，恢复被二元监督压平的层级结构；同时提出BBench基准测试。

Result: BBCritic-3B在无需额外标注的情况下，性能超越7B参数的SOTA二元分类模型，并展现出跨平台、跨任务的强零样本迁移能力。

Conclusion: BBCritic通过无需额外标注的训练方式超越7B参数的SOTA二元分类模型，展示了跨平台和跨任务的强零样本迁移能力，验证了"GUI批评本质上是度量学习问题而非分类问题"的论断。

Abstract: Test-Time Scaling (TTS), which samples multiple candidate actions and ranks them via a Critic Model, has emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist GUI agents. Its efficacy thus hinges on the critic's fine-grained ranking ability. However, existing GUI critic models uniformly adopt binary classification. Our motivational analysis of these models exposes a severe entanglement: scores for valid actions and plausible-but-invalid distractors become indistinguishable. We attribute this failure to two structural defects: Affordance Collapse--the hierarchical affordance space is compressed into 0/1 labels; and Noise Sensitivity--binary objectives overfit to noisy decision boundaries. To resolve this, we introduce BBCritic (Beyond-Binary Critic), a paradigm shift grounded in the Functional Equivalence Hypothesis. Through two-stage contrastive learning, BBCritic aligns instructions and actions in a shared Affordance Space, recovering the hierarchical structure that binary supervision flattens. We also present BBBench (Beyond-Binary Bench), the first GUI critic benchmark that pairs a dense action space with a hierarchical four-level taxonomy, enabling fine-grained ranking evaluation. Experimental results show that BBCritic-3B, trained without any extra annotation, outperforms 7B-parameter SOTA binary models. It demonstrates strong zero-shot transferability across platforms and tasks, supporting our methodological view: GUI critique is fundamentally a metric-learning problem, not a classification one.

</details>


### [132] [Guided Diffusion Sampling for Precipitation Forecast Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14317)
*Ayumu Ueyama,Kazuhiko Kawamoto,Hiroshi Kera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出基于数据驱动天气预报模型（GenCast）的"天气干预"框架：通过梯度引导扩散模型的采样轨迹（而非像对抗攻击那样直接扰动大气状态）来减少目标区域降水，同时保持与大气分布的一致性。在 WeatherBench2 2022 构建的 219 个极端降水事件数据集上，该方法在降水削减强度上与对抗攻击 AOWF 相当或略弱，但物理合理性显著更优：扰动集中于对中低层、更稀疏、潜空间轨迹偏差更小、且可迁移至 GraphCast。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端降水造成严重社会与经济损失，天气调控（weather control）长期被视为潜在缓解手段。既有方案依赖数值天气预报（NWP）模型，计算代价高昂，限制实时探索；而数据驱动预报模型（Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、GenCast 等）推理近实时，为高效设计与评估干预提供了可能。已有最相关工作 AOWF 属于对抗攻击范畴，其扰动利用模型伪影、诱导非物理行为，且缺少"干预需有施效延迟"的现实约束。本文动机在于：(1) 首次在数据驱动预报模型上开展基于扰动的降水削减干预研究；(2) 直接梯度优化扰动（如 PGD/AOWF）过于激进，会使扰动后的预报迅速偏离大气状态分布，必须引入物理合理性约束。

Method: 形式化：设大气状态 X^t∈R^{H×W×V}，一步预报模型 f（递归 T 步），干预仅施加于 t+1 步（存在施效准备时间），目标为最小化目标区域 R 在 t+T 时刻的降水场，损失 L(P_R[X̂^{t+T}])= 目标区域网格平均预报降水。

方法核心（梯度引导扩散采样）：以 GenCast 为骨干。其生成归一化残差 Z^{t+1}，X̂^{t+1}=X^t+S Z^{t+1}；在每个噪声级 σ_i，用去噪器 d 估计 Ẑ_i^{t+1}，并对该估计施加控制目标梯度修正：Z̃_i^{t+1}= Ẑ_i^{t+1} − λ∇_{Ẑ_i} L(P_R[X̂_i^{t+T}])（i=0,…,N−1，在最终噪声级 σ_N 省略引导以避免过度扰动）；最终扰动 δ^{t+1}=X̃^{t+1}−X̂^{t+1}。近似推断：仅从 N 个噪声级中取 n 个代表级做前后向推理，避免全链反传。

实现细节：GenCast 单步 12 小时预报；扰动变量限温度与 u/v 风分量（排除比湿，理由是实际执行器位于开阔海域、水汽由海面持续补充）；目标区域为超阈值点的 ±2° 邻域；损失为区域内降水均值；AOWF 基线预算 ε=0.07（归一化空间标准差投影）、50 步 PGD，本方法与 AOWF 均用 n=2 近似推断、T=2。

计算复杂度：AOWF 需 100 前向 + 100 反向去噪器调用，本方法 60 前向 + 40 反向，约 2× 更省；实测每事件墙钟时间 8.4s vs AOWF 14.1s。

Result: 数据集：从 WeatherBench2 2022、1° 分辨率提取，逐日气候态求降水距平，取各网格点年最大距平的 99 百分位的空间均值 τ=0.06668 作为阈值，限定陆面，48 小时/300 km 内去重，并以 GenCast 一步预报可复现事件为可预报性过滤，最终得 219 个事件（日本、巴西、印度、澳大利亚、莫桑比克等）。

有效性：本文方法 λ=1000/2500/5000/7500/10000 的削减比分别为 0.3136/0.5414/0.7198/0.8025/0.8479，成功率 0.7818/0.9420/0.9972/1.0/1.0；非目标区 RMSE（×10^-4）为 0.94/1.77/2.60/3.10/3.45，MAE（×10^-6）为 2.97/4.95/8.15/8.45/10.45。AOWF 削减比 0.9491、成功率 1.000，但 RMSE 15.95、MAE 435.0（严重畸变）。定性上本文方法将降水"转移"到邻近区域（物理上合理），AOWF 则近乎凭空消失降水。

合理性检验1（扰动廓线）：AOWF 扰动幅度最大的层出现在高层/上对流层，与中尺度极端降水的低-中对流层成雨机制不符；本文方法集中于低-中层（温度偏低层、风偏中层），廓线随气压平滑，更稀疏（|δ|<0.01 占比更高），空间梯度平缓、不易激发虚假重力波。

合理性检验2（潜空间偏差）：取 GenCast 去噪器 processor 输出为潜特征，逐步比较再分析/标准预报/干预预报。标准预报最贴近再分析；AOWF 在第 13–14 步后 RMSE 急升、余弦相似度骤降，且有外溢；本文方法 RMSE 更低、余弦相似度更高，第 14 步后 RMSE 稳定、后期余弦相似度回升，非目标区与标准预报几乎一致。3D PCA 轨迹可视化中，本方法轨迹持续指向再分析目标点，而 AOWF 常漂向不同簇。

合理性检验3（跨模型迁移）：将 GenCast 上优化的 δ^{t+1} 直接加到 GraphCast 输入并连推两步（6 小时/步）。AOWF 迁移后削减比降至 0.4773、成功率 0.8084（非目标 RMSE 1.86、MAE 29.10）；本文方法 λ=10000 达削减比 0.5614、成功率 0.8879，均优于 AOWF，且在印度、巴西明显削减、日本（台风型）部分削减。

补充（附录 E）：非目标区 FSS，本文方法在所有 λ 与邻域尺度下均 ≥0.957（1°/3°/5°：0.9901→0.9590 等），AOWF 仅 0.4652–0.5796，说明 AOWF 的退化并非"双惩罚"式空间平移假象，而是真正破坏了周边降水格局。

Conclusion: 本文开创性地将"天气干预"从 NWP 迁移到数据驱动扩散预报模型：核心思想是"不直接扰动大气状态，而是引导扩散采样轨迹"，从而在实现有效降水削减的同时保持与大气分布（潜空间）的一致性；配套构建了 219 个极端降水事件数据集与一套物理合理性度量（扰动廓线、潜空间偏差、跨模型迁移性）。结果表明，本文方法在控制强度与 AOWF 相当的前提下，显著更少地破坏非目标区预报、更符合降水形成的垂直结构、潜空间更稳定、且迁移性更好，代价是降水削减幅度较温和、且存在控制强度与非目标畸变之间的权衡（λ 越大削减越强但 RMSE/MAE 越高）。局限与未来方向：(1) 缺乏 NWP 验证——扰动未必动力平衡，在 NWP 积分中可能迅速衰减，且 NWP 需额外预处理与调优；(2) 对干预区域的空间分布控制能力有限，未来需支持海洋等稀疏人口区域的任意形状干预；(3) 作者亦指出天气控制的伦理与潜在风险需专门研究。

Abstract: Extreme precipitation causes severe societal and economic damage, and weather control has long been discussed as a potential mitigation strategy. However, to the best of our knowledge, perturbation-based interventions for weather control using data-driven weather forecasting models have not yet been explored. While adversarial attacks also generate perturbations that alter forecasts, they aim to exploit model artifacts and do not account for physical plausibility. In this paper, we propose a gradient-based guidance framework for precipitation-reduction interventions through diffusion sampling in diffusion-based weather forecasting models. Instead of directly perturbing atmospheric states, our method steers the diffusion sampling trajectory, enabling precipitation reduction while maintaining consistency with the atmospheric distribution. To assess physical plausibility, we evaluate from three perspectives: (i) vertical and variable-wise perturbation profiles, (ii) latent-space trajectory deviation, and (iii) cross-model transferability. Experiments on extreme precipitation events from WeatherBench2 demonstrate that our method achieves effective precipitation reduction while yielding more physically plausible interventions than adversarial perturbations.

</details>


### [133] [Dynamic Latent Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14323)
*Fangyuan Yu,Xin Su,Amir Abdullah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出DLR方法，通过在单一训练阶段中动态搜索联合学习离散潜码和路由策略，在低数据微调场景下显著超越SFT（平均提升6.6个百分点），并通过机理分析证明了其学习到的结构化路由行为的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中具有时变奖励函数的子策略时间组合问题，旨在找到在复杂时变环境下的最优目标可达策略。

Method: 提出了General Dijkstra Search (GDS)方法，证明了全局最优目标可达策略可通过中间最优子策略的时间组合恢复。受GDS的"搜索、选择、更新"原则启发，提出Dynamic Latent Routing (DLR)方法，这是一种语言模型后训练方法，在单一训练阶段中通过动态搜索联合学习离散潜码、路由策略和模型参数。

Result: 在低数据微调设置下，DLR在四个数据集和六个模型上匹配或超越了监督微调（SFT），平均提升+6.6个百分点，而此前的离散潜码基线方法持续表现不如SFT。

Conclusion: Mechanistic analyses and targeted code ablations show that DLR learns structured routing behaviors with distinct causal roles，证明了DLR在低数据微调场景中的有效性及其学习到的结构化路由行为的因果意义。

Abstract: We investigate the temporal concatenation of sub-policies in Markov Decision Processes (MDP) with time-varying reward functions. We introduce General Dijkstra Search (GDS), and prove that globally optimal goal-reaching policies can be recovered through temporal composition of intermediate optimal sub-policies. Motivated by the "search, select, update" principle underlying GDS, we propose Dynamic Latent Routing (DLR), a language-model post-training method that jointly learns discrete latent codes, routing policies, and model parameters through dynamic search in a single training stage. In low-data fine-tuning settings, DLR matches or outperforms supervised fine-tuning across four datasets and six models, achieving a mean gain of +6.6 percentage points, while prior discrete-latent baselines consistently underperform SFT. Mechanistic analyses and targeted code ablations show that DLR learns structured routing behaviors with distinct causal roles.

</details>


### [134] [AIM-DDI: A Model-Agnostic Multimodal Integration Module for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14327)
*Yerin Park,Sangseon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AIM-DDI proposes an architecture-independent multimodal integration module that treats drug modality information as tokens in a shared latent space, enabling model-agnostic fusion of structural, chemical, and semantic signals for improved drug-drug interaction prediction, particularly for unseen drugs.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing multimodal DDI models have fusion mechanisms tightly coupled to specific prediction architectures, limiting reusability across different models and hindering generalization to unseen drugs.

Method: AIM-DDI represents heterogeneous modality information as tokens in a shared latent space and models cross-modality dependencies through a unified fusion module, enabling model-agnostic integration of structural, chemical, and semantic drug signals.

Result: AIM-DDI consistently improves DDI prediction performance across diverse models and DrugBank-based settings, with the most significant gains observed in the both-unseen scenario where neither drug in a test pair is observed during training.

Conclusion: Treating multimodal integration as a reusable, architecture-independent module is an effective strategy for robust unseen-drug DDI prediction, with consistent performance improvements across diverse models and strongest gains in the most challenging both-unseen setting.

Abstract: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is a critical task in computational biomedicine, as adverse interactions between co-administered drugs can cause severe side effects and clinical risks. A key challenge is unseen-drug generalization, where interactions must be predicted for drugs not observed during training. Although multimodal DDI models exploit diverse drug-related information, their fusion mechanisms are often tied to specific prediction architectures, limiting their reuse across models. To address this, we propose AIM-DDI, an architecture-independent multimodal integration module that represents heterogeneous modality information as tokens in a shared latent space. By modeling dependencies across modality tokens through a unified fusion module, AIM-DDI enables model-agnostic integration of structural, chemical, and semantic drug signals across different DDI prediction architectures. Extensive evaluations across diverse DDI models and DrugBank-based settings show that AIM-DDI consistently improves prediction performance, with the strongest gains under the most challenging both-unseen setting where neither drug in a test pair is observed during training. These results suggest that treating multimodal integration as a reusable module, rather than a model-specific fusion component, is an effective strategy for robust unseen-drug DDI prediction.

</details>


### [135] [Nearest-Neighbor Radii under Dependent Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14343)
*Yuanyuan Gao,Yilong Hou,Zhexiao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The paper extends nearest-neighbor analysis to dependent sampling scenarios using strong mixing, proving convergence and moment bounds that depend only on intrinsic dimension rather than ambient dimension.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nearest-neighbor methods are fundamental yet typically analyzed under independent sampling; need to understand whether dependence changes the scale of nearest-neighbor neighborhoods in real-world dependent data.

Method: Analyzed strong mixing dependent observations; established distribution-free almost sure convergence under polynomial mixing and sharp non-asymptotic moment bounds under geometric mixing.

Result: Established distribution-free almost sure convergence under polynomial mixing and sharp non-asymptotic moment bounds under geometric mixing.

Conclusion: The bounds depend on local intrinsic dimension rather than ambient dimension, making results applicable to high-dimensional data on lower-dimensional manifolds; experiments confirm nearest-neighbor geometry remains informative under dependence.

Abstract: Nearest-neighbor methods are fundamental to classical and modern machine learning, yet their geometric properties are typically analyzed under independent sampling. In this paper, we study the nearest-neighbor radii under dependent sampling. We consider strong mixing dependent observations and ask whether dependence changes the scale of nearest-neighbor neighborhoods. We establish distribution-free almost sure convergence under polynomial mixing and sharp non-asymptotic moment bounds under geometric mixing. The moment bounds depend on the local intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension, making the results applicable to high-dimensional data concentrated near lower-dimensional manifolds. Synthetic experiments and real-world time-series benchmarks support the theory, showing that nearest-neighbor geometry remains informative under dependence sampling.

</details>


### [136] [Exemplar Partitioning for Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14347)
*Jessica Rumbelow*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Exemplar Partitioning (EP) is a new unsupervised method for building interpretable feature dictionaries from LLM activations that uses leader-clustering with distance thresholds. It achieves comparable or better performance than SAEs on concept detection (AUROC 0.881 vs SAE leaderboard 0.755) while requiring ~1000× less training compute. Key advantages include cross-layer/model/checkpoint comparability and built-in OOD detection.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) require ~10³× more tokens for training, and learned dictionaries lack direct comparability across layers, models, or checkpoints. There is a need for more efficient and interpretable feature dictionary construction methods.

Method: EP uses leader-clustering on streamed activations within a distance threshold to create Voronoi partitions. Each region is anchored by an observed exemplar that serves as both membership criterion and intervention direction. Dictionary size is determined dynamically by activation geometry rather than being prespecified.

Result: EP dictionaries achieve: (1) interpretable regions supporting causal interventions (exemplar ablation can collapse refusal); (2) ~20% regions match SAE features at F1>0.5; (3) ~97% probe accuracy retention at ℓ₀=1; (4) on AxBench at Gemma-2-2B-it L20, EP reaches mean AUROC 0.881, +0.126 over GemmaScope SAE leaderboard and within 0.030 of SAE-A's 0.911.

Conclusion: EP provides an efficient, interpretable alternative to SAEs for analyzing LLM activations, with direct cross-layer/model/checkpoint comparability, causal intervention capability, and strong OOD detection performance at ~1000× less compute than comparable SAEs.

Abstract: We introduce Exemplar Partitioning (EP), an unsupervised method for constructing interpretable feature dictionaries from large language model activations with $\sim 10^{3}\times$ fewer tokens than comparable sparse autoencoders (SAEs). An EP dictionary is a Voronoi partition of activation space, built by leader-clustering streamed activations within a distance threshold. Each region is anchored by an observed exemplar that serves as both its membership criterion and intervention direction; dictionary size is not prespecified, but determined by the activation geometry at that threshold. Because exemplars are observed rather than learned, dictionaries built from the same data stream are directly comparable across layers, models, and training checkpoints.
  We characterise EP as an interpretability object via targeted demonstrations of properties newly accessible through this construction, plus one head-to-head benchmark. In Gemma-2-2B, EP dictionary regions are interpretable and support causal interventions: refusal in instruction-tuned Gemma concentrates in a region whose exemplar ablation can collapse held-out refusal. Cross-checkpoint matching between base and instruction-tuned dictionaries separates the directions preserved through finetuning from those introduced by it. EP regions and Gemma Scope SAE features decompose activation space differently but agree on a shared core: $\sim 20\%$ of EP regions match an SAE feature at $F_{1} > 0.5$, and EP one-hot probes retain $\sim 97\%$ of raw-activation probe accuracy at $\ell_{0} = 1$. Nearest-exemplar distance provides a free out-of-distribution signal at inference. On AxBench latent concept detection at Gemma-2-2B-it L20, EP at $p_{1}$ reaches mean AUROC $0.881$, $+0.126$ over the canonical GemmaScope SAE leaderboard entry and within $0.030$ of SAE-A's $0.911$, at $\sim 10^{3}\times$ less build compute.

</details>


### [137] [Distributionally Robust Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Task Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14350)
*Nicholas E. Corrado,Wenyuan Huang,Josiah P. Hanna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DRATS算法，通过自适应任务采样解决多任务强化学习中的数据分配不平衡问题，自适应地优先采样远离解决状态的困难任务，并在元世界基准上验证了数据效率和最差任务性能的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多任务强化学习面临任务学习不平衡问题：简单任务快速解决，困难任务学习缓慢。现有方法主要关注梯度冲突，但忽视了另一个关键问题——数据分配不平衡。标准MTRL对所有任务分配相等的交互次数，导致简单任务过度分配、困难任务分配不足。

Method: 将MTRL形式化为可行性问题，推导出最小化最差情况收益差距的minimax目标函数。提出Distributionally Robust Adaptive Task Sampling (DRATS)算法，自适应地优先采样距离被解决最远的任务。

Result: 在MetaWorld-MT10和MT50基准测试中，DRATS相比现有任务采样算法显著提高了数据效率，并提升了最差任务的性能。

Conclusion: 通过关注数据分配而非仅关注梯度冲突，DRATS有效缓解了多任务强化学习中的任务不平衡问题，证明了自适应采样困难任务的重要性。

Abstract: Multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) aims to train a single agent to efficiently optimize performance across multiple tasks simultaneously. However, jointly optimizing all tasks often yields imbalanced learning: agents quickly solve easy tasks but learn slowly on harder ones. While prior work primarily attributes this imbalance to conflicting task gradients and proposes gradient manipulation or specialized architectures to address it, we instead focus on a distinct and under-explored challenge: imbalanced data allocation. Standard MTRL allocates an equal number of environment interactions to each task, which over-allocates data to easy tasks that require relatively few interactions to solve and under-allocates data to hard tasks that require substantially more experience to solve. To address this challenge, we introduce Distributionally Robust Adaptive Task Sampling (DRATS), an algorithm that adaptively prioritizes sampling tasks furthest from being solved. We derive DRATS by formalizing MTRL as a feasibility problem from which we derive a minimax objective for minimizing the worst-case return gap, the difference between a desired target return and the agent's return on a task. In benchmarks like MetaWorld-MT10 and MT50, DRATS improves data efficiency and increases worst-task performance compared to existing task sampling algorithms.

</details>


### [138] [RQ-MoE: Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts for Efficient Input-Dependent Vector Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14359)
*Zhengjia Zhong,Shuyan Ke,Zaizhou Lin,Jiaqi Song,Hongyi Lan,Hui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RQ-MoE通过双层MoE与双流量化实现输入依赖的动态码本适配，突破静态码本限制并解决顺序依赖瓶颈，理论证明可退化为标准RQ和QINCo，实验验证其优越性能与加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法采用静态码本，无法适应异构数据几何结构；动态量化器虽能适配个体输入，但严格的顺序依赖导致解码瓶颈。

Method: 提出RQ-MoE框架，融合双层专家混合架构与双流量化机制，实现输入依赖的码本动态适配。该架构将指令流与量化流解耦，支持并行解码。

Result: 实验表明RQ-MoE在重构和检索任务上达到最优或可比性能，解码速度较先前方法提升6-14倍。

Conclusion: RQ-MoE在重构和检索任务上达到或接近最优性能，同时将解码速度提升6-14倍，代码已开源。

Abstract: Vector quantization is a fundamental tool for compressing high-dimensional embeddings, yet existing multi-codebook methods rely on static codebooks that limit expressiveness under heterogeneous data geometry. While recent dynamic quantizers like QINCo adapt codebooks to individual inputs and improve expressiveness, their strict sequential dependencies create decoding bottlenecks. We propose Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts (RQ-MoE), a framework combining a two-level MoE with dual-stream quantization to enable input-dependent codebook adaptation for efficient vector quantization. RQ-MoE enables dynamic codebook construction and decouples instruction from quantization, facilitating parallel decoding. Theoretically, we show that standard Residual Quantization and QINCo can be recovered as constrained special cases of RQ-MoE, and derive a guideline for setting expert dimensionality in RQ-MoE. Extensive experiments show that RQ-MoE achieves state-of-the-art or on-par performance in reconstruction and retrieval, while providing 6x-14x faster decoding than prior vector quantization methods. The implementation is available at https://github.com/KDEGroup/RQ-MoE.

</details>


### [139] [MoRe: Modular Representations for Principled Continual Representation Learning on Squantial Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14364)
*Jiaqi Sun,Boyang Sun,Mohamad Rasmy,Xiangchen Song,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MoRe框架，通过在表示层面识别模块化而非架构层面，将知识分解为基本模块和特定模块的层次结构，实现持续学习中的知识保留与适应，实验验证了其有效性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习需要在保持原有知识的同时适应新数据。现有方法通过修改模型参数或架构以监督的、任务特定的方式解决这一问题，但根本问题是表征性的：任务需要既相互独立又有结构关联的表征，可选择性更新而不干扰其他表征，且结构应反映数据内在组织而非任务边界。在序列数据中，时间延迟依赖关系为揭示这种组织提供了自然信号。

Method: MoRe框架在表示本身识别模块化，而非在架构层面分配模块。该方法将知识分解为基本模块和特定模块的层次结构，具有可识别性保证，支持模块复用、对齐和扩展，构造性地保留旧模块。

Result: 在合成基准和真实LLM激活数据上的实验表明，MoRe能够产生可解释的层次结构，并改善了可塑性-稳定性权衡。

Conclusion: MoRe为持续适应提供了一个有原则的基础，通过表示层面的模块化分解而非架构层面的修改来实现知识保留与新知识获取的平衡。实验验证了其在合成基准和真实LLM激活数据上的有效性。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new data while preserving previously acquired knowledge. At its core, this challenge can be viewed as principled one-step adaptation: incorporating new information with minimal interference to existing representations. Most existing approaches address this challenge by modifying model parameters or architectures in a supervised, task-specific manner. However, the underlying issue is representational: tasks require distinct yet structured representations that can be selectively updated without disrupting representations, while structure should reflect intrinsic organization in the data rather than task boundaries. In sequential data, time-delayed dependencies provide a natural signal for uncovering this organization, revealing how fundamental representations give rise to more specific ones. Inspired by the modular organization of the human brain, we propose MoRe, a framework that identifies modularity in the representation itself rather than allocating it at the architectural level. MoRe decomposes knowledge into a hierarchy of fundamental and specific modules with identifiability guarantees, enabling principled module reuse, alignment, and expansion during adaptation while preserving old modules by construction. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world LLM activations demonstrate interpretable hierarchical structure, improved plasticity-stability trade-offs, suggesting MoRe as a principled foundation for continual adaptation

</details>


### [140] [LoMETab: Beyond Rank-1 Ensembles for Tabular Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14365)
*Changryeol Choi,Hyewon Park,Yujin Kwon,Gowun Jeong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoMETab 将 TabM/BatchEnsemble 固定的 rank-1 乘性掩码推广为 rank-r 的"恒等残差"Hadamard 低秩形式（成员有效权重 W_k = W ⊙ (1 + A_k B_kᵀ)），并证明 r≥2 时严格扩张了 BatchEnsemble 的假设空间。该方法把"适配器秩 r"与"初始化尺度 σ_init"暴露为两个可调的多样性控制轴：实验显示其成员间 pairwise KL 跨配置可变化数个数量级，且乘性形式相比加性低秩消融能"持续"维持更高多样性；在 37 个表格基准数据集上取得平均排名 2.1±1.3（优于 TabM 的 2.3±1.8），并能以 K=16 达到或超过 TabM K=32 的精度与校准水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格学习基准已呈现"紧密性能簇"而非清晰层级（GBDT、注意力模型、TabM 等隐式集成差距很小），单纯刷榜收益趋缓，因此需要一个互补目标：理解并控制简单 MLP 型表格模型具备竞争力的机制。作者指出 TabM 继承了 BatchEnsemble 的 rank-1 乘性掩码，成员多样性不可显式调节，且已有工作报告 BatchEnsemble 成员可能收敛到近乎相同的函数，即固定 rank-1 调制未必能实现有意义的多样性。作者的定位是：表格隐式集成的关键设计问题不是"平均更多成员"，而是"允许成员以何种方式偏离共享骨干"。

Method: **方法（LoMETab）**
1. **层构造**：对每个成员 k 分配低秩因子 A_k ∈ R^{d_out×r}、B_k ∈ R^{d_in×r}，有效权重为 W_k = W ⊙ (1 + A_k B_kᵀ)。W 共享，1 + A_k B_kᵀ 是"恒等残差"乘性扰动（形式借鉴 HiRA 的乘性重参数化，但用途不同：用于从头训练的表格隐式集成成员多样化，而非单模型微调）。
2. **表达力定理（Proposition 1）**：因 s_k r_kᵀ − 1 的秩至多为 2，任何 BatchEnsemble 掩码在 r≥2 时均可被 LoMETab 表示（H_BE ⊆ H_LoMETab^(r)）；反向不成立——构造反例 M₁ = e₁f₁ᵀ + e₂f₂ᵀ、M₂ = 0，其元素比矩阵 Q₁₂ 的左上 2×2 子块行列式为 3≠0（秩≥2），而任何 BE 参数化下 Q_ij = uvᵀ 秩至多为 1，故 H_BE ⊊ H_LoMETab^(r)。注意 r=1 时 LoMETab 与 BatchEnsemble 并不等价。
3. **训练目标**：沿用 TabM 的成员级监督 L = (1/K)Σ_k ℓ_task(o_k(x), y)（回归 MSE / 二分类 BCE / 多分类 CE），使各成员适配器被直接监督而允许专门化；推理时对成员输出（回归取标量均值，分类取 sigmoid/softmax 概率后）取平均。
4. **多样化轴**：r 与 σ_init（A、B ~ N(0, σ_init²)）。参数增量仅为 Kr(d_in+d_out)，远小于全量权重，且 HPO 常自动选择更窄的 d/L，故实际参数量常不超过 TabM。
5. **实验协议**：继承 TabM 官方代码库与同一评测流水线（同一数据加载、预处理、划分、指标、Optuna 预算），37 个源数据集（9 Default + 28 TabZilla，排除存在流水线不一致的 house 数据集，展开为 77 个 split 级任务），每数据集最多 100 次 Optuna 试验，配置用 15 个随机种子评估；对比基线为 Gorishniy 等发布的 TabM 基准报告（GBDT、TabR、MNCA、各类 MLP 等）。

Result: **结果**
1. **基准性能**：37 个数据集上 LoMETab 平均排名 2.1±1.3，优于 TabM 的 2.3±1.8，并领先于强 GBDT 基线；14 个数据集排名第一，89.2% 位于前三。作者明确声明排名仅为描述性证据，不主张统计显著性。
2. **乘性形式维持多样性**：在 adult、higgs-small、otto 上与同骨干、同优化器、同 K、同 r 的加性低秩变体（W_k = W + A_k B_kᵀ）对比，加性变体迅速落入低多样性平台，LoMETab 全程保持显著更高的 pairwise KL（"持续差距"）。
3. **(r, σ_init) 网格控制**：K=32、r∈{1,2,4,8,16}、σ_init∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1,2,3} 共 30 配置。σ_init=0.1 时秩几乎无影响（adult 的 KL 约 6e-4–9e-4，higgs-small 约 1e-4–2e-4）；σ_init=1.0 时秩的作用显现（adult 约 0.006→0.022，higgs-small 约 0.006→0.063）。argmax 不一致率由约 ≤1% 升至 adult 的 5–6%、higgs-small 的 14–17%。回归侧呈相同"秩—尺度激活"模式：california 归一化 ambiguity 约 0.001→0.016，black-friday 约 8e-4→0.010，且最大 ambiguity 单元并不对应最优 RMSE。
4. **消融（性能/校准）**：单纯调整 TabM 的 K 不稳定（K=64 在多数数据集反而变差）；而 LoMETab 在 K=16 下单独调 r 或 σ_init 即在多数数据集追平或超过 TabM K=32 基线（最大增益出现在 covtype2 +2.6%、churn +1.8%），且最优 (r, σ_init) 随数据集而变（r=16 选 41/77 次，σ_init=1.0 选 46/77 次）。校准方面，TabM 增大 K 往往以精度换 ECE，而 LoMETab 在 HI/OT/CH 上可同时改善精度与 ECE，但 covtype2 上精度 +2.6% 的同时 ECE 恶化，说明"更多多样性"并不自动解决校准问题。
5. **参数量**：附录 H 显示 LoMETab 在多个数据集上参数量与 TabM 相当甚至更低（如 Brazilian_houses fold2 低 2573K，credit fold0 低 3497.5K），表明额外表达力不必付出成比例的参数代价。
6. **算力**：单张 H100 上调参约 64.8 GPU 小时、15 种子多任务评估约 14.1 GPU 小时，总计约 79 GPU 小时。

Conclusion: **结论与局限**
LoMETab 用 rank-r 恒等残差乘性扰动替换固定 rank-1 掩码，在 r≥2 时严格扩大层级假设类，同时给出 r 与 σ_init 两个实用多样性控制轴：乘性形式比加性低秩消融更能"持续"维持成员差异；成对 KL 变化跨越两个数量级以上，并传导到 argmax 不一致率、回归 ambiguity 以及数据集相关的精度/校准表现。结论性观点是：对表格隐式集成而言，"成员被允许以何种方式偏离共享骨干"（秩与尺度）是一个核心设计维度，比单纯增加成员数 K 更有价值。
局限与未来工作：论文仅建立了 (r, σ_init) 的二维多样性可控性，尚未验证这种可控多样性带来的下游收益；最有前景的后续方向是把该多样性用于表格数据上的不确定性估计与分布外（OOD）检测。作者亦指出排名差异无统计显著性证据，未直接讨论部署安全与公平性问题。

Abstract: Recent tabular learning benchmarks increasingly show a tight performance cluster rather than a clear hierarchy among leading methods, spanning gradient boosted decision trees, attention-based architectures, and implicit ensembles such as TabM. As benchmark gains plateau, a complementary goal is to understand and control the mechanisms that make simple neural tabular models competitive. We propose LoMETab, a rank-$r$ generalization of multiplicative implicit ensembles. LoMETab lifts the rank-1 BatchEnsemble/TabM modulation to a rank-$r$ identity-residual Hadamard family by parameterizing each member weight as $W_k = W \odot (1 + A_kB_k^\top)$, where $W$ is shared and $(A_k, B_k)$ are member-specific low-rank factors. This exposes two practical diversity-control axes: the adapter rank $r$ and the initialization scale $σ_{\mathrm{init}}$, and we prove that for $r \ge 2$ this generalization strictly enlarges BatchEnsemble's hypothesis class. Empirically, we show that this added capacity manifests as measurable predictive diversity after training: on representative classification datasets, LoMETab sustains higher pairwise KL than an additive low-rank ablation, and $(r, σ_{\mathrm{init}})$ provides broad control over pairwise KL, varying by up to several orders of magnitude across configurations. The induced diversity is reflected in task-appropriate output-level measures: argmax disagreement for classification and ambiguity for regression, indicating that the control extends beyond pairwise KL to decision- and output-level member variation. Finally, experiments sweeping over adapter rank $r$ and initialization scale $σ_{\mathrm{init}}$ reveal that predictive performance is dataset-dependent over the $(r, σ_{\mathrm{init}})$ grid, supporting LoMETab as a controllable family of implicit ensembles rather than a fixed rank-1 construction.

</details>


### [141] [Turning Stale Gradients into Stable Gradients: Coherent Coordinate Descent with Implicit Landscape Smoothing for Lightweight Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14373)
*Chen Liang,Xiatao Sun,Qian Wang,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对零阶优化中样本效率与方差的固有矛盾，提出确定性方法CoCD，通过利用历史梯度信息实现O(1)查询复杂度，并证明更大有限差分步长反而改善收敛稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ZO优化方法存在根本性权衡：标准有限差分样本效率低，随机子空间方法方差高。

Method: 提出CoCD方法，通过梯度相干性理论将历史陈旧梯度转化为计算资产，实现与带"热启动"的BCCD等效；采用更大有限差分步长产生隐式平滑效应，降低有效平滑常数。

Result: 达到O(1)每步查询复杂度，保持全局下降方向；发现反直觉结论——更大步长可降低有效平滑常数，提升收敛稳定性；在MLP、CNN、ResNet（最高27万参数）上显著优于BCCD和随机ZO方法。

Conclusion: 确定性、结构感知的更新为轻量级ZO优化提供了优于随机化的替代方案。

Abstract: Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization is pivotal for scenarios where backpropagation is unavailable, such as memory-constrained on-device learning and black-box optimization. However, existing methods face a stark trade-off: they are either sample-inefficient (e.g., standard finite differences) or suffer from high variance due to randomized estimation (e.g., random subspace methods). In this work, we propose Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic, sample-efficient, and budget-aware ZO optimizer. Theoretically, we formalize the notion of gradient coherence and demonstrate that CoCD is equivalent to Block Cyclic Coordinate Descent (BCCD) with ``warm starts,'' effectively converting historical (stale) gradients from a liability into a computational asset. This mechanism enables $O(1)$ query complexity per step while maintaining global descent directions. Furthermore, we derive error bounds revealing a counter-intuitive insight: larger finite-difference step sizes can induce an implicit smoothing effect on the optimization landscape by reducing the effective smoothness constant, thereby improving convergence stability. Experiments on MLP, CNN, and ResNet architectures (up to 270k parameters) demonstrate that CoCD significantly outperforms BCCD in terms of sample efficiency and convergence loss/accuracy, and exhibits superior stability over randomized ZO methods. Our results suggest that deterministic, structure-aware updates offer a superior alternative to randomization for lightweight ZO optimization.

</details>


### [142] [Optimal Pattern Detection Tree for Symbolic Rule-Based Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14374)
*Young-Chae Hong,Yangho Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OPDT模型，基于混合整数规划发现可解释的最优规则，通过BSC框架融入领域知识，在保证解最优性的同时提升规则发现的可解释性和实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒深度学习模型缺乏可解释性，而符号规则发现虽能提供人类可理解的规则，但现有方法难以保证解的最优性或在模型中融入先验知识与约束条件。

Method: 提出Optimal Pattern Detection Tree (OPDT)，基于新型混合整数规划(MIP)通过二分分类发现单个最优模式；引入Branching Structure Constraints (BSC)框架将领域知识和合规要求编码到模型中。

Result: 实验表明OPDT能在合理运行时间内，对中等规模数据集发现带最优性保证的模式。

Conclusion: OPDT通过MIP框架在小规模数据集上实现了带最优性保证的规则发现，BSC框架增强了模型的实用性。

Abstract: Pattern discovery in data plays a crucial role across diverse domains, including healthcare, risk assessment, and machinery maintenance. In contrast to black-box deep learning models, symbolic rule discovery emerges as a key data mining task, generating human-interpretable rules that offer both transparency and intuitive explainability. This paper introduces the Optimal Pattern Detection Tree (OPDT), a rule-based machine learning model based on novel mixed-integer programming to discover a single optimal pattern in data through binary classification. To incorporate prior knowledge and compliance requirements, we further introduce the Branching Structure Constraints (BSC) framework, which enables decision makers to encode domain knowledge and constraints directly into the model. This optimization-based approach discovers a hidden underlying pattern in datasets, when it exists, by identifying an optimal rule that maximizes coverage while minimizing the false positive rate due to misclassification. Our computational experiments show that OPDT discovers a pattern with optimality guarantees on moderately sized datasets within reasonable runtime.

</details>


### [143] [NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14381)
*Qazi Mamunur Rashid,Xuan Yang,Zhengzhe Yang,Yanzhou Pan,Erin van Liemt,Darlene Neal,Kshitij Pancholi,Jamila Smith-Loud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NodeSynth是一种基于证据的合成查询生成方法，通过微调分类生成器在真实证据基础上生成社会相关测试数据，评估发现主流LLM失败率显著高于人类基准，且现有防护模型存在关键漏洞，现已开源以支持大规模模型安全评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI合成数据缺乏敏感领域所需的社会技术细微差别，亟需针对性方法提升数据质量

Method: NodeSynth方法论：使用基于真实世界证据微调的分类生成器(TaG)生成社会相关的合成查询

Result: 在4个主流LLM（如Claude 4.5 Haiku）上诱发高达人类基准测试5倍的失败率；消融研究证实细粒度分类扩展显著驱动失败率；独立验证揭示Llama-Guard-3等主流防护模型的严重缺陷

Conclusion: 开源端到端研究原型和数据集，实现大规模高风险模型评估和有针对性的安全干预

Abstract: Recent advancements in generative AI facilitate large-scale synthetic data generation for model evaluation. However, without targeted approaches, these datasets often lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains. We introduce NodeSynth, an evidence-grounded methodology that generates socially relevant synthetic queries by leveraging a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) anchored in real-world evidence. Evaluated against four mainstream LLMs (e.g., Claude 4.5 Haiku), NodeSynth elicited failure rates up to five times higher than human-authored benchmarks. Ablation studies confirm that our granular taxonomic expansion significantly drives these failure rates, while independent validation reveals critical deficiencies in prominent guard models (e.g., Llama-Guard-3). We open-source our end-to-end research prototype and datasets to enable scalable, high-stakes model evaluation and targeted safety interventions (https://github.com/google-research/nodesynth).

</details>


### [144] [Watch your neighbors: Training statistically accurate chaotic systems with local phase space information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14405)
*Joon-Hyuk Ko,Andrus Giraldo,Deok-Sun Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"Neighborhood"训练法：在相空间中对混沌吸引子的局部邻域（环状集合）构造有限覆盖，用真实数据与Neural ODE各自演化的邻域推前测度（pushforward measure）之间以MMD²做正则化损失。该方法同时提升Jacobian精度（在含1%/5%/10%噪声数据上显著优于Vanilla与DySLIM）、改进Lyapunov指数估计，并保持与SOTA统计准确方法（DySLIM）相当的长时统计精度与短期预测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混沌系统中长期精确轨迹预测本质不可行（误差指数增长），因此"好的代理模型"需重新定义。现有两条路线各有缺陷：(1) 动力学系统领域强调学习准确的Jacobian以刻画相空间局部收缩/膨胀（Lyapunov指数、初始条件敏感性、斑图切换等混沌特征）；(2) 机器学习领域强调"统计准确"，即训练后的Neural ODE需保持不变测度（物理测度）以复现长时统计行为。前者常需逐点局部回归、计算昂贵且与"全局模型"脱节，后者只约束全局不变测度，丢失局部流形形变信息，甚至出现"函数值拟合准确但导数完全错误"的现象（Vanilla训练的Jacobian几乎全错）。已有工作（Park et al., 2025）尝试用Jacobian作为条件，但依赖真实Jacobian的"oracle"，无法用于含噪的真实数据。作者希望把两者统一，并使方法在观测噪声下依然稳健。

Method: 框架：将目标从"全局不变测度一致"细化为"局部覆盖集上的推前测度一致"——约束 (φ_{Δt;θ})#μ|_{φ_{Δt;θ}(U_i)} = (φ_{Δt})#μ|_{φ_{Δt}(U_i)}，其中 {U_i} 为吸引子的有限可测覆盖。Theorem 1证明：若两个测度在覆盖集上逐集限制相等，则全局相等，故局部约束可间接保证长期不变测度（统计准确），同时约束流对局部集合的膨胀/压缩（Jacobian准确）。三要素实现：(1) 从数据构造覆盖——以每个数据点为中心取环状邻域（内半径r_min=8倍噪声标准差，外半径r_max使每个邻域平均含数据集约5%的点），用KDTree高效检索相空间邻居；(2) 用Neural ODE的二阶Taylor/变分方程展开演化"相对中心点的扰动"而非直接积分邻居，从而约束局部几何一致性、避免虚假局部畸变；(3) 损失用平方MMD（有理二次核混合，σ={0.2,0.5,0.9,1.3}）比较真实演化邻居样本与模型演化邻居样本。总损失 L = L_traj + λ·邻域MMD损失，每个训练步采样B'个中心点与K个邻居（|B|=B'(K+1)）。实验：Lorenz63(3D)、超混沌Chen(4D)、Lorenz96(6D)，各50条轨迹×1000时间点，Δt=0.01τ，训练/验证加1%、5%、10%高斯噪声；MLP[d,64,64] + Tsit5求解器，adabelief优化，batch 2048，lr 2e-3，5000–10000步；基线为Vanilla与DySLIM；评估含VPT（阈值0.3，以最大Lyapunov指数归一）、MMD²（t̄=100）、相对向量场误差、相对Jacobian误差（均考虑数据归一化对真值方程的变换）、Shimada法Lyapunov指数误差；超参用Sinkhorn散度小网格搜索。

Result: 含噪条件下：Vanilla的短时VPT与长时MMD²明显劣化，Neighborhood与DySLIM显著更好；Neighborhood在短期VPT上与DySLIM相当，长时统计精度略逊于DySLIM（后者直接优化物理测度一致性），但Neighborhood在所有系统与噪声水平下的相对向量场误差与相对Jacobian误差均显著优于两者——尤其Lorenz63原点附近的"瓣切换"敏感区域，Vanilla与DySLIM均失败而Neighborhood能给出空间上均匀准确的速度场。Lyapunov指数方面Neighborhood给出最准确预测（既需物理测度准确又需Jacobian准确），Vanilla在高噪声下连负指数也无法恢复。核心理论贡献：局部覆盖约束在MMD²为零时同时保证覆盖像集重合与受限推前测度一致，从而在"统计准确"与"局部准确"之间建立桥梁，定位为全局与局部Jacobian估计之间的中间路线（单一全局模型+邻域距离演化约束）。

Conclusion: Neighborhood方法为从（可能含噪的）轨迹数据训练兼具长时统计准确性与准确局部动力学的Neural ODE提供了理论与算法基础，在Jacobian精度与Lyapunov指数上大幅优于Vanilla与DySLIM，同时保持有竞争力的统计精度。未来方向：扩展到更高维与部分可观测系统；改进吸引子覆盖集的构造（例如考虑吸引子上局部可预测性的差异）；设计更适合真实含噪部署的超参选择策略（作者承认当前用无噪验证集选参与实际部署存在差距）。

Abstract: Chaotic systems pose fundamental challenges for data-driven dynamics discovery, as small modeling errors lead to exponentially growing trajectory discrepancies. Since exact long-term prediction is unattainable, it is natural to ask what a good surrogate model for chaotic dynamics is. Prior work has largely focused either on reproducing the Jacobian of the underlying dynamics, which governs local expansion and contraction rates, or on training surrogate models that reproduce the ground-truth dynamics' long-term statistical behavior. In this work, we propose a new framework that aims to bridge these two paradigms by training surrogate dynamics models with accurate Jacobians and long-term statistical properties. Our method constructs a local covering of a chaotic attractor in phase space and analyzes the expansion and contraction of these coverings under the dynamics. The surrogate model is trained by minimizing the maximum mean discrepancy between the pushforward distributions of the coverings under the surrogate and ground-truth dynamics. Experiments show that our method significantly improves Jacobian accuracy while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art statistically accurate dynamics learning methods. Our code is fully available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/neighborwatch.

</details>


### [145] [GeoViSTA: Geospatial Vision-Tabular Transformer for Multimodal Environment Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14406)
*Yuhao Liu,Sadeer Al-Kindi,Ashok Veeraraghavan,Guha Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoViSTA是一种视觉-表格融合架构，通过双侧交叉注意力和地理感知注意力机制学习来自配准栅格图像和表格数据的统一地理空间嵌入，旨在解决现有地理空间基础模型忽略社会经济数据的问题，提升复杂环境-社会-健康关联推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地理空间基础模型未能直接建模表格形式的结构化社会经济协变量，导致模态差距，限制了其捕捉完整总体环境的能力，这对于推理复杂的环境、社会和健康相关结果至关重要。

Method: GeoViSTA采用双侧交叉注意力机制进行跨模态信息交换，并通过地理感知注意力机制将连续图像块与不规则人口普查区域标记对齐。训练采用自监督联合掩码自编码目标，强制模型利用局部空间上下文和跨模态线索恢复缺失图像块和表格行。

Result: GeoViSTA的统一嵌入在下游任务中提升了线性探测性能，在疾病特异性死亡率和火灾风险频率预测任务上超越了基线方法。

Conclusion: 联合建模物理环境和结构化社会经济背景产生了可迁移的地理空间表示，在疾病死亡率预测和火灾风险预测等下游任务中超越了基线方法。

Abstract: Large-scale pretraining on Earth observation imagery has yielded powerful representations of the natural and built environment. However, most existing geospatial foundation models do not directly model the structured socioeconomic covariates typically stored in tabular form. This modality gap limits their ability to capture the complete total environment, which is critical for reasoning about complex environmental, social, and health-related outcomes. In this work, we propose GeoViSTA (Geospatial Vision-Tabular Transformer), a vision-tabular architecture that learns unified geospatial embeddings from co-registered gridded imagery and tabular data. GeoViSTA utilizes bilateral cross-attention to exchange spatial and semantic information across modalities, guided by a geography-aware attention mechanism that aligns continuous image patches with irregular census-tract tokens. We train GeoViSTA with a self-supervised joint masked-autoencoding objective, forcing it to recover missing image patches and tabular rows using local spatial context and cross-modal cues. Empirically, GeoViSTA's unified embeddings improve linear probing performance on high-impact downstream tasks, outperforming baselines in predicting disease-specific mortality and fire hazard frequency across held-out regions. These results demonstrate that jointly modeling the physical environment alongside structured socioeconomic context yields highly transferable representations for holistic geospatial inference.

</details>


### [146] [MahaVar: OOD Detection via Class-wise Mahalanobis Distance Variance under Neural Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14413)
*Donghwan Kim,Hyunsoo Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MahaVar——一种后验（post-hoc）OOD 检测器，在 L2 归一化的 Mahalanobis 距离（Mahalanobis++）得分上叠加一项“类间距离方差”项。核心经验观察：ID 样本的类 Mahalanobis 距离呈“尖锐最小值”结构（最近类距离很小、其余类距离较大并很快趋于平台），从而类间方差高；OOD 样本的最小值结构不明显，方差更低。作者在放松的 Neural Collapse（弱 NC1+NC2，simplex ETF 类均值）假设下给出理论刻画，证明 ID 样本类间距离方差结构性偏高，并给出 ID 严格大于 OOD 方差的充分条件与 ETF 子空间对齐下的保证。在 OpenOOD v1.5 协议下，MahaVar 在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上取得 SOTA，ImageNet（ResNet-50/Swin-B/ViT-B 平均）AUROC 88.64%、FPR@95 44.74%，全面优于 Mahalanobis++（87.75/47.42）；推理开销与 Mahalanobis++ 相同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络在闭世界假设下训练后面对分布外样本会过度自信甚至产生灾难性错误，OOD 检测是安全攸关部署的关键环节。后验方法无需额外训练或 OOD 数据，实用性强；其中 Mahalanobis 类检测器表现强，但仅利用“到最近类均值的最小马氏距离”，信息未被充分利用。作者观察到类 Mahalanobis 距离排序后的“尖锐最小值”结构在 ID 与 OOD 之间存在系统差异（此前未被刻画或利用），且该结构在 Neural Collapse 几何下有理论解释，因此有望作为独立且互补的 OOD 信号。

Method: 方法：(1) 观察与诊断——在 CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-18）与 ImageNet（ResNet-50/Swin-B/ViT-B）上对 Mahalanobis/Mahalanobis++ 提取逐类马氏距离并排序，发现 rank-0 距离骤降、rank≥1 迅速进入平台的“尖锐最小值”结构；该结构在 L2 归一化与不归一化下均成立。(2) 理论：放松的 Neural Collapse 假设（弱 NC1：类内样本位于类均值 ε_c 球内且 ε<K/2；NC2：中心化类均值构成 simplex ETF，等范数 R、等类间距 K）；定理 4.2 给出 ID 样本类间 ℓ2 距离方差的上下界（ε→0 时收敛到 (C-1)K⁴/C²）；定理 4.3 证明当 OOD 样本满足 max_c|φ̂ᵀμ_c| < R(R−ε)/√(C−1) 时 ID 方差严格大于 OOD；推论 4.4 在 ETF 子空间对齐假设 ρ_ID=1 下给出对任意 OOD 的普遍方差分离，并导出恒等式 Var_c[d_c²]=4R²ρ/(C−1)（ρ 为特征在类均值子空间投影能量）。(3) 得分：S(x) = −min_c d_Maha,c(φ̂(x)) + α·Var_c[d_Maha,c(φ̂(x))]，φ̂ 为 L2 归一化倒数第二层特征，类均值与共享（tied）协方差由训练集估计（加 10⁻³I 正则），α 在 [0,10] 上 26 点网格按验证 AUROC 选（0.05/0.1/0.07/0.015/0.03）。另给出无超参的 Var/d_(1) 比值变体与加偏度项的扩展。实验遵循 OpenOOD v1.5（ID: CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet；近/远 OOD 多数据集），与 MSP、MaxLogit、KL-matching、Energy、GEN、ReAct、ASH-S、SCALE、KNN、NCI、fDBD、ViM、NNGuide、Mahalanobis(++) 及 CADRef/LTS/OptFS/AdaSCALE 等比较，指标 AUROC 与 FPR@95。

Result: ImageNet（三骨干平均）：MahaVar AUROC 88.64 / FPR@95 44.74，优于 Mahalanobis++（87.75/47.42）；所有近 OOD 数据集（SSB-Hard、NINCO）与 iNaturalist、OpenImage-O 均最佳，仅 Texture 略逊于 Mahalanobis++。CIFAR-100：83.80/68.03，为全部方法最佳；CIFAR-10：91.12/45.56，优于所有 Mahalanobis 系方法（AUROC 略低于 KNN 的 91.81）。消融：仅加方差项（不归一化）即把 Mahalanobis 从 80.24/62.86 提至 86.76/52.33；方差单独作得分仅 59.91/88.90，说明两信号互补而非替代；偏度项增益微弱（88.72/44.56）且符号随骨干变化，故主方法只用方差；距离度量换成 L1/L2 均获益（86.67→87.50、87.39→88.02），马氏最优；参与方差的类数 K 越大越好（ResNet-50/Swin-B 取 K=1000，ViT-B 峰值 K=500）；特征中心化在 ResNet-50 上显著有害（全局均值范数 21.5），故实现中不做中心化；α 最佳区间 0.05–0.1。比值变体在 ResNet-50 上 88.40/39.96，略优于调参加法形式。对比 NCDD 式“非最近距离之和”“最近-次近之差”两种受控替代时 β 均收敛至 0（等同 Mahalanobis++），证明增益来自全体类距离结构而非单对比较。收益幅度随 d/C 增大：ResNet-50 +1.19、Swin-B +1.20、ViT-B +0.30（d/C=0.77 < 1，ETF 无法完全形成）；ρ_ID > ρ_OOD 在全部 22 个 D≥C 的骨干-数据集组合中成立。

Conclusion: 结论：类 Mahalanobis 距离方差是 Neural Collapse 几何下的“类对齐度”指示量，ID 样本因尖锐最小值结构而具有结构性更高的类间方差，与最小类距离互补。MahaVar 以极简形式（一个 α 超参、零额外推理开销）稳定超越所有 Mahalanobis 系基线，并在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上达到 SOTA。局限：CIFAR-10 上不优于 KNN；增益在个别 OOD 数据集上不均匀；方差单独不足以构成得分；α 依赖留出的 OOD 验证集（部署假设较强）；理论依赖训练末期 Neural Collapse 几何与 ETF 假设，未涵盖一般特征几何，且 μ_G≠0（中心化）情形仅做实证而未给理论。未来方向：超越 Neural Collapse 的理论框架、高阶矩、中心化情形的严格处理、比值型得分的分离性保证、以及在 d≳C 时的适用性判据（可用 NC1/NC2 诊断统计量评估）。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is a critical component for ensuring the reliability of deep neural networks in safety-critical applications. In this work, we present a key empirical observation: for in-distribution (ID) samples, class-wise Mahalanobis distances exhibit a pronounced sharp minimum structure, where the distance to the nearest class is small while distances to all other classes remain large, resulting in high variance across classes. In contrast, OOD samples tend to exhibit a less pronounced sharp minimum structure, producing comparatively lower variance across classes. We further provide a theoretical analysis grounding this observation in Neural Collapse geometry: under relaxed Neural Collapse assumptions on within-class compactness and inter-class separation, ID samples are shown to structurally exhibit high class-wise distance variance, offering a theoretical basis for its use as an OOD score. Motivated by this observation and its theoretical backing, we propose MahaVar, a simple and effective post-hoc OOD detector that augments the Mahalanobis distance with a class-wise distance variance term. Following the OpenOOD v1.5 benchmark protocol, MahaVar achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, with consistent improvements in both AUROC and FPR@95 over existing Mahalanobis-based methods across all benchmarks.

</details>


### [147] [What if Tomorrow is the World Cup Final? Counterfactual Time Series Forecasting with Textual Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14422)
*Shuqi Gu,Yongxiang Zhao,Baoyu Jing,Kan Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper introduces counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, addressing limitations of traditional methods that overlook counterfactual scenarios and simple structured conditions. They propose an evaluation framework supporting both factual and counterfactual settings without ground truth data, along with a text-attribution mechanism that separates mutable from immutable factors to improve forecasting accuracy under complex textual conditions.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Traditional time series forecasting relies on historical data or factual future conditions while overlooking counterfactual scenarios, and many existing approaches are restricted to simple structured conditions, limiting generalization to real-world complexities.

Method: The paper introduces counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, a comprehensive evaluation framework for factual and counterfactual settings, and a novel text-attribution mechanism that distinguishes mutable from immutable factors.

Result: Improved forecast accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions.

Conclusion: The proposed text-attribution mechanism distinguishes mutable from immutable factors, enabling more flexible and condition-aware forecasting, with improved accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions. The framework supports both factual and counterfactual evaluation even without ground truth time series.

Abstract: Time series forecasting has become increasingly critical in real-world scenarios, where future sequences are influenced not only by historical patterns but also by forthcoming events. In this context, forecasting must dynamically adapt to complex and stochastic future conditions, which introduces fundamental challenges in both forecasting and evaluation. Traditional methods typically rely on historical data or factual future conditions, while overlooking counterfactual scenarios. Furthermore, many existing approaches are restricted to simple structured conditions, limiting their ability to generalize to the real-world complexities. To address these gaps, we introduce the task of counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, enabling more flexible and condition-aware forecasting. We propose a comprehensive evaluation framework that encompasses both factual and counterfactual settings, even in the absence of ground truth time series. Additionally, we present a novel text-attribution mechanism that distinguishes mutable from immutable factors, thereby improving forecast accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions. The project page is at https://seqml.github.io/TADiff/

</details>


### [148] [Collaborative Yet Personalized Policy Training: Single-Timescale Federated Actor-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14423)
*Leo Muxing Wang,Pengkun Yang,Lili Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出单时间尺度联邦个性化 Actor-Critic 算法 pFedAC：K 个异构 agent 共享一个 r 维线性子空间表示 B*，各自保留本地 critic 头 ω^k 与个性化 actor θ^k，在 Markovian 采样下的经典单时间尺度更新中，通过新的"联合线性逼近"框架建立有限时间收敛：critic 误差以 Õ(1/((1-γ)^4√(TK))) 收敛，策略梯度范数以 Õ(1/((1-γ)^6√(TK))) 收敛，对 agent 数 K 具有线性加速。实验在联邦 Hopper-v5 的 action-map 异构基准上验证个性化（FedPer PPO）优于 Single PPO 与 FedAvg PPO，且学到的共享 trunk 可作为可迁移的"基础模型"用于下游单智能体任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦强化学习（FedRL）工作在两方面不完整：(1) 多数研究忽视环境异质性，或只针对共同策略/共同价值函数/加权平均的"虚构环境"给出最优性刻画；(2) 已有个性化 TD 学习工作（如 Xiong et al. 2025）仅分析全局策略（局部策略平均），并未在异构转移核下为每个 agent 的个性化策略提供有限时间保证。同时，Actor-Critic 的有限时间分析在多智能体与异构环境下仍属空白。

作者的核心观察是：个性化联邦学习（PFL）中的"共享子空间 + 本地头部"结构（如 Collins et al. 2021 的 FedRep）在监督学习中已被证明有效，但将其搬到 RL 会引入三重紧耦合误差动力学——共享子空间 B、局部 critic 头 ω^k、个性化 actor θ^k，且采样是具有时间依赖的 Markovian 采样（而非常规 PFL 分析中的 i.i.d. 样本），并且 QR 正交化步骤会放大扰动。已有单智能体 AC 有限时间分析（Chen & Zhao 2024）与已有 PFL 分析（Collins et al. 2021）都无法直接套用。此外，critic 更新使用的极限分布 μ_θ 与策略梯度所需的折扣访问分布 ν_θ 不一致，需借助模拟器构造"重置"型伴随 MDP 来缓解。

因此本文目标：在异构转移核、Markovian 采样、单时间尺度更新下，为"共享子空间 + 个性化局部组件"的联邦 AC 建立有限时间收敛理论，同时保留个性化能力。

Method: **问题设定**：1 个参数服务器 + K 个 agent，每个 agent 为 MDP M^k = <S, A, γ, P^k, R^k>，转移核 P^k 与奖励 R^k 互相异构。线性函数逼近 V(s)=⟨φ(s), z*⟩，假设所有 agent 的最优线性逼近系数 z^{k,*} 张成同一个 r 维子空间，存在正交基 B* ∈ R^{d×r} 使 z_θ^{k,*} = B* ω_θ^{k,*}。

**算法 pFedAC（Algorithm 1）**，每轮 t：
- Critic：每个 agent 采样长度为 L 的轨迹，计算 TD(L) 误差 δ^k_{t,L}，执行 (a) 局部头更新 ω^{k}_{t+1} = Π_{U_ω}(ω^k_t + (β/L) δ^k_{t,L} B_t^T φ(s^k_{t,0}))；(b) 子空间更新 B_{t+1}^k = B_t + (ζ/L) B_{t,⊥}B_{t,⊥}^T δ^k_{t,L} φ(s^k_{t,0})(ω^k_t)^T（创新投影抑制交叉项放大，使 QR 扰动保持二阶）。
- Actor：每个 agent 从"伴随 MDP" P̂^k = γP^k + (1-γ)η 采样辅助轨迹（可任意 reset 状态的模拟器），用一步 TD 误差作为优势估计，做 minibatch 策略梯度更新 θ^k_{t+1} = θ^k_t + α (1/L)Σ_ℓ δ^{k,act}_{t,ℓ} ∇log π(a|s)。
- 服务器：平均各 agent 的 B 更新得 B̄_{t+1}，再做 QR 分解 B̄_{t+1} = B_{t+1}R_{t+1}，广播 B_{t+1}。
- 单时间尺度参数化：β = cζ，α = c_θ ζ。

**关键技术工具**：
1. Proposition 2（TD 特征分解）：δ^k_{t,L}φ(s^k_{t,0}) = ξ^k_{t,L} + A^k_{L,θ_t^k} x^k_t = Ã^k_{t,L} x^k_t + b^k_{t,L}，把"Markovian 噪声"与"价值估计误差"分离，是全部分析的枢纽。
2. 两条"冻结策略"辅助 Markov 链（ critic 链与 actor 链），在最近 τ 轮内冻结 θ_k，配合条件期望 E_{t-τ} 与 Dobrushin 单步收缩，建立原链与辅助链之间的扰动界（Lemma I.7–I.9、Corollary 2–4）。
3. Lemma 5.1（局部头误差上界）、Lemma 5.2（下界，说明 M_t 与 X̄_t 必须同时学习）、Lemma 5.3（主子角距离递推，用 principal-angle/SVD 几何处理 QR 扰动）、Lemma 5.4（策略梯度分析，把小批量估计与真实梯度之差分解为 D1 临界误差、D2 参数漂移、D3 原链/辅助链失配、D4 Markovian 采样误差四项）。
4. Theorem 1：取 ζ = L^{1/4}/√T，τL = max{⌈2log_ρ ζ⌉, ⌈2log_γ ζ⌉}，三组递推通过吸收/望远镜求和得最终速率。

**假设**：探索性（λ_max A^k_{L,θ} ≤ -λL）、一致遍历性 + Dobrushin 单步收缩、策略梯度有界与 Lipschitz、特征范数有界（‖φ(s)‖≤1）、子空间覆盖性（(1/K)λ⁺_min(Z*Z*^T) ≥ ν）。

Result: **理论结果（Theorem 1）**：
- Critic 误差 X̄_T ≤ Õ(1/((1-γ)^4 L^{1/4}√T) + L^{1/4}/((1-γ)^4 K√T) + √L/((1-γ)^5 T))；
- 策略梯度范数 Ḡ_T ≤ Õ(1/((1-γ)^6 L^{1/4}√T) + L^{1/4}/((1-γ)^6 K√T) + √L/((1-γ)^7 T))；
- 取 L = K² 且高阶项被主导后：X̄_T ≤ Õ(1/((1-γ)^4√(TK)))，Ḡ_T ≤ Õ(1/((1-γ)^6√(TK)))，即对 agent 数 K 的标准线性加速（Õ(1/√(TK)) 的 actor 驻点率），且在异构转移核与耦合学习动态下依然成立。

**实验结果**：将共享表示 + 个性化头部结构实例化为 FedPer PPO（共享 2×256 MLP trunk，每 10 episode 只同步 trunk，actor/critic/logσ 头保持个性化），在联邦 Hopper-v5（动作置换 + 客户端特定缩放构成异构转移核，healthy reward 由 1.0 降至 0.2）上与 Single PPO、FedAvg PPO 对比，按每客户端 0.4M 环境步公平预算、3 个种子报告：
- 完全异构（6-unique）：FedPer/Single = 2.63×，FedPer/FedAvg = 3.78×；
- 分组异构（3 客户端共享 2 张动作表）：2.04× 与 1.40×。即参数平均失效最严重的场景，个性化共享 trunk 收益最大；FedAvg 可退化为对两个动作表特化的共享参数。
- 基础模型迁移：用 FedPer 6-unique 的 trunk，冻结 trunk 只训练随机初始化的头（1,031/69,895 参数），在 vanilla Hopper 上达 1328±74 vs 从头训练 245±45（5.42×），在 OOD 动作尺度（0.5，低于预训练范围）下 701±101 vs 200±23（3.50×）；冻结甚至优于整体微调（>3.44×、>2.21×），说明 on-policy 微调会破坏预训练表示。
- 附录 K 进一步按环境步（非 episode）对齐重绘曲线，验证排序不受"回合长度"混淆影响。

Conclusion: 本文首次在异构环境、Markovian 采样、单时间尺度更新下，为联邦个性化 Actor-Critic 建立了有限时间收敛保证：critic 误差 Õ(1/((1-γ)^4√(TK)))、策略梯度 Õ(1/((1-γ)^6√(TK)))，实现对 agent 数的线性加速。方法论上，新提出的"联合线性逼近"框架可同时控制共享子空间、局部 critic 头与个性化策略三条紧耦合误差动力学；投影算子（含对 ω 的 ℓ₂ 球投影与对子空间更新的创新投影）既提供粗界又抑制扰动放大，是线性加速得以成立的关键。实验表明"共享 trunk + 个性化头"在异构联邦中优于参数平均，且所获共享表示具有面向下游任务的迁移价值，可视为可复用的基础模型。

局限与展望（论文自述）：
1. 对折扣因子的依赖 (1-γ)^{-1} 与 (1-γ)^{-2} 不最优，在近无折扣（γ→1）区域尤为突出，作者建议通过更精细地利用 Markov 结构、方差缩减、或改进 actor-critic 稳定性分析来改进；
2. 因 Assumption 4（‖φ(s)‖≤1）掩盖了维度 d 的影响，r≪d 带来的收益未在速率中体现，需要更细粒度的假设；
3. actor 更新依赖可任意 reset 状态的模拟器（构造伴随 MDP P̂^k = γP^k + (1-γ)η），这是实践中的额外假设；
4. 理论假设较强（一致遍历性 + Dobrushin 收缩、探索性、精确线性逼近 ε=0、子空间覆盖性等），在更一般的非线性参数化与部分可观测设定下有待扩展。

Abstract: Despite the popularity of the actor-critic method and the practical needs of collaborative policy training, existing works typically either overlook environmental heterogeneity or give up personalization altogether by training a single shared policy across all agents. We consider a federated actor-critic framework in which agents share a common linear subspace representation while maintaining personalized local policy components, and agents iteratively estimate the common subspace, local critic heads, and local policies (i.e., actors). Under canonical single-timescale updates with Markovian sampling, we establish finite-time convergence via a novel joint linear approximation framework. Specifically, we show that the critic error converges to zero at the rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/((1-γ)^4\sqrt{TK}))$, and the policy gradient norm converges to zero at the rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/((1-γ)^6\sqrt{TK}))$, where $T$ is the number of rounds, $K$ is the number of agents, and $γ\in (0,1)$ is the discount factor. These results demonstrate linear speedup with respect to the number of agents $K$, despite heterogeneous Markovian trajectories under distinct transition kernels and coupled learning dynamics. To address these challenges, we develop a new perturbation analysis for the projected subspace updates and QR decomposition steps, together with conditional mixing arguments for heterogeneous Markovian noise. Furthermore, to handle the additional complications induced by policy updates and temporal dependence, we establish fine-grained characterizations of the discrepancies between function evaluations under Markovian sampling and under temporally frozen policies. Experiments instantiate the framework within PPO on federated \texttt{Hopper-v5} action-map heterogeneity, showing gains over Single PPO and FedAvg PPO and downstream transfer from the learned shared trunk.

</details>


### [149] [FrontierSmith: Synthesizing Open-Ended Coding Problems at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14445)
*Runyuan He,Qiuyang Mang,Shang Zhou,Kaiyuan Liu,Hanchen Li,Huanzhi Mao,Qizheng Zhang,Zerui Li,Bo Peng,Lufeng Cheng,Tianfu Fu,Yichuan Wang,Wenhao Chai,Jingbo Shang,Alex Dimakis,Joseph E. Gonzalez,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FrontierSmith系统，从封闭赛题自动生成开放式编程问题用于训练LLM编码能力，显著提升模型在开放编码任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放赛题数据稀缺且构建成本高昂，难以训练LLM完成开放式编程任务。

Method: 从竞赛编程题出发，通过目标变更、输出限制、输入泛化生成变体；采用想法发散度指标筛选多样化问题；由智能体生成测试用例和验证器。

Result: Qwen3.5-9B在FrontierCS上提升+8.82分，ALE-bench上提升+306.36分；Qwen3.5-27B分别提升+12.12和+309.12分。

Conclusion: 封闭赛题可作为长程编程数据的实用起点。

Abstract: Many real-world coding challenges are open-ended and admit no known optimal solution. Yet, recent progress in LLM coding has focused on well-defined tasks such as feature implementation, bug fixing, and competitive programming. Open-ended coding remains a weak spot for LLMs, largely because open-ended training problems are scarce and expensive to construct. Our goal is to synthesize open-ended coding problems at scale to train stronger LLM coders. We introduce FrontierSmith, an automated system for iteratively evolving open-ended problems from existing closed-ended coding tasks. Starting from competitive programming problems, FrontierSmith generates candidate open-ended variants by changing the problems'goals, restricting outputs, and generalizing inputs. It then uses a quantitative idea divergence metric to select problems that elicit genuinely diverse approaches from different solvers. Agents then generate test cases and verifiers for the surviving candidates. On two open-ended coding benchmarks, training on our synthesized data yields substantial gains over the base models: Qwen3.5-9B improves by +8.82 score on FrontierCS and +306.36 (Elo-rating-based performance) on ALE-bench; Qwen3.5-27B improves by +12.12 and +309.12, respectively. The synthesized problems also make agents take more turns and use more tokens, similar to human-curated ones, suggesting that closed-ended seeds can be a practical starting point for long-horizon coding data.

</details>


### [150] [When Answers Stray from Questions: Hallucination Detection via Question-Answer Orthogonal Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14449)
*Siyang Yao,Erhu Feng,Yubin Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QAOD是一种单次推理的幻觉检测框架，通过将答案表示投影到问题正交方向来消除领域相关的变异性，同时保留域无关的事实性信号。该方法结合Fisher重要性进行层和神经元选择，设计了联合探测和纯正交探测两种策略，分别优化域内检测和跨域泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型幻觉检测需要在准确性、效率和分布偏移鲁棒性之间取得平衡。现有的黑盒一致性方法需要重复推理开销大，单次白盒探针将答案表示孤立处理，在领域偏移下性能急剧下降。

Method: QAOD通过投影消除答案表示中的问题对齐方向获得问题正交分量；采用多样性惩罚的Fisher评分选择关键层；使用Fisher重要性筛选判别神经元；设计两种探测策略——联合探测（正交分量+问题上下文）和纯正交探测。

Result: 联合探测器在所有评估的模型-数据集对上取得最佳域内AUROC；正交分量探测器实现最强OOD迁移，在BioASQ上超越最佳白盒基线达21%，计算成本低于生成成本的25%。

Conclusion: QAOD通过正交分解平衡了域内检测和跨域泛化，joint probe在域内表现最佳，orthogonal-only probe在OOD迁移上最优，且计算成本仅为生成成本的25%以下。

Abstract: Hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs) requires balancing accu racy, efficiency, and robustness to distribution shift. Black-box consistency methods are effective but demand repeated inference; single-pass white-box probes are effi cient yet treat answer representations in isolation, often degrading sharply under domain shift. We propose QAOD (Question-Answer Orthogonal Decomposition), a single-pass framework that projects away the question-aligned direction from the answer representation to obtain a question-orthogonal component that suppresses domain-conditioned variation. To identify informative signals, QAOD further selects layers via diversity-penalized Fisher scoring and discriminative neurons via Fisher importance. To address both in-domain detection and cross-domain generalization, we design two complementary probing strategies: pairing the or thogonal component with question context yields a joint probe that maximizes in-domain discriminability, while using the orthogonal component alone preserves domain-agnostic factuality signals for robust transfer. QAOD's joint probe achieves the best in-domain AUROC across all evaluated model-dataset pairs, while the orthogonal-only probe delivers the strongest OOD transfer, surpassing the best white-box baseline by up to 21% on BioASQ at under 25% of generation cost.

</details>


### [151] [LiSA: Lifelong Safety Adaptation via Conservative Policy Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14454)
*Minbeom Kim,Lesly Miculicich,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Mihir Parmar,Phillip Wallis,Bharath Chandrasekhar,Kyomin Jung,Tomas Pfister,Long T. Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LiSA是一个保守策略归纳框架，通过结构化记忆使AI护栏能够在稀疏、噪声反馈场景下持续自适应提升，解决了AI智能体在复杂工作流环境中护栏失效的实践挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体从聊天界面扩展到读取私密数据、调用工具、执行多步骤工作流的系统时，护栏失效的后果从单纯的答案质量问题升级为实际的部署危害——可能泄露机密、授权不安全操作或阻断合法工作。最棘手的失败往往是情境依赖的：某动作是否可接受取决于本地隐私规范、组织策略和用户期望，而这些难以在部署前完全规范。这造成了实践缺口：护栏必须适应自身运行环境，但部署反馈通常局限于稀疏的、噪声化的用户报告失败，且反复微调往往不切实际。
