Hierarchical verification improves task success on functional reasoning tasks by 14 to 16 percentage points over binary rewards, and curriculum learning is required for strong design performance. The resulting models generate topologically correct circuits, generalize to novel biological parts, and rediscover canonical designs from the synthetic biology literature.

</details>


### [299] [Fusion-fission forecasts when AI will shift to undesirable behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14218)
*Neil F. Johnson,Frank Yingjie Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于群动力学数学模型的AI行为转变预测方法，可跨模型架构通用，提供实时预警信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ChatGPT类AI的行为可能从期望转向非期望（鼓励自残、极端行为、财务损失、医疗军事错误），且无人能预测何时发生转变；尽管对齐和安全措施取得进展，转变仍持续存在。

Method: 向量化的融合-裂变群动力学（fusion-fission group dynamics）模型，通过数学推导得到转变条件，基于对话历史（C）与期望响应（B）和非期望响应（D） basins 动力学之间的群级竞争，可用给定应用的先验信息估计。

Result: 在六个独立测试中验证：（1）7个AI模型（124M-12B参数）90%准确率；（2）10个前沿聊天机器人的生产规模持续性；（3）在Stanford 'Delusional Spirals'语料库出现前11个月进行时间戳预测；（4）207,443条人机交互确认。

Conclusion: 提供了一个实时预警信号，可跨当前和未来ChatGPT类AI架构移植，并在可定义竞争响应类的应用领域中可实例化；该公式位于当前安全堆栈之下，可补充现有对齐技术。

Abstract: The key problem facing ChatGPT-like AI's use across society is that its behavior can shift, unnoticed, from desirable to undesirable -- encouraging self-harm, extremist acts, financial losses, or costly medical and military mistakes -- and no one can yet predict when. Shifts persist in even the newest AI models despite remarkable progress in AI modeling, post-training alignment and safeguards. Here we show that a vector generalization of fusion-fission group dynamics observed in living and active-matter systems drives -- and can forecast -- future shifts in the AI's behavior. The shift condition, which is also derivable mathematically, results from group-level competition between the conversation-so-far (C) and the desirable (B) and undesirable (D) basin dynamics which can be estimated in advance for a given application. It is neither model-specific nor driven by stochastic sampling. We validate it across six independent tests, including: 90 percent correct across seven AI models spanning two orders of magnitude in parameter count (124M-12B); production-scale persistence across ten frontier chatbots; and a priori time-stamped prediction eleven months before the Stanford 'Delusional Spirals' corpus appeared, and independently confirmed by that corpus of 207,443 human-AI exchanges. Because it sits architecturally below the current safety stack, the same formula provides a real-time warning signal that current alignment does not supply, portable across current and future ChatGPT-like AI architectures and instantiable in application domains where competing response classes can be defined.

</details>


### [300] [Good to Go: The LOOP Skill Engine That Hits 99% Success and Slashes Token Usage by 99% via One-Shot Recording and Deterministic Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14237)
*Xiaohua Wang,Kai Yu,XuXiao Liang,Liang Wang,Chao Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Loop Skill Engine解决LLM-based AI agent在重复性任务中的成本和稳定性问题：通过一次性录制完整执行轨迹，后续完全绕过LLM进行确定性回放，实现99% token节省和99%成功率，同时保持确定性和低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将LLM-based AI agent应用于重复性周期性任务时，存在三个核心矛盾：(1)LLM的灵活性与内在随机性导致的不可预测失败；(2)重复调用LLM带来的高昂token成本；(3)LLM输出的非确定性

Method: 核心方法采用"一次性录制+确定性回放"范式：首次运行时记录完整tool-call轨迹，通过贪心长度降序模板提取算法将录制转换为参数化、无分支的Loop Skill，同时将时间依赖和结果依赖变量参数化；后续执行完全绕过LLM，根据实时值解析模板变量并确定性回放工具序列。此外，通过可重入锁和原子文件替换保证并发写入安全。

Result: 在5分钟到24小时间隔的周期性任务基准测试中：(1)token消耗降低93.3%-99.98%；(2)执行延迟降低8.7倍；(3)消除输出非确定性；(4)达到99%的综合成功率。多层降级策略保证任务永不卡滞。

Conclusion: Loop Skill Engine通过将AI agent任务从"每次都需要LLM推理"转变为"一次性录制+后续确定性回放"的模式，成功解决了LLM在周期性任务中的核心矛盾。该引擎已作为开源项目buddyMe的一部分发布，为企业级AI agent应用提供了可行的高效、低成本、确定性执行方案。

Abstract: Deploying AI agents for repetitive periodic tasks exposes a critical tension: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer unmatched flexibility in tool orchestration, yet their inherent stochasticity causes unpredictable failures, and repeated invocations incur prohibitive token costs. We present the LOOP SKILL ENGINE, a system that achieves a combined 99% success rate and 99% token reduction for periodic agent tasks through a one-shot recording, deterministic replay paradigm. On its first run, the agent executes the task with full LLM reasoning while the system transparently intercepts and records the complete tool-call trajectory. A greedy length-descending template extraction algorithm then converts this recording into a parameterized, branch-free Loop Skill -- a deterministic execution plan that captures the task's functional intent while parameterizing time-dependent and result-dependent variables. All subsequent executions bypass the LLM entirely: the engine resolves template variables against real-time values and replays the tool sequence deterministically. We prove two theorems: (1) Replay Determinism -- the step sequence of a validated Loop Skill is invariant across all future executions; (2) Write Safety -- concurrent access to persistent configuration is serialized through reentrant locks and atomic file replacement. Across a benchmark of periodic agent tasks spanning intervals from 5 minutes to 24 hours, the Loop Skill Engine reduces monthly token consumption by 93.3%--99.98% and cuts execution latency by 8.7x while eliminating output non-determinism. A multi-layer degradation strategy guarantees that tasks never stall. We release the engine as part of the buddyMe open-source agent framework.

</details>


### [301] [Hypergraph Enterprise Agentic Reasoner over Heterogeneous Business Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14259)
*Ling Wang,Songnan Liu,Jianan Wang,Cheng Cheng,Xin Liu,Yihan Zhu,Enyu Li,Yu Xiao,Jiangyong Xie,Duogong Yan,Jiangyi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HEAR是一个企业级智能推理系统，基于分层超图本体论构建，通过证据驱动的推理循环动态编排本体工具，在供应链订单履行阻塞根因分析任务中达到94.7%准确率，无需LLM重训练即可实现可扩展、可审计的企业智能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Applying LLMs to heterogeneous enterprise systems is hindered by hallucinations and failures in multi-hop, n-ary reasoning. Existing paradigms like GraphRAG and NL2SQL lack the semantic grounding and auditable execution required for these complex environments.

Method: HEAR operates on a Stratified Hypergraph Ontology consisting of a base Graph Layer (virtualizes provenance-aware data interfaces) and a Hyperedge Layer (encodes n-ary business rules and procedural protocols). It employs an evidence-driven reasoning loop that dynamically orchestrates ontology tools for structured multi-hop analysis without requiring LLM retraining.

Result: On supply-chain tasks including order fulfillment blockage root cause analysis (RCA), HEAR achieves up to 94.7% accuracy. It demonstrates adaptive efficiency by utilizing procedural hyperedges to minimize token costs while leveraging topological exploration for rigorous correctness on complex queries.

Conclusion: HEAR establishes a scalable, auditable foundation for enterprise intelligence by achieving adaptive efficiency—using procedural hyperedges to minimize token costs while leveraging topological exploration for rigorous correctness on complex queries. It matches proprietary model performance with open-weight backbones and automates manual diagnostics.

Abstract: Applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to heterogeneous enterprise systems is hindered by hallucinations and failures in multi-hop, n-ary reasoning. Existing paradigms (e.g., GraphRAG, NL2SQL) lack the semantic grounding and auditable execution required for these complex environments. We introduce HEAR, an enterprise agentic reasoner built on a Stratified Hypergraph Ontology. Its base Graph Layer virtualizes provenance-aware data interfaces, while the Hyperedge Layer encodes n-ary business rules and procedural protocols. Operating an evidence-driven reasoning loop, HEAR dynamically orchestrates ontology tools for structured multi-hop analysis without requiring LLM retraining. Evaluations on supply-chain tasks, including order fulfillment blockage root cause analysis (RCA), show HEAR achieves up to 94.7% accuracy. Crucially, HEAR demonstrates adaptive efficiency: utilizing procedural hyperedges to minimize token costs, while leveraging topological exploration for rigorous correctness on complex queries. By matching proprietary model performance with open-weight backbones and automating manual diagnostics, HEAR establishes a scalable, auditable foundation for enterprise intelligence.

</details>


### [302] [Heuristic Pathologies and Further Variance Reduction via Uncertainty Propagation in the AIVAT Family of Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14261)
*Juho Kim,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: The paper identifies and addresses vulnerabilities in AIVAT's heuristic value function selection for multiagent evaluation. By fixing the function prior to data observation and propagating heuristic uncertainty via inverse-variance weighting, sample efficiency improves by 43%.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current AIVAT literature lacks guidelines for choosing the heuristic value function and handling its output uncertainty, creating potential vulnerabilities in agent evaluation with limited samples.

Method: 1) Parameterize the heuristic value function to expose vulnerabilities via gradient descent manipulation of sample variance and p-hacking; 2) Propagate heuristic uncertainty to quantify AIVAT estimate uncertainty, using inverse-variance weighted averaging for variance reduction.

Result: On a 10,000 poker hands dataset, the approach achieves 43.0% reduction in samples needed to draw statistical conclusions.

Conclusion: The heuristic value function should be fixed prior to observing evaluation data to avoid manipulation. Uncertainty propagation with inverse-variance weighted averaging can reduce required samples by 43%, though at the cost of AIVAT's unbiasedness guarantee.

Abstract: How should an agent's performance in a multiagent environment be evaluated when there is a limited sample size or a high cost of running a trial? The AIVAT family of variance reduction techniques was proposed to address this challenge by introducing unbiased low-variance estimators of agents' expected payoffs. An important component of AIVAT is a heuristic value function that discriminates between potentially low- and high-value counterfactual histories. A notable gap in the literature is that there is little to no constraint or guideline on how the heuristic value function should be chosen or how uncertainty in its output should be handled.
  In our first contribution, we parameterize the heuristic value function to highlight AIVAT's potential vulnerabilities: a) the sample variance can be set pathologically low by directly applying gradient descent on the sample variance, and b) one can p-hack to draw a desired statistical conclusion via gradient descent/ascent on the test statistic. The main takeaway is that the heuristic value function should be fixed prior to observing the evaluation data! In our second contribution, we show how the heuristic uncertainty can be propagated to quantify the uncertainty of AIVAT estimates. It is then possible to further reduce the variance using inverse-variance weighted averaging, but AIVAT's unbiasedness guarantee may have to be sacrificed. In our experiments, we use a dataset of 10,000 poker hands to demonstrate our heuristic pathology and uncertainty results, with the latter yielding a 43.0% reduction in the number of samples (poker hands) needed to draw statistical conclusions.

</details>


### [303] [Parallelizing Counterfactual Regret Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14277)
*Juho Kim,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通用的CFR算法并行化框架，通过将CFR重新表述为线性代数操作来利用并行计算加速。实验结果显示GPU实现相比CPU实现可获得约10000倍的加速，并可推广至CFR+、折扣CFR等变体算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行化技术已在AI领域广泛应用并显著加速了模型训练，但在计算博弈求解中的应用探索不足，存在巨大潜力；CFR算法家族是不完美信息游戏求解的核心方法，但其串行特性限制了大规模问题的处理能力。

Method: 将CFR算法重新框架为一系列线性代数运算，从而可以利用现有的并行线性代数技术进行加速；该方法可扩展至CFR+、折扣CFR及预测型CFR等表格类CFR变体算法。

Result: 实验表明，在GPU上运行的CFR实现比Google DeepMind OpenSpiel的CPU实现快四个数量级。

Conclusion: 该研究将并行计算技术成功应用于博弈论中的CFR算法家族，为大规模不完美信息游戏的求解提供了可扩展的高性能解决方案。

Abstract: Parallelization has played an instrumental role in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), drastically reducing the time taken to train and evaluate large AI models. In contrast to its impact in the broader field of AI, applying parallelization to computational game solving is relatively unexplored, despite its great potential. In this paper, we parallelize the family of counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) algorithms, which were central to important breakthroughs for solving large imperfect-information games. We present a generalized parallelization framework, reframing CFR as a series of linear algebra operations. Then, existing techniques for parallelizing linear algebra operations can be applied to accelerate CFR. We also describe how our technique can be applied to other tabular members of the CFR family of algorithms, including the state-of-the-art, such as CFR+, discounted CFR, and predictive variants of CFR. Experimentally, we show that our CFR implementation on a GPU is up to four orders of magnitude faster than Google DeepMind OpenSpiel's CFR implementations on a CPU.

</details>


### [304] [Precise Verification of Transformers through ReLU-Catalyzed Abstraction Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14294)
*Hengjie Liu,Zhenya Zhang,Jianjun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 BuFFeT（Bound Using-based reFinEment for Transformers），一种通过"ReLU 催化"的抽象精化（abstraction refinement）方法来提升 Transformer 形式化验证精度：把自注意力中点积的两个对偶平面上下界用 ReLU 精确表示，再借助经典神经网络验证中成熟的 ReLU 线性松弛技术导出一族参数化平面界；由此得到规则型 r-BuFFeT 与优化型 o-BuFFeT 两个框架，在 SST/Yelp 情感分析的 10 个模型、1400 个鲁棒性验证任务上相比 SOTA 基线 CrownBaF 显著提升最大可验证扰动半径（最高 3.6 倍），代价是 o-BuFFeT 时间开销约 33.5–96.9 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 在安全关键场景（自动驾驶、医疗）广泛部署，但自注意力中的点积、softmax 等双线性/高阶非线性使精确界计算呈指数复杂度。现有主流方法（如 Shi et al. 的 CrownBaF）用抽象解释构造凸上近似，效率高但精度不足：其对 QK^T 中点积只使用单一"平面"松弛（固定覆盖双曲抛物面的一侧），存在次优性，逐层累积近似误差，导致抽象解释固有的完备性问题——频繁产生假警报（false alarms），浪费验证时间与资源。既有工作还表明 ReLU 的线性松弛策略（如固定取 0 或 1、或按面积启发式选择）在所有情形下都不是最优的，因此需要新的、更精细的近似构造，同时仍保持线性（凸）界以维持可扩展性。

Method: 核心是 ReLU 的"新用法"。先构造点积的对偶平面界：基线式 f_qk^U1 = k^U·Q + q^L·K − q^L k^U、f_qk^L1 = k^L·Q + q^L·K − q^L k^L（文献[23]），以及新提出的对偶式 f_qk^U2 = k^L·Q + q^U·K − q^U k^L、f_qk^L2 = k^U·Q + q^U·K − q^U k^U（Lemma 1 证明其可靠性）。取两者的 min/max 可得更紧但非线性的紧界；论文用 ReLU 精确重写：f_qk^U = f_qk^U1 − ReLU(f_qk^U1 − f_qk^U2)，f_qk^L = f_qk^L1 + ReLU(f_qk^L2 − f_qk^L1)（附录 D 证明与 min/max 等价）。由于只需保证可靠性，线性下界 f_relu^L(x)=α·x (α∈[0,1]) 即足够，代入后得到参数化平面界 f_qk^U* = (1−α)f_qk^U1 + α·f_qk^U2、f_qk^L* = α·f_qk^L2 + (1−α)f_qk^L1，可沿 transformer 各层线性传播。作者进一步指出：基线方法等价于 α=0，对偶界等价于 α=1，二者均为该表示的特例且次优。两种精化策略：（1）r-BuFFeT（规则型，借鉴 DeepPoly）——根据 ReLU 输入区间 [l,u] 比较 |l| 与 |u| 选择使过近似面积最小的 α（|l|>|u| 取 0，否则取 1）；（2）o-BuFFeT（优化型，借鉴 OptNet/深度优化思路）——把 α 作为决策变量，以 softplus 损失 L = log(1+exp(−Margin_lower)) 为目标（Margin = min_i(Y_il − Y_i)，验证等价于其下界 > 0），利用自动微分与 Adam 等现成求解器迭代细化近似，一旦 Margin 下界为正即提前终止并认证鲁棒性。Theorem 4.1 证明两者在 α∈[0,1] 下均可靠（sound）。实现基于 CrownBaF 库。

Result: 实验：SST 与 Yelp polarity 两个情感分析数据集，标准 encoder-only Transformer（N=1/2/3/6 层，8 头，隐藏维 512，ReLU）+ TinyBERT（4 层），共 10 个模型；每模型 140 个单词扰动（L1 范数）验证任务，总计 1400 个；基线为 CrownBaF，指标为最大可验证 ε（精度）与耗时。精度：绝大多数任务上两方法优于基线，且优势随层数加深而增大——N=6 时 r-BuFFeT 最高 1.8 倍、o-BuFFeT 最高 3.6 倍，TinyBERT 上最高约 2.7 倍；o-BuFFeT 稳定优于 r-BuFFeT（中位数与最大值均更高）。反例：r-BuFFeT 在少量任务（Yelp N=6、TinyBERT）不如基线（因其 α 选择为启发式面积策略）；o-BuFFeT 仅出现 1 例（Yelp, N=3）弱于基线。效率：r-BuFFeT 时间约为基线的 1.1–1.7 倍（同数量级，可接受）；o-BuFFeT 为基线的 33.5–96.9 倍，但比值随 N 基本稳定（约两个数量级），6 层模型与 TinyBERT 仍在数分钟内完成。消融显示 Margin 下界在优化过程中持续上升，约 100 步越过 0、约 600 步超过基线 Margin，基线失败者约 800 步仍可解出。与 Wei et al. 的 LSE softmax 松弛横向对比（3 层 SST、固定半径、平均归一化 margin 比）：baseline 1.000、wei_lse 1.01182、o-BuFFeT 1.00463、二者组合 1.01610，说明两者作用于不同误差源、可叠加互补。

Conclusion: 本文证明了 ReLU 可以作为"催化"手段，把 Transformer 验证与经典神经网络验证方法论打通：点积的对偶平面界可统一为 α∈[0,1] 的单参数族线性松弛，使成熟的 ReLU 界精化技术可直接迁移到自注意力，显著降低过近似误差与假警报、扩大可认证安全边界，同时保持线性界的效率与可靠性（Theorem 4.1）。r-BuFFeT 以可忽略的耗时换取稳定的精度提升；o-BuFFeT 以约两个数量级的时间代价换取最高 3.6 倍的认证半径提升，且在难任务上能通过持续迭代逐步解出基线无法判定的问题。未来工作：用基线的 α 作为 o-BuFFeT 的初始化以提升效率；扩展到其他领域的 Transformer（如 Transformer-based 控制器）；与 softmax 专用松弛（如 LSE）组合使用。作者亦指出局限：仅覆盖 encoder-only 架构，且绕过 embedding 层直接在嵌入空间做扰动，对 NLP 局部鲁棒性的实际意义有限（可与刻画有意义词超矩形的技术协同）。

Abstract: Formal verification of transformers has become increasingly important due to their widespread deployment in safety-critical applications. Compared to classic neural networks, the inferences of transformers involve highly complex computations, such as dot products in self-attention layers, rendering their verification extremely difficult. Existing approaches explored over-approximation methods by constructing convex constraints to bound the output ranges of transformers, which can achieve high efficiency. However, they may sacrifice verification precision, and consequently introduce significant approximation error that leads to frequent occurrences of false alarms. In this paper, we propose a transformer verification approach that can achieve improved precision. At the core of our approach is a novel usage of ReLU, by which we represent a precise but non-linear bound for dot products such that we can further exploit the rich body of literature for convex relaxation of ReLU to derive precise bounds. We extend two classic approaches to the context of transformers, a rule-based one and an optimization-based one, resulting in two new frameworks for efficient and precise verification. We evaluate our approaches on different model architectures and robustness properties derived from two datasets about sentiment analysis, and compare with the state-of-the-art baseline approach. Compared to the baseline, our approach can achieve significant precision improvement for most of the verification tasks with acceptable compromise of efficiency, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [305] [Semantic Feature Segmentation for Interpretable Predictive Maintenance in Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14318)
*Emilio Mastriani,Alessandro Costa,Federico Incardona,Kevin Munari,Sebastiano Spinello*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出「语义特征分割」框架，将复杂系统（如容器化 Cassandra 集群）的监测特征空间按领域知识划分为保留主导预测信息的「规范空间（canonical）」与结构上边缘的「残差空间（residual）」，并用时间感知交叉验证下的期望预测风险作为任务相关信息量的操作化代理来验证该划分。实验显示：规范空间 Intra-Canonical Correlation (0.3820) 显著高于 Inter-Canonical Correlation (0.0791)（Mann–Whitney U，p<0.001），且在 MST 去冗余剪枝后仍保持（0.3108 vs 0.0745）；时间循环移位扰动会使该分离反转/坍塌，证明其源于协调的时间动态而非静态统计相似性。规范空间在所有时间切分与聚合窗口下预测风险均低于残差空间（平均 log-loss 0.155 vs 0.202），并与全特征空间（0.200）和 PCA 表示（0.163）性能相当但不显著差异，同时保留变量语义可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统的预测性维护（PdM）面临监测变量异质性与冗余性问题：特征各自由不同运行机制驱动（累计计数器、延迟分位数、连接状态、内存压力等），无差别使用会淹没故障信号、增加模型复杂度并削弱可解释性。传统特征选择与降维方法（PCA 等）基于统计方差/相关准则，缺乏与系统结构的语义联系，所得特征难以解释。因此需要一种既保留任务相关信息、又锚定在系统功能语义上的特征空间分解方法。

Method: 1）形式化四条性质：段可分离性（segment separability）、冗余削减下的稳健性、系统的功能分解、canonical 支配与 residual 边缘性。2）基于专家知识的语义相关 sim(f_a,f_b) 将特征空间 F_C（规范集，按 p 个语义段 S_k 划分）与 F_R（残差集）互补不交。3）相关性算子：ICC_k（段内 Spearman 平均，含 macro/micro 聚合）与 ICOR_ab（段间平均），用 Mann–Whitney U 检验 H0: ICC≤ICOR vs H1: ICC>ICOR。4）冗余削减算子 P: F_C→F̃_C 为段内选择性投影，剪枝后需满足 ICC^(P)>ICOR^(P) 且近似准不变。5）预测视角：以 log-loss 期望风险 R_C<R_R 作为 I(X_C;Y)>I(X_R;Y) 的操作化代理。6）流程：InfluxDB 原始数据（2,157,331 行×17 列 → 12,120 行×137 列 → 清洗后 83 变量）→ 语义变换阶段（按段分别施加 MCR、LTC、BSR、一阶差分、GBD、RBDR + 对应归一化）→ 段内 Spearman 相关 + 距离矩阵 + 最小生成树（MST）去冗余剪枝 → 残差空间按四类软分类做轻量预处理 → 时间感知交叉验证（切分数 2–9，聚合窗口 5/10/15/20 min）对比 canonical/residual/full/PCA。7）附加实验：特征级循环移位时间扰动测试；LGBM、XGBoost、随机森林三模型跨预测时域 Δ 的 log-loss 与 AUC；高风险区（p_C>θ_C）条件相关 corr(p_R,p_C|p_C>θ_C)。

Result: （1）可分离性：ICC_micro=0.3820，ICOR_micro=0.0791，Δ≈0.3029，p<0.001；State 段 ICC 最高约 0.675；Latency–State 段间均值 0.4246 但中位数极低，属离群型结构。（2）时间扰动：循环移位后 ICC_shift=0.061、ICOR_shift=0.0343，分离消失/反转，证明可分离性源于协调时间动态而非静态结构。（3）剪枝稳健性：ICC 降至 0.3108，ICOR 几乎不变（0.0745），Δ=0.2363，p<0.001。（4）功能分解：所有时间配置下 R_R>R_C，且聚合窗口越长差距越大；平均 log-loss：canonical 0.155 < PCA 0.163 < full 0.200 < residual 0.202；canonical 与 full/PCA 的配对检验差异均不显著。（5）canonical 支配：跨 Rolling LGBM/XGBoost/RF 与各 Δ，canonical 风险持续更低、AUC 约 0.55–0.63，residual 的 AUC 持续接近 0.5、风险接近非信息基线；高风险条件下 corr(p_R,p_C|p_C>θ_C) 在零附近波动、无稳定符号，说明 residual 不提供系统性互补确认信号。

Conclusion: 语义特征分割可视为一种「信息保持的结构性过滤器」：它将高维异质监测变量重组为六个语义上同质、动态上协调的可解释功能子系统（Cumulative、Latency、Pressure、Network、State、Structural），在几乎不损失预测性能的前提下获得与 PCA/全特征空间相当的风险水平，同时保留变量与运行机制之间的语义对应关系，为 PdM 提供可解释的结构化组织方式；建模与特征工程应主要聚焦于 canonical 空间。局限包括：仅在单一系统、有限故障事件上验证；分割规则依赖人工领域知识、跨系统可移植性受限；"信息集中"仅以经验风险与条件依赖作操作化刻画，缺乏形式化的信息论分解；未来可扩展至更多基础设施与故障模式、融合数据驱动分割、引入显式信息论度量（如互信息估计）。

Abstract: Predictive maintenance in complex systems is often complicated by the heterogeneity and redundancy of monitored variables,which can obscure fault-relevant information and reduce model interpretability. This work proposes a semantic feature segmentation framework that decomposes the monitored feature space into a canonical component,expected to retain the dominant predictive information, and a residual component containing structurally peripheral signals. The segmentation is defined through domain informed criteria and sets up monitoring variables into functional groups reflecting operational mechanisms such as throughput,latency,pressure,network activity,and structural state. To evaluate the effectiveness of this decomposition, we adopt a predictive perspective in which expected predictive risk is used as an operational proxy for task-relevant information. Experimental results obtained through time-aware cross-validation show that the canonical space consistently achieves lower predictive risk than the residual space across multiple temporal configurations, indicating that the semantic segmentation concentrates the most relevant information for fault anticipation. In addition, the canonical segments exhibit significantly stronger intra-segment coherence than inter-segment dependence, and this structural organization remains stable after redundancy reduction. When compared with the full feature space and with a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) representation, the canonical space carries out comparable predictive performance and furthermore preserves the semantic meaning of the original variables. These findings suggest that semantic feature segmentation provides an interpretable and information-preserving decomposition of monitoring signals, enabling competitive predictive performance without sacrificing the operational interpretability required in predictive maintenance applications.

</details>


### [306] [Are Agents Ready to Teach? A Multi-Stage Benchmark for Real-World Teaching Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14322)
*Zixin Chen,Peng Liu,Rui Sheng,Haobo Li,Jianhong Tu,Xiaodong Deng,Kashun Shum,Dayiheng Liu,Huamin Qu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EduAgentBench 是一个用于全面评估 tutor agent 能力的基准测试，包含150个任务，涵盖专业教学判断、情境化辅导和教学管理工作流三大维度。研究发现当前前沿模型在bounded教学判断上尚可，但无法满足专业教学在情境化辅导和自主工作流执行方面的要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语言智能体在复杂专业工作流中应用日益广泛，但 tutoring 作为高风险应用场景，现有基准测试缺乏有效评估。真正的 tutor agent 不仅需要给出正确答案，还需诊断学习者状态、随时间调整支持、做出有教学理论依据的决策，并在真实学习管理系统中执行干预措施。

Method: 通过教育洞察驱动的任务构建流程，开发了包含150个质量控制任务的基准测试，涵盖三大能力维度：专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导和Canvas风格教学工作流完成，采用互补验证信号与人工审查相结合的方式进行评估。

Result: 前沿模型在受限教学判断方面表现尚可，但在情境化多轮辅导和自主教学工作流执行方面仍远未达到专业教学水准。

Conclusion: EduAgentBench是首个理论驱动、面向真实场景的 tutor agent 全面评估基准，为开发能够支持实际教学工作的 tutor agent 提供了测量基础。

Abstract: Language agents are increasingly deployed in complex professional workflows, with tutoring emerging as a particularly high-stakes capability that remains largely unmeasured in existing benchmarks. Effective tutor agents require more than producing correct answers or executing accurate tool calls: a robust tutor must diagnose learner state, adapt support over time, make pedagogically justified decisions grounded in educational evidence, and execute interventions within realistic learning-management systems. We introduce EduAgentBench, a source-grounded benchmark for holistically evaluating tutor agents across the full scope of teaching work. It contains 150 quality-controlled tasks across three capability surfaces: professional pedagogical judgment, situated multi-turn tutoring, and Canvas-style teaching workflow completion. Tasks are constructed through a pedagogical-insight-driven pipeline and evaluated with complementary verification signals and human review. Across a comprehensive evaluation of frontier models, our findings reveal that current models are generally capable of bounded pedagogical judgment, but still fall short of professional teaching standards in situated tutoring and autonomous teaching-workflow execution. To our knowledge, EduAgentBench is the first theory-grounded and realistic benchmark for evaluating the holistic teaching capability of tutor agents, providing a measurement foundation for developing future tutor agents that can support realistic teaching work.

</details>


### [307] [CrystalReasoner: Reasoning and RL for Property-Conditioned Crystal Structure Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14344)
*Yuyang Wu,Stefano Falletta,Delia McGrath,Sherry Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CrystalReasoner是一个端到端LLM框架，通过引入物理先验作为思考令牌和强化学习多目标奖励对齐，实现从自然语言指令生成有效、稳定且具有特定属性的晶体结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成模型在原子级精度上存在不足，而扩散模型难以整合高层科学知识，导致生成的晶体结构无效、不稳定或缺乏理想性质，自然语言指令与3D结构之间存在显著鸿沟。

Method: 提出CrystalReasoner框架，包含两个核心创新：1) 引入物理先验作为"思考令牌"(thinking tokens)，在生成原子坐标前先考虑晶体学对称性、局部配位环境和预测物理性质；2) 采用强化学习(RL)结合多目标密集奖励函数进行对齐训练，优化物理有效性、化学一致性和热力学稳定性；针对属性条件生成任务，设计了针对离散约束（如空间群）和连续属性（如弹性、热膨胀）的任务特定奖励函数。

Result: 相比先前工作和无思考痕迹/RL的基线模型，CrystalReasoner在多项指标上表现更优，S.U.N.比率提升三倍，属性条件生成性能更佳，并展现出可扩展的自适应推理能力（随原子数增加推理长度相应增长）。

Conclusion: CrystalReasoner成功实现了一个结合推理与强化学习的端到端晶体结构生成框架，通过物理先验思考令牌和多目标奖励函数，显著提升了生成结构的质量、稳定性及属性控制能力，且表现出可扩展的自适应推理能力。

Abstract: Generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal structure discovery. However, existing LLM-based generative models struggle with low-level atomic precision, while diffusion-based methods fall short in integrating high-level scientific knowledge. As a result, generated structures are often invalid, unstable, or do not possess desirable properties. To address this gap, we propose CrystalReasoner (\method), an end-to-end LLM framework that generates crystal structures from natural language instructions through reasoning and alignment. \method introduces physical priors as thinking tokens, which include crystallographic symmetry, local coordination environments and predicted physical properties before generating atomic coordinates. This bridges the gap between natural language and 3D structures. \method then employs reinforcement learning (RL) with a multi-objective, dense reward function to align generation with physical validity, chemical consistency, and thermodynamic stability. For property-conditioned tasks, we design task-specific reward functions and train specialized models for discrete constraints (e.g., space group) and continuous properties (e.g., elasticity, thermal expansion). Empirical results demonstrate that compared to prior works and baselines without thinking traces or RL, \method obtains better performance on diverse metrics, triples S.U.N. ratio, and achieves better performance for property conditioned generation. \method also exhibits adaptive reasoning, increasing reasoning lengths as the number of atoms increases. Our work demonstrates the potential of leveraging thinking traces and RL for generating valid, stable, and property-conditioned crystal structures. Please see our work at https://crystalreasoner.github.io/ .

</details>


### [308] [Herculean: An Agentic Benchmark for Financial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14355)
*Xueqing Peng,Zhuohan Xie,Yupeng Cao,Haohang Li,Lingfei Qian,Yan Wang,Vincent Jim Zhang,Huan He,Xuguang Ai,Linhai Ma,Ruoyu Xiang,Yueru He,Yi Han,Shuyao Wang,Yuqing Guo,Mingyang Jiang,Yilun Zhao,Youzhong Dong,Xiaoyu Wang,Yankai Chen,Ye Yuan,Qiyuan Zhang,Fuyuan Lyu,Haolun Wu,Yonghan Yang,Zichen Zhao,Yuyang Dai,Fan Zhang,Rania Elbadry,Ayesha Gull,Muhammad Usman Safder,Nuo Chen,Fengbin Zhu,Tianshi Cai,Zimu Wang,Polydoros Giannouris,Yuechen Jiang,Zhiwei Liu,Mohsinul Kabir,Yuyan Wang,Yixiang Zheng,Yangyang Yu,Weijin Liu,Wenbo Cao,Anke Xu,Peng Lu,Jerry Huang,Fengran Mo,Mingquan Lin,Prayag Tiwari,Yijia Zhao,Victor Gutierrez Basulto,Xiao-Yang Liu,Kaleb E Smith,Jiahuan Pei,Arman Cohan,Jimin Huang,Yuehua Tang,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Xi Chen,Xue Liu,Junichi Tsujii,Jian-Yun Nie,Sophia Ananiadou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Herculean is the first agentic financial intelligence benchmark covering 4 professional workflows. Testing reveals frontier agents excel at simpler tasks but fail at complex, high-stakes workflows requiring sustained state management and verification—highlighting a critical gap in current AI agent capabilities.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing financial benchmarks only evaluate static competencies (QA, retrieval, summarization, classification) but cannot assess whether AI agents can reliably carry out professional financial work requiring dynamic, multi-step agentic capabilities.

Method: Introduced Herculean, a benchmark with 4 MCP-based skill environments (Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, Auditing), each with unique tools, dynamics, constraints, and success criteria to enable consistent end-to-end assessment.

Result: Frontier agents performed relatively well on Trading and Market Insights workflows, but struggled substantially on Hedging and Auditing tasks where long-horizon coordination, state consistency, and structured verification are critical.

Conclusion: Current AI agents have a significant gap between financial reasoning capabilities and dependable execution in high-stakes workflows. The benchmark reveals that long-horizon coordination, state consistency, and structured verification are key limitations.

Abstract: As AI agents improve, the central question is no longer whether they can solve isolated well-defined financial tasks, but whether they can reliably carry out financial professional work. Existing financial benchmarks offer only a partial view of this ability, as they primarily evaluate static competencies such as question answering, retrieval, summarization, and classification. We introduce Herculean, the first skilled benchmark for agentic financial intelligence spanning four representative workflows, including Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, and Auditing. Each workflow is instantiated as a standardized MCP-based skill environment with its own tools, interaction dynamics, constraints, and success criteria, enabling consistent end-to-end assessment of heterogeneous agent systems. Across frontier agents, we find agents perform relatively well on Trading and Market Insights, but struggle substantially on Hedging and Auditing, where long-horizon coordination, state consistency, and structured verification are critical. Overall, our results point to a key gap in current agents in turning financial reasoning into dependable workflow execution in high-stakes financial workflows.

</details>


### [309] [Uncovering the Representation Geometry of Minimal Cores in Overcomplete Reasoning Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14358)
*Sanjoy Chowdhury,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了语言模型推理过程中中间步骤的冗余程度。通过定义"最小核心"——即支持最终答案所需的最小步骤子集——发现当前模型的推理轨迹普遍存在严重冗余，平均近半数步骤可移除。最小核心不仅能压缩推理，还揭示了更清晰的任务解决结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常生成较长的链式思维推理轨迹，但这些中间推理步骤中有多大比例是真正必要的仍不清楚，这是一个重要但尚未被充分研究的问题。

Method: 定义了"过完备推理轨迹"和"最小核心"的概念框架；设计了压缩率、冗余质量、步骤必要性和必要性集中度等评估指标；采用贪婪算法进行最小核心提取；在6个不同类型基准测试上进行了广泛实验验证。

Result: 发现显著过完备性：平均46%的步骤可移除，同时86%情况下保留原答案；前三个步骤贡献了平均65%的必要性质量；最小核心提升了正确/错误轨迹分离度11个百分点，降低内在维度估计34%，跨模型族迁移时保持85%的答案保留率。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了语言模型的推理过程存在大量冗余，最小核心方法不仅能有效压缩推理轨迹，还能揭示更清晰的任务解决几何结构，具有跨模型家族的泛化能力。这表明当前LLM的推理过程存在大量冗余计算，最小核心可以作为更高效推理的基础。

Abstract: Language models often generate long chain-of-thought traces, but it remains unclear how much of this reasoning is necessary for preserving the final prediction. We study this through the lens of overcomplete reasoning traces: generated traces that contain more intermediate steps than are needed to support the model's answer. We define the minimal core as the smallest subset of steps that preserves either the final answer or predictive distribution, and introduce metrics for compression ratio, redundancy mass, step necessity, and necessity concentration. Across six deliberative reasoning benchmarks spanning arithmetic, competition mathematics, expert scientific reasoning, and commonsense multi-hop QA, we find substantial overcompleteness: on average, 46% of steps are removable under greedy minimal-core extraction while preserving the original answer in 86% of cases. We also find that predictive support is concentrated: the top three steps account for 65% of measured necessity mass on average. Beyond compression, minimal cores expose a cleaner geometry of reasoning: compared with full traces, they improve correct-incorrect trace separation by 11 points, reduce estimated intrinsic dimensionality by 34%, and transfer across model families with 85% off-diagonal answer retention. Theoretically, we establish existence of minimal sufficient subsets, local irreducibility guarantees for greedy elimination, and certificates of overcompleteness and sparse necessity. Together, these results suggest that full reasoning traces are often verbose and overcomplete, while minimal cores isolate the effective support underlying language-model predictions.

</details>


### [310] [Nexus : An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14389)
*Sarkar Snigdha Sarathi Das,Palash Goyal,Mihir Parmar,Nanyun Peng,Vishy Tirumalashetty,Chun-Liang Li,Rui Zhang,Jinsung Yoon,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Nexus是一个多智能体预测框架，通过将预测分解为专业阶段（宏观/微观时间波动隔离、上下文信息整合、最终预测综合）来弥合时间序列基础模型与LLM之间的差距。在Zillow房产数据和股票市场数据上的实验表明，该方法在知识截止日期后的数据上始终匹配或超越最先进的TSFM和强LLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前时间序列基础模型(TSFM)擅长数值模式预测但无法处理非结构化上下文信息；LLM虽能做零样本预测但在跨领域表现不一致。现实世界的预测任务需要整合数值推理与文本上下文（如新闻、事件），现有方法缺乏将两者有效结合的架构。

Method: 提出Nexus多智能体框架，包含三个专门阶段：(1)分离宏观层面的季节性信号；(2)捕获微观层面的波动模式；(3)整合可用上下文信息后综合最终预测。该框架不依赖外部统计锚点或单一提示工程，而是通过智能体协作实现适应性推理。评估采用知识截止日期之后的真实数据（Zillow房产指标、波动性股票）。

Result: 当前LLM具有比先前认知更强的内在预测能力，关键在于数值推理与上下文推理的组织方式。在超越知识截止日期的Zillow房产和股票市场数据上，Nexus持续匹配或超越SOTA TSFM及强LLM基线。此外，Nexus生成高质量推理轨迹，显式展示每个预测背后的驱动因素。

Conclusion: 真实世界的预测本质上是一个智能体推理问题，远超序列建模范畴。Nexus的成功表明，将预测任务分解为专门的推理阶段，结合数值与上下文信息，是超越纯序列建模方法的有效路径。

Abstract: Time series forecasting is not just numerical extrapolation, but often requires reasoning with unstructured contextual data such as news or events. While specialized Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) excel at forecasting based on numerical patterns, they remain unaware to real-world textual signals. Conversely, while LLMs are emerging as zero-shot forecasters, their performance remains uneven across domains and contextual grounding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Nexus, a multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes prediction into specialized stages: isolating macro-level and micro-level temporal fluctuations, and integrating contextual information when available before synthesizing a final forecast. This decomposition enables Nexus to adapt from seasonal signals to volatile, event-driven information without relying on external statistical anchors or monolithic prompting. We show that current-generation LLMs possess substantially stronger intrinsic forecasting ability than previously recognized, depending critically on how numerical and contextual reasoning are organized. Evaluated on data strictly succeeding LLM knowledge cutoffs spanning Zillow real estate metrics and volatile stock market equities, Nexus consistently matches or outperforms state-of-the-art TSFMs and strong LLM baselines. Beyond numerical accuracy, Nexus produces high-quality reasoning traces that explicitly show the fundamental drivers behind each forecast. Our results establish that real-world forecasting is an agentic reasoning problem extending well beyond only sequence modeling.

</details>


### [311] [Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14392)
*Yucheng Shi,Zhenwen Liang,Kishan Panaganti,Dian Yu,Wenhao Yu,Haitao Mi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoEnv方法，将语言模型的自我改进从数据生成循环转变为环境构建循环。核心洞见是稳定自我改进需要"求解-验证不对称性"——任务要么算法上难以推理但作为代码 trivial，要么本身难以求解但容易验证。这种不对称性创造了一个持续的信息差距，使奖励信号在模型改进过程中保持有效。实验表明，通过构建结构上超出自身能力的可执行环境，模型可实现稳定的自我改进（Qwen3-4B上相对提升3.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进范式依赖数据生成循环，模型仅生成待模仿的问题或轨迹。根本问题：随着模型能力提升，奖励信号会逐渐失效（模型学会"作弊"验证器），导致自我改进无法持续。需要将自我改进从数据生成循环转变为环境构建循环。

Method: EvoEnv是一个单策略生成器-求解器方法，从十个种子合成Python环境，并经过多阶段验证：语义自审、求解器相对难度校准和原创性检查。关键设计原则是环境需具备稳定的"求解-验证不对称性"——模型能编写一次oracle但无法可靠地在新实例上执行，或任务求解困难但验证容易。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Thinking上，固定的公共数据RLVR和固定手工环境RLVR均导致平均性能下降，而EvoEnv实现了从72.4到74.8的提升，相对增益3.3%。

Conclusion: EvoEnv通过环境构造实现了稳定的自我改进，在Qwen3-4B-Thinking上从72.4提升至74.8（相对提升3.3%）。核心结论：稳定的自我改进不依赖于生成更多合成数据，而在于模型学会构建结构上超出自身能力的"世界"。

Abstract: We pursue a vision for self-improving language models in which the model does not merely generate problems or traces to imitate, but constructs the environments that train it. In zero-data reasoning RL, this reframes self-improvement from a data-generation loop into an environment-construction loop, where each artifact is a reusable executable object that samples instances, computes references, and scores responses. Whether this vision sustains improvement hinges on a single property: the environments must exhibit stable solve--verify asymmetry, the model must be able to write an oracle once that it cannot reliably execute in natural language on fresh instances. This asymmetry takes two complementary forms. Some tasks are algorithmically hard to reason through but trivial as code: a dynamic program or graph traversal, compiled once, yields unboundedly many calibrated instances. Others are intrinsically hard to solve but easy to verify, like planted subset-sum or constraint satisfaction. Both create a durable gap between proposing and solving that the policy cannot close by gaming the verifier, and it is this gap that keeps reward informative as the learner improves. We instantiate this view in EvoEnv, a single-policy generator, solver method that synthesizes Python environments from ten seeds and admits them only after staged validation, semantic self-review, solver-relative difficulty calibration, and novelty checks. The strongest evidence comes from the already-strong regime: on Qwen3-4B-Thinking, fixed public-data RLVR and fixed hand-crafted environment RLVR reduce the average, while EvoEnv improves it from 72.4 to 74.8, a relative gain of 3.3%. Stable self-improvement, we suggest, depends not on producing more synthetic data, but on models learning to construct worlds whose difficulty stays structurally beyond their own reach.

</details>


### [312] [Coding Agent Is Good As World Simulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14398)
*Hongyu Wang,Jingquan Wang,Bocheng Zou,Radu Serban,Dan Negrut*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于智能体框架的物理驱动世界模型，通过可执行仿真代码构建，而非传统的视频生成方法。框架包含规划、代码生成、视觉审查和物理分析四个智能体，通过迭代反馈确保生成的仿真既符合用户指令又满足物理约束，在物理准确性等方面优于现有视频生成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频的世界模型从视频中推断动态并存储在潜在状态中，不显式强制物理约束，导致生成的视频 rollout 物理上不可信，表现为接触不稳定、形状扭曲或运动不一致。

Method: 该框架协调四个智能体协同工作：规划智能体将自然语言提示转换为结构化场景计划；代码智能体将其实现为可执行仿真代码；视觉审查智能体提供视觉反馈；物理分析智能体检查物理一致性。代码根据反馈迭代修订，直至仿真满足提示要求和物理约束。

Result: 该框架在物理准确性、指令保真度和视觉质量上均优于先进的基于视频模型。

Conclusion: 该框架可应用于驾驶仿真和具身机器人等多种场景，在物理准确性和视觉质量上均优于基于视频的世界模型。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for building interactive simulation environments, with recent video-based approaches demonstrating impressive progress in generating visually plausible dynamics. However, because these models typically infer dynamics from video and represent them in latent states, they do not explicitly enforce physical constraints. As a result, the generated video rollouts are not physically plausible, exhibiting unstable contacts, distorted shapes, or inconsistent motion. In this paper, we present an agentic framework constructing physics-based world models through executable simulation code. The framework coordinates planning, code generation, visual review, and physics analysis agents. The planning agent converts the natural language prompt into a structured scene plan, the code agent implements it as executable simulation code, and the visual review agent provide visual feedback while the physics analysis agent checks physical consistency. The code is iteratively revised based on the feedback until the simulation matches the prompt reqirements and physical constraints. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity and visual quality, which could be applied to various scenarios including driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.

</details>


### [313] [Metis AI: The Overlooked Middle Zone Between AI-Native and World-Movers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14407)
*Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战了AI能力边界的传统认知框架，提出"Metis AI"概念——指那些完全在数字环境中执行、但因制度性和社会性纠缠而无法被可靠自动化的一类任务。作者区分了构成性metis（形式化即被破坏的知识）与操作性metis（可被渐进吸收的系统特定熟悉度），并提出五个结构特征：重大不可逆性、关系不可简化性、规范开放性、对手共演化、责任锚定。研究认为这些特征是任务本身的属性而非当前模型的局限，对Metis AI任务的正确设计响应不是更好的自动化，而是人机协作的"半人马架构"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI局限性的话语将AI能力边界定义为数字任务（AI擅长）与物理任务（需要具身化）之间的划分，但作者认为这一框架遗漏了最关键的边界——数字任务内部的边界。

Method: Theoretical analysis distinguishing two types of metis (constitutive vs. operational) and proposing five structural characteristics that define the Metis AI zone: consequential irreversibility, relational irreducibility, normative open texture, adversarial co-evolution, and accountability anchoring.

Result: 识别出一类名为"Metis AI"的任务，这些任务完全在计算机上执行，但因制度、社会和规范层面的纠缠而抗拒可靠的AI自动化。

Conclusion: The appropriate design response to Metis AI tasks is not better automation but centaur architectures (human-led with AI support), rather than full automation attempts.

Abstract: The dominant discourse on AI limitations frames the boundary of AI capability as a divide between digital tasks (where AI excels) and physical tasks (where embodiment is required). We argue this framing misses the most consequential boundary: the one within digital tasks. We identify a class of tasks we call Metis AI, named for the Greek concept of metis (practical, contextual knowledge), that are performed entirely on computers yet resist reliable AI automation. These tasks are not computationally intractable; they are institutionally, socially, and normatively entangled in ways that defeat algorithmic approaches. We distinguish constitutive metis (knowledge destroyed by the act of formalization) from operational metis (system-specific familiarity that automation can progressively absorb), and propose five structural characteristics that define the Metis AI zone: consequential irreversibility, relational irreducibility, normative open texture, adversarial co-evolution, and accountability anchoring. We ground each in established theory from across the social sciences, philosophy, and humanitarian practice, argue that these characteristics are properties of the tasks themselves rather than limitations of current models, and show that the appropriate design response is not better automation but centaur architectures in which humans lead and AI supports.

</details>


### [314] [A Unified Knowledge Embedded Reinforcement Learning-based Framework for Generalized Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14416)
*Wen Wang,Xiangchen Wu,Liang Wang,Hao Hu,Xianping Tao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受"路线优先-聚类其次"启发式算法启发的知识嵌入框架，通过双层知识融合（问题分解与动态规划）和历史增强上下文处理模块解决CVRP，在解质量和泛化能力上优于现有强化学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统端到端强化学习方法缺乏显式问题求解知识，导致解质量受限；现实CVRP涉及多样化目标和复杂约束（时间窗、回程需求等），亟需统一解决方案框架。

Method: 该框架采用双层知识嵌入策略：(1) 将CVRP分解为"路线优先-聚类其次"的子问题；(2) 利用动态规划求解第二子问题，其结果指导基于强化学习的构建式求解器解决第一子问题。同时引入统一的历史增强上下文处理模块以缓解问题分解带来的部分可观测性。

Result: 实验表明该框架在多种CVRP变体上显著优于现有学习方法，缩小了与经典启发式方法的性能差距。

Conclusion: 所提出的知识嵌入框架在多种CVRP变体上展现出优异性能，相比当前最优学习方法获得更优解质量，且与经典启发式方法的差距更小，证明了强泛化能力。

Abstract: The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) is a fundamental NP-hard problem with broad applications in logistics and transportation. Real-world CVRPs often involve diverse objectives and complex constraints, such as time windows or backhaul requirements, motivating the development of a unified solution framework. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have shown promise in combinatorial optimization, yet they rely on end-to-end learning and lack explicit problem-solving knowledge, limiting solution quality. In this paper, we propose a knowledge-embedded framework inspired by the Route-First Cluster-Second heuristics. It incorporates knowledge at two levels: (1) decomposing CVRPs into the route-first and cluster-second subproblems, and (2) leveraging dynamic programming to solve the second subproblem, whose results guide the RL-based constructive solver to solve the first problem. To mitigate partial observability caused by problem decomposition, we introduce a unified history-enhanced context processing module. Extensive experiments show that this framework achieves superior solution quality compared with state-of-the-art learning-based methods, with a smaller gap to classical heuristics, demonstrating strong generalization across diverse CVRP variants.

</details>


### [315] [DVMap: Fine-Grained Pluralistic Value Alignment via High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14420)
*Pengyun Zhu,Yuqi Ren,Zhen Wang,Lei Yang,Deyi Xiong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DVMap框架，通过人口统典型提取、结构化CoT推理和GRPO优化，实现从粗粒度国家标签到细粒度多维人口统计约束的价值观对齐，在三重泛化测试中超越现有LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM依赖粗粒度的国家标签进行多元价值观对齐，这种宏观层面的监督掩盖了国家内部的价值异质性，导致对齐效果松散。需要从国家标签转向多维人口统计约束，以识别具有可预测、高共识价值偏好的群体。

Method: 1）人口统典型提取策略：从WVS构建56,152样本的高质量价值对齐语料，通过严格保留相同人口统计特征下价值偏好一致的受访者；2）结构化思维链（Structured CoT）机制：显式引导LLM推理人口统计-价值关联；3）群体相对策略优化（GRPO）：实现价值分布的自适应锚定。

Result: Qwen3-8B-DVMap在跨人口统计测试中达到48.6%准确率，优于DeepSeek-v3.2的45.1%；三重泛化基准（跨人口统计、跨国家、跨价值观）共21,553样本，验证了模型的有效泛化和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DVMap实现了从粗粒度国家标签到细粒度多维人口统计约束的价值对齐范式转变，在三重泛化测试中表现优异，Qwen3-8B-DVMap在跨人口统计测试中以48.6%准确率超越DeepSeek-v3.2（45.1%），证明了高共识人口统计-价值映射学习的有效性。

Abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on coarse-grained national labels for pluralistic value alignment. However, such macro-level supervision often obscures intra-country value heterogeneity, yielding a loose alignment. We argue that resolving this limitation requires shifting from national labels to multi-dimensional demographic constraints, which can identify groups with predictable, high-consensus value preference. To this end, we propose DVMap (High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping), a framework for fine-grained pluralistic value alignment. In this framework, we first present a demographic archetype extraction strategy to construct a high-quality value alignment corpus of 56,152 samples from the World Values Survey (WVS) by strictly retaining respondents with consistent value preferences under identical demographics. Over this corpus, we introduce a Structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism that explicitly guides LLMs to reason about demographic-value correlations. Subsequently, we employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to achieve adaptive anchoring of value distributions. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we further establish a triple-generalization benchmark (spanning cross-demographic, cross-country, and cross-value) comprising 21,553 samples. Experimental results demonstrate that DVMap effectively learns the manifold mapping from demographics to values, exhibiting strong generalization and robustness. On cross-demographic tests, Qwen3-8B-DVMap achieves 48.6% accuracy, surpassing the advanced open-source LLM DeepSeek-v3.2 (45.1%). The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/DVMap.

</details>


### [316] [BEAM: Binary Expert Activation Masking for Dynamic Routing in MoE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14438)
*Juntong Wu,Jialiang Cheng,Qishen Yin,Yue Dai,Yuliang Yan,Fuyu Lv,Ou Dan,Li Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BEAM通过可训练二进制掩码实现动态专家稀疏选择，保持模型能力同时将MoE计算量降低85%，在vLLM上实现2.5倍解码加速，是一种无需重训练的即插即用MoE推理优化方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MoE采用固定Top-K路由策略，导致计算冗余和推理延迟不理想；现有加速方法需高昂重训练成本或因训练-推理不一致在高稀疏度下性能严重下降。

Method: BEAM通过可学习的二进制掩码实现令牌自适应专家选择，使用直通估计器和辅助正则化损失进行端到端训练以诱导动态专家稀疏性，并设计了高效的Custom CUDA内核以集成到vLLM框架。

Result: BEAM保留原模型超过98%的性能，MoE层FLOPs减少高达85%，解码速度提升2.5倍，吞吐量提升1.4倍。

Conclusion: BEAM是一种实用、即插即用的MoE高效推理解决方案，通过可学习的二进制掩码实现动态专家稀疏性，在保持模型性能的同时显著提升推理效率。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enhance the efficiency of large language models by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, standard MoE employs a fixed Top-K routing strategy, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal inference latency. Existing acceleration methods either require costly retraining with architectural changes or suffer from severe performance drop at high sparsity due to train-inference mismatch. To address these limitations, we propose BEAM (Binary Expert Activation Masking), a novel method that learns token-adaptive expert selection via trainable binary masks. With a straight-through estimator and an auxiliary regularization loss, BEAM induces dynamic expert sparsity through end-to-end training while maintaining model capability. We further implement an efficient custom CUDA kernel for BEAM, ensuring seamless integration with the vLLM inference framework. Experiments show that BEAM retains over 98\% of the original model's performance while reducing MoE layer FLOPs by up to 85\%, achieving up to 2.5$\times$ faster decoding and 1.4$\times$ higher throughput, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical, plug-and-play solution for efficient MoE inference.

</details>


### [317] [Synthesizing POMDP Policies: Sampling Meets Model-checking via Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14440)
*Debraj Chakraborty,Anirban Majumdar,Prince Mathew,Sayan Mukherjee,Jean-François Raskin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合采样、 automata 学习和模型检验的 POMDP 综合框架，通过借鉴 L* 算法思想（采样作为成员查询、模型检验作为等价性查询）综合具有形式化保证的有限状态控制器。方法在采样诱导策略为规则的假设下具有相对完备性，实验验证了对安全阈值问题的有效性，可作为组合求解 POMDP 问题组合策略中的有价值组件。 | This paper proposes a POMDP synthesis framework combining sampling, automata learning, and model-checking, inspired by L* algorithm (sampling as membership oracle, model-checking as equivalence oracle) to synthesize finite-state controllers with formal guarantees. The method has relative completeness under the assumption that the sampling-induced policy is regular. Experiments validate effectiveness on threshold-safety problems, positioning the algorithm as a valuable component in portfolio approaches for POMDP synthesis.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在根本性矛盾：基于采样的方法虽然可扩展但缺乏形式化正确性保证，无法应用于安全关键场景；而形式化综合技术虽能保证正确性，但因一般 POMDP 综合的不可判定性而难以扩展。需要在这两个极端之间建立桥梁。 | Fundamental contradiction: sampling-based methods scale well but lack formal guarantees (unsuitable for safety-critical apps), while formal synthesis provides correctness-by-construction but struggles with scalability due to undecidability of general POMDP synthesis. Need to bridge this gap.

Method: 将 L* 算法思想应用于 POMDP 综合：使用采样作为成员查询 oracle，模型检验作为等价性查询 oracle。关键是假设采样诱导的策略是规则的（regular）。该方法综合出有限状态控制器并提供形式化正确性保证。 | Adapting L* algorithm to POMDP synthesis: using sampling as membership oracle and model-checking as equivalence oracle. Key assumption: the sampling-induced policy is regular. Synthesizes finite-state controllers with formal correctness guarantees.

Result: 实验结果表明该方法成功解决了阈值安全问题（threshold-safety problems），这些问题对现有形式化综合工具仍具挑战性。 | Experimental results demonstrate successful solving of threshold-safety problems that remain challenging for existing formal synthesis tools.

Conclusion: 提出了一种有相对完备性保证的POMDP综合框架，结合采样、 automata 学习和模型检验，成功解决了现有形式化综合工具难以处理的安全阈值问题。 | The conclusion proposes a POMDP synthesis framework with relative completeness guarantees, combining sampling, automata learning, and model-checking, which successfully solves safety threshold problems challenging for existing formal synthesis tools.

Abstract: Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are the standard framework for decision-making under uncertainty. While sampling-based methods scale well, they lack formal correctness guarantees, making them unsuitable for safety-critical applications. Conversely, formal synthesis techniques provide correctness-by-construction but often struggle with scalability, as general POMDP synthesis is undecidable. To bridge this gap, we propose a synthesis framework that integrates sampling, automata learning, and model-checking. Inspired by Angluin's $L^*$ algorithm, our approach utilizes sampling as a membership oracle and model-checking as an equivalence oracle. This enables the synthesis of finite-state controllers with formal guarantees, provided the sampling-induced policy is regular. We establish a relative completeness result for this framework. Experimental results from our prototypical implementation demonstrate that this method successfully solves threshold-safety problems that remain challenging for existing formal synthesis tools. We believe our algorithm serves as a valuable component in a portfolio approach to tackling the inherent difficulty of POMDP synthesis problems.

</details>


### [318] [Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ): A Framework for Measuring Organizational AI Impact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14455)
*Chandan Rajah,Neha Sengupta,Federico Castanedo,Robin Mills,Amit Bahree,Ramesh Krishnan Muthukrishnan,Larry Murray*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IIQ（智能影响商数）是一个综合指标，用于量化AI系统融入组织工作的深度及其影响。该指标通过结合新颖性加权的时间衰减代币存量、使用频率、宽限期时效门控、组织杠杆率、任务复杂度和自主性等六个维度，构建原始IAI和归一化0-1000的IIQ指数，旨在区分低杠杆高频使用、语义重复提示和高度自主高后果的AI辅助工作场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI影响评估方法（如访问次数或代币总量）无法充分反映AI系统的真实嵌入深度和影响效果，缺乏对使用质量、组织杠杆、任务自主性等因素的综合考量。组织需要一个正式的、可部署的测量框架来追踪AI在工作流中的嵌入程度。

Method: IIQ整合六大核心要素：①新颖性加权时间衰减代币存量（区分信息增量）；②使用频率；③宽限期时效门控（确保相关性）；④组织杠杆率（跨部门影响）；⑤任务复杂度；⑥自主性程度。通过加权组合生成原始IAI，再归一化为0-1000的IIQ指数，支持异构用户和单元的比较，并推导出日内更新规则和效率/财务影响的边界解释层。

Result: 形成可部署的AI嵌入追踪测量框架，具备以下判别能力：区分频繁低杠杆使用、语义重复性提示 vs. 高度自主、高后果的AI辅助工作；支持组织内跨部门、跨用户的横向比较；提供效率提升和财务影响的估算边界。

Conclusion: IIQ定位为部署导向的测量框架而非模型能力评估或因果生产力测量的替代品。合成场景验证表明该指标能有效区分不同类型和深度的AI使用模式，为组织AI价值评估提供了系统性方法论基础，但仍需与因果分析框架结合使用以获取真正的生产力洞察。

Abstract: The Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ) is a composite metric intended to quantify the depth to which AI systems are integrated into organizational work and their impact. Rather than treating access counts or aggregate token volume as sufficient evidence of impact, IIQ combines a novelty-weighted, time-decayed token stock with usage frequency, a grace-period recency gate, organizational leverage, task complexity, and autonomy. The formulation produces a raw Intelligence Adoption Index (IAI) and a normalized 0-1000 IIQ index for comparison between heterogeneous users and units. We also derive sub-daily update rules and a bounded interpretation layer for estimated efficiency and financial impact. The paper positions IIQ as a deployment-oriented measurement framework: a formal proposal for tracking AI embedding in workflows, not a direct measure of model capability or a substitute for causal productivity evaluation. Synthetic scenarios illustrate how the revised metric distinguishes between frequent low-leverage use, semantically repetitive prompting, and more autonomous, higher-consequence AI-assisted work.

</details>


### [319] [Stateful Reasoning via Insight Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14457)
*Bin Lei,Caiwen Ding,Jiachen Yang,Ang Li,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了CoT推理中长链准确率下降的根本原因——关键洞察随推理增长而变得难以访问，并提出InsightReplay方法通过定期提取并重放关键洞察来解决该问题，在多种模型和基准上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 推理的效益并不随链长单调增长：虽然较长的CoT通常能使模型处理更难的问题，但对于特定问题，准确率通常先随CoT长度增加而上升，之后反而下降。研究发现核心原因是：随着CoT增长，模型对推理早期产生的关键洞察的注意力逐渐减弱，使得这些洞察在最需要时变得难以访问。

Method: 提出了InsightReplay方法，这是一种有状态推理方法。模型定期从推理轨迹中提取关键洞察，并将这些洞察重放在活跃生成前沿附近，从而在推理规模扩展时保持其可访问性。

Result: 在2×3×4的基准网格上进行了广泛实验，覆盖模型规模{8B, 30B}、模型家族{Qwen3.5, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen, Gemma-4}和推理基准{AIME, HMMT, GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench v5}。3轮InsightReplay在所有24个设置中均获得准确率提升，平均提升+1.65个百分点，在R1-Distill-32B的LiveCodeBench v5子集上获得最大单设置提升+9.2个百分点。

Conclusion: InsightReplay方法表明，测试时扩展的有效性不仅取决于模型进行了多少推理，还取决于关键中间洞察是否在整个长推理轨迹中保持可访问性。该研究揭示了CoT长度与准确性之间非单调关系的根本原因，并为提升长程推理能力提供了新思路。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has become a foundation for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, but recent studies show that its benefits do not scale monotonically with chain length: while longer CoT generally enables a model to tackle harder problems, on a given problem, accuracy typically increases with CoT length up to a point, after which it declines. We identify a major cause of this phenomenon: as the CoT grows, the model's attention to critical insights produced earlier in the trace gradually weakens, making those insights progressively less accessible when they are most needed. Therefore, we propose \textbf{InsightReplay}, a stateful reasoning approach in which the model periodically extracts critical insights from its reasoning trace and replays them near the active generation frontier, keeping them accessible as the reasoning scales. Extensive experiments on a $\mathbf{2}\!\times\!\mathbf{3}\!\times\!\mathbf{4}$ benchmark grid, covering model scales $\{\text{8B}, \text{30B}\}$, model families $\{\text{Qwen3.5}, \text{DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen}, \text{Gemma-4}\}$, and reasoning benchmarks $\{\text{AIME}, \text{HMMT}, \text{GPQA Diamond}, \text{LiveCodeBench v5}\}$, show that 3-round InsightReplay yields accuracy gains across \textbf{all 24 settings}, with an averaged improvement of $\mathbf{+1.65}$ points over standard CoT, and a largest single-setting gain of $\mathbf{+9.2}$ points on R1-Distill-32B's LiveCodeBench v5 subset. Our results suggest that the effectiveness of test-time scaling depends not only on how much a model reasons, but also on whether critical intermediate insights remain accessible throughout long reasoning trajectories.

</details>


### [320] [OmniDrop: Layer-wise Token Pruning for Omni-modal LLMs via Query-Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14458)
*Yeo Jeong Park,Hyemi Jang,Minseo Choi,Jongsun Lee,Jooyoung Choi,Yongkweon Jeon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OmniDrop 是一个免训练的、面向全模态大模型（Omni-LLM）的逐层音视频 token 剪枝框架：它在 LLM 解码器层内部而非输入嵌入层做渐进式剪枝，用文本 query 的注意力作为跨模态语义中介来评估音视频 token 重要性，并引入时间多样性分数（TDS）以保留全局时序上下文。在 Qwen2.5-Omni 7B/3B 上，20%–30% token 保留率下超越 OmniZip、DASH 等基线（最高 +3.58 分），prefill 时延最多降低 40%、GPU 显存最多降低 14.7%，且在 VideoMME 上甚至超过全 token 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全模态大模型（同时处理文本、音频、视频）在实时交互与长视频推理中面临"token 爆炸"问题：Qwen2.5-Omni 中 1 分钟视频即可产生超过 1 万个音视频 token，导致注意力计算与显存随序列长度二次增长。已有 Omni-LLM token 压缩方法（OmniZip、DASH 等）均在"输入嵌入层"剪枝，其隐含假设是"跨模态余弦相似度高即语义对齐""时间共现即语义对应"。作者用实证分析推翻该假设：(1) PCA 与余弦相似度分布显示音频与视频 token 在 LLM 输入空间占据不同子空间，跨模态相似度集中在 0.0–0.2，无判别力；(2) 在 WorldSense 上消融 OmniZip 的音频锚点整合（AC）阶段，去掉 AC 或改用随机采样反而优于相似度 top-k 选择，说明基于嵌入相似度的选择并不优于随机；(3) 层次分析显示 token 重要性是"查询相关"的且注意力稀疏度随层变化：浅层 text-to-音视频注意力 top-20% 召回低于 0.6（token 普遍被关注，难以区分），中层达到峰值并保持较高稀疏度，模型从中层开始才具备清晰的查询相关偏好。因此需要在层内、且以查询为条件地剪枝，而非输入级一刀切。

Method: 1）渐进式层内剪枝（PLP）：第 l 层剪枝比例 p_l = p_init + (p_final − p_init)·σ(l, t_mid, β)，其中 σ 为在归一化层位置上的陡峭 Sigmoid（β=20，t_mid=0.5，3B 的 20% 配置用 0.55），剪枝执行至倒数第二层 L−2，以保留紧邻语言建模头的隐状态；早层几乎不剪、中层起急剧剪枝，形成"前段保融合、后段提效率"的双阶段。累计保留率满足 r_{l+1} = r_l·(1−p_l)，通过解析推导（Phase1 r=0.45、Phase2 均值 0.15，得 p_final≈0.146，实取保守值 0.2）反解出满足平均保留率 20%/30% 的超参。2）查询引导的 token 重要性：以文本 query token 到音/视频 token 的注意力均值 S = (1/n_T)·Σ_q Attn_{q→{V,A}} 作为重要性分数，在每层剪除分数最低的 k_l = ⌊(n_A^l + n_V^l)·p_l⌋ 个 token；该机制天然实现模态无关、任务自适应的模态预算分配（音中心任务保留更多音频 token，视觉中心任务保留更多视频 token），并可在不训练、不改结构的前提下使用。3）时间多样性分数（TDS）：为避免高注意力 token 主导、其余被抹除，在候选集（分数最低的 2k_l 个）内，识别最高分 token 所在关键 chunk c_max，对与 c_max 时间距离归一化 D=|c_max−c_i|/max(C)，并用 S_TDS = S + λ_div·D 提升远离关键事件的 token 的分数，使其不易被剪，兼顾局部证据与全局时序上下文；多样性机制仅从中段层起启用（7B 第14层、3B 第19层）。4）LLM 前模态内剪枝：音频沿用 OmniZip 的编码器末层注意力保留策略（保留 70%），视频沿用 DyCoKE 的 TTM 时间 token 合并（每 4 帧合并、剪枝率 0.8，保留 40%），合计保留约 45% token 进入 LLM。

Result: 在 VideoMME、WorldSense、AVUT 三个基准、Qwen2.5-Omni 7B/3B 上与 OmniZip、DASH 对比：30% 保留率下 OmniDrop 全面最优，VideoMME 甚至超过 100% 全 token 基线（7B 66.52 vs 64.67；3B 63.07 vs 62.51）；20% 保留率下在 7B 的 AVUT 上取得 63.67，较 DASH 的 60.09 提升 3.58 分。从 30% 压到 20% 时 OmniDrop 平均仅下降 0.18（7B）/0.47（3B）分，而 OmniZip、DASH 下降超过 1.0 分。效率上，WorldSense 上 prefill 时间降低 39.9%（7B）/28.1%（3B），显存降低 11.3%/14.7%（prefill 1.73s→1.04s，显存 28.92GB→25.65GB）。消融显示：仅模态内剪枝在 30% 预算下退化至 WS 44.33/AVUT 59.34，加入 PLP 后回升到 46.53/63.90；20% 预算下 Sigmoid 调度优于指数调度（WS 45.93→46.25，AVUT 63.03→63.32）；TDS 在所有预算下继续增益（20% 时 WS 46.25→46.50、AVUT 63.32→63.67）。以音频注意力引导替代文本引导会明显变差（20% 时 WS 43.25 vs 46.19，AVUT 56.57 vs 60.55），且音频-视频注意力图开销大导致 7B OOM。任务自适应性验证：AR 任务音频保留率最高、SR 任务视频保留率最高、ASL 保持均衡，说明无需任务标签即可实现模态自适应预算分配。附录还给出 WorldSense 八领域与 AVUT 六子任务的细粒度结果，OmniDrop 在多数领域/子任务上取得最优且分布均衡。

Conclusion: OmniDrop 通过"把剪枝从输入层搬到解码器层内部、以文本 query 作为语义中介、用 TDS 维持时序多样性"，解决了现有输入级音视频相似度/共现式压缩的信号不可靠问题，可在无需训练与结构改动的前提下实现模态无关、任务自适应的音视频 token 保留，显著改善了精度-效率折中。作者亦指出局限：依赖文本 prompt，纯音视频输入场景不适用；剪枝调度与超参仍靠经验设定，未来可用标定数据学习或联合优化。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models have demonstrated remarkable potential in holistic multimodal understanding; however, the token explosion caused by high-resolution audio and video inputs remains a critical bottleneck for real-time applications and long-form reasoning. Existing omni-modal token compression methods typically prune tokens at the input embedding level, relying on audio-video similarity or temporal co-occurrence as proxies for semantic relevance. In practice, such assumptions are often unreliable. To address this limitation, we propose OmniDrop, a training-free, layer-wise token pruning framework that progressively prunes audiovisual tokens within the LLM decoder layers rather than at the input-level, allowing early layers to preserve sufficient omni-modal information fusion before aggressively removing tokens in deeper layers. We further utilize text queries as guidance for modality-agnostic and task-adaptive token pruning. We also introduce a temporal diversity score that encourages balanced token survival to preserve global temporal context. Experimental results across various audiovisual benchmarks demonstrate that OmniDrop outperforms all baselines by up to 3.58 points while reducing prefill latency by up to 40% and memory usage by up to 14.7%.

</details>


### [321] [From Table to Cell: Attention for Better Reasoning with TABALIGN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14465)
*Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Zeyong Zhang,Xinyu Wang,Chunhe Wang,Xiaofeng Lin,Hanwei Wu,Lei Ding,Guang Cheng,Zhijiang Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TABALIGN解决表格推理中规划与执行缺乏明确单元锚定契约的问题，通过掩码扩散语言模型规划器生成二进制单元掩码计划步骤，配合基于人类验证注意力标准训练的验证器进行评分，在8个基准上提升15.76个百分点，推理速度加快44.64%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Multi-step LLM table reasoning fails due to: (1) no explicit cell-grounding contract between planning/execution, (2) left-to-right factorization incompatible with permutation invariance, (3) content-only intermediate state scoring ignoring cell grounding.

Method: TABALIGN pairs masked DLM planner (binary cell mask emission via bidirectional denoising) with TABATTN verifier (1,600 human-verified attention standards) scoring steps by attention-mask overlap.

Result: DLMs show 40.2% median reduction in attention-AUROC variability under row reordering (more permutation-stable/human-aligned).

Conclusion: TABALIGN achieves 15.76pp improvement over strongest 8B-class baseline on 8 benchmarks; DLM planner contributes 2.87pp independent gain; downstream reasoning 44.64% faster.

Abstract: Multi-step LLM reasoning over structured tables fails because planning and execution share no explicit cell-grounding contract. Existing methods constrain the planner to a left-to-right factorization at odds with table permutation invariance, and score intermediate states by generated content alone, overlooking cell grounding. We conduct a pilot study showing that diffusion language models (DLMs) produce more human-aligned and permutation-stable cell attention on tables than autoregressive models, with a 40.2% median reduction in attention-AUROC variability under row reordering. Motivated by this, we propose TABALIGN, a planned table reasoning framework that operationalizes the contract. TABALIGN pairs a masked DLM planner, whose bidirectional denoising emits plan steps as binary cell masks, with TABATTN, a lightweight verifier trained on 1,600 human-verified attention standards to score each step by its attention overlap with the plan-designated mask. Across eight benchmarks covering table question answering and fact verification, TABALIGN improves average accuracy by 15.76 percentage points over the strongest open-source baseline at comparable 8B-class scale, with a matched-backbone ablation attributing 2.87 percentage points of this gain to the DLM planner over an AR planner on a fixed reasoner. Cleaner DLM plans also accelerate downstream reasoning execution by 44.64%.

</details>


### [322] [LEMON: Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14483)
*Xudong Chen,Yixin Liu,Hua Wei,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文（arXiv 全文中名为 Collator，摘要中称 LEMON）提出一个基于 LLM 的编排器，把多智能体系统的编排设计统一为一份可执行的 YAML 编排规范（同时包含任务特定角色/职责、容量等级与依赖结构），并用"局部反事实信用分配"改造编排级 GRPO 训练，使奖励对比只回传到被编辑的字段 token 跨度上；在 MMLU、GSM8K、AQuA、MultiArith、SVAMP、HumanEval 六个基准上平均 90.72%，优于所有对比的多智能体编排基线，并处于准确率–token 消耗 Pareto 前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的效果不仅取决于个体智能体能力，更取决于编排设计：角色专门化、容量分配（worker 模型规模）与依赖/信息流共同决定解的质量与计算开销。现有自动化方法存在三方面局限：(1) 只优化设计空间的局部成分——拓扑学习方法（G-Designer、AgentPrune、ARG-Designer、OFA-MAS、AgentDropout）在预定义 agent/角色集上搜索信息流结构；工作流方法（AFlow）依赖预定义 worker 接口与工作流原语；路由/组队方法通过分阶段或级联控制器决定角色与模型路由，均未把职责、容量、依赖合成到同一份规范中做联合决策；(2) 固定手工设计难以跨任务复用，简单任务浪费算力、困难任务能力不足；(3) 稀疏信用分配——端到端执行奖励（任务成功、整体效用）只能判断"整个规范好坏"，无法指明是哪个角色、哪个容量、哪条依赖导致结果，因而学习粒度停留在规范级而非字段级。

Method: 问题形式化：给定任务 x，编排器 πθ 生成统一编排规范 y~πθ(·|x)，规范编译为有向无环图 G_y=(V_y,E_y)，每个 agent v=(b_v,d_v,c_v) 由基础角色、任务特定职责和容量等级（small/medium/large → 7B/14B/32B worker）定义，依赖 (u,v) 表示 u 的输出作为 v 的上下文；同 step 的 agent 可并发执行，ref 只能指向先前 step 的活跃 agent，从而保证分层 DAG。

训练（两阶段 + 两项损失）：
1) SFT 预热：在可执行规范上监督微调，保证 YAML schema 合法与可执行性。
2) 编排级 GRPO：奖励 R_orch = R_task + λ_tok·B_tok − λ_str·Ω_str（无效规范给 r_invalid<0）。Ω_str = ω_V|V|+ω_E|E|+ω_H·h(G)（agent 数、依赖数、图深度）；容量加权 worker token 成本 C(x,y)=Σ_v ω_cap(c_v)(n_v^in+n_v^out)，其中 ω_cap 为 0.5/1/2；有界 token 效率奖励 B_tok 在任务特定的 [τ_x^−, τ_x^+] 区间内线性递减，正确解 g_y=1、有效但未解 g_y=ρ∈[0,1)。
3) 局部反事实信用分配：对生成规范采样一个反事实族 φ∈F_cf={依赖删除、角色回滚、容量降级} 与一个字段位置 ℓ，得到仅差一个字段的 ỹ=μ_{φ,ℓ}(y)，分别执行并计算 ΔR=R_orch(x,y)−R_orch(x,ỹ)。对事实与反事实的字段值 token 跨度计算平均对数概率 s_θ^fact、s_θ^cf，用 w_cf(ΔR)=min(|ΔR|,δ_max)/δ_max 截断，|ΔR|<δ_min 时忽略，并以 J_cf = −E[1{...}·w_cf·log σ(β_cf·sign(ΔR)·(s^fact−s^cf))] 只在编辑跨度上施加偏好；span 外的 token 仅作条件上下文。总体损失 J_total = J_GRPO + λ_cf·J_cf；反事实执行仅用于训练，通过节点级执行缓存复用未改变的 worker 调用以控制开销；另有对反事实族的自适应采样（按近期 |ΔR| 分配概率，同时保持对三类族的探索）。

实现要点：规则化 YAML 校验器检查必填属性、合法容量值、agent 标识唯一性、ref 指向先前 step、终止 agent 角色合法性；规范直接编译执行，无需额外 DSL 工具。

Result: 六个基准平均分 90.72%，为对比方法最优：较 SC-CoT、Tree-MAS、AgentPrune、AFlow 分别高 3.96、2.19、2.59、5.39 个百分点；在 5 个基准上排名第一，仅 MMLU 略低于 ARG-Designer（84.32% vs 85.30%）。逐项：GSM8K 94.32、AQuA 86.22、MultiArith 99.17、SVAMP 95.60、HumanEval 84.68（pass@1）。

效率：四个基准上均位于准确率–token Pareto 前沿；MMLU 约用 0.2×10^4 worker token 达到有竞争力精度，而 ARG-Designer 约 0.3×10^4、多条拓扑基线超过 0.6×10^4；GSM8K/AQuA/SVAMP 上在低于部分拓扑基线的 token 消耗下取得最高精度。

消融：SFT-only 明显弱于最强单智能体；在同一 SFT 检查点上，编排级 GRPO 带来 +10.19/+11.75/+5.90 点（MMLU/GSM8K/AQuA），局部反事实再带来 +1.24/+0.92/+0.79 点并降低 worker token 15.5%/10.2%/31.7%；去掉任一设计组件均掉点（去依赖构造 MMLU −3.46，去角色设计 AQuA −3.15，去容量分配使 AQuA token 由 2056 翻倍至 4154）；去掉任一反事实族（依赖/角色/容量）均降低精度，说明三类信用互补；完全去掉 SFT 崩塌至 48.53/75.82/64.96，说明 SFT 是可执行生成的必要前提。

训练动态：加入局部反事实后最终奖励由约 2.0 提升至 2.25，每次执行 worker token 由 1.30K 降至 1.15K（约 −11.1%）；依赖删除早期 |ΔR| 最大，角色回滚与容量降级在后期提供持续信号；各族采样概率在 1/3 基准线附近波动。案例显示 Collator 生成的 agent 对应具体推理步骤（提取量→列方程→核验单位→计算→终答），而 ARG-Designer/OFA-MAS 多用泛化或重复角色（如 Inspector、Critic、Knowledgeable Expert）。

Conclusion: 把多智能体编排从"分阶段优化拓扑/工作流/路由"重新表述为"组合式编排规范设计"是有效的统一范式：单一 YAML 规范同时决定职责、容量与依赖，可直接校验、编译、执行，因而天然可学习、可复现。在此框架内，把执行级奖励差转化为字段级（span 级）监督的局部反事实信用分配，同时改善了准确率与 token 效率，优于单智能体提示、固定结构 MAS、拓扑设计与自适应工作流等基线。局限与后续方向：反事实需要额外执行开销（依赖节点级缓存缓解）、只考虑单向"劣化型"编辑（删依赖、回滚角色、降容量）而非升级型反事实、依赖字段级局部差异与端到端奖励之间存在噪声与混淆、容量仅限三档离散 worker 模型、且实验集中在推理与代码类基准而非开放域任务。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a strong foundation for multi-agent systems, but their effectiveness depends heavily on orchestration design. Across different tasks, role design, capacity assignment, and dependency construction jointly affect both solution quality and execution efficiency. Existing approaches automate parts of this design process, yet they often optimize these decisions partially or sequentially, and rely on execution-level feedback that provides limited credit assignment for local orchestration decisions. We propose LEMON (\textbf{L}earning \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{M}ulti-agent \textbf{O}rchestratio\textbf{N} via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning), an LLM-based orchestrator that generates an executable orchestration specification. The specification integrates task-specific roles, customized duties, capacity levels, and dependency structure into a single deployable system. To train the orchestrator, we augment the orchestration-level GRPO objective with a localized counterfactual signal that edits role, capacity, or dependency fields and applies the resulting reward contrast only to the edited spans. Experiments on six reasoning and coding benchmarks, including MMLU, GSM8K, AQuA, MultiArith, SVAMP, and HumanEval, show that LEMON achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated multi-agent orchestration methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LEMON-B23C.

</details>


### [323] [Deepchecks: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14488)
*Assaf Gerner,Netta Madvil,Nadav Barak,Alex Zaikman,Jonatan Liberman,Liron Hamra,Rotem Brazilay,Shay Tsadok,Yaron Friedman,Neal Harow,Noam Bresler,Shir Chorev,Philip Tannor,Lior Rokach*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Deepchecks is a comprehensive evaluation framework designed for RAG applications, addressing evaluation challenges through multi-faceted assessment, root cause analysis, and production monitoring to ensure reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Evaluating RAG systems is challenging due to the stochastic nature of generated outputs and the complex interaction between retrieval and generation components.

Method: Multi-faceted evaluation approach, root cause analysis, and production monitoring for RAG applications.

Result: A comprehensive framework tailored for evaluating RAG applications, ensuring alignment with application-specific requirements.

Conclusion: Deepchecks framework provides a robust foundation for assessing reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction in RAG systems by combining multi-faceted evaluation, root cause analysis, and production monitoring capabilities.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques are revolutionizing applications across multiple domains, such as healthcare, finance, and customer service. Despite their potential, evaluating RAG systems remains a complex challenge due to the stochastic nature of generated outputs and the intricate interplay between retrieval and generation components. This paper introduces Deepchecks, a comprehensive framework tailored for evaluating RAG applications. Deepchecks' evaluation framework addresses RAG applications evaluation through a multi-faceted approach, root cause analysis and production monitoring. By ensuring alignment with application-specific requirements, Deepchecks framework provides a robust foundation for assessing reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction in RAG systems.

</details>


### [324] [Learning Scenario Reduction for Two-Stage Robust Optimization with Discrete Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14494)
*Tianjue Lin,Jianan Zhou,Jieyi Bi,Yaoxin Wu,Wen Song,Zhiguang Cao,Jie Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对两阶段鲁棒优化的场景约简问题，提出了边际影响评估的PRISE方法及其神经 surrogate 模型NeurPRISE，通过GNN-Transformer和模仿学习实现快速、高质量的场景子集选择，显著加速且保持零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两阶段鲁棒优化(2RO)处理离散不确定性时计算复杂度高，精确求解困难；现有场景约简方法问题无关，仅依赖不确定性集而未考虑可行域或补偿结构，导致效果有限。

Method: 提出PRISE方法，通过评估每个场景的边际影响进行序贯前瞻选择；进一步提出NeurPRISE，采用GNN-Transformer架构编码单场景结构并通过注意力机制捕捉跨场景交互；采用带增益感知的排序目标进行模仿学习训练，将PRISE的边际增益知识蒸馏到学习的评分函数中。

Result: NeurPRISE在三个2RO问题上表现竞争力，具有强可扩展性（场景数可变时）、比PRISE快7-200倍，且在更大问题规模（5倍）、更多场景（4倍）和分布偏移下展现出良好的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 实验验证了NeurPRISE的有效性，展示了在保持竞争力的同时实现大规模场景快速选择的潜力，且具备跨规模、跨场景数和分布偏移下的零样本泛化能力。

Abstract: Two-Stage Robust Optimization (2RO) with discrete uncertainty is challenging, often rendering exact solutions prohibitive. Scenario reduction alleviates this issue by selecting a small, representative subset of scenarios to enable tractable computation. However, existing methods are largely problem-agnostic, operating solely on the uncertainty set without consulting the feasible region or recourse structure. In this paper, we introduce PRISE, a problem-driven sequential lookahead heuristic that constructs reduced scenario sets by evaluating the marginal impact of each scenario. While PRISE yields high-quality scenario subsets, each selection step requires solving multiple subproblems, making it computationally expensive at scale. To address this, we propose NeurPRISE, a neural surrogate model built on a GNN-Transformer backbone that encodes the per-scenario structure via graph convolution and captures cross-scenario interactions through attention. NeurPRISE is trained via imitation learning with a gain-aware ranking objective, which distills marginal gain information from PRISE into a learned scoring function for scenario ranking and selection. Extensive results on three 2RO problems show that NeurPRISE consistently achieves competitive regret relative to comprehensive methods, maintains strong calability with varying numbers of scenarios, and delivers 7-200x speedup over PRISE. NeurPRISE also exhibits strong zero-shot generalization, effectively handling instances with larger problem scales (up to 5x), more scenarios (up to 4x), and distribution shifts.

</details>


### [325] [When Robots Do the Chores: A Benchmark and Agent for Long-Horizon Household Task Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14504)
*Zilin Zhu,Longteng Guo,Yanghong Mei,Bowen Pang,Zongxun Zhang,Xingjian He,Ruyi Ji,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LongAct is a new benchmark for evaluating long-horizon household task planning in embodied AI, isolating high-level cognitive capabilities. HoloMind is a VLM-driven agent with DAG-based hierarchical planning, spatial and episodic memory, and reflective supervision. Experiments show HoloMind improves performance but even state-of-the-art models struggle with only 59% goal completion, highlighting the need for stronger long-horizon planning in embodied agents.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing embodied AI benchmarks largely overlook long-horizon household tasks that demand robust high-level planning and sustained reasoning. Current benchmarks emphasize short-horizon navigation or manipulation and rely on fixed task categories, failing to evaluate higher-level cognitive capabilities required for complex household activities.

Method: The authors introduce two main contributions: (1) LongAct, a benchmark that isolates high-level cognitive capabilities by abstracting away embodiment-specific low-level control, evaluating instruction understanding, dependency management, memory maintenance, and adaptive planning through free-form instructions; (2) HoloMind, a VLM-driven agent featuring a DAG-based long-horizon hierarchical planner, a Multimodal Spatial Memory for persistent world modeling, an Episodic Memory for experience reuse, and a global Critic for reflective supervision.

Result: Experiments conducted with GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL models demonstrate that HoloMind substantially improves long-horizon performance while reducing reliance on model scale. Performance analysis reveals that even top models achieve only 59% goal completion and 16% full-task success, underscoring the benchmark's difficulty.

Conclusion: LongAct presents significant challenges for current state-of-the-art models. HoloMind substantially improves long-horizon performance while reducing reliance on model scale. Even top models achieve only 59% goal completion and 16% full-task success, highlighting the difficulty of the benchmark and the pressing need for stronger long-horizon planning capabilities in embodied agents.

Abstract: Long-horizon household tasks demand robust high-level planning and sustained reasoning capabilities, which are largely overlooked by existing embodied AI benchmarks that emphasize short-horizon navigation or manipulation and rely on fixed task categories. We introduce LongAct, a benchmark designed to evaluate planning-level autonomy in long-horizon household tasks specified through free-form instructions. By abstracting away embodiment-specific low-level control, LongAct isolates high-level cognitive capabilities such as instruction understanding, dependency management, memory maintenance, and adaptive planning. We further propose HoloMind, a VLM-driven agent with a DAG-based long-horizon hierarchical planner, a Multimodal Spatial Memory for persistent world modeling, an Episodic Memory for experience reuse, and a global Critic for reflective supervision. Experiments with GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL models show that HoloMind substantially improves long-horizon performance while reducing reliance on model scale. Even top models achieve only 59% goal completion and 16% full-task success, underscoring the difficulty of LongAct and the need for stronger long-horizon planning in embodied agents.

</details>


### [326] [Cattle Trade: A Multi-Agent Benchmark for LLM Bluffing, Bidding, and Bargaining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14537)
*Robert Müller,Clemens Müller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Cattle Trade是一个评估LLM作为多智能体战略推理智能体的基准测试，涵盖拍卖、交易、议价等综合任务。研究发现战略连贯性而非单一能力或支出量决定表现，且启发式代码智能体可超越大多数LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准测试孤立测试各项能力，无法评估智能体是否能在竞争性多智能体经济游戏中整合多种能力（博弈、讨价还价、虚张声势、对手建模、资源分配等）。

Method: 引入Cattle Trade多智能体基准，结合拍卖、隐藏报价交易挑战、议价、虚张声势、对手建模和资源分配，在50-60回合的长视野游戏中测试；对7个成本高效语言模型和3个确定性代码智能体进行242场游戏评估，并记录每轮出价、交易挑战报价、反报价和卡牌选择以进行行为分析。

Result: 战略连贯性（支出效率、资源纪律、阶段自适应出价）与排名关联性比支出量或任何单一子技能更强；两个启发式代码智能体优于大多数测试的LLM；行为追踪揭示LLM典型失败模式包括过度出价、自我竞价、破产交易挑战发起和弱对手状态适应。

Conclusion: 评估智能体能力需要基准测试在多智能体环境中检验多种能力的联合部署，这些环境应具备冲突激励、不确定性和经济动态特征。

Abstract: We introduce \textsc{Cattle Trade, a multi-agent benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) as agents in strategic reasoning under imperfect information, adversarial interaction, and resource constraints. The benchmark combines auctions, hidden-offer trade challenges (TCs), bargaining, bluffing, opponent modeling, and resource allocation within a single long-horizon game lasting 50--60 turns. Unlike prior agent benchmarks that test these abilities in isolation, \textsc{Cattle Trade} evaluates whether agents integrate them across a competitive, multi-agent economic game with conflicting incentives. The benchmark logs every bid, TC offer, counteroffer, and card selection, enabling behavioural analysis beyond final scores or win rates.
