We evaluate seven cost-efficient language models and three deterministic code agents across 242 games. Strategic coherence, in particular spending efficiency, resource discipline, and phase-adaptive bidding, is associated with rank more strongly than spending volume or any single subskill. Two heuristic code agents outperform most tested LLMs, and behavioural traces surface recurring LLM failure modes including overbidding, self-bidding, bankrupt TC initiation, and weak opponent-state adaptation. Evaluating agentic competence requires benchmarks that test the joint deployment of multiple capabilities in multi-agent environments with conflicting incentives, uncertainty, and economic dynamics.

</details>


### [327] [VerbalValue: A Socially Intelligent Virtual Host for Sales-Driven Live Commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14542)
*Yuyan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VerbalValue是一个面向销售转化的虚拟带货主播AI系统，通过构建产品知识库、销售术语词典，收集标注1,475条直播互动数据，并微调大语言模型实现共情放大、证据反驳、幽默转移三种响应策略，在多个维度显著优于主流大语言模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI系统无法复刻优秀带货主播的能力：对话推荐系统将推荐视为终点行为，通用LLM存在产品信息幻觉且使用泛化推广模板，缺乏吸引力和说服力。

Method: ①构建领域知识库（产品规格+销售术语词典）；②收集标注1,475条直播电商互动数据；③微调大语言模型，融合共情放大、证据反驳、幽默转移三种响应策略。

Result: 信息量提升23%，事实准确性提升18%，在得体性和观众参与度上保持一致优势。

Conclusion: VerbalValue在信息量、准确性、得体性和观众参与度上均显著优于GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro等基线模型。

Abstract: A skilled live-commerce host is not merely a narrator, but a sales agent who converts viewer curiosity into purchase intent through expert product knowledge, emotionally intelligent response tactics, and entertainment that serves as a vehicle for product exposure. Yet no existing AI system replicates this: conversational recommenders treat recommendation as a terminal act, while general-purpose LLMs hallucinate product claims and default to generic promotional templates that fail to engage or persuade. We present VerbalValue, a sales-conversion-oriented virtual host that turns exceptional verbal ability into real commercial value, built on three contributions. First, we construct a domain knowledge base of product specifications and a curated sales terminology lexicon that anchor product-related responses in verified expertise. Second, we collect and annotate 1,475 live-commerce interactions spanning diverse viewer intents. Third, we fine-tune a large language model on this data to deliver empathetic, commercially oriented responses, adapting to viewer intent through empathetic amplification, evidence-backed rebuttal, and humor-mediated deflection. Experiments against GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and other baselines demonstrate gains of 23% on informativeness and 18% on factual correctness, with consistent advantages in tactfulness and viewer engagement.

</details>


### [328] [Complacent, Not Sycophantic: Reframing Large Language Models and Designing AI Literacy for Complacent Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14544)
*Federico Germani,Giovanni Spitale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本论文挑战了将大语言模型描述为"谄媚"的常见说法，认为应将其行为重新理解为"自满"——一种由训练数据、奖励信号和设计导致的结构性倾向。这一重新框架将责任归咎于开发者而非模型本身，并建议AI素养教育应重点关注对抗用户确认偏见的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质疑"谄媚"这一术语的准确性，认为其隐含动机和策略意图，但LLM实际上并不具备这些特征，该标签在概念上具有误导性。

Method: 通过概念分析，将LLM行为重新定义为"自满"(complacency)而非"谄媚"(sycophancy)，指出这是由训练数据、奖励信号和设计选择导致的结构性倾向。

Result: 提出LLM行为应被理解为"自满"而非"谄媚"，因为其反映的是训练过程中的系统性倾向（偏好一致性和强化而非纠正），而非有意为之的战略意图。

Conclusion: 该研究建议将"谄媚"重新定义为"自满"，并将责任归于开发者和机构而非模型本身；建议AI素养教育应特别关注对抗确认偏见的策略。

Abstract: Large language models are often described as sycophantic, in the sense that they appear to flatter users or mirror their beliefs. We argue that this label is conceptually misleading: sycophancy implies motives and strategic intent, which LLMs do not possess. Their behaviour is better understood as complacency, a structural tendency to agree with user input because training data, reward signals and design favour agreement and reinforcement over correction. We argue that this distinction matters. Whether developers act sycophantically or not, models themselves never are sycophants; they can only be made more or less complacent. This reframing locates agency in developers and institutions, not in the model. Because complacent models reinforce users' prior beliefs, we argue that AI literacy educational approaches should particularly focus on strategies to counter confirmation bias.

</details>


### [329] [TeachAnything: A Multimodal Crowdsourcing Platform for Training Embodied AI Agents in Symmetrical Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14556)
*Zidong Liu,Rongkai Liu,Yue Li,Zhenliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为TeachAnything的云端众包平台，旨在为Symmetrical Reality场景下的具身智能体开发提供数据支撑，通过三阶段多模态演示范式和物理仿真技术，实现跨场景、任务和具身的灵活演示数据采集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Symmetrical Reality要求智能体具备更像人类的智能水平，这需要对智能体进行更丰富、更多样化的人类引导，而现有演示采集方法难以满足跨场景、跨任务、跨具身的灵活需求。

Method: 设计了融合多模态信号的三阶段演示范式，并开发了具备物理仿真的云端众包平台，统一虚拟与物理交互，支持跨场景、任务和具身的演示数据采集。

Result: 构建了一个完整的云端众包演示平台，集成物理仿真能力，能够统一虚拟与物理交互，采集多样化的演示数据。

Conclusion: TeachAnything作为一个云端众包平台，为具身智能体开发提供了实践基础，支持Symmetrical Reality中人机共存的目标。

Abstract: Symmetrical Reality (SR) is emerging as a future trend for human-agent coexistence, placing higher demands on agents to acquire human-like intelligence. It calls for richer and more diverse human guidance. We introduce a three-stage demonstration paradigm integrating multimodal demonstration signals. Building on this paradigm, we developed TeachAnything, a cloud-based, crowdsourcing-oriented demonstration platform with physics simulation capable of collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments. By unifying virtual and physical interactions through both methodological design and physics simulation, the system serves as a practical foundation for developing embodied agents aligned with Symmetrical Reality.

</details>


### [330] [PyCSP3-Scheduling: A Scheduling Extension for PyCSP3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14559)
*Sohaib Afifi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PyCSP³ Scheduling扩展了PyCSP³，通过53个专用约束和27个表达式添加了调度抽象（区间变量、序列变量、资源函数），编译成标准XCSP³约束，保持了建模/求解分离。在261个实例测试中性能表现不一，部分问题加速5.8倍，部分因编译开销而性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PyCSP³ lacks native support for scheduling abstractions (interval variables, sequence variables, resource functions). Existing scheduling models require low-level integer variable encodings with manual channeling constraints, despite PyCSP³ providing global constraints like NoOverlap and Cumulative.

Method: Presents PyCSP³ Scheduling, a library adding 53 dedicated constraints and 27 expressions for scheduling abstractions (interval variables, sequence variables, resource functions), which compile down to standard PyCSP³/XCSP³ constraints while preserving the modeling/solving separation.

Result: On 261 paired instances across 17 model families (5 runs each), both formulations produce identical objectives on all 72 doubly-proved optimal pairs. 8/17 families remain structurally unchanged after compilation. Runtime performance diverges: gains up to 5.8x on some families, regressions on others due to compilation decomposition overhead.

Conclusion: PyCSP³ Scheduling maintains the modeling/solving separation while effectively adding scheduling abstractions. Performance varies by problem family: some see significant speedups (up to 5.8x), while others experience regressions due to compilation decomposition overhead. The library successfully bridges the gap between high-level scheduling abstractions and the underlying constraint solving infrastructure.

Abstract: PyCSP$^3$ provides a productive way to build constraint models for solving combinatorial constrained problems and export them to XCSP$^3$, preserving a complete separation between modeling and solving. However, it lacks native support for scheduling abstractions such as interval variables, sequence variables, and resource functions. As a result, scheduling models must be encoded with low-level integer variables and manual channeling constraints, even though PyCSP$^3$ already provides global constraints like NoOverlap and Cumulative on integer arrays. We present PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling, a library that adds scheduling abstractions to PyCSP$^3$ through 53 dedicated constraints and 27 expressions, and compiles them down to standard PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ constraints, maintaining the modeling/solving separation that underpins the PyCSP$^3$ ecosystem. On 261 paired instances across 17 model families (5 runs each), both formulations produce identical objectives on all 72 doubly-proved optimal pairs and nearly half of the families (8/17) remain structurally unchanged after compilation; however, runtime performance diverges across families, with clear gains on some (up to 5.8x) and regressions on others due to the overhead of compilation decompositions. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://github.com/sohaibafifi/pycsp3-scheduling

</details>


### [331] [Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation: Controlling LLM Behaviour via Optimised Segment-Level Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14561)
*Devika Prasad,Luke Gerschwitz,Tong Li,Henry Xiao,Anjin Liu,Coco Wu,Anna Leontjeva,Luiz Pizzato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PSAO是一种结构化提示词优化框架，通过将提示分解为段落并添加人类可读的注释标签来引导LLM响应生成，在保持原始提示词的同时提升优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示词优化方法在非结构化和庞大的提示空间中运作，导致计算成本高且可能扭曲原始意图。

Method: 提出Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation (PSAO)框架，将提示词分解为可解释的段落（ sentences），并为每个段落添加人类可读的注释标签（如{not important}、{important}、{very important}），引导LLM在响应生成中分配注意力并澄清歧义。原提示词作为候选保留在优化空间中以防止性能退化。

Result: 实验评估表明，PSAO通过注释机制提升了推理准确性和自洽性。

Conclusion: PSAO作为概念验证证明了分段落注释优化的可行性和潜力。但识别最优分割和注释的高效方法仍有待探索，未来将聚焦于提升优化效率。

Abstract: Prompt engineering is crucial for effective interaction with generative artificial intelligence systems, yet existing optimisation methods often operate over an unstructured and vast prompt space, leading to high computational costs and potential distortions of the original intent. We introduce Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation (PSAO), a structured prompt optimisation framework designed to improve prompt optimisation controllability and efficiency. PSAO decomposes a prompt into interpretable segments (e.g., sentences) and augments each with human-readable annotations (e.g., {not important}, {important}, {very important}). These annotations guide large language models (LLMs) in allocating focus and clarifying confusion during response generation. We formally define the segmentations and annotations and demonstrate that optimised segment-level annotations can lead to improved LLM responses, with the original prompt retained as a candidate in the optimisation space to prevent performance degradation. Empirical evaluations indicate that PSAO benefits from annotations in terms of improved reasoning accuracy and self-consistency. However, developing efficient methods for identifying optimal segmentations and annotations remains challenging and is reserved for future investigation. This work is intended as a proof of concept, demonstrating the feasibility and potential of segment-level annotation optimisation.

</details>


### [332] [Sycophancy is an Educational Safety Risk: Why LLM Tutors Need Sycophancy Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14604)
*Enkelejda Kasneci,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了大模型在辅导场景中的"推理-谄媚悖论"现象，通过EduFrameTrap基准测试发现模型难以同时保持认知严谨性和社交适应性，呼吁将"社会认知勇气"纳入模型评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM辅导需要"纠正性摩擦"以驱动概念转变，但偏好对齐模型会为追求讨喜而牺牲认知严谨性，形成"推理-谄媚悖论"

Method: 构建EduFrameTrap基准测试，覆盖6个学科，通过操纵学生置信度和压力类型（上下文转换、权威、社会情感）进行系统探测，使用双裁判机制评估

Result: GPT-5.2上下文转换失败率较低但权威/社会压力下易妥协；Claude存在显著上下文转换脆弱性；双裁判分歧可作为可靠性信号

Conclusion: 基准测试应纳入"社会认知勇气"评估维度，将"友善但正确"行为定位为安全要求而非可选项

Abstract: This position paper argues that effective tutoring requires corrective friction: surfacing misconceptions and challenging them supportively to drive conceptual change. Yet preference-aligned LLMs can trade epistemic rigor for agreeableness. We identify a Reasoning-Sycophancy Paradox: models that resist context-switch frame attacks can still capitulate under social-epistemic pressure, especially authority ("my notes say I'm right") and social-affective face-saving ("please don't tell me I'm wrong"). We introduce EduFrameTrap, a tutoring benchmark across math, physics, economics, chemistry, biology, and computer science that varies student confidence and pressure (context-switch, authority, social-affective). Across two frontier LLMs, context-switch failures are comparatively lower for GPT-5.2, while authority and social pressure more often trigger epistemic retreat. In contrast, Claude shows substantial context-switch fragility in this run. Because these failures are hard to judge automatically, we report two-judge disagreement as a reliability signal. We argue benchmarks should measure social-epistemic courage, i.e., supportive but corrective tutoring, and treat kind-but-correct behavior as a safety requirement.

</details>


### [333] [SliceGraph: Mapping Process Isomers in Multi-Run Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14619)
*Kang Chen,Junjie Nian,Yixin Cao,Yugang Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SliceGraph uses mutual-kNN clustering on activation-key Jaccard similarity to construct a problem-model-cell graph from multi-run CoT trajectories, identifying "process families" as strategy-coherent reasoning units within biconnected components. The paper demonstrates that correct answers often arise from multiple distinct reasoning path families (process isomers), and that final-answer aggregation loses critical information about multi-route process geometry.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current approaches to multi-run chain-of-thought reasoning aggregate trajectories to final answers, discarding information about how sampled trajectories share, split, and rejoin through intermediate computation. This loss of process-level information misses the structured geometry of reasoning paths.

Method: SliceGraph: a post-hoc problem-model-cell graph built using mutual-kNN over sparse activation-key Jaccard similarity between CoT slices. Process families identified within biconnected components. A label-seeded reward field provides separate value-landscape analysis. Typed-state transition analysis with matched null controls. Validated through representation ablations, cross-architecture replication, and cross-scale replications.

Result: In 85.5% of 954 problem-model cells, correct CoTs with the same normalized answer split into multiple process families. Among cells with ≥2 runs, 76.6% of run pairs are cross-family on average. Success-associated regions often split into disconnected high-value cores, and route families specialize over these core footprints. Process families navigate the same atlas with distinct transition kernels.

Conclusion: Final-answer aggregation overlooks structured multi-route process geometry that can be captured by SliceGraph's biconnected components and process families. Route families navigate the same value-space atlas with distinct transition kernels, suggesting that collapsing CoT reasoning to final answers loses important information about the reasoning process itself.

Abstract: Multi-run chain-of-thought reasoning is usually collapsed to final-answer aggregates, which discard howsampled trajectories share, split, and rejoin through intermediate computation. We propose SliceGraph, a post-hoc problem-model-cell graph built by mutual-kNN over sparse activation-key Jaccard similarity between CoT slices, and treat it as a measurement object for process geometry rather than as a decoding program. Across sampled CoT ensembles from three primary 4B/8B models on math and science benchmarks, blinded annotation supports SliceGraph biconnected components as shared reasoning-state units and process families as within-family strategy-coherent route units. In 85.5% of 954 problem-model cells, correct CoTs sharing the same normalized answer split into multiple process families; among cells with at least two such runs, 76.6% of run pairs are cross-family on average. We call such same-answer, family-divergent correct trajectories process isomers. A label-seeded reward field provides a separate value-landscape layer: success-associated regions often split into disconnected high-value cores, and route families specialize over these core footprints rather than merely duplicating one another. A typed-state transition analysis further shows that process families navigate the same atlas with distinct transition kernels under matched null controls. Representation ablations, a cross-architecture replication, and two cross-scale replications support the robustness of the route-family scaffold, showing that final-answer aggregation overlooks this structured multi-route process geometry.

</details>


### [334] [Teaching Large Language Models When Not to Know: Learning Temporal Critique for Ex-Ante Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14636)
*Chenlu Ding,Jiancan Wu,Yanchen Luo,Zheyuan Liu,Yancheng Yuan,Xiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM在时间截点推理中的知识泄露问题，发现提示设计虽能引导模型进入时间框架但无法实现时间可接受性验证，提出TCFT框架通过训练模型识别事后泄露、解释时间违规和判断答案时间有效性来解决这一问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在时间截点推理中常常失败：当被要求从早期时间点回答时，模型会利用截点后才有的知识，存在"事后诸葛亮"式的知识泄露问题。

Method: 通过系统分析提示级干预措施，发现时间泄露对截点表述和指令位置高度敏感；显式截点陈述优于隐式历史框架，前缀约束比后缀约束更能减少泄露；提出TCFT（时间批评微调）框架，训练模型进行截点感知的时间验证。

Result: 实验表明TCFT在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上分别将平均泄露率降低41.89和37.79个百分点，持续优于提示工程和SFT基线方法。

Conclusion: TCFT框架有效解决了LLM在时间截点推理中的知识泄露问题，通过训练模型识别事后知识、解释时间边界违规和判断时间可接受性，显著优于传统提示和监督微调方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to reason under temporal cutoffs: when prompted to answer from the standpoint of an earlier time, they exploit knowledge that became available only later. We study this failure through the lens of ex-ante reasoning, where a model must rely exclusively on information knowable before a cutoff. Through a systematic analysis of prompt-level interventions, we find that temporal leakage is highly sensitive to cutoff formulation and instruction placement: explicit cutoff statements outperform implicit historical framings, and prefix constraints reduce leakage more effectively than suffix constraints. These findings indicate that prompting can steer models into a temporal frame, but does not endow them with the ability to verify whether a response is temporally admissible. We further argue that supervised fine-tuning is insufficient, since ex-ante correctness is not an intrinsic property of an answer, but a relation between the answer and the cutoff. To address this gap, we propose TCFT, a Temporal Critique Fine-Tuning framework that trains models to acquire cutoff-aware temporal verification. Given a query, a cutoff, and a candidate response, TCFT teaches the model to identify post-cutoff leakage, explain temporal boundary violations, and judge temporal admissibility. Experiments with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct show that TCFT consistently outperforms prompting and SFT baselines, reducing average leakage by 41.89 and 37.79 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [335] [MindGap: A Conversational AI Framework for Upstream Neuroplastic Intervention in Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14660)
*Eranga Bandara,Ross Gore,Asanga Gunaratna,Ravi Mukkamala,Nihal Siriwardanagea,Sachini Rajapakse,Isurunima Kularathna,Pramoda Karunarathna,Wathsala Herath,Chalani Rajapakse,Sachin Shetty,Anita H. Clayton,Christopher K. Rhea,Ng Wee Keong,Kasun De Zoysa,Amin Hass,Shaifali Kaushik,Preston Samuel,Atmaram Yarlagadda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MindGap 是一个隐私保护的端侧（on-device）对话式 AI 框架，用于 PTSD 的"上游"神经可塑性干预。它借用佛教"缘起"（dependent origination）心理学中"受触→受 feelings tone→爱憎"的间隙，命名为"情感基调间隙"（feeling tone gap），将其定位为杏仁核-HPA 级联尚未完成时的前额叶调节窗口；通过在设备端微调的轻量级 LLM（Phi-3 Mini / Gemma 2B / LLaMA 3.2 3B，4-bit 量化）引导患者完成三层观察练习（情绪粒度、去中心化、对隐含信念的元认知觉察），配合六级刺激校准阶梯与疗效窗（window of tolerance）、步进/回退与危机安全协议，实现长时程抑制（LTD）介导的反应通路"溶解"而非"抑制"。本文为理论框架+系统架构+临床用例分析，并提出 RCT 验证方案，尚无实证疗效数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PTSD 一线治疗（延长暴露、EMDR、CBT）虽有效，但作者认为均作用于反应性级联的"下游"：路径完整发放后再靠消退学习/认知重构/再加工来管理其表达，属于"抑制相邻"（suppression-adjacent）机制，不产生上游 LTD 介导的通路溶解，因而缺乏最直接的结构性神经重组。作者指出 PTSD 本质是神经可塑性问题：创伤接触事件经 Hebbian 长时程增强（LTP）把过度反应通路写入杏仁核威胁评估系统，降低激活阈值；而同一 Hebbian 机制也提供双向可塑性（LTD 弱化未完成发放的通路 + LTP 强化前额叶调节回路），这正是上游干预可奏效的机制基础。此外，稀疏的每周治疗频次无法满足神经可塑改变所需的高频练习；而军事与敏感临床场景中 DoD/VA 数据治理禁止患者心理健康数据外传，云端方案不可部署。AI 代理具备"无自我、无反移情"、可实时校准刺激强度、可高频交付、可完全本地运行等独特适配性。作者同时指出在相关文献中尚无工作将完整的缘起框架用于 PTSD 康复，也无研究将缘起式练习微调进端侧模型。

Method: 1) 理论框架（第3节）：将缘起链条（受触→受境/情感基调→爱憎→无明→有漏/ conditioned formation）映射到 PTSD 神经生物学，说明两层条件化基质（情感效价与创伤编码的隐含信念）如何前置于接触事件；用 100–200 ms 的杏仁核价标签与前额叶下行调节窗口论证"情感基调间隙"的生物学对应；区分上游 LTD 溶解与下游抑制；给出三层"观照"练习的神经可塑性对应（Layer1 情绪粒度→前额叶调控参与+观察通路 LTP；Layer2 去中心化→减少 DMN 叙事捕获；Layer3 隐含信念元认知→直接针对 conditioned formation 本身）。2) 系统架构（第4节）：四组件——端侧微调 LLM、治疗协议引擎（状态机）、情感基调诱发框架、进展追踪与临床集成模块；模型在三套语料（缘起练习对话、创伤知情治疗语言、情感基调诱发提示）上微调，目标为"窄而深"能力；刺激校准阶梯六级（概念→外围→邻近→直接→中度→强激活），2–5 级为疗效窗，需连续三次稳定 Layer 1 观察方可进阶，超窗自动回退并执行 grounding 与危机升级；实时响应分类（达到层深 1/2/3 × 激活度三档）；全部数据本地加密存储，临床共享仅由患者主动导出。3) 神经可塑性行为代理指标：激活轨迹、层深进展、情感基调识别潜伏期。4) 移动端旅程（接入码引导的自然对话式入组、5–10 分钟每日练习、30–45 分钟每周深度练习、现实世界支持、维护模式降阶标准）。5) 临床用例分析（第6节）：以 34 岁阿富汗两轮服役战斗退伍军人 Marcus（PCL-5=58）为代表性剖面，走查 12 周弧线（第2周错过间隙、第7周超市真实情境拦截、第4个月首次 Layer 3 识别"总有人说要死了"的隐含信念），并明确声明为说明性而非观察性数据。6) 验证设计：军事/退伍人群 RCT（MindGap+标准治疗 vs 标准治疗），主要神经可塑性指标为 fMRI 杏仁核反应性、前额叶-杏仁核功能连接、HRV；症状指标 PCL-5、CAPS-5；次要指标为应用日志行为标记物。

Result: 1) 理论主张：PTSD 是 LTP 编码问题而非单纯心理反应；恐惧回路发放在意识之前完成；已有治疗均下游；缘起链条精确标出可介入点为"情感基调—爱憎"间隙。2) 提出并形式化 MindGap：端侧微调轻量 LLM + 协议引擎 + 诱发框架 + 进展追踪，四组件零数据外传；六级刺激阶梯、疗效窗判定、连续三次稳定 Layer 1 进阶规则、超阈值自动回退、危机模式与临床转介；只依赖患者主动导出的月度摘要实现临床整合。3) 用例分析（示例性）：Marcus 12 周内会话起始激活度从 6.8 降至 3.8（约降 44%，刺激强度等同或更高）、Layer 2 自第 4 周可及（约 60% 会话）、Layer 3 自第 9 周出现（约 40% 会话）、刺激等级由 Level 1 推进至 Level 4；超市真实情境中未完成撤离行为，被视为生态效度上最具意义的上游拦截事件；月度摘要实际影响三项临床决策（暴露升级、拥挤空间作为重点刺激类别、药物是否续用的讨论）。4) 明确局限：无任何真实受试者数据；论文为理论+架构+用例+验证方案；作者自陈用例不可作为疗效证据；校准逻辑与进阶/回退阈值需实证确定；重度 PTSD、复杂创伤史与共病人群可能进展更慢、更难维持疗效窗。

Conclusion: MindGap 主张一种与现行标准治疗正交的干预逻辑：PTSD 不是"时间能治愈的心理反应"，而是"时间会加深的神经可塑性编码"，故应针对级联上游的通路溶解而非下游的输出管理；其创新在于把 2500 年 contemplative 框架与神经可塑性科学、端侧推理三条线首次汇合为可部署的临床系统——PTSD 临床针对性、上游间隙干预、三层观照、LTD 溶解机制、缘起理论根基、端侧隐私、移动交付八个维度同时成立（表1 声称为首例）。作者明确将受控纵向 RCT 列为优先事项，在 fMRI 杏仁核反应性、前额叶-杏仁核连接、PCL-5/CAPS-5 与应用行为标记物获得证据前，MindGap 不应被推荐为临床干预，仅定位为现有临床照护的"高频神经可塑性练习补充"而非替代。未来工作方向包括生理传感器客观化疗效窗监测、扩展至焦虑与物质使用障碍、VR 高强度暴露、精英运动与高压军事决策等非临床场景的上游溶解应用，同时保持对 DoD/VA 合规与患者数据主权的持续尊重。

Abstract: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) is fundamentally a neuroplastic problem traumatic contact events encode over-reactive neural pathways through Hebbian long-term potentiation, producing hair-triggered amygdala-HPA stress cascades that fire before conscious awareness can intercept them. Existing therapeutic approaches, prolonged exposure, EMDR, cognitive behavioural therapy, operate predominantly downstream of the reactive cascade, teaching patients to tolerate or reframe distress after it has arisen. While clinically valuable, these suppression-based approaches do not produce the upstream pathway dissolution that constitutes lasting structural neural reorganisation. This paper proposes MindGap, a privacy-preserving on-device conversational AI framework that delivers structured neuroplastic rehabilitation for PTSD through the practice of dependent origination, a Buddhist psychological framework that identifies the precise moment between the pre-cognitive affective signal and the reactive elaboration that follows as the site of therapeutic intervention. MindGap guides patients through three progressive layers of observation at this feeling tone gap: noticing the bare affective signal before reactive elaboration, recognising it as self-arising rather than caused by the stimulus, and recognising the conditioned implicit belief beneath the feeling. Each layer corresponds to progressively deeper prefrontal regulatory engagement and progressively deeper long-term depression-mediated weakening of the reactive pathway, producing genuine upstream dissolution rather than downstream suppression. Running entirely on-device with no data egress, MindGap delivers daily calibrated exposure sessions through a fine-tuned lightweight large language model, making it deployable in sensitive clinical and military contexts where cloud-based solutions are not permitted.

</details>


### [336] [Monitoring Data-aware Temporal Properties (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14666)
*Alessandro Gianola,Marco Montali,Sarah Winkler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次研究 LTL_f modulo theories (LTL_f^MT) 数据的「预期式监控」(anticipatory monitoring)：在只观测到有限轨迹前缀的前提下，判定属性当前是满足/违反，还是永久满足/永久违反。作者提出了一套结合自动机理论与SMT自动推理的基础框架（回溯回归 + 共可达图），在量化自由片段 dataLTL_f 上给出可判定性判据（无环签名、单调性约束、局部有限性、有界回看），并以工具 MonThe（基于 CVC5）实现验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 系统中大量组件（自主代理、异构服务）内部规格不可访问，模型检测等设计时验证方法不适用，只能在运行时监控（runtime verification）。已有监控方法多用命题式 LTL_f，无法表达对结构化数据（数值、集合、未解释函数）的约束；而引入 SMT 理论后，LTL_f^MT 的监控问题在纯线性实数算术下已被证明不可判定（Felli et al. 2023），且 dataLTL_f 的「预期式监控」此前是完全未解的开放问题。核心困难在于：监控状态不仅取决于已观测前缀，还取决于前缀的所有（无穷多个）可能有限后继，因此需要既能处理时序维度又能处理一阶数据维度的技术，并且必须识别出实践中相关且可判定的片段。

Method: 1) 语义框架：多排序一阶签名上的 LTL_f^MT（带 lookback 算子 ⊲ 与 next/weak next/until/release），追踪 = (模型 M, 状态赋值序列)；延续(continuation)通过模型论「嵌入」(embedding) 概念锚定，即后继模型保守地扩展既有元素的事实、允许引入新元素事实。定义四态监控判定 ps/cs/cv/pv（永久满足/当前满足/当前违反/永久违反）。
2) 自动机：将 dataLTL_f 属性编译为 NFA N_ψ，字母表 Θ = 2^{C^±∪{λ,¬λ}} 为一阶公式的集合，λ 标记迹尾；引入「safe lookback」假设与一致性(consistency)概念，证明 Thm.10（迹满足 ψ ⟺ 存在与迹一致且被 NFA 接受的良构词），并有确定性性质 Lem.11（唯一词与状态）。
3) 监控技术：定义 regress（把验证义务沿约束反向传播的量词消去式前像运算），构造「共可达图」CG⁺/CG⁻，节点为 (自动机状态, 量化自由公式)，边由 regress 后的 T*-等价公式确定；由此得 ExtSat(q)/ExtViol(q)，最终算法 monitor(ψ,τ) 用 SMT 检查 M,α_n ⊨ ExtViol/ExtSat 给出四态判定（Thm.18 正确性）。
4) 假设 Assumptions 5：(a) 存在式公式可满足性可判定；(b) 背景理论 T 泛型且有模型完备化 T*，或 T 具量词消去（以 T*=T）。
5) 可判定性判据：i) 无环签名 ⇒ 有限项 ⇒ 可判定（Thm.19）；ii) tame 签名 + 无环 + 单调性约束 MCs（DB-LTL_f-MC，涵盖 Thm.20，涵盖 Felli et al. 2023 Thm.20）；iii) k-局部有限理论（单变量公理）⇒ 可判定（Thm.21, Cor.22）；iv) K-有界回看（由计算图定义，推广 feedback freedom）⇒ 可判定（Thm.24，附录 C 用有界量词深度证明）。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 形式化定义了 LTL_f^MT 的预期式监控问题，并给出 dataLTL_f 片段上基于 NFA + 共可达图 + 模型完备化的正确监控算法（Thm.10/18）；(2) 首次识别出实践中相关且可判定的片段 DB-LTL_f（= 只读数据库 EUF 理论 ∪ 线性算术理论），涵盖数据感知业务流程与运行于只读数据库之上的系统，其四种可判定判据分别基于无环签名、单调性约束、局部有限性与有界回看；(3) 明确指出纯线性实数算术背景下监控不可判定。原型工具 MonThe（基于 CVC5 做 SMT 检查与量词消去，https://monitoring.adatool.dev）实现了完整流程。初步实验（附录 D）在 4 个领域、17 个属性、5 条变长迹上评估：多数属性秒级完成，最难案例（webshop/VERIFAS 的 DDS dynamics，|φ|=101–143）耗时 121–158 秒，其中绝大部分（104–145 秒）消耗在 NFA 预处理/核心化阶段，实际监控仅 1.3–1.8 秒，说明瓶颈在自动机与回归约束的预计算而非逐迹判定。

Conclusion: 本文首次解决了 LTL_f^MT 数据的预期式监控，确立了「自动机处理时序 + SMT 处理数据」的基础框架，并给出可判定片段 DB-LTL_f，兼顾了表达力与可计算性。作者指出未来工作包括：(1) 更大规模的实证评估；(2) 支持数据随时间部分变化的动态系统（例如票价被更新这类受控数据库更新），当前模型假设既有元素的事实固定不变，限制了表达力。作者亦说明 MonThe 支持在线监控接口，可缓存 NFA 与共可达图以支持多迹复用。

Abstract: Dynamic systems in AI are often complex and heterogeneous, so that an internal specification is not accessible and verification techniques such as model checking are not applicable. Monitoring is in such cases an attractive alternative, as it evaluates desirable properties along traces generated by an unknown dynamic system. In this work, we consider anticipatory monitoring of linear-time properties enriched with an arbitrary SMT theory over finite traces (LTLfMT). Anticipatory monitoring in this setting is highly challenging, as the monitoring state depends on both the trace prefix seen so far and all its possible finite continuations. Under reasonable assumptions on the background theory, we present and formally prove the correctness of a novel foundational framework for monitoring properties in an expressive fragment of LTLfMT. The framework combines automata-theoretic methods to handle the temporal aspects of the logic, with automated reasoning techniques to address the first-order dimension. Moreover, we identify for the first time decidable fragments of this monitoring problem that are practically relevant as they combine linear arithmetic with uninterpreted functions, which covers e.g. data-aware business processes and dynamic systems operating over a read-only database. Feasibility is witnessed by a prototype implementation and preliminary evaluation.

</details>


### [337] [How Sensitive Are Radiomic AI Models to Acquisition Parameters?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14667)
*D. Gil,I. Sanchez,C. Sanchez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: A mixed-effects framework to quantify scan parameter sensitivity of radiomic AI models, identifying optimal CT acquisition parameters that improve cross-dataset robustness for lung cancer diagnosis.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI radiomic systems suffer performance degradation when deployed across heterogeneous multicentre acquisition protocols, limiting clinical adoption.

Method: Mixed-effects framework to quantify acquisition parameter influence on model performance with subject-level random effects; applied to lung cancer CT diagnosis across two independent multicentre datasets.

Result: Optimal CT configuration: tube current ≥200 mA, spiral pitch ≤1.5, slice thickness ≤1.25 mm. Performance improved from sensitivity 0.79±0.04 → 0.90±0.10 and specificity 0.47±0.10 → 0.79±0.13.

Conclusion: The proposed mixed-effects framework successfully identifies optimal CT acquisition parameters that balance diagnostic quality with low radiation dose, achieving significant performance improvements in cross-dataset robustness for AI radiomic models.

Abstract: A main barrier for the deployment of AI radiomic systems in clinical routine is their drop in performance under heterogeneous multicentre acquisition protocols. This work presents a performance-oriented framework for quantifying scan parameter sensitivity of radiomic AI models, while identifying clinically significant parameter regions associated with improved cross-dataset robustness. We formulate a mixed-effects framework for quantifying the influence that clinically relevant acquisition parameters have on models performance, while accounting for subject-level random effects. We have applied our framework to lung cancer diagnosis in CT scans using two independent multicentre datasets (a public database and own-collected data) and several SoA architectures. To evaluate across-database reproducibility, CT parameters have been adjusted using the data collected and tested on the public set. The optimal configuration selected is the current of the X-ray tube >= 200 mA, spiral pitch <= 1.5, slice thickness <= 1.25 mm, which balances diagnostic quality with low radiation dose. These configuration push metrics from 0.79+-0.04 sensitivity, 0.47+-0.10 specificity in low quality scans to 0.90+-0.10 sensitivity, 0.79 +- 0.13 specificity in high quality ones.

</details>


### [338] [$π$-Bench: Evaluating Proactive Personal Assistant Agents in Long-Horizon Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14678)
*Haoran Zhang,Luxin Xu,Zhilin Wang,Runquan Gui,Shunkai Zhang,Haodi Lei,Zihao He,Bingsu He,Chicheng Qin,Tong Zhu,Xiaoye Qu,Yang Yang,Yu Cheng,Yafu Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: π-Bench is a benchmark evaluating proactive assistance in personal assistant agents through 100 multi-turn tasks with hidden user intents and cross-session dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that proactive assistance is still challenging, task completion and proactivity are distinct capabilities, and prior interaction context improves proactive intent resolution.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Personal assistant agents require proactive assistance capabilities, as users often have underspecified requests with unstated needs/constraints. Existing benchmarks fail to evaluate whether agents can identify hidden intents before explicit statements, especially in sustained multi-turn interactions where needs emerge gradually.

Method: Developed π-Bench benchmark with 100 multi-turn tasks across 5 domain-specific personas, incorporating hidden intents, inter-task dependencies, and cross-session continuity to evaluate agents in long-horizon interaction trajectories.

Result: Proactive assistance remains challenging; clear distinction exists between task completion and proactivity; prior interaction context is valuable for proactive intent resolution in later tasks.

Conclusion: π-Bench remains challenging for current agents; task completion and proactivity are distinct capabilities; prior interaction context significantly improves proactive intent resolution in subsequent tasks.

Abstract: The rise of personal assistant agents, e.g., OpenClaw, highlights the growing potential of large language models to support users across everyday life and work. A core challenge in these settings is proactive assistance, since users often begin with underspecified requests and leave important needs, constraints, or preferences unstated. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can identify and act on such hidden intents before they are explicitly stated, especially in sustained multi-turn interactions where user needs emerge gradually. To address this gap, we introduce $π$-Bench, a benchmark for proactive assistance comprising 100 multi-turn tasks across 5 domain-specific user personas. By incorporating hidden user intents, inter-task dependencies, and cross-session continuity, $π$-Bench evaluates agents' ability to anticipate and address user needs over extended interactions, jointly measuring proactivity and task completion in long-horizon trajectories that better reflect real-world use. Experiments show (1) proactive assistance remains challenging, (2) a clear distinction between task completion and proactivity, and (3) the value of prior interaction for proactive intent resolution in later tasks.

</details>


### [339] [On Strong Equivalence Notions in Logic Programming and Abstract Argumentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14721)
*Giovanni Buraglio,Wolfgang Dvorak,Stefan Woltran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了逻辑程序与抽象论证框架在动态更新下的强等价性问题。针对现有语义在两类形式化之间无法保持强等价的缺陷，提出了一种新的逻辑程序强等价概念，使其在向论证框架转换时能够维持强等价性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然逻辑程序和抽象论证框架在静态环境下已被证明是语义等价的，但在动态语境（即更新操作）下，两者的对齐关系破裂，因为两者采用了不同的更新语义，导致从一个形式化到另一个形式的强等价性无法保持。

Method: 引入了一种新的强等价定义，该定义在特定类别的逻辑程序、Dung风格论证框架和增补声明论证框架之间的转换下保持强等价性。

Result: 成功建立了逻辑程序与论证框架之间的强等价保持关系，解决了跨形式化方法中的兼容性问题。

Conclusion: 提出了一种新的逻辑程序强等价概念，该概念在逻辑编程与抽象论证形式化之间维持强等价性，从而恢复了跨形式化方法的兼容性。

Abstract: Strong equivalence between knowledge bases ensures the possibility of replacing one with the other without affecting reasoning outcomes, in any given context. This makes it a crucial property in nonmonotonic formalisms. In particular, the fields of logic programming and abstract argumentation provide primary examples in which this property has been subject to vast investigations. However, while (classes of) logic programs and abstract argumentation frameworks are known to be semantically equivalent in static settings, this alignment breaks in dynamic contexts due to differing notions of update. As a result, strong equivalence does not always carry over from one formalism to the other. In this paper, we carefully investigate this discrepancy and introduce a new notion of strong equivalence for logic programs. Our approach preserves strong equivalence under translation between certain classes of logic programs and both Dung-style and claim-augmented argumentation frameworks, thus restoring compatibility across these formalisms.

</details>


### [340] [Agentifying Patient Dynamics within LLMs through Interacting with Clinical World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14723)
*Minghao Wu,Yuting Yan,Zhenyang Cai,Ke Ji,Chuangsen Fang,Ziying Sheng,Xidong Wang,Rongsheng Wang,Hejia Zhang,Shuang Li,Benyou Wang,Hongyuan Zha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SepsisAgent，一个基于世界模型增强的LLM Agent用于脓毒症治疗推荐。该系统通过临床世界模型模拟干预响应，采用提议-模拟-优化工作流程，结合三阶段课程训练（监督微调、行为克隆、强化学习），在MIMIC-IV数据集上实现了最优治疗价值和安全表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICU脓毒症管理需要根据快速变化的患者生理状态做出连续的治疗决策。虽然大语言模型(LLMs)编码了广泛的临床知识并能够推理指南，但它们本质上并未根植于动作条件下的患者动态。论文指出，仅访问世界模型会导致LLM决策性能不一致，因此需要专门针对Agent进行训练。

Method: SepsisAgent采用"提议-模拟-优化"(propose-simulate-refine)的工作流程：首先利用临床世界模型模拟候选液体-血管加压素干预下的患者响应，然后通过三阶段课程训练——患者动力学监督微调、提议-模拟-优化行为克隆、基于世界模型的Agentic强化学习——对模型进行训练。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV脓毒症轨迹数据上，SepsisAgent在离线策略价值评估中优于所有传统RL和基于LLM的基线方法，同时在指南依从性和不安全动作指标下实现了最佳安全性表现。

Conclusion: SepsisAgent通过三阶段课程训练范式成功地将世界模型与LLM Agent相结合，在MIMIC-IV脓毒症轨迹上实现了最优的离线策略价值评估，同时获得了最佳的安全性表现。进一步分析表明，与临床世界模型的反复交互使Agent能够学习患者演变的规律性，即使移除模拟器访问后仍然有用。

Abstract: Sepsis management in the ICU requires sequential treatment decisions under rapidly evolving patient physiology. Although large language models (LLMs) encode broad clinical knowledge and can reason over guidelines, they are not inherently grounded in action-conditioned patient dynamics. We introduce SepsisAgent, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. SepsisAgent uses a learned Clinical World Model to simulate patient responses under candidate fluid--vasopressor interventions, and follows a propose--simulate--refine workflow before committing to a prescription. We first show that world-model access alone yields inconsistent LLM decision performance, motivating agent-specific training. We then train SepsisAgent through a three-stage curriculum: patient-dynamics supervised fine-tuning, propose--simulate--refine behavior cloning, and world-model-based agentic reinforcement learning. On MIMIC-IV sepsis trajectories, SepsisAgent outperforms all traditional RL and LLM-based baselines in off-policy value while achieving the best safety profile under guideline adherence and unsafe-action metrics. Further analysis shows that repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model enables the agent to learn regularities in patient evolution, which remain useful even when simulator access is removed.

</details>


### [341] [XDomainBench: Diagnosing Reasoning Collapse in High-Dimensional Scientific Knowledge Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14754)
*Gong Zhiren,Tiantong Wu,Jiaming Zhang,Fuyao Zhang,Che Wang,Yurong Hao,Yikun Hou,Foo Ping,Yilei Zhao,Fei Huang,Chau Yuen,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: XDomainBench评估发现LLM在科学知识组合推理中存在系统性崩溃，随领域组合复杂度增加而恶化，揭示了当前LLM在跨学科交互式科学推理中的能力局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要关注单轮受限场景，无法捕捉真实交互式科学工作流中LLM的能力边界，需系统评估LLM在科学知识合成中的组合泛化能力。

Method: 构建了XDomainBench基准，包含8,598个跨20个领域、4类任务的交互会话，涵盖8种难度和领域混合动态的真实轨迹模式，对组合顺序和混合结构进行系统化压力测试。

Result: 大规模评估发现：随着组合顺序增加，LLM出现系统性推理崩溃，表现为错误累积、推理断裂和领域混淆，最终导致会话崩溃。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM在组合推理中的系统性崩溃，主要源于：(1) 领域组合直接增加难度；(2) 交互模式触发错误累积、推理断裂和领域混淆，最终导致会话崩溃。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for knowledge synthesis, yet their capacity for compositional generalization in scientific knowledge remains under-characterized. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on single-turn restricted scenarios, failing to capture the capability boundaries exposed by real-world interactive scientific workflows. To address this, we introduce XDomainBench, a diagnostic benchmark for interactive interdisciplinary scientific reasoning. We formalize the composition order and mixture structure to enable systematic stress-testing from single-discipline to inter-disciplinary, comprising 8,598 interactive sessions across 20 domains and 4 task categories, with 8 realistic trajectory patterns covering difficulty and domain-mixture dynamics, simulating real AI4S scenarios. Large-scale evaluation of LLMs reveals a systematic reasoning collapse as composition order increases, stemming from two root causes: (i) direct difficulty increases induced by domain composition, and (ii) indirect interaction-amplified failures where trajectory patterns trigger error accumulation, reasoning breaks, and domain confusion, ultimately leading to session collapse.

</details>


### [342] [Probabilistic Verification of Recurrent Neural Networks for Single and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14758)
*Luca Marzari,Enrico Marchesini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RNN-ProVe addresses verification challenges in RNN-based policies for partially observable RL by using probabilistic sampling and statistical error bounds to estimate the likelihood of undesired behaviors, providing more accurate and scalable guarantees than existing approaches.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: History-dependent policies induced by RNNs in partially observable RL are challenging to verify; existing tools rely on restrictive assumptions or coarse over-approximations, leading to overly conservative or inconclusive results.

Method: Policy-driven sampling to approximate feasible hidden state sets, combined with statistical error bounds for bounded-error, high-confidence guarantees.

Result: RNN-ProVe yields more quantitative, feasibility-aware probabilistic guarantees compared to existing tools, and scales effectively to recurrent and multi-agent settings.

Conclusion: RNN-ProVe provides bounded-error, high-confidence estimates of behavioral violations in RNN-based policies.

Abstract: History-dependent policies induced by recurrent neural networks (RNNs) rely on latent hidden state dynamics, making verification in partially observable reinforcement learning (RL) challenging. Existing RNN verification tools typically rely on restrictive modeling assumptions or coarse over-approximations of the hidden state space, which can lead to overly conservative or inconclusive results. We propose $\textbf{RNN}$ $\textbf{Pro}$babilistic $\textbf{Ve}$rification ($\texttt{RNN-ProVe}$), a probabilistic framework that $\textit{estimates the likelihood}$ of undesired behaviors in RNN-based policies. $\texttt{RNN-ProVe}$ uses policy-driven sampling to approximate the set of hidden states that are feasible under a trained policy, and derives statistical error bounds to produce bounded-error, high-confidence estimates of behavioral violations. Experiments on partially observable single-agent and cooperative multi-agent tasks show that $\texttt{RNN-ProVe}$ yields more quantitative, feasibility-aware probabilistic guarantees than existing tools, while scaling to recurrent and multi-agent settings.

</details>


### [343] [AI Outperforms Humans in Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment via LLM-Based Interviews and Semantic Feature Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14761)
*Yoshia Abe,Tatsuya Daikoku,Yasuo Kuniyoshi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究利用大语言模型结合深度学习，提出通过半结构化访谈主动获取个体审美偏好的系统，实验证明该系统在捕捉个体审美评价方面优于人类预测者及其自身未来评价，为AI作为人类审美感受深度诠释者的可能性提供了新视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度学习模型仅能提取低层客观特征，但审美偏好具有主观性和个体依赖性，需提取高层语义特征并主动收集目标个体的偏好信息。

Method: 开发了一个集成DL-LLM系统，通过LLM驱动的半结构化访谈主动获取审美偏好，并结合低层和高层图像特征进行审美评价预测。

Result: 该系统优于所有对比系统（包括传统系统、人类预测者和个体自身时间间隔后的再评价），在高分图像上表现尤为突出；预测误差小于个体内变异度，而人类预测者误差最大。

Conclusion: AI可能比人类本身更能捕捉个体审美偏好，为"AI能否成为比人类更深入的人类审美感受诠释者"这一新问题提供了实证基础。

Abstract: Accurately predicting individual aesthetic evaluation for images is a fundamental challenge for AI. Various deep learning (DL)-based models have been proposed for this task, training on image evaluation data to extract objective low-level features. However, aesthetic preferences are inherently subjective and individual-dependent. Accurate prediction thus requires the extraction of high-level semantic features of images and the active collection of preference information from the target individual. To address this issue, we focus on the utility of Large Language Models (LLMs) pretrained on vast amounts of textual data, and develop an integrated DL-LLM system. The system actively elicits aesthetic preferences through LLM-based semi-structured interviews and predicts aesthetic evaluation by leveraging both low-level and high-level features. In our experiments, we compare the proposed system against conventional systems, human predictors, and the target individual's own re-evaluations after a certain time interval. Our results show that the proposed system outperforms all of them, with particularly strong performance on highly-rated images. Moreover, the prediction error of the proposed system is smaller than within-person variability, while human predictors show the largest error, likely due to the influence of their own aesthetic values. These results suggest that AI may be better positioned than others or one's future self to capture individual aesthetic preferences at a given point. This opens a new question of whether AI could serve as a deeper interpreter of human aesthetic sensibility than humans themselves.

</details>


### [344] [MediaClaw: Multimodal Intelligent-Agent Platform Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14771)
*Shaoan Zhao,Huanlin Gao,Qiang Hui,Ting Lu,Xueqiang Guo,Yantao Li,Xinpei Su,Fuyuan Shi,Chao Tan,Fang Zhao,Kai Wang,Shiguo Lian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MediaClaw 是中国联通元境团队基于 OpenClaw 生态构建的多模态智能体平台，采用"统一抽象 + 插件化扩展 + 工作流编排"三层架构，把图像、视频、语音、数字人等异构 AIGC 能力统一为"元能力池"，并以任务导向的 Skill 将复杂生产流程沉淀为可复用工作流资产。本技术报告重点阐述其架构设计哲学、核心能力模型逻辑与工程权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业级 AIGC 落地存在三大痛点：一是能力碎片化，不同厂商/模型的接口标准、参数格式与调用方式差异巨大，每接入一项新能力都要重复适配，成本与交付周期高；二是生产流程割裂，完整多媒体生产需跨多能力、多平台切换，人工成本高且优质流程无法沉淀复用；三是使用门槛高，业务用户需学习多个工具，技术团队反复重建能力适配层。为此平台确立三条设计原则（最小认知成本、最大扩展灵活性、最大资产复用）与三层设计目标（接入层降低集成成本、效率层提升生产效率、生态层构建开放生态），定位为"AIGC 能力中间层"：向下屏蔽异构生成与本地处理差异，中间提供可复用编排框架并积累场景方案，向上提供统一接口与交互入口解决落地最后一公里问题。

Method: 整体架构由三大核心组件构成：(1) 元能力池（Meta-Capability Pool）——按"AIGC 生成能力"与"本地处理能力"两类组织，涵盖文生图、图生视频、多图生视频（参考图风格一致 / 首尾帧）、TTS、数字人播报视频、图像理解问答、字幕烧录、绿幕抠像等，全部遵循统一 Tool 接口规范；部署上同时对接商业 API（YuanJing）与私有化开源模型（SGLang 标准适配，用户自训模型按规范部署即可接入），并对开源模型应用 Lemica、MeanCache 等推理加速技术；本地处理类基于 FFmpeg 实现，经实践对比后选择插件化而非命令行 Skill 方式（调用链更短、运行更稳）。(2) 插件系统采用请求级 / 能力级 / 全局级三级路由配置，切换厂商或模型无需改动上层业务代码，避免厂商锁定。(3) Skill 层——在原子能力之上构建场景化编排模板，含商品宣传海报生成 Skill（"需求结构化—生成—多维评估（卖点表达、主体突出、视觉美感、品牌一致性、信息层级）—定向优化—最优留存"闭环，保留历史最佳结果防劣化与风格漂移）、长视频生成 Skill（LLM 自动生成分镜→文生视频→以片段末帧作为下一段首帧保证视觉连续→用图像 QA 能力精修提示词，不修改底层模型，将 5 秒能力编排扩展至约 15 秒）、数字人播报 Skill（长文本切句→按语义匹配动作 ID→批量调用数字人插件→自动拼接并同步 TTS 与字幕，内置新闻/课程/产品/欢迎等动作匹配规则，支持自定义与手动编排）、Video Use Skill（集成开源 video-use，基于 FFmpeg 与语音模型，核心思想是 LLM "读"音频而非"看"画面，先转写为带时间戳文本再做剪辑导出，支持智能剪辑去口癖/重复/静音与多次录制优选、自动调色与预设风格、时间轴对齐字幕、Manim/Remotion/PIL 动画叠加、响度归一化、HDR 检测与 HLG/PQ 转 SDR）。(4) MediaUI 基于 OpenClaw-Admin 构建，自动识别输出文件路径与媒体类型并在对话界面实时渲染，无需改 Skill 代码即插即用，支持 Skill 编排各节点输入输出与中间临时产物的全链路可视化；非多媒体输出沿用原机制以保持生态兼容。

Result: 已实现能力包括文生图、图像问答、文生视频、图生视频、多图生视频、TTS、数字人视频、字幕烧录、绿幕背景替换（元境与 SGLang 支持情况见表 1）。数字人原子能力限定在"单段内容生成"边界内，内置多个形象 ID 与动作 ID，自动完成语音合成、口型同步与动作视频渲染；多动作编排、多段拼接、字幕对齐上移至 Skill 层解决——原因是自定义数字人形象需经历扫描、3D 建模、绑定、动作捕捉的长链路、周期长，而标准化能力已能满足新闻播报、课程讲解、产品介绍等常见需求且生成快、门槛低；未来将逐步支持自定义形象上传与定制动作编排。各 Skill 落地验证：海报 Skill 在电商营销场景中仅需商品描述即可调度 LLM 与文生图插件完成生成，无需掌握复杂提示词工程；长视频 Skill 风格一致、转场自然，编排耗时分钟级，已用于低成本的内部彩铃等批量内容生产；数字人播报 Skill 在技术介绍与"16+8"业务营销两个差异化场景中验证了泛化性与拼接连续性，唇动与 TTS 对齐、多段转场自然、字幕定位准确；Video Use 对源素材质量与一致性（尤其分辨率统一性）高度敏感，素材一致时在时间轴编排、片段排序与淡入淡出转场效果表现良好。

Conclusion: MediaClaw 的核心价值不在于调用单个模型或工具，而在于把分散的多模态生成能力组织成可复用的生产工作流：既支持商业 API 接入，也支持私有化开源模型部署与本地多媒体处理；通过统一能力抽象与三级路由实现底层模型/厂商的无感切换而不改动上层业务流程；通过 Skill 机制把实战工程经验固化为可复用模板，显著降低多媒体 AIGC 应用的开发与使用门槛。平台后续将持续扩充元能力池、丰富场景 Skill、优化 MediaUI 交互体验。工程权衡要点在于：把复杂编排留给 Skill 层、把原子生成收敛在插件层；本地处理能力插件化优于命令行 Skill 化；以及 Video Use 后续需重点降低对高一致性源素材的依赖以应对混合质量真实输入。

Abstract: MediaClaw is a multimodal agent platform built on the OpenClaw ecosystem. Its core design follows a three-layer architecture of unified abstraction, pluginized extension, and workflow orchestration. The system is intended to address practical deployment pain points in AIGC adoption, including fragmented capabilities, heterogeneous interfaces, disconnected production processes, and limited reuse of high-quality production workflows. \system{} abstracts full-category AIGC capabilities into a unified invocation model, uses plugins to support hot-pluggable capability expansion, and uses task-oriented Skills to turn complex production processes into reusable workflow assets. This report focuses on the architectural design philosophy of MediaClaw, the design logic of its core capability model, and the key engineering trade-offs in implementation. It aims to provide reusable practical reference for building multimodal capability platforms.

</details>


### [345] [Identifying Culprits Through Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient Deep Learning Investigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14774)
*Lata B T,Savitha N J*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This research proposes a DDPG-based deep learning model for criminal identification, trained on crime scene materials, witness statements, and suspect profiles. The method achieves 95% accuracy, outperforming existing approaches.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Traditional criminal investigation methods rely on limited data analysis, and identifying offenders from complex datasets while minimizing false positives and false negatives remains a significant challenge in modern AI applications.

Method: A deep learning approach using Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) trained on crime scene materials, witness statements, and suspect profiles datasets.

Result: The proposed DDPG model achieved a 95% accuracy rate in criminal identification.

Conclusion: DDPG demonstrates exceptional criminal identification capabilities, outperforming multiple existing methods.

Abstract: In the world of AI and advanced technologies investigation aspects identification of a crime or criminal plays a major problem. In this research we focus on a Conventional ways of implicating criminal investigations usually rely on limited data analysis. Finding an optimal and efficient method that will effectively identify criminals from complex datasets and minimise false positives and false negatives is the considered as a challenge. The main novelty approach of this work is based on the deep learning algorithm Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) is presented in this paper. We train the DDPG model with a dataset of crime scene material, witness statements and suspect profiles. The algorithm uses features to maximise the likelihood of identifying the offender while minimising the noise impact and irrelevant data. We show the efficacy of the proposed method, where DDPG identified criminals with an amazing accuracy of 95% than other several existing methods.

</details>


### [346] [A Heterogeneous Temporal Memory Governance Framework for Long-Term LLM Persona Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14802)
*Zhao Yang,Wang Huan,Li Yingshuo,Tu Haomiao,Lin Hujite*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ARPM（Analysis-Based Role-Playing with Memory）——一个面向长期对话的外部时间记忆治理框架，将静态知识记忆与动态对话经验记忆物理分离，配合向量检索+BM25+RRF 融合、双时间坐标（物理时间与对话轮次）重排序、时间证据展开（按时间顺序组织并保留原始语义与来源）以及受控的 `<analysis>` 协议（生成前证据校验与答案绑定），并以白盒原子化日志回写实现可追溯审计。基于完整工程日志的三组实验表明：高噪声下自动评分规则显著低估了真实证据利用率（1:5 时 54%→100%，1:200+ 时 44%→80%）；消融显示对话历史检索（100%→66.7%）与 BM25（→80.0%）不可替代，双时间重排序主要提供时间组织与参照系稳定；跨模型交接（183 轮、510 万字噪声底座、周期性清空上下文）表明长期人格一致性不完全绑定于单一模型权重，但受基础模型协议合规能力上界约束，专用角色扮演模型反而出现更严重的"戏剧化漂移"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期人机交互中，LLM 常出现事实遗忘、时间线混乱、人格漂移与稳定性下降，特别是在三类压力同时存在时：(1) 高噪声外部知识库；(2) 上下文被周期性清空；(3) 基础模型被替换（跨模型迁移）。已有两条路线各有明显缺陷：将人格一致性编码进模型权重的角色微调/偏好优化在基座模型更换后迁移性有限；依赖长上下文或系统提示词的方法会随对话变长与清空而退化；且传统 RAG（DrQA/REALM/DPR/Advanced RAG）优化的是"单问是否答对"，未处理记忆类型异质性（客观知识、聊天经历、用户纠正、风格边界、任务状态处于不同时间尺度与可靠性层级）与"证据入 Prompt 后是否被二次利用"的度量错位问题——机械 top-1 匹配会把"规则未命中"误判为"系统检索失败"。因此论文将问题重新定义为：连续性不是权重问题，而是可追溯、可审计、可迁移的外部治理问题；并强调自动评分与人工复核必须区分，否则会把评分规则的缺陷误当作框架的缺陷。

Method: 方法为四组件闭环的模块化单体 Web 服务架构（前端多轮对话/干预界面，后端检索—排序—生成—回写闭环）。① 异构双源记忆解耦：knowledge memory（父子分块，子块做细粒度语义匹配、父块提供完整上下文切片）与 experience memory（用户事实、交互状态、局部话题链，支持口语化指代与事实纠正恢复）物理隔离，避免检索竞争；知识路线用 FAISS 向量内积 + BM25+（正偏 IDF），经 RRF 融合（k_rrf=60）并加角色/来源偏置；经验路线用归一化余弦相似度加会话/角色偏置。② 双时间排序与时间证据展开：为每块记忆维护绝对物理时间与相对对话轮次两个坐标，衰减项 w_round=exp(-|r_cur-r_d|/λ_round)、w_clock=exp(-Δh/λ_hours)，双时间保留权重为二者乘积（默认 λ_round=20、λ_hours=168 小时），分别乘到两路基础分上（s_kb=s_kb^0·w_temporal^k，s_chat=s_chat^0·w_temporal^c）；检索结果按时间顺序展开，保留原始语义与来源标注，并显式暴露最近一轮日期与相对轮次线索。③ 分析驱动的证据验证：`<analysis>` 被限定为检索后、生成前的受控校验机制（非开放式 CoT），执行三步——判定证据需求类型（知识/经验/混合）、对已进入 Prompt 的父块做语义校验与隐式重排序、将答案绑定到可解释证据来源；机制上与 CoT、self-consistency、ReAct 相关但收敛为证据绑定闭环。④ 白盒原子化写回：每轮将 query、候选父块、生成前分析、最终回复、来源标注以标准化 JSON（chunk_id、session_id、user_input、assistant_reply、source_type、物理时间戳、相对轮次）实时落盘，不做压缩式重写或图结构改写，支持离线回放与归因。实验参数：knowledge_k=5、chat_history_k=10、similarity_threshold=0.5，高噪声实验强制 3+3，其余 5+10；日志规模>1000 个原子记忆块、6 个独立会话段与 9 个消融会话段、主链深度约 180 轮。评估上并联 CSV_RollingAccuracy 与 Manual_RollingAccuracy，后者以 FinalCorrect_i=1 当且仅当 ManualSupport_i=1 且 AnswerCorrect_i=1（要求证据确实入 Prompt 且直接支撑答案），并辅以消融（知识库检索、对话历史检索、双时间排序、混合检索、自动修复/协议收紧、纯对话模式、强一致性预设）与跨模型实验（三维曲线：语气/边界迁移度与过往内容判断准确率；五维人格一致性热力图：语气、职业属性、称谓、任务、感官连续性；`<analysis>` 行为统计：平均长度、合理性分、缺失标签数、修复触发数；匿名化人工盲评 A–E 五级）。

Result: 实验一（50 轮结构化 QA，同一题集两种信噪比）：1:5 下 CSV 自动判分为 27/50（54.0%），人工复核后 50/50（100.0%），23 轮由 0 修正为 1；1:200+ 下自动 22/50（44.0%），人工 40/50（80.0%），18 轮修正，另有 10 轮仍待复核或判 0（支撑文本不直接、父块仅含弱相关线索、无法建立有效证据链）。无任何"1 被改回 0"的反向修正，说明自动规则系统性低估而非标准过松。实验二（消融）：完整系统（A/A2）与强一致性预设（H）均达 100% 严格准确率与 100% 无异常率；禁用对话历史检索降至 66.7%（近期事实恢复与上下文归纳失败）；禁用 BM25 降至 80.0%（纠正节点定位与硬事实追踪不足）；禁用双时间排序未立即导致单轮失败但显著增加 CoT 异常、参照系漂移与近期事实排序失衡；纯对话模式保留流畅度但缺乏可验证的跨轮可回溯性。实验三（跨模型：DeepSeek、GPT-5.5、Claude、Gemini、GLM、Kimi、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B、LongCat-Flash、MiniMAX-M2-Her，共 183 轮，2 次 API 超时作为外部调用异常剔除）：Gemini-3-pro、GPT-5.5、DeepSeek-v4-pro、GLM-5.1、Kimi-K2.6X 保持在较高一致性区间；Qwen2.5-7B 出现断崖式下滑（`<analysis>` 合理性降至 36，5 处缺 analysis、4 处缺 response、4 次修复触发）；Qwen3-8B 回升至 68 但仍有缺标签与修复；LongCat-Flash 平均分析长度 203.6、合理性 91；专用角色模型 MiniMAX-M2-Her 平均长度降至 45.2、合理性仅 24、8 处缺 analysis、9 处缺 response、9 次修复，戏剧化漂移与后续幻觉更严重。早期通用模型阶段合理性多在 82–93，GLM-5.1 与 Kimi-K2.6X 分析长度约 75 字符仍保持 82–83，说明短分析不必然失败。

Conclusion: 论文得出四点结论：(1) 证据利用率——ARPM 的优势不仅体现在自动规则命中率，更体现在 `<analysis>` 驱动的证据校验、隐式重排序与答案绑定能力；(2) 组件功能分化——对话历史检索负责近期连续性，BM25 负责硬事实与纠正节点的精确定位，双时间重排序负责时间组织与参照系稳定，时间证据展开进一步把时间组织能力传递到模型实际阅读环节；(3) 跨模型可迁移性——长期人格一致性不完全绑定单一基础模型权重，外部记忆、时间锚定与生成约束的协同可支撑跨模型迁移；(4) 系统边界可观测——协议合规不足、受污染上下文、参照系漂移与专用角色模型的戏剧化倾向都会损害最终连续性，故通用模型往往比过度角色化的模型更能遵守统一协议与证据约束。作者据此主张：长期人格一致性可被拆解为外部记忆治理、时间排序、证据验证、时间证据展开与白盒审计等工程问题并以白盒方式评估，记忆治理是实现可迁移、稳定长程交互的可行路径。局限与展望：现有高噪声实验以结构化 QA 为主，需扩展到开放式情感对话、任务规划与多跳世界知识；人工复核成本高，需半自动审计工具与更稳定的标注协议；跨模型评估仍混合人工与模型辅助打分，需多标注者双盲与标注一致性统计及跨平台复现；后续将压缩并稳定 `<analysis>` 协议（可借鉴 Self-Refine 类测试时自反馈）以适配小模型，延伸时间跨度与噪声强度，处理记忆晋升、回滚、冲突合并与长期结构化，并优化阅读阶段的时序组织、标注与审计工具及类似工具增强语言模型的外部接口机制。

Abstract: Large language models often suffer from fact loss, timeline confusion, persona drift, and reduced stability during long-range interaction, especially under high-noise knowledge bases, context clearing, and cross-model transfer. To address these issues, we introduce ARPM, an external temporal memory governance framework for long-term dialogue. ARPM separates static knowledge memory from dynamic dialogue experience memory and combines vector retrieval, BM25, RRF fusion, dual-temporal reranking, chronological evidence reading, and a controlled analysis protocol for evidence verification and answer binding. Unlike approaches that encode persona consistency into model weights or rely only on long context, ARPM treats continuity as a traceable, auditable, and transferable governance problem. Using engineering logs, we conduct three experiments. First, in a 50-round question-answering setting, we compare signal-to-noise ratios of 1:5 and 1:200+, and distinguish CSV auto-judgment from manual review. Under 1:5, CSV recall accuracy is 54.0%, while manual review raises it to 100.0%. Under 1:200+, the values are 44.0% and 80.0%. These results show that automatic rules can underestimate recall after supporting evidence enters the prompt. Second, ablation results show that dialogue history retrieval is necessary for recent continuity: disabling it reduces strict accuracy from 100% to 66.7%, and disabling BM25 reduces it to 80.0%, indicating that pure semantic retrieval is insufficient for correction and tracing. Third, under a 5.1-million-character noise substrate, periodic context clearing, and multi-model handoff, ARPM maintains semantic continuity, boundary continuity, and persona consistency, while exposing limits caused by weak protocol compliance. These findings show that long-term persona consistency can be decomposed into governable components and evaluated in a white-box manner.

</details>


### [347] [Interestingness as an Inductive Heuristic for Future Compression Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14831)
*Vincent Herrmann,Jürgen Schmidhuber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究将"有趣性"(interestingness)形式化为预测未来压缩进度的归纳启发式方法，基于Kolmogorov复杂性和算法统计理论证明了其预测能力。关键发现是：未来进步期望与最近突破时间呈指数关系，且算法先验比长度先验更乐观，可获得平方级增长的发现率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The bottleneck in recursively self-improving systems is identifying which tasks or data hold potential for future progress—i.e., determining "interestingness" prospectively rather than retrospectively.

Method: Complexity-runtime profiles analyzed under Length, Algorithmic, and Speed priors, using tools from Kolmogorov Complexity and Algorithmic Statistics.

Result: Expected future progress depends exponentially on recency of last observed breakthrough. Algorithmic Prior yields quadratic increase in expected discovery compared to Length Prior for the same observed profile.

Conclusion: The inductive property of interestingness is both theoretically viable and empirically supported. Algorithmic Prior outperforms Length Prior with quadratic improvement in discovery rates. Findings are validated across three universal computational paradigms.

Abstract: One of the bottlenecks on the way towards recursively self-improving systems is the challenge of interestingness: the ability to prospectively identify which tasks or data hold the potential for future progress. We formalize interestingness as an inductive heuristic for future compression progress and investigate its predictability using tools from Kolmogorov Complexity and Algorithmic Statistics. By analyzing complexity-runtime profiles under Length, Algorithmic, and Speed priors, we demonstrate that the inductive property of interestingness -- the capacity for past progress to signal future discovery -- is theoretically viable and empirically supported. We prove that expected future progress depends exponentially on the recency of the last observed breakthrough. Furthermore, we show that the Algorithmic Prior is significantly more optimistic than the Length Prior, yielding a quadratic increase in expected discovery for the same observed profile. These findings are experimentally confirmed across three diverse universal computational paradigms.

</details>


### [348] [Emotion-Attended Stateful Memory (EASM):The Architecture for Hyper-Personalization at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14833)
*Vineet Kotecha,Vansh Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种情感参与的状态记忆架构，通过长期历史、情感信号和推断意图在推理时动态构建用户特定对话上下文；实验表明该架构在记忆锚定、计划清晰度和情感验证方面均有显著提升，可能成为超个性化AI系统的基础设施层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语言模型系统在跨会话场景下本质上是无状态的，缺乏跨时间持久理解个体用户的能力；现有的检索增强生成和微调方法虽能改进知识获取和领域能力，但无法实现对用户的持续个性化理解。

Method: 在相同底层语言模型条件下，设置记忆增强组与无状态基线组，进行对照A/B测试；对话涵盖六个情绪类别、三十场非脚本对话，包括悲伤、痛苦和不确定性等情绪对抗场景。

Result: 记忆增强组在所有评估场景中一致优于无状态基线；记忆锚定提升95%，计划清晰度提升57%，情感验证提升34%；即使在情绪对抗性对话中结果仍保持一致。

Conclusion: 情感状态记忆可能成为超个性化AI系统的基础设施层，但需要在更大、更多样的评估中进一步验证。

Abstract: Current language model systems remain fundamentally stateless across sessions, limiting their ability to personalize interactions over time. While retrieval-augmented generation and fine-tuning improve knowledge access and domain capability, they do not enable persistent understanding of individual users. We propose an emotion-attended stateful memory architecture that dynamically constructs user-specific conversational context using long-term history, emotional signals, and inferred intent at inference time. To evaluate its impact, we conducted a controlled A/B study across thirty non-scripted conversations spanning six emotionally distinct categories using the same underlying language model in both conditions. The memory-enriched condition consistently outperformed the stateless baseline across all evaluated scenarios. The largest gains were observed in memory grounding (95% improvement), plan clarity (57%), and emotional validation (34%). Results remained consistent even in emotionally adversarial conversations involving grief, distress, and uncertainty. These findings suggest that stateful emotional memory may represent a foundational infrastructure layer for hyper-personalized AI systems, though broader validation across larger and more diverse evaluations remains necessary

</details>


### [349] [Holistic Evaluation and Failure Diagnosis of AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14865)
*Netta Madvil,Gilad Dym,Alon Mecilati,Edo Dekel,Jonatan Liberman,Rotem Brazilay,Liron Schliesser,Max Svidlo,Shai Nir,Orel Shalom,Yaron Friedman,David Connack,Amos Rimon,Philip Tannor,Shir Chorev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种层级化智能体评估框架，通过将自顶向下诊断与自底向上跨距级评估相结合，解决当前评估方法无法解释失败原因和精确定位错误的问题。该方法在TRAIL基准上取得最优性能，证明评估方法本身而非模型能力是当前瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前评估不足：结果指标仅报告成功或失败而无法解释原因，过程级方法难以将失败类型与长结构化轨迹中的精确位置关联。

Method: 提出一种将自顶向下的智能体级诊断与自底向上的跨距级评估相结合的框架，将分析分解为独立的跨距级评估，实现任意长度轨迹的扩展，并生成每个判决的跨距级理由。

Result: 在TRAIL基准上实现SOTA，在GAIA和SWE-Bench上所有指标最优；类别F1相对提升38%，定位准确率提升3.5倍，联合定位-分类准确率提升12.5倍；在更多错误类别上领先。

Conclusion: 相同的前沿模型在框架内比作为整体判断器时准确率高出数倍，表明瓶颈在于评估方法而非模型能力。

Abstract: AI agents execute complex multi-step processes, but current evaluation falls short: outcome metrics report success or failure without explaining why, and process-level approaches struggle to connect failure types to their precise locations within long, structured traces. We present a holistic agent evaluation framework that pairs top-down agent-level diagnosis with bottom-up span-level evaluation, decomposing analysis into independent per-span assessments. This decomposition scales to traces of arbitrary length and produces span-level rationales for each verdict. On the TRAIL benchmark, our framework achieves state-of-the-art results across all metrics on both GAIA and SWE-Bench, with relative gains over the strongest prior baselines of up to 38% on category F1, up to 3.5x on localization accuracy, and up to 12.5x on joint localization-categorization accuracy. Per-category analysis shows our framework leading in more error categories than any other evaluator. Notably, the same frontier model achieves several times higher localization accuracy when used inside our framework than as a monolithic judge over the full trace, showing that evaluation methodology, not model capability, is the bottleneck.

</details>


### [350] [BiFedKD: Bidirectional Federated Knowledge Distillation Framework for Non-IID and Long-Tailed ECG Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14886)
*Zixuan Shu,Tiancheng Cao,Hen-Wei Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对IoMT场景下ECG联邦监测中联邦蒸馏(FedMD)在non-IID与长尾标签分布下性能退化的问题，提出BiFedKD：服务器侧先聚合客户端上传的logits并经温度缩放生成中间软标签，再蒸馏更新一个教师模型，由教师在代理数据集上推理生成全局软目标并下行广播监督客户端学生模型（双向蒸馏）。在MIT-BIH心律失常数据集上，Accuracy/Macro-F1分别提升3.52%/9.93%；达到相同Macro-F1时通信开销降低40%、计算开销降低71.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoMT医疗网络受GDPR/HIPAA等隐私法规限制，无法集中训练ECG模型；联邦学习虽保持原始数据本地化，但频繁传输高维模型参数在带宽受限链路上带来沉重流量。联邦蒸馏(FD)以logit替代参数交换，通信效率更高，但在真实ECG部署中数据高度non-IID且长尾（正常窦性搏动占主导，罕见心律失常类型极少），FedMD直接平均logits会让头部类与多数客户端主导聚合，使服务器软目标偏置，对尾部类乃至缺失类提供极弱监督。此外IoMT上行链路是主要瓶颈且设备算力受限，仅提升精度不足，必须同时量化通信与计算预算。

Method: 系统含1个服务器与K个客户端，服务器与客户端共享公开代理数据集Dp，客户端持有带标签私有数据集Dk。服务器维护教师模型ws，客户端维护学生模型wk。流程：(1) 预热——教师在Dp上以交叉熵训练Es=100轮，学生在Dk上预训练Ek=1轮，得到标签感知初始化；(2) 上行——客户端在Dp上推理得到logits Zk^r∈R^{|Dp|×C}并上传；(3) 服务器聚合——按元素平均得Z^r，再经温度缩放T=3做softmax生成中间软标签矩阵Q^r；(4) 教师蒸馏——教师损失H=λT²F_CE+(1−λ)F_KL(λ=0.3)，联合代理数据真实标签的CE与对Q^r的KL，兼顾标签判别性与吸收客户端知识；(5) 下行——教师在Dp上推理生成全局软目标Q̃^r并广播；(6) 客户端蒸馏——学生用Q̃^r在Dp上蒸馏，再在Dk上做一轮监督re-align以纠正漂移并保持个性化性能。理论分析给出通信开销：每客户端每轮2b|Dp|C比特，全系统2Kb|Dp|C，随|Dp|线性增长；计算开销以FLOPs建模（客户端预训练Ek|Dk|F_k^train；每轮|Dp|F_k^infer+|Dp|F_k^train+|Dk|F_k^train；服务器每轮|Dp|F_s^train+|Dp|F_s^infer+O(K|Dp|C)），并给出R轮总成本。实验：MIT-BIH 48例患者，3客户端各约3000–4000样本（AAMI标准5类，IR 29.82/116.80/无），代理集1000类均衡样本，360点R峰对齐心搏；学生为5层1D-CNN，教师默认1D-CNN Transformer；R=50，Adam，batch 64，lr 2e-4，32位浮点传输。

Result: 与FedMD、FedAvg相比，BiFedKD收敛更快且精度持续更高：约10轮即可达到基线的最佳Accuracy与Macro-F1，25轮内稳定（基线需30轮，FedAvg的Macro-F1需约40轮稳定）。摘要给出Macro-F1提升9.93%、Accuracy提升3.52%；在达到相同Macro-F1前提下通信开销降低40%、计算开销降低71.7%。通信预算收紧时BiFedKD的Macro-F1下降最小、鲁棒性最强，FedAvg最敏感；在0.70/0.75/0.80三个目标Macro-F1下BiFedKD所需计算成本最低、FedMD居中、FedAvg最高且随目标变严增长更快。教师架构对比：CNN Transform精度/Macro-F1最优（94.75%、0.8956，48.11 GFLOPs）；CNN-7计算最高（202.28 GFLOPs）但性能不及CNN Transform（94.44%、0.8828）；CNN-5（94.21%、0.8775，1.04 GFLOPs）与CNN-3（93.81%、0.8764，0.64 GFLOPs）性能仅轻微下降但服务器成本极低，适合实际部署。

Conclusion: BiFedKD通过服务器端教师模型的自上而下监督机制与聚合-蒸馏（aggregation-by-distillation）流水线，解耦了客户端异构性与下发给客户端的监督信号，并借温度缩放抑制过置信聚合与多数类偏置，从而在长尾、non-IID的ECG数据上实现更好的跨客户端知识对齐与类别平衡缓解，同时显著降低通信与计算成本，具备面向资源受限IoMT的可扩展性与部署价值。局限性方面：实验仅基于MIT-BIH三个客户端、单一数据集与特定AAMI五类设定，未验证更多客户端/更多数据集/真实设备链路，代理数据集的选取对通信成本与性能的影响也未深入消融。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring in Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) networks is constrained by strict data-sharing regulations and privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative learning by keeping raw ECG data on devices, but frequent transmissions of high-dimensional model updates incur heavy per-round traffic over bandwidth-limited links. To alleviate this bottleneck, federated distillation (FD) replaces parameter exchange with logit-based knowledge transfer. However, the performance of FD often degrades under the non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) and long-tailed label distributions in ECG deployments. To address these challenges, we propose a bidirectional federated knowledge distillation (BiFedKD) framework that employs an aggregation-by-distillation pipeline with temperature scaling to produce a stable global distillation signal for cross-client alignment. Experiments on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia dataset show that BiFedKD improves accuracy and Macro-F1 over the baseline by $3.52\%$ and $9.93\%$, respectively. Moreover, to reach the same Macro-F1, BiFedKD reduces communication overhead by $40\%$ and computation cost by $71.7\%$ compared with the baseline.

</details>


### [351] [Beyond Individual Intelligence: Surveying Collaboration, Failure Attribution, and Self-Evolution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14892)
*Shihao Qi,Jie Ma,Rui Xing,Wei Guo,Xiao Huang,Zhitao Gao,Jianhao Deng,Jun Liu,Lingling Zhang,Bifan Wei,Boqian Yang,Pinghui Wang,Jianwen Sun,Jing Tao,Yaqiang Wu,Hui Liu,Yu Yao,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This survey introduces the "LIFE progression" framework (Lay capabilities, Integrate agents, Find faults, Evolve) to unify previously fragmented research on LLM-based multi-agent systems, identifying causal dependencies between stages and proposing a closed-loop research agenda for self-improving collective intelligence.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing surveys cover individual agent capabilities, multi-agent collaboration, or agent self-evolution separately, leaving causal dependencies among them unexamined; multi-agent coordination amplifies error propagation risks with limited structural self-improvement approaches.

Method: Unified survey organized around the "LIFE progression" framework with four causally linked stages, providing systematic taxonomies and formally characterizing dependencies between adjacent stages.

Result: Identified open challenges at stage boundaries and revealed how each stage both depends on and constrains the next, bridging previously fragmented research threads in autonomous agent systems.

Conclusion: Proposed a cross-stage research agenda for closed-loop multi-agent systems capable of continuous diagnosis, reorganization, and behavioral refinement; aims to provide a systematic reference and conceptual roadmap toward autonomous, self-improving multi-agent intelligence.

Abstract: LLM-based autonomous agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool use, yet remain limited when tasks require sustained coordination across roles, tools, and environments. Multi-agent systems address this through structured collaboration among specialized agents, but tighter coordination also amplifies a less explored risk: errors can propagate across agents and interaction rounds, producing failures that are difficult to diagnose and rarely translate into structural self-improvement. Existing surveys cover individual agent capabilities, multi-agent collaboration, or agent self-evolution separately, leaving the causal dependencies among them unexamined. This survey provides a unified review organized around four causally linked stages, which we term the LIFE progression: Lay the capability foundation, Integrate agents through collaboration, Find faults through attribution, and Evolve through autonomous self-improvement. For each stage, we provide systematic taxonomies and formally characterize the dependencies between adjacent stages, revealing how each stage both depends on and constrains the next. Beyond synthesizing existing work, we identify open challenges at stage boundaries and propose a cross-stage research agenda for closed-loop multi-agent systems capable of continuously diagnosing failures, reorganizing structures, and refining agent behaviors, extending current coordination frameworks toward more self-organizing forms of collective intelligence. By bridging these previously fragmented research threads, this survey aims to offer both a systematic reference and a conceptual roadmap toward autonomous, self-improving multi-agent intelligence.

</details>


### [352] [COREKG: Coreset-Guided Personalized Summarization of Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14900)
*Sohel Aman Khan,Raghava Mutharaju,Supratim Shit*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COREKG是一种基于coreset理论的个性化知识图谱摘要方法，通过敏感性加权采样为每个用户构建与其查询行为相关的图摘要子集，在大幅缩减图规模的同时保持高查询准确率和结构覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模知识图谱在问答和可视化等任务中变得笨重，需要可行的替代方案。同时，个性化KG摘要对于数据驱动世界至关重要，因为它能基于用户查询模式捕获特定需求，从而减少存储需求和查询运行时间。

Method: 基于coreset理论，采用敏感性加权重要性采样方法。从用户特定查询工作负载出发，计算 triples 的敏感性分数以衡量其重要性，随后使用coreset构建算法采样相关三元组子集。

Result: 在Freebase、WikiData和DBpedia数据集上，COREKG在查询准确率和结构覆盖率方面均优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: COREKG在保持仅一小部分原始图的同时，实现了比GLIMPSE、PPR、iSummary、PEGASUS和APEX²等最先进方法更高的查询准确率和结构覆盖率。

Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are extensively used across different domains and in several applications. Often, these KGs are very large in size. Such KGs become unwieldy for tasks such as question answering and visualization. Summarization of KGs offers a viable alternative in such cases. Furthermore, personalized KG summarization is crucial in the current data-driven world as it captures the specific requirements of users based on their query patterns. Since it only maintains relevant information, the personalized summaries of KG are small, resulting in significantly smaller storage requirements and query runtime. In this work, we adapt the coreset theory to create personalized KG summaries. For a given dataset and a user-specific query workload, we present an approach that samples a relevant subset of triples using sensitivity-based importance sampling. We ensure that the subset approximates the characteristics of the full dataset with bounded approximation error. We define sensitivity scores that measure the importance of a triple with respect to a user's query workload, which are then used by our coreset construction algorithm. We explicitly focus on personalized knowledge graph summarization by constructing summaries independently for each user based on their query behaviour.
  Our evaluation on Freebase, WikiData, and DBpedia shows that COREKG delivers higher query-answering accuracy and structural coverage than the state-of-the-art methods, such as GLIMPSE, PPR, iSummary, PEGASUS and APEX$^2$ while requiring only a tiny fraction of the original graph.

</details>


### [353] [KGPFN: Unlocking the Potential of Knowledge Graph Foundation Model via In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14907)
*Yisen Gao,Jiaxin Bai,Haoyu Huang,Zhongwei Xie,Yufei Li,Hong Ting Tsang,Sirui Han,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KGPFN 把"先验数据拟合网络(PFN)"范式引入知识图谱基础模型：把 KG 上下文拆为"局部上下文"(查询邻域)与"全局上下文"(查询关系的正/负样例)，用关系图消息传递 + 多层 NBFNet 提取可迁移结构表征，再用结合特征级注意力与样本级注意力的 PFN 在推理时做上下文学习，无需参数更新即可适配未见图。在 57 个 KG 上，不微调与微调两种协议下均取得最佳平均 MRR（总平均 0.396 / 0.434），并证明负例上下文与 3 跳局部上下文最关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱基础模型（ULTRA、TRIX、MOTIF、KGICL 等）主要聚焦"关系级通用性"，即学习可跨图迁移的关系结构，但作为基础模型另一支柱的"上下文学习"(ICL)在 KG 推理中基本未被探索。作者指出 KG 的上下文天然是结构化且异质的：准确预测既需要条件于查询实体周围的局部上下文（local context），也需要条件于刻画该关系在众多实例上如何表现的全局上下文（global context）。仅靠可迁移的结构模式无法刻画某关系在特定图中的实例化方式，因此需要在推理时显式条件于关系特异的正负样例。

Method: 1) 关系表征：在关系图 G_r（节点为关系，边按 t2h/h2h/h2t/t2t 四种基本交互类型标注）上做查询条件化的消息传递（ULTRA/TRIX 风格），得到查询条件关系嵌入 R_r。2) 局部上下文：以 (h,r) 为条件运行 6 层 NBFNet（隐藏维 64），头节点用关系嵌入初始化；取前 3 层的头节点状态作为多尺度局部上下文 C_loc（k 跳），第 6 层给出所有候选尾实体表征；通过共享一次图编码完成全部候选打分。3) 尾实体感知打分特征：拼接 TransE 型 (z_h+r−z_t)、DistMult 型 (z_h⊙r⊙z_t)、余弦型三组交互特征 S_tail。4) 全局上下文：检索查询关系的 20 条正例三元组 + 负采样得到的 80 条负例（约 80% 负例来自头的 2 跳邻域作为困难负例），仅使用可见支持边以避免泄漏。5) 特征融合：三个轻量 MLP adapter 分别投影 C_loc、[z_h;r;z_t]、S_tail 并拼接成 x_k。6) PFN 结构（由预训练 TabICL 权重初始化，移除特征预处理模块）：特征级注意力——每条三元组特征序列加 4 个可学习 class token，经带 RoPE 的 Transformer 自注意力，class token 汇聚为样本级表示 u_k；样本级注意力——上下文行标签经线性 target encoder 注入，K/V 仅来自上下文行，候选行只做 cross-attention 并保留残差，使用 TabICL 的 query-aware scalable softmax (QASSMax) 调制以避免注意力熵坍缩；最后两层 MLP 输出分数。7) 数据先验：从训练 KG 采样 support–query episode（基础保留率 ρ∈[0.5,0.9]，关系特定扰动 δ∈[0,0.08]）构造经验任务先验而非合成生成过程。8) 训练目标：BCE 损失（含温度 τ 的自对抗难负例权重）+ softmax 交叉熵损失之和；微调时先训结构编码器 3 epoch，再冻结编码器训 PFN 20 epoch。9) 理论：Lemma 2 给出条件消息传递的有限跳局部性；Proposition 1 证明双线性代理下上下文等价于对有效结构权重的平移修正 A·μ_S，即上下文改变打分当且仅当 c(q)^T A(μ_S1−μ_S2) ≠ 0。10) 推理优化：支持集 KV 缓存与候选分块（chunking），共享图编码摊薄成本。

Result: 57 个 KG（16 直推、18 实体归纳、23 全归纳）上：不微调时 KGPFN 总平均 MRR 0.396 / H@10 0.560，MRR 在三个设定均最佳（全归纳 0.373、归纳 0.460、直推 0.355），H@10 与 FLOCK 并列最佳；相较 ULTRA(0.366)、MOTIF(0.372)、TRIX(0.391)、FLOCK(0.392) 均有提升。微调后总平均 MRR 从 0.396 提升至 0.434、H@10 0.594，各设定 MRR/H@10 均最佳（优于 KGICL 0.419、FLOCK 0.427）；在域差异大的图上收益显著，如 ConceptNet100k 0.116→0.291、AristoV4 0.205→0.342、Hetionet 0.276→0.405、DBpedia100k 0.418→0.462。上下文敏感性：对正例数不敏感（5~20），增加负例（20→80）持续提升 MRR；局部上下文深度以 3 跳最佳，1~2 跳甚至低于无局部上下文变体，超过 3 跳无一致增益。消融显示三种打分特征互补，去掉 TransE 型特征降幅最大（0.396→0.389）。效率上 KGPFN 62.1 ms/query、峰值显存 2.78 GB，与 KGICL (61.8 ms) 延迟相当但显存少约 9 倍，比 FLOCK (491 ms, 50.9 GB) 快约 8 倍，但慢于纯结构打分器 ULTRA/TRIX/MOTIF (0.95~18.7 ms)。可视化案例（CoDEx-Large）中正确候选把注意力集中于正例上下文，错误候选则弥散地关注负例。

Conclusion: KG 基础模型的上下文应分为局部邻域与全局关系实例视角两类；KGPFN 通过关系图消息传递（可迁移关系表征）+ NBFNet 中间层多尺度局部上下文 + PFN（特征级/样本级注意力）在推理时融合正负标注证据，实现了无需参数更新的零样本/上下文适配，并在 57 个图上取得最佳平均 MRR。作者指出局限在于上下文检索与编码带来额外推理开销（未来方向：自适应选择上下文示例、扩展到复杂逻辑查询与时序/多模态 KG），并明确披露使用生成式 AI 辅助写作与代码实现。

Abstract: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models aim to generalize across graphs with unseen entities and relations by learning transferable relational structure. However, most existing methods primarily emphasize relation-level universality, while in-context learning, the other pillar of foundation models remains under-explored for KG reasoning. In KGs, context is inherently structured and heterogeneous: effective prediction requires conditioning on the local context around the query entities as well as the global context that summarizes how a relation behaves across many instances. We propose KGPFN, a KG foundation model using Prior-data Fitted Network that unifies transferable relational regularities with inference-time in-context learning from structured context. KGPFN first learns relation representations via message passing on relation graphs to capture cross-graph relational invariances. For query-specific reasoning, it encodes local neighborhoods using a multi-layer NBFNet as local context. To enable ICL at global scale, it constructs relation-specific global context by retrieving a large set of instances of the query relation together with their local neighborhoods, and aggregates them within a Prior-Data Fitted Network framework that combines feature-level and sample-level attention. Through multi-graph pretraining on diverse KGs, KGPFN learns when to instantiate reusable patterns and when to override them using contextual evidence. Experiments on 57 KG benchmarks demonstrate that KGPFN achieves strong adaptation to previously unseen graphs through in-context learning alone, consistently outperforming competitive fine-tuned KG foundation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/KGPFN.

</details>


### [354] [GraphFlow: An Architecture for Formally Verifiable Visual Workflows Enabling Reliable Agentic AI Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14968)
*Drewry H. Morris,Luis Valles,Reza Hosseini Ghomi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GraphFlow是一个可视化工作流系统，旨在提高关键任务智能AI自动化的可靠性。它通过将工作流图作为可执行规范，结合编译时合约证明检查和运行时持久化执行引擎来解决错误累积问题。初步试点在临床环境中验证了可行性，但完整的正式验证框架仍在开发中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多步骤关键任务流程中，小错误会快速累积——理想独立步骤模型下，十步流程每步90%可靠性仅35%完成率。现有工作流平台缺乏语义正确性保证，而智能体系统在推理时规划，行为对提示词变化敏感且难以审计。

Method: GraphFlow将工作流图作为可执行规范，在编译时为受限类图生成可重用自动化，其合约（前置条件、后置条件、组合义务）可被证明检查。运行时采用持久化引擎记录到仅追加事件日志，在系统边界强制执行合约，支持重放、重试和审计。泳道（Swimlanes）使信任边界显式化，隔离已验证逻辑与外部系统、人类判断和AI决策。

Result: 一年试点横跨三个临床站点，执行8,728个队列入组工作流运行，在无验证核心子系统的早期原型下达到97.08%完成率，观察到的失败主要局限在外部集成环节。

Conclusion: GraphFlow的形式语义和证明验证的准入模型仍在积极开发中，验证核心子系统的评估将留待未来工作。该系统在临床环境中的初步试点证明了其可行性和实用性，但完整的正式验证框架尚未完成。

Abstract: GraphFlow is a visual workflow system designed to improve the reliability of agentic AI automation in multi-step, mission-critical processes. In these workflows, small errors compound rapidly: under an idealized model of independent steps, a ten-step process with 90% per-step reliability completes successfully only 35% of the time. Existing workflow platforms provide durable execution and observability but offer few semantic correctness guarantees, while agentic systems plan at inference time, making behavior sensitive to prompt variation and difficult to audit.
  GraphFlow is designed to address this gap by treating workflow diagrams as the executable specification, a single artifact defining data scope, execution semantics, and monitoring. At compile time, a restricted class of diagrams is specified to produce reusable automations whose contracts (preconditions, postconditions, and composition obligations) are intended to be proof-checked before admission to a shared library. At runtime, a durable engine records outcomes in an append-only event log and can enforce contracts at system boundaries, supporting replay, retries, and audit. Swimlanes make trust boundaries explicit, separating verified logic from external systems, human judgment, and AI decisions.
  A year-long pilot across three clinical sites executed 8,728 cohort-enrolled workflow runs with a 97.08% completion rate under an early prototype without the verified-core subsystem; observed failures were localized primarily to external integrations. The formal semantics and proof-checked admission model described here are specified and under active development. Evaluation of the verified core is reserved for future work.

</details>


### [355] [Explainable Detection of Depression Status Shifts from User Digital Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14995)
*Loris Belcastro,Francesco Gervino,Fabrizio Marozzo,Domenico Talia,Paolo Trunfio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper proposes an explainable framework combining BERT-based multi-dimensional signal extraction with LLM-based reporting to detect and analyze depression-related status shifts in user digital traces. Evaluated on two social media datasets, the approach outperforms direct LLM reporting in temporal coherence and change point detection.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
